184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)
205			return result, err
206		}
207	
208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
209		jobs := make(chan int)
210		workers := s.options.Concurrency
211		if workers > len(targets) {
212			workers = len(targets)
213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return
230							}
231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
233							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)
250				return result, ctx.Err()
251			}
252		}
253		close(jobs)
254		wg.Wait()
255		for _, partial := range projectResults {
256			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
257			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
258		}
259		finalizeResult(&result)
260		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
261			return result, err
262		}
263		return result, nil
264	}

400			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
401			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
402			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
403			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
404			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
405			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
406		}
407	}
408	
409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}
487

18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])

95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}

105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

 	return &cobra.Command{
 		Use:   "doctor",
 		Short: "Check dependencies, paths and runtime backends",
 		Long: `Report what dev can and cannot do on this machine.
 
 Only git is required. Everything else — a multiplexer, a forge CLI — enables
 extra behaviour and degrades cleanly when missing, so a warning here is not a
 problem to fix unless you want that capability.`,
 		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
 			return runDoctor(app)
 		},
 	}

 // Execute runs the CLI and maps errors to exit codes. SilenceErrors and
 // SilenceUsage are set on the root, so nothing reaches the terminal unless it
 // is printed here; ExecuteC hands back the command that failed so a usage
 // mistake can be answered with that command's usage rather than the root's.
 func Execute() int {
 	trace, tracePath, traceErr := traceFromEnvironment()
 	app := &App{
 		In: os.Stdin, Out: os.Stdout, Err: os.Stderr,
 		trace: trace, tracePath: tracePath, traceOnce: &sync.Once{},
 	}
 	if traceErr != nil {
 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: performance trace disabled: %v\n", traceErr)
 	}
 	app.trace.Mark(perftrace.CLIExecuteBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
 	defer app.finishTrace()
 
 	sweepStaleUpgradeArtifacts()
 	finishRoot := app.trace.Start(perftrace.CLIRootBuild, perftrace.Fields{})
 	root := newRootCommand(app)
 	finishRoot(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
 	cmd, err := root.ExecuteC()
 	if err == nil {
 		return 0
 	}
 	style := styleForWriter(os.Stderr, colorModeFromArgs(os.Args[1:]))
 	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, style.danger("dev:")+" "+err.Error())
 	if cmd != nil && wantsUsage(err) {
 		fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, renderCobraHelp(cmd.UsageString(), style))
 	}
 	return 1
 }

 package cli
 
 import (
 	"fmt"
 	"strings"
 
 	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
 )
 
 // familyTLDR holds one ASCII orientation block per command family, keyed by
 // command path. Cobra help answers "what are the flags"; these answer "what is
 // the shape of this workflow", which was previously only documented for the
 // default task loop in workflowTLDR.
 //
 // ASCII only, like workflowTLDR: this text lands in terminals whose encoding
 // dev does not control. assertASCIIDiagram enforces it.
 var familyTLDR = map[string]string{
 	"dev repo": `TL;DR: acquire the checkout, then choose how ready it should be
 
   dev repo new/create --> scaffold --> optional upstream --> cd/open/start
   dev repo clone      --> checkout --> optional setup    --> cd/open/start
   dev repo setup      --> idempotent files/skills/hooks --> review or commit
 
   Local-only is the default. Project-owned executable config must be trusted
   by its exact content hash before dev runs it.`,
 
 	"dev wt": `TL;DR: the checkout is disposable, the branch is not
 
   dev start --mode worktree --> paths.worktree_path/<repo>/<branch>
                                   |
                                   +-- dev wt list       what exists, and how dirty
                                   +-- dev wt open       attach a runtime to one
                                   +-- dev wt provision  re-run installs after a pull
                                   |
   dev done --ff --> MERGED --> dev retire --> checkout gone, branch kept
 
   dev wt rm removes a checkout. It never removes a branch or its commits.`,
 
 	"dev tries": `TL;DR: the experiment keeps its identity after the directory moves
 
   dev try <name> --> a dated scratch directory  (create or open)
                        |
                        +-- dev tries mark       tags and a note
                        +-- dev tries archive    hide it, keep the ID
                        +-- dev tries restore    bring it back into view
                        +-- dev graduate         promote it to a real project
 
   The catalog ID survives archive, restore and graduation. The path does not.`,
 
 	"dev note": `TL;DR: thoughts that outlive the checkout
 
   dev note add <repo> -m "..."  --> Markdown under the state dir  (durable)
                                       |
                                       +-- dev note list / show
                                       +-- dev note search    <- SQLite full text
                                       +-- dev note edit / delete
 
   Markdown is the truth. The search index is disposable: dev note reindex.`,
 
 	"dev fleet": `TL;DR: read other machines without sharing their filesystem
 
   remotes.toml --> dev fleet status   can each host be reached?
                      |
                      +-- dev fleet list    repos, tasks and runtimes per host
                      +-- dev fleet sync    fast-forward clean matching checkouts
                      +-- dev fleet open    Herdr, or an SSH login shell
 
   Every host runs its own dev with its own config and its own paths. A host
   that is unreachable degrades to its cached snapshot; the fleet still answers.`,
 
 	"dev skill": `TL;DR: what the agents on this machine already know
 
-  dev skill list     project and global skills, their agents and update state
-  dev skill add      install one through the external skills provider
-  dev skill update   refresh a skill that provider manages
+  dev skill list        current checkout and global native inventory
+  dev skill list --all  every canonical repository, then global once
+  dev skill add/update  explicit mutation through a direct skills executable
 
   dev's own bundled skill ships inside the binary and updates with dev itself,
   never through the provider.`,
 
+	"dev mcp": `TL;DR: declared capabilities, not live connections
+
+  dev mcp list         current checkout plus user/system declarations
+  dev mcp list --all   every canonical repository, then user/system once
+  dev mcp list --json  sanitized servers, diagnostics and coverage
+
+  Static inventory never starts a server, runs a helper, resolves credentials,
+  or claims that a declaration is connected, healthy or effective.`,
+
 	"dev retire": `TL;DR: integrate, exit, then clean up from outside
 
   dev done --ff --> MERGED   (runtime and worktree deliberately kept)
                       |
     the agent exits,  |  dev prepare arms its transcript to finalize later
     or another shell  v
   dev retire <task> --> close runtime --> remove worktree --> keep the branch
 
   dev retire refuses to run inside the workspace it would delete, and refuses
   a live agent, dirty state, or an unfinalized artifact.`,
 }
 
 // helpTopics links a command family to the quick-reference page behind it.
 // Cobra help documents syntax; `dev help <topic>` documents when and why.
 // Before this map neither one mentioned the other.
 var helpTopics = map[string]string{
 	"dev wt":        "worktrees",
 	"dev repo":      "repositories",
 	"dev note":      "notes",
 	"dev fleet":     "fleet",
 	"dev journal":   "journal",
 	"dev summary":   "summary",
 	"dev retire":    "retirement",
 	"dev artifact":  "retirement",
 	"dev prepare":   "retirement",
 	"dev done":      "retirement",
 	"dev bootstrap": "bootstrap",
 	"dev adopt":     "adopting",
 	"dev park":      "parking",
 	"dev resume":    "parking",
 	"dev cache":     "storage",
 	"dev config":    "storage",
 	"dev tui":       "tui",
 	"dev start":     "branching",
 	"dev tries":     "tries",
 	"dev try":       "tries",
 	"dev skill":     "skills",
+	"dev mcp":       "mcp",
 	"dev status":    "git-status",
 }
 
 // topicForCommand resolves a bare command name or alias to its help topic, so
 // `dev help wt` reaches the worktrees page instead of failing a filename match.
 func topicForCommand(name string) (string, bool) {
 	topic, ok := helpTopics["dev "+name]
 	return topic, ok
 }
 
 // annotateHelp attaches the family diagram and the topic cross-reference to
 // each command's Long text. Doing it in one pass over the assembled tree keeps
 // the pointers from drifting out of sync with the map above.
 func annotateHelp(cmd *cobra.Command) {
 	for _, child := range cmd.Commands() {
 		annotateHelp(child)
 	}
 	path := cmd.CommandPath()
 	long := cmd.Long
 	if long == "" {
 		long = cmd.Short
 	}
 	if diagram, ok := familyTLDR[path]; ok {
 		long = strings.TrimRight(long, "\n") + "\n\n" + diagram
 	}
 	if topic, ok := helpTopics[path]; ok {
 		long = strings.TrimRight(long, "\n") + fmt.Sprintf("\n\nSee also: dev help %s", topic)
 	}
 	if long != cmd.Long {
 		cmd.Long = long
 	}
 }

 // Package perftrace records opt-in, process-local performance diagnostics.
 // Events deliberately carry only fixed categorical fields and relative times:
 // repository names, paths, commands, keys, URLs and raw errors never enter the
 // trace schema.
 package perftrace
 
 import (
 	"encoding/json"
 	"errors"
 	"fmt"
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
 	"sync"
 	"time"
 )
 
 const (
 	// SchemaVersion is the on-disk trace format.
 	SchemaVersion = 1
 	// DefaultLimit bounds memory use when a dashboard is refreshed repeatedly.
 	DefaultLimit = 4096
 )
 
 // Name identifies one stable trace boundary.
 type Name string
 
 const (
 	CLIExecuteBegin         Name = "cli.execute_begin"
 	CLIRootBuild            Name = "cli.root_build"
 	AppLoad                 Name = "app.load"
 	TUISetup                Name = "tui.setup"
 	TUIRuntimeResolve       Name = "tui.runtime_resolve"
 	TUIRuntimeList          Name = "tui.runtime_list"
 	TUIProjectRootResolve   Name = "tui.project_root_resolve"
 	TUICacheRemoteRead      Name = "tui.cache.remote_read"
 	TUICacheFleetRead       Name = "tui.cache.fleet_read"
 	TUIProgramRunBegin      Name = "tui.program_run_begin"
 	TUIInitialViewReturned  Name = "tui.initial_view_returned"
 	TUIFirstKeyReceived     Name = "tui.first_key_received"
 	TUIKeyUpdate            Name = "tui.key_update"
 	TUIProducerTasks        Name = "tui.producer.tasks"
 	TUIProducerRepos        Name = "tui.producer.repos"
 	TUIProducerTries        Name = "tui.producer.tries"
 	TUIProducerRemote       Name = "tui.producer.remote"
 	TUIProducerFleet        Name = "tui.producer.fleet"
 	TUIProducerSkills       Name = "tui.producer.skills"
+	TUIProducerMCP          Name = "tui.producer.mcp"
 	TUIProducerTools        Name = "tui.producer.tools"
 	TUIViewLoadRequested    Name = "tui.view.load_requested"
 	TUIViewSnapshotAccepted Name = "tui.view.snapshot_accepted"
 	TUIViewLoadFinished     Name = "tui.view.load_finished"
 	TUIViewResultDiscarded  Name = "tui.view.result_discarded"
 )
 
 // View is a fixed dashboard view name.
 type View string
 
 const (
 	ViewTasks  View = "tasks"
 	ViewRepos  View = "repos"
 	ViewFleet  View = "fleet"
 	ViewTries  View = "try"
 	ViewRemote View = "remote"
 	ViewSkills View = "skills"
+	ViewMCP    View = "mcp"
 )
 
 // Stage is a categorical lifecycle stage.
 type Stage string
 
 const (
 	StageRequested        Stage = "requested"
 	StageCacheAccepted    Stage = "cache_accepted"
 	StageSnapshotAccepted Stage = "snapshot_accepted"
 	StageFirstEnrichment  Stage = "first_enrichment"
 	StageFinished         Stage = "finished"
 	StageDiscarded        Stage = "discarded"
 )
 
 // Source identifies where a result came from.
 type Source string
 
 const (
 	SourceCache Source = "cache"
 	SourceLive  Source = "live"
 )
 
 // Freshness classifies a usable snapshot without making it authoritative.
 type Freshness string
 
 const (
 	FreshnessFresh Freshness = "fresh"
 	FreshnessStale Freshness = "stale"
 )
 
 // Outcome is a fixed terminal result class. Raw errors are intentionally absent.
 type Outcome string
 
 const (
 	OutcomeSuccess    Outcome = "success"
 	OutcomePartial    Outcome = "partial"
 	OutcomeFailed     Outcome = "failed"
 	OutcomeCanceled   Outcome = "canceled"
 	OutcomeSuperseded Outcome = "superseded"
 )
 
 // Fields are the optional categorical dimensions accepted by a trace event.
 type Fields struct {
 	View       View
 	Stage      Stage
 	Source     Source
 	Freshness  Freshness
 	Outcome    Outcome
 	Generation uint64
 	Rows       *int
 }
 
 // Event is one immutable entry in the versioned trace.
 type Event struct {
 	Sequence   uint64    `json:"sequence"`
 	AtMicros   int64     `json:"at_us"`

 func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
 	value := func(key string) string {
 		for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
 			if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
 				return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
 			}
 		}
 		return ""
 	}
 	if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
 		row := m.overlay.repoTarget
 		tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
 		note := value("note")
 		m.overlay = overlayState{}
 		m.err = nil
 		m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
 		return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
 	}
 
 	request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
 	switch m.overlay.action {
 	case TryCreate:
 		request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
 		if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
 			m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
 			return m, nil
 		}
 		gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
 		if !ok {
 			m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
 			return m, nil
 		}
 		request.NoGit = !gitInit
 	case TryMark:
 		request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
 		request.Note = value("note")
 	case TryRestore:
 		request.To = value("to")
 	case TryGraduate:
 		request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
 	case TryArchive:
 		if value("confirm") != "YES" {
 			m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
 			return m, nil
 		}
 	default:
 		m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
 		return m, nil
 	}
 	m.overlay = overlayState{}
 	m.err = nil
 	m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
 	return m, m.applyTry(request)
 }

2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"

18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}

226	type Filter struct {

228		Scope          Scope
229		Source         DeclarationSource

237	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
238	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
239		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
240			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
241			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
242			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
243			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
244			return false
245		}
246		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
247			return false
248		}
249		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
250			return false
251		}
252		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
253			return false
254		}
255		return true
256	}
257	
258	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
259	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
260		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
261		for _, row := range rows {
262			if f.Match(row) {
263				out = append(out, row)
264			}
265		}
266		return out
267	}
268	
269	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
270	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
271		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
272			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
273			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
274			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
275			for n := range ak {
276				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
277					return ak[n] < bk[n]
278				}
279			}
280			return false
281		})
282	}
283	
284	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
285		switch scope {
286		case ScopeProject:
287			return "0-project"
288		case ScopeLocal:
289			return "1-local"
290		case ScopeUser:
291			return "2-user"
292		case ScopeCustom:
293			return "3-custom"
294		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
295			return "4-system-defaults"
296		case ScopeSystemOverride:
297			return "5-system-override"
298		case ScopeManaged:
299			return "6-managed"
300		default:
301			return "9-" + string(scope)
302		}
303	}

305	func diagnosticMessage(code DiagnosticCode) string {
306		switch code {
307		case DiagnosticUnreadable:
308			return "configuration file could not be read"
309		case DiagnosticTooLarge:
310			return "configuration file exceeds the scan size limit"
311		case DiagnosticNotRegular:
312			return "configuration source is not a regular file"
313		case DiagnosticSymlinkLimit:
314			return "configuration symlink chain exceeds the scan limit"
315		case DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape:
316			return "project configuration resolves outside the checkout"
317		case DiagnosticMalformed:
318			return "configuration file could not be decoded"
319		case DiagnosticControlCharacter:
320			return "configuration contains an unsupported control character"
321		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
322			return "server declaration has an invalid field"
323		case DiagnosticInvalidName:
324			return "server declaration has an invalid name"
325		case DiagnosticUnknownTransport:
326			return "server transport cannot be determined statically"
327		case DiagnosticConflictingTransport:
328			return "server declaration contains conflicting transport fields"
329		case DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint:
330			return "server endpoint could not be represented safely"
331		case DiagnosticInvalidReference:
332			return "credential reference name is invalid"
333		case DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent:
334			return "plugin override does not include the plugin server definition"
335		case DiagnosticTransportPrecedence:
336			return "lower-precedence transport fields were ignored"
337		default:
338			return "configuration could not be fully represented"
339		}
340	}

342	func coverage(code DiagnosticCode) CoverageDiagnostic {

171	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
172	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
173		options = normalizeOptions(options)
174		s := &Scanner{options: options}
175		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk

179	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
180	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
181		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
182	}
183	
184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)
205			return result, err
206		}
207	
208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
209		jobs := make(chan int)
210		workers := s.options.Concurrency
211		if workers > len(targets) {
212			workers = len(targets)
213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return
230							}
231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
233							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)
250				return result, ctx.Err()
251			}
252		}
253		close(jobs)
254		wg.Wait()
255		for _, partial := range projectResults {
256			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
257			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
258		}
259		finalizeResult(&result)
260		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
261			return result, err
262		}
263		return result, nil
264	}

409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}

16	var errSymlinkLimit = errors.New("symlink limit reached")
17	
18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
91			}
92			if readErr != nil {
93				if !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
94					return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}
104	
105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

21	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
22	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
23	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
24	type MutationProvider struct {
25		Available bool
26		Command   string
27		Path      string
28		Detail    string
29	}
30	
31	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
32	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
33	// or project code.
34	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
35		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
36	}
37	
38	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
39	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
40	// mutates it.
41	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
42		if path, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
43			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
44				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
45			}
46			return MutationProvider{Path: path, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside a repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
47		}
48		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
49			return MutationProvider{
50				Path:   path,
51				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
52			}
53		}
54		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
55	}

57	func trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot string) (string, bool) {
58		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
59			return "", false
60		}
61		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
62		if pathUsesNodeModulesBin(clean) || projectRoot != "" && lexicalPathInside(projectRoot, clean) {
63			return "", false
64		}
65		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(clean)
66		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) || pathUsesNodeModulesBin(resolved) {
67			return "", false
68		}
69		resolved = filepath.Clean(resolved)
70		if projectRoot != "" {
71			inside, err := pathx.Contains(projectRoot, resolved)
72			if err != nil || inside {
73				return "", false
74			}
75		}
76		return resolved, true
77	}

79	func pathUsesNodeModulesBin(path string) bool {
80		parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(path), "/")
81		for index := 0; index+1 < len(parts); index++ {
82			if parts[index] == "node_modules" && parts[index+1] == ".bin" {
83				return true
84			}
85		}
86		return false

103	func canonicalMutationRoot(root string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
104		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
105		if err != nil {
106			return "", err
107		}
108		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
109		if err != nil {
110			if allowMissing && os.IsNotExist(err) {
111				return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil

113			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve skill mutation root: %w", err)

122	func lexicalPathInside(root, candidate string) bool {
123		root, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
124		candidate, candidateErr := filepath.Abs(candidate)
125		if rootErr != nil || candidateErr != nil {
126			return false
127		}
128		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(root), filepath.Clean(candidate))
129		return err == nil && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != ".." &&
130			!strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
131	}

141	// AddCommand opens the upstream interactive installer in projectRoot.

160	// InstallCommand installs an explicit set of skills for explicit agents in
161	// project scope. The caller owns confirmation; --yes only suppresses the
162	// provider's duplicate prompt after that decision.
163	func InstallCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string, names, agents []string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
164		if source == "" {
165			source = DefaultSource
166		}
167		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
168			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
169		}
170		if len(names) == 0 {
171			return nil, errors.New("at least one skill is required")
172		}
173		for _, name := range names {
174			if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
175				return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
176			}
177		}
178		if len(agents) == 0 {
179			return nil, errors.New("at least one agent is required")
180		}
181		for _, agent := range agents {
182			if !safeProviderArgument(agent) {
183				return nil, errors.New("agent name is not safe to pass to the provider")
184			}
185		}
186		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		args := []string{"add", source, "--skill"}
191		args = append(args, names...)
192		args = append(args, "--agent")
193		args = append(args, agents...)
194		args = append(args, "--yes")
195		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(ProjectRoot(ctx, projectRoot), true)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil

202	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
203	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {

206		}

209		}

211			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
212		}

215			return nil, err
216		}

218		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
219			args = append(args, "--global")
220		} else {
221			args = append(args, "--project")
222		}
223		args = append(args, name)
224		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
229	}

231	// ProviderVersion reports a directly installed skills executable. It never
232	// falls back to npx, even with --no-install, because version probes are reads.
233	func ProviderVersion(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (string, error) {
234		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(cwd)
235		if !status.Available {

237		}

241		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
242		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
243			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
244			if detail == "" {
245				detail = err.Error()
246			}
247			return "", fmt.Errorf("skills: %s", detail)
248		}
249		return "skills " + strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
250	}

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}
180	
181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {
182		switch base {
183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:
186			return home, ""
187		case baseConfigHome:
188			if value := absoluteEnvironment("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"); value != "" {
189				return value, "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
190			}
191			if home == "" {
192				return "", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
193			}
194			return filepath.Join(home, ".config"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
195		case baseCodexHome:
196			return environmentBase("CODEX_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".codex")), "CODEX_HOME"
197		case baseClaudeHome:
198			return environmentBase("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", filepath.Join(home, ".claude")), "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
199		case baseVibeHome:
200			return environmentBase("VIBE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".vibe")), "VIBE_HOME"
201		case baseHermesHome:
202			return environmentBase("HERMES_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".hermes")), "HERMES_HOME"
203		case baseAutohandHome:
204			return environmentBase("AUTOHAND_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".autohand")), "AUTOHAND_HOME"
205		case baseGrokHome:
206			return environmentBase("GROK_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".grok")), "GROK_HOME"
207		case baseOpenClawHome:
208			if home == "" {
209				return "", ""
210			}
211			for _, candidate := range []string{".openclaw", ".clawdbot", ".moltbot"} {
212				path := filepath.Join(home, candidate)
213				if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
214					return path, ""
215				}
216			}
217			return filepath.Join(home, ".openclaw"), ""
218		default:
219			return home, ""
220		}
221	}
222	
223	func environmentBase(name, fallback string) string {
224		if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); filepath.IsAbs(value) {
225			return filepath.Clean(value)
226		}
227		if filepath.IsAbs(fallback) {
228			return fallback
229		}
230		return ""
231	}
232	
233	func absoluteEnvironment(name string) string {
234		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
235		if filepath.IsAbs(value) {
236			return filepath.Clean(value)
237		}
238		return ""
239	}

60	func projectScanLocations(root string, definitions []AgentDefinition, document lockDocument) []physicalScanLocation {
61		logical := make([]logicalScanLocation, 0, len(definitions))
62		for _, definition := range definitions {
63			if definition.ProjectSkillsDir == "" {
64				continue
65			}
66			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
67				Path: filepath.Join(root, definition.ProjectSkillsDir), AgentIDs: []string{definition.ID},
68			})
69		}
70		subagents := map[string]bool{}
71		for _, entry := range document.Entries {
72			for _, subagent := range entry.Subagents {
73				if safePathComponent(subagent) {
74					subagents[subagent] = true
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		subagentRoot := filepath.Join(root, "agent", "subagents")
79		if entries, err := os.ReadDir(subagentRoot); err == nil {
80			for _, entry := range entries {
81				if !safePathComponent(entry.Name()) {
82					continue
83				}
84				if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(subagentRoot, entry.Name())); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
85					subagents[entry.Name()] = true
86				}
87			}
88		}

124	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
125	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
126	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
127	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
128		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
129		for _, location := range input {
130			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
131			current := byLogical[path]
132			if current == nil {
133				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
134				byLogical[path] = &copy
135				current = &copy
136			}
137			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
138		}
139		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
140		for path := range byLogical {
141			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
142		}
143		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
144	
145		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
146		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
147			logical := *byLogical[path]
148			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)
149			physical := path
150			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
151				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
152			}
153			group := byPhysical[physical]
154			if group == nil {
155				group = &physicalScanLocation{Path: physical}
156				byPhysical[physical] = group
157			}
158			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
159		}
160		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
161		for path := range byPhysical {
162			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
163		}
164		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
165		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
166		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
167			group := byPhysical[path]
168			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
169			result = append(result, *group)
170		}
171		return result
172	}

337	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
338		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
339		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340			return "", false, nil
341		}
342		if err != nil {
343			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not inspect SKILL.md: %w", err)
344		}
345		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
346			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
347		}
348		file, err := os.Open(filename)
349		if err != nil {
350			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
351		}
352		defer file.Close()
353		if openedInfo, err := file.Stat(); err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
354			return "", true, errors.New("opened SKILL.md is not a regular file")
355		}
356	
357		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
358		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
359		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
360		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
361		consumed := int64(len(first))
362		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
363			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
364		}
365		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
366		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
367			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
368		}
369		var frontmatter strings.Builder
370		closed := false
371		for {
372			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
373			consumed += int64(len(line))
374			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
375				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376			}
377			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
378				closed = true
379				break
380			}
381			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
382			if lineErr != nil {
383				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
384					break
385				}
386				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
387			}
388		}
389		if !closed {
390			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
391		}
392		var metadata struct {
393			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
394			Description string `yaml:"description"`
395		}
396		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
397			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
398		}
399		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
400		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
401		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
402			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
403		}
404		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
405			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
406		}
407		return metadata.Name, true, nil
408	}

410	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
411		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))

415			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)

418		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
419			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
420				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
421			}
422			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
423		})
424		var agents []string
425		for _, installation := range installations {

427		}

432			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
433			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
434			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
435			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
436			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,

439		if len(installations) > 0 {

444				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
445				row.Source = "dev binary"
446				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
447				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
448			} else {

455			row.Lock = &copy
456			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills

458			row.UpdateDetail = ""
459			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)

463		if len(candidates) > 1 {
464			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
465		}
466		return row

497	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
498		files, err := skill.Files()
499		if err != nil {
500			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
501			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
502			return
503		}
504		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
505		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
506		for index := range row.Installations {
507			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
508			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
509			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
510			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
511				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
512				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
513			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
514				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
515				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
516			}
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
521		for relative, want := range files {
522			got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
523			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
524				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
525			}
526		}
527		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
528	}
529	
530	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
531	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
532	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
533		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
534			return UpdateCurrent, detail
535		}
536		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
537			return UpdateAvailable, detail
538		}
539		return UpdateFailed, detail
540	}

542	func sourceDisplay(value string) string {
543		if value == "" {
544			return ""
545		}
546		if !safeDisplayValue(value) {
547			return "[redacted]"
548		}
549		value = repo.RedactCloneRef(value)
550		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
551		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
552			parsed.User = nil
553			parsed.RawQuery = ""
554			parsed.ForceQuery = false
555			parsed.Fragment = ""
556			return parsed.String()
557		}
558		return value
559	}
560	
561	func safeSourceType(value string) string {
562		if value == "" || safeDisplayValue(value) {
563			return value
564		}
565		return "[redacted]"
566	}

572	func decorateDiagnostics(input []Diagnostic, target agenttarget.Target) []Diagnostic {
573		result := make([]Diagnostic, len(input))
574		for index, diagnostic := range input {
575			result[index] = decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic, target)
576		}

583		diagnostic.Checkout = target.CheckoutRoot

254			return "", err
255		}
256		if ref != "" {
257			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", "origin", ref); err != nil {
258				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
259				return "", err
260			}
261			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
262				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
263				return "", err
264			}
265		}
266		return dir, nil
267	}
268	
269	func safeFetchRef(ref string) bool {
270		if ref == "" {
271			return true
272		}
273		if strings.TrimSpace(ref) != ref || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "-") {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !strings.ContainsFunc(ref, func(r rune) bool {
277			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
278		})
279	}
280	
281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""
283		computed := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ComputedHash)
284		folder := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.SkillFolderHash)
285		content := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ContentHash)
286	
287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {
288			switch {
289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {
301				return
302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"
310			return
311		}
312		// Scope-less package tests and older callers may still supply either global
313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func validHexHash(value string, length int) bool {
323		if len(value) != length {
324			return false
325		}
326		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
327		return err == nil
328	}
329	
330	func checkOneResult(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
331		entry := skillLock(row)
332		if entry == nil {
333			return UpdateUnknown, "skill has no lock metadata"
334		}
335		folder, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath)
336		if !ok {
337			return UpdateUnknown, "invalid skill path in lock entry"
338		}
339		abs := filepath.Join(repoDir, filepath.FromSlash(folder))
340		info, err := os.Stat(abs)
341		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
342			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
343				return UpdateMissing, "skill path no longer exists upstream"
344			}
345			return UpdateFailed, "could not inspect upstream skill path"
346		}
347		if !insidePath(repoDir, abs) {
348			return UpdateUnknown, "skill path escapes the fetched source"
349		}
350	
351		expected, kind := entry.RecordedHash, entry.HashKind
352		if expected == "" {
353			copy := *entry
354			normalizeRecordedHash(&copy)
355			expected, kind = copy.RecordedHash, copy.HashKind
356		}
357		var actual string
358		var hashErr error
359		switch kind {
360		case "git-tree":
361			spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
362			if folder != "" {
363				spec = "HEAD:" + folder
364			}
365			actual, hashErr = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
366		case "sha256-folder":
367			actual, hashErr = folderHashContext(ctx, abs)
368		case "sha256-skill-file":
369			actual, hashErr = fileHashContext(ctx, filepath.Join(abs, "SKILL.md"))
370		}
371		if hashErr != nil {
372			if ctx.Err() != nil {
373				return UpdateFailed, "update check canceled"
374			}
375			return UpdateFailed, "could not compute upstream content hash"
376		}
377		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
378			return UpdateUnknown, "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
379		}
380		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
381			return UpdateCurrent, "matches the recorded upstream content"
382		}
383		return UpdateAvailable, "upstream content changed"
384	}
385	
386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}
411	
412	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
413		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
414	}
415	
416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

57	func readLockDocument(filename string, scope Scope, minimumVersion, maximumVersion int) lockDocument {
58		document := lockDocument{Path: filename, Scope: scope, Entries: map[string]LockMetadata{}}
59		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
60		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

63		if err != nil {

65				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect lock file: %v", err)))
66			return document
67		}
68		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
69			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
70				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, "lock path is not a regular file"))
71			return document
72		}
73		if info.Size() > maxLockBytes {
74			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
75				DiagnosticLockOversized, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("lock file exceeds %d bytes", maxLockBytes)))
76			return document
77		}
78		file, err := os.Open(filename)
79		if err != nil {
80			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
81				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not read lock file: %v", err)))
82			return document
83		}
84		defer file.Close()
85		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
86		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
87			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
88				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, "opened lock is not a regular file"))
89			return document
90		}
91		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxLockBytes+1))
92		if err != nil {
93			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
94				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not read lock file: %v", err)))
95			return document
96		}
97		if int64(len(data)) > maxLockBytes {
98			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
99				DiagnosticLockOversized, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("lock file exceeds %d bytes", maxLockBytes)))
100			return document
101		}

103		var raw rawLockFile
