1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}
293

190	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
191		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
192		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
193			return "", err
194		}
195		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
198		}
199		return destination, nil
200	}

514					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
515				}
516				if opened.Directory != "" {
517					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
518				} else {
519					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
520				}
521				return opened, dest, nil
522			},
523	
524			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
525				active := appState.Current()
526				current, err := active.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
527				if err != nil {
528					return "", err
529				}
530				updated := *current
531				if next != "" {
532					updated.Next = next
533				}
534				runtimeForTask(active, &updated) // normalize empty handle/name provenance
535				if updated.RuntimeHandle != "" {
536					if _, _, err := closeTaskRuntime(ctx, active, &updated, checkoutOf(&updated)); err != nil {
537						return "", err
538					}
539				}
540				// The dashboard only parks warm: going cold removes a checkout,
541				// which is too consequential for a single keystroke.
542				updated.State, updated.Owner = task.Warm, config.Hostname()
543				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
544					return "", err
545				}
546				return updated.Title() + " parked warm — worktree and branch kept", nil
547			},
548	
549			SetNext: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) error {
550				active := appState.Current()
551				current, err := active.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
552				if err != nil {
553					return err
554				}
555				updated := *current
556				updated.Next = next
557				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
558					return err
559				}
560				annotate(active, runtimeForTask(active, &updated), &updated)
561				return nil
562			},

564			// Start is the bridge from "here are my repositories" to "here is what
565			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the
566			// dashboard to type a command.
567			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
570				if err != nil {
571					return "", err
572				}
573				actionApp := *active
574				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
575				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
576					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
577				})
578				if err != nil {
579					return "", err
580				}
581				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
582				if err != nil {
583					return "", err
584				}
585				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil
586			},
587	
588			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
589				active := appState.Current()
590				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
591				if err != nil {
592					return "", err
593				}
594				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
595					return "", err
596				}
597				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
598				if err != nil {
599					return "", err
600				}
601				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
602					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
603				}
604				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
605				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
606					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
607				}
608				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
609				if err != nil {
610					return "", err
611				}
612				t := &task.Task{
613					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
614					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
615					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
616				}
617				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
618				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
619					return "", err
620				}
621				annotate(active, rt, t)
622				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
623			},
624	
625			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
626				active := appState.Current()
627				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
628				if err != nil {
629					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
630				}
631				defer store.Close()
632				until := time.Now()
633				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
634				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
635					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
636				})
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
639				}
640				seconds, days := 0, 0
641				for _, value := range totals {
642					seconds += value
643					if value > 0 {
644						days++
645					}
646				}
647				return tui.StatsPanel{
648					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
649					Since: since, Until: until,
650					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
651						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
652					}),
653				}, nil
654			},
655	
656			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
657				active := appState.Current()
658				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, active.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoName)
659				if err != nil {
660					return err
661				}
662				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
663				if err != nil {
664					return err
665				}
666				defer store.Close()
667				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
668				return err
669			},

673				return proc, err

678			},

681			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
682			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.

688			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
689				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
690				if err != nil {
691					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
692				}
693				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
694				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
695				if err != nil {
696					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
697				}
698				status := "config + data reloaded"
699				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
700					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
701				}
702				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
703					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
704					Tools:       externalTools(next),
705					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
706					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
707					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
708				}, status, nil
709			},
710		}
711	
712		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
713		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
714		// while dozens of repos are probed.
715		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
716		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
717		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
718		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
719		cancelRun()
720		app.finishTrace()
721		if err != nil {
722			return err
723		}
724		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
725		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
726		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
727			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
728				return app.cdDirective(dir)
729			}
730			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
731				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
732				if resolveErr != nil {
733					return resolveErr
734				}
735				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
736			}
737		}
738		return nil
739	}

741	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
742		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
743		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
744	}
745	
746	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
747		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
748		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
749		if err != nil {
750			return nil, err
751		}
752		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
753		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
754		if !sessionsSet {
755			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
756		}
757		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
758		for _, item := range items {
759			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
760			if item.Entry != nil {
761				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
762					copy := location
763					row.Location = &copy
764				}
765			}
766			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
767			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
768				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
769					sizeRepo = &discovered
770				}
771			}
772			if sizeRepo != nil {
773				worktreeCount := 0
774				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
775					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
776				}
777				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
778			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
779				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
780			}
781			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
782				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
783			}
784			if item.Live.Present {
785				for _, session := range sessions {
786					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
787						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
788						row.Live = true
789						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
790						break
791					}
792				}
793			}
794			rows = append(rows, row)
795		}
796		return rows, listErr
797	}
798	
799	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
800		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
801		if err != nil {
802			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
803		}
804		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
805			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
806				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
807				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
808			})
809			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
810			return item, resolveErr
811		}
812		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
813			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
814				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
815			}
816			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
817			if openErr != nil {
818				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
819			}
820			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
821			if rt.Name() == "none" {
822				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
823			} else {
824				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
825				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
826			}
827			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
828				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
829			}
830			return result, nil
831		}
832	
833		switch request.Action {
834		case tui.TryOpen:
835			item, resolveErr := resolve()
836			if resolveErr != nil {
837				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
838			}
839			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
840	
841		case tui.TryCreate:
842			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
843				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
844			})
845			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
846			if created.InitWarning != nil {
847				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
848			}
849			if createErr != nil {
850				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
851			}
852			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
853			if created.Existing {
854				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
855			}
856			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
857			result.RefreshRepos = true
858			return result, openErr
859	
860		case tui.TryMark:
861			item, resolveErr := resolve()
862			if resolveErr != nil {
863				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
864			}
865			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
866			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
867			note := request.Note
868			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
869				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
870			})
871			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
872			return tui.TryActionResult{
873				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
874			}, patchErr
875	
876		case tui.TryDeprecate:
877			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
878			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
879			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
880	
881		case tui.TryReactivate:
882			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
883			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
884			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
885	
886		case tui.TryArchive:
887			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
888			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
889			return tui.TryActionResult{
890				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
891			}, transitionErr
892	
893		case tui.TryRestore:
894			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
895			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
896			return tui.TryActionResult{
897				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
898			}, transitionErr
899	
900		case tui.TryGraduate:
901			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
902				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
903			})
904			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
905			if graduateErr != nil {
906				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
907			}
908			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
909			result.RefreshRepos = true
910			return result, openErr
911		}
912		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
913	}
914	
915	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
916	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
917	type repoCollectOptions struct {
918		IncludeTries bool
919		Sessions     []runtime.Session
920		SessionsSet  bool
921		Tasks        []*task.Task
922		TasksSet     bool
923		Repos        []repo.Repo
924		ReposSet     bool
925		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
926	}
927	
928	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
929	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
930	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
931		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
932	}
933	
934	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
935		repos := options.Repos
936		var err error
937		if !options.ReposSet {
938			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
939			if err != nil {
940				return nil, err
941			}
942		}
943		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
944		if err != nil {
945			return nil, err
946		}
947		if !options.IncludeTries {
948			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
949			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
950			for index, repository := range repos {
951				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
952					continue
953				}
954				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
955				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
956			}
957			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
958		}
959		tasks := options.Tasks
960		if !options.TasksSet {
961			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
962			if err != nil {
963				return nil, err
964			}
965		}
966		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
967		for _, t := range tasks {
968			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
969		}
970		sessions := options.Sessions
971		if !options.SessionsSet {
972			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
973		}
974		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
975		if app.Notes != nil {
976			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
977			if noteErr != nil {
978				return nil, noteErr
979			}
980			for _, n := range allNotes {
981				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
982			}
983		}
984	
985		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
986		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
987		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
988		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
989		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
990		limiter := options.Limiter
991		if limiter == nil {
992			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
993		}
994		var wg sync.WaitGroup
995		for i, r := range repos {
996			wg.Add(1)
997			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
998				defer wg.Done()
999				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1000				if !ok {
1001					return
1002				}
1003				defer release()
1004	
1005				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1006				if row.Asset != nil {
1007					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1008					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1009					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1010						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1011					}
1012				}
1013				if r.HasGit {
1014					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1015				}
1016				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1017				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1018					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1019				}
1020				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1021				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1022				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1023				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1024					row.Status = main.Status
1025				}
1026				if !r.Bare {
1027					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1028				}
1029				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1030					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1031					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1032				}
1033				if r.HasGit {
1034					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1035						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1036						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1037					}, row.Worktrees)
1038				} else {
1039					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1040				}
1041				out[i] = row
1042			}(i, r)
1043		}
1044		wg.Wait()
1045		return out, ctx.Err()
1046	}
1047	
1048	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1049	//
1050	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1051	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1052	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1053	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1054		var out []tui.Tool
1055		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1056			run := t.Run
1057			name := t.Name
1058			if name == "" {
1059				name = firstWord(run)
1060			}
1061			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1062			if t.Interactive {
1063				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1064				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1065				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1066				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1067				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1068			}
1069			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1070				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1071				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1072			})
1073		}
1074		return out
1075	}
1076	
1077	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1078	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1079	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1080	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1081		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1082	}
1083	
1084	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1085		if ctx == nil {
1086			ctx = context.Background()
1087		}
1088		word := firstWord(run)
1089		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1090			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1091			if word == "" {
1092				return false
1093			}
1094			word = firstWord(word)
1095		}
1096		if word == "" {
1097			return false
1098		}
1099		if interactive {
1100			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1101			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1102			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1103			defer cancel()
1104			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1105				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1106			return probe.Run() == nil
1107		}
1108		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1109			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1110			return err == nil
1111		}
1112		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1113		return err == nil
1114	}
1115	
1116	func firstWord(s string) string {
1117		f := strings.Fields(s)
1118		if len(f) == 0 {
1119			return ""
1120		}
1121		return f[0]
1122	}
1123	
1124	func shellPath() string {
1125		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1126			return s
1127		}
1128		return "/bin/sh"
1129	}

1131	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1132	// of private repositories.
1133	func remoteCachePath() string {
1134		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1135	}

1137	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1138		parts := []string{
1139			"forge-source-v1",
1140			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1141			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1142			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1143		}
1144		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1145			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1146		}
1147		sort.Strings(parts)
1148		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1149		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1150	}

1152	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1153	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1154	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1155	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1156		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1157		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1158		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1159			return nil, false, false
1160		}
1161		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1162		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {

1164		}
1165		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)

1168	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1169	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1170	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1171		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())

1173			return nil, false

1178	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1179		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1180		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1181		for _, r := range locals {
1182			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1183				continue
1184			}
1185			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1186			if ambiguous[key] {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1190				delete(byRemote, key)
1191				ambiguous[key] = true
1192				continue
1193			}
1194			byRemote[key] = r
1195		}
1196		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1197		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1198			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1199			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1200				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1201				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1202				if local.Asset != nil {
1203					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1204				}
1205			}
1206			out = append(out, row)
1207		}
1208		return out
1209	}

1233	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1234		Locals       []tui.RepoRow

1236		Providers    []forge.Forge

1244	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {

1247	
1248	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1249		type result struct {
1250			kind  forge.Kind
1251			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1252			err   error
1253		}
1254		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1255		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1256			if options.LocalsSet {
1257				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1258			}
1259			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1260		}
1261		providers := options.Providers
1262		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1263			providers = configuredForges(app)
1264		}
1265		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1266		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1267		available := 0
1268		var unavailable []error
1269		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1270		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1271		for _, f := range providers {
1272			if !f.Available() {
1273				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1274				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1275				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1276					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1277					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1278					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1279				}
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1283			available++
1284			wg.Add(1)
1285			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1286				defer wg.Done()
1287				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1288				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1289			}(f)
1290		}
1291		wg.Wait()
1292		close(ch)
1293		if available == 0 {
1294			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1295				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1296				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1297					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1298				}
1299				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1300			}
1301			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1302				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1303			}
1304			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1305		}
1306	
1307		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1308		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1309			old = forge.Cache{}
1310		}
1311		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1312		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1313		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1314			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1315		}
1316		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1317			statuses[kind] = status
1318		}
1319		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1320		successful := 0
1321		now := time.Now().UTC()
1322		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1323			status := statuses[kind]
1324			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1325			statuses[kind] = status
1326		}
1327		for res := range ch {
1328			if res.err != nil {
1329				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1330				status := statuses[res.kind]
1331				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1332				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1333					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1334					status.FetchedAt = now
1335					status.Complete = false
1336				}
1337				statuses[res.kind] = status
1338				continue
1339			}
1340			successful++
1341			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1342			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1343		}
1344		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1345		complete := true
1346		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1347		for kind := range expected {
1348			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1349			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1350				complete = false
1351			}
1352			if ok {
1353				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1354			}
1355			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1356		}
1357		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1358		if successful > 0 {
1359			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1360				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1361				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1362			})
1363		}
1364		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1365	}

1367	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1368		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1369			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1370				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1371			}
1372			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1373		})
1374	}
1375	
1376	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1377		providers := forge.All()
1378		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1379			return providers
1380		}
1381		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1382		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1383			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1384				Organization: target.Organization,
1385				Project:      target.Project,
1386			})
1387		}
1388		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1389	}

1391	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1392		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1393		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1394		if assetErr != nil {
1395			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1396			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1397		}
1398		type localMatch struct {
1399			repository repo.Repo
1400			asset      *catalog.Entry
1401		}
1402		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1403		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1404		for index, r := range locals {
1405			if r.Bare {
1406				continue
1407			}
1408			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1409			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1410				continue
1411			}
1412			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1413			if ambiguous[key] {
1414				continue
1415			}
1416			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1417				delete(localByRemote, key)
1418				ambiguous[key] = true
1419				continue
1420			}
1421			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1422		}
1423		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1424		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1425			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1426			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1427				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1428				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1429				if local.asset != nil {
1430					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1431				}
1432			}
1433			out = append(out, row)
1434		}
1435		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1436		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1437		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1438		return out
1439	}
1440	
1441	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1442		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1443			return
1444		}
1445		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1446		if err != nil {
1447			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1448			return
1449		}
1450		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1451			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1452		}
1453		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1454			return
1455		}
1456		host := config.Hostname()
1457		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1458		for _, entry := range entries {
1459			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1460			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1461				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1462				continue
1463			}
1464			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1465		}
1466		for index := range rows {
1467			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1468			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1469			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1470				continue
1471			}
1472			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1473			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1474			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1475			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1476		}
1477	}
1478	
1479	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1480		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1481			if candidate == "" {
1482				continue
1483			}
1484			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1485				return candidate
1486			}
1487		}
1488		return ""
1489	}

1491	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1492		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1493		if err != nil {
1494			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1495		}
1496		path := tmp.Name()
1497		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1498			_ = tmp.Close()
1499			_ = os.Remove(path)
1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1503			_ = os.Remove(path)
1504			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1505		}
1506		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1507		if err != nil {
1508			_ = os.Remove(path)
1509			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1510		}
1511		return tui.NoteEdit{
1512			Command: proc,
1513			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1514				if runErr != nil {
1515					_ = os.Remove(path)
1516					return runErr
1517				}
1518				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1519				if err != nil {
1520					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1521				}
1522				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1523					_ = os.Remove(path)
1524					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1525				}
1526				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1527				if err != nil {
1528					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1529				}
1530				_ = os.Remove(path)
1531				return nil
1532			},
1533		}, nil
1534	}

95		// AfterFirstView performs optional background work only after the initial
96		// application frame has been computed.
97		AfterFirstView func(ctx context.Context)
98		// CheckSkills performs the explicitly requested read-only network comparison.
99		CheckSkills func(ctx context.Context, rows []agentskill.Skill) []agentskill.Skill
100		// AddSkill and UpdateSkill return interactive processes for tea to suspend around.
101		AddSkill    func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
102		UpdateSkill func(row agentskill.Skill) (*exec.Cmd, error)
103		// Repos and Tries group asset-specific metadata and lifecycle actions.
104		Repos RepoActions
105		Tries TryActions
106		Notes NoteActions
107		Sizes SizeActions
108		Local LocalActions
109		// Open makes a task live.
110		Open func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (OpenResult, error)
111		// OpenRepo makes a repository live.
112		OpenRepo func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow) (OpenResult, error)
113		// OpenCheckout makes one linked worktree live.
114		OpenCheckout func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) (OpenResult, error)
115		// OpenRemote opens a remote's existing local checkout.
116		OpenRemote func(ctx context.Context, r RemoteRow) (OpenResult, error)

118		OpenFleet func(ctx context.Context, r FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error)
119		// CloneRemote clones a remote that has no local checkout and returns the
120		// new path, so the row can be updated without querying the network again.
121		CloneRemote func(ctx context.Context, r RemoteRow) (OpenResult, string, error)
122		// Park closes a task's session and records its next action.
123		Park func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) (string, error)
124		// SetNext records a task's next action.
125		SetNext func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) error
126		// Start creates an isolated worktree task in a repository.
127		Start func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, name string) (string, error)
128		// StartDirect tracks the repository's currently checked-out branch without
129		// creating a branch or worktree.
130		StartDirect func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, name string) (string, error)
131		// LoadStats builds the selected repository's activity heatmap.
132		LoadStats func(ctx context.Context, repo string) (StatsPanel, error)
133		// BackfillStats derives this repository's history into the activity store.
134		BackfillStats func(ctx context.Context, repo string) error
135		// Copy writes one of the repo-context payloads to the system clipboard.
136		Copy func(text string) error
137		// EditConfig returns the editor process; tea suspends around it.
138		EditConfig func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
139		// EditFleetConfig does the same for remotes.toml, which is a separate file
140		// with its own schema — the FLEET view's `e` would otherwise open the
141		// config that has nothing to do with what it is showing.
142		EditFleetConfig func() (*exec.Cmd, error)

144		// unknown fields, so a typo has to surface rather than silently drop a host.
145		ValidateFleetConfig func() error

147		// Runtime backend changes need a TUI restart, which status explains.
148		ReloadConfig func(ctx context.Context) (ConfigUpdate, string, error)
149		// RepoColumns and sorting are live-updatable display policy.
150		RepoColumns []string

236	// Model is the dashboard state.
237	type Model struct {
238		actions Actions
239		// trace is the one intentional shared pointer in the value-copied model. The
240		// recorder is append-only, bounded and concurrency-safe; it never controls UI
241		// behavior.
242		trace *perftrace.Recorder
243		// runContext bounds read/probe commands to this Bubble Tea program. Mutating
244		// actions deliberately keep their own contexts and completion handling.
245		runContext     context.Context
246		loadContexts   [viewCount]context.Context
247		loadCancels    [viewCount]context.CancelFunc
248		configCancel   context.CancelFunc
249		configContext  context.Context
250		localCancel    context.CancelFunc
251		localContext   context.Context
252		firstViewReady chan struct{}
253		firstViewOnce  *sync.Once
254	
255		view    View
256		rows    []inventory.Row
257		repos   []RepoRow
258		tries   []TryRow
259		remotes []RemoteRow
260		fleet   []FleetRow
261		skills  []agentskill.Skill
262		mcp     []agentmcp.Declaration
263		// Each fixed view owns value-copied request/readiness state. Optional views
264		// stay lazy; no synthetic all-tabs-ready state exists.
265		loads        [viewCount]viewLoadState
266		viewErrors   [viewCount]error
267		viewStatuses [viewCount]string
268		initialLoad  bool
269		// skillsChecking is a separate explicit network operation, not initial tab
270		// readiness.
271		skillsChecking     bool
272		skillsInventoryErr error
273		sizeLoad           diskusage.Load
274		forceSizeReload    bool
275		configGeneration   uint64
276		localGeneration    uint64
277		toolGeneration     uint64
278	
279		// Cursors are plain fields, one per view, rather than a map: bubbletea
280		// passes the model by value and expects each returned copy to be
281		// independent. A map would be shared between every copy, so a keypress
282		// that produced two candidate models would have them silently agree.
283		taskCursor   int
284		repoCursor   int
285		tryCursor    int
286		remoteCursor int
287		fleetCursor  int
288		skillCursor  int
289		mcpCursor    int
290		// expandedRepos is a slice rather than a map because Bubble Tea copies the
291		// model by value; a map would make candidate models share mutation.
292		expandedRepos []string
293		// filter is the live text query; states narrows the task view.
294		filter string
295		states []task.State
296		// showDone includes finished tasks, which are hidden by default because a
297		// finished task is not work in progress.
298		showDone bool
299		// showAllTries includes deprecated, archived, evicted, and graduated history.
300		showAllTries bool
301		// showLocalFleet includes this machine in FLEET. It is hidden by default
302		// because REPOS already provides the richer local inventory.
303		showLocalFleet bool

310		stats             *StatsPanel
311		overlay           overlayState
312	
313		notes              []*note.Note
314		noteTarget         NoteTarget
315		noteCursor         int
316		noteQuery          string
317		noteExpanded       bool
318		noteLoading        bool
319		noteReturnToBrowse bool
320		noteRequest        uint64
321	
322		status string
323		err    error

331	// New builds the dashboard.
332	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
333		in := textinput.New()
334		in.CharLimit = 200
335	
336		m := Model{
337			actions:        actions,
338			rows:           rows,
339			repos:          repos,
340			input:          in,
341			width:          100,
342			height:         30,
343			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
344			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
345		}
346		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
347			m.toolGeneration = 1
348		}
349		if rows != nil {
350			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
351		}
352		if repos != nil {
353			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
354		}
355		return m
356	}
357	
358	// WithTrace observes performance boundaries without controlling model state.
359	func (m Model) WithTrace(trace *perftrace.Recorder) Model {
360		m.trace = trace
361		return m
362	}
363	
364	// WithContext bounds asynchronous read/probe commands to one dashboard run.
365	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
366		m.runContext = ctx
367		return m
368	}

370	// WithRemotes seeds the lazy forge view from a fresh on-disk cache. The first
371	// switch is then instant; r still refreshes explicitly.
372	func (m Model) WithRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) Model {
373		m.remotes = rows
374		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRemote, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
375		return m
376	}
377	
378	// WithFleet seeds cached fleet rows while the first live refresh remains lazy.
379	func (m Model) WithFleet(rows []FleetRow) Model {
380		m.fleet = rows
381		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewFleet, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessStale, true)
382		return m
383	}
384	
385	// WithRemotesStale marks seeded rows for background refresh on first visit.
386	func (m Model) WithRemotesStale(stale bool) Model {
387		if stale {
388			m.loads[int(ViewRemote)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
389		}
390		return m
391	}
392	
393	// WithTries seeds the Try view, primarily for tests and embedded callers. The
394	// production dashboard loads it with the other local inventories in Init.
395	func (m Model) WithTries(rows []TryRow) Model {
396		m.tries = rows
397		m.matchRemoteLocals()
398		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTries, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
399		return m
400	}

402	// BeginLoading makes Init load task, repository, and Try data asynchronously. This lets
403	// the alternate screen appear immediately instead of blocking on dozens of Git
404	// probes before Bubble Tea starts.
405	func (m Model) BeginLoading() Model {
406		m.initialLoad = true
407		m.beginLocalLoads(loadInitial)
408		return m
409	}

411	// Chosen reports a directory the caller should cd into after the program
412	// exits, or "" when there is none.
413	func (m Model) Chosen() string { return m.chosen }
414	
415	// Activation reports the runtime handle to switch/attach after the dashboard
416	// has restored the terminal, or "" when the user quit normally.
417	func (m Model) Activation() string { return m.activate }
418	
419	// CurrentView reports which list is showing.
420	func (m Model) CurrentView() View { return m.view }
421	
422	// Init implements tea.Model.
423	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
424		commands := []tea.Cmd{textinput.Blink}
425		if m.initialLoad {
426			commands = append(commands, m.reload())
427		}
428		if len(m.actions.Tools) > 0 {
429			commands = append(commands, m.probeTools())
430		}
431		if m.actions.LoadRemoteCache != nil {
432			commands = append(commands, m.loadRemoteCache())
433		}
434		if m.actions.LoadFleetCache != nil {
435			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetCache())
436		}
437		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
438			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
439		}
440		return tea.Batch(commands...)
441	}

595	
596	func traceOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
597		switch {
598		case err == nil:
599			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
600		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
601			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
602		default:
603			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
604		}
605	}
606	
607	func snapshotValid[T any](rows []T, err error) bool { return err == nil || rows != nil }
608	
609	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
610		filtered := commands[:0]
611		for _, command := range commands {
612			if command != nil {
613				filtered = append(filtered, command)
614			}
615		}
616		switch len(filtered) {
617		case 0:
618			return nil
619		case 1:
620			return filtered[0]
621		default:
622			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
623		}
624	}
625	
626	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
627		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
628			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
629		}
630	}

632	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
633		return func() tea.Msg {
634			select {
635			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
636				return nil
637			case <-m.firstViewReady:
638				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
639				return nil
640			}
641		}
642	}

644	func (m Model) loadRemoteCache() tea.Cmd {
645		generation := m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).generation
646		return func() tea.Msg {
647			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUICacheRemoteRead, perftrace.Fields{
648				View: perftrace.ViewRemote, Generation: generation,
649			})
650			result := m.actions.LoadRemoteCache(m.baseContext())
651			finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
652			return remoteCacheMsg{generation: generation, result: result}
653		}
654	}
655	
656	func (m Model) loadFleetCache() tea.Cmd {
657		generation := m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).generation
658		return func() tea.Msg {
659			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUICacheFleetRead, perftrace.Fields{
660				View: perftrace.ViewFleet, Generation: generation,
661			})
662			result := m.actions.LoadFleetCache(m.baseContext())
663			finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
664			return fleetCacheMsg{generation: generation, result: result}
665		}
666	}
667	
668	func (m Model) probeTools() tea.Cmd {
669		generation := m.toolGeneration
670		tools := append([]Tool(nil), m.actions.Tools...)
671		ctx := m.baseContext()
672		return func() tea.Msg {
673			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTools, perftrace.Fields{Generation: generation})
674			jobs := make(chan int, len(tools))
675			for index := range tools {
676				jobs <- index
677			}
678			close(jobs)
679			var workers sync.WaitGroup
680			for range min(2, len(tools)) {
681				workers.Go(func() {
682					for index := range jobs {
683						available := true
684						if tools[index].Probe != nil {
685							available = tools[index].Probe(ctx)
686						}
687						if ctx.Err() != nil {
688							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnknown
689						} else if available {
690							tools[index].Availability = ToolAvailable
691						} else {
692							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnavailable
693						}
694					}
695				})
696			}
697			workers.Wait()
698			finish(traceOutcome(ctx.Err()))
699			return toolsMsg{generation: generation, tools: tools}
700		}
701	}
702	
703	func (m Model) reload() tea.Cmd {
704		if m.actions.Local.Start != nil {
705			return m.startLocalLoad()
706		}
707		return func() tea.Msg {
708			ctx := m.viewContext(ViewTasks)
709			out := reloadMsg{
710				forceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
711				rowsGeneration:  m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
712				reposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
713				triesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
714			}
715			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
716				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTasks, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTasks})
717				out.rows, out.rowsErr = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
718				out.rowsSet, out.rowsValid = true, snapshotValid(out.rows, out.rowsErr)
719				finish(traceOutcome(out.rowsErr))
720			}
721			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
722				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRepos, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos})
723				out.repos, out.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
724				out.reposSet, out.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(out.repos, out.reposErr)
725				finish(traceOutcome(out.reposErr))
726			}
727			if m.actions.Tries.Reload != nil {
728				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTries, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTries})
729				out.tries, out.triesErr = m.actions.Tries.Reload(ctx, m.showAllTries)
730				out.triesSet, out.triesValid = true, snapshotValid(out.tries, out.triesErr)
731				finish(traceOutcome(out.triesErr))
732			}
733			return out
734		}
735	}
736	
737	func (m Model) reloadTries(includeRepos bool) tea.Cmd {
738		return func() tea.Msg {
739			tryCtx := m.viewContext(ViewTries)
740			repoCtx := m.viewContext(ViewRepos)
741			out := triesMsg{
742				triesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
743				reposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
744			}
745			if m.actions.Tries.Reload != nil {
746				out.tries, out.triesErr = m.actions.Tries.Reload(tryCtx, m.showAllTries)
747				out.triesSet, out.triesValid = true, snapshotValid(out.tries, out.triesErr)
748			}
749			if includeRepos && m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
750				out.repos, out.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(repoCtx)
751				out.reposSet, out.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(out.repos, out.reposErr)
752			}
753			return out
754		}
755	}

763			return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
764		}

773			return tryActionMsg{result: result, err: err}

798		}

880	func (m Model) reloadUpdatedSkill(name, lockName string, scope agentskill.Scope, checkout string) tea.Cmd {
881		generation := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).generation
882		locals := append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)
883		return func() tea.Msg {
884			if m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos == nil && m.actions.ReloadSkills == nil {
885				return skillsMsg{
886					generation: generation, valid: true, loaded: true, status: "updated " + name,
887					inventoryErr: m.skillsInventoryErr, err: m.skillsInventoryErr,
888				}
889			}
890			var rows []agentskill.Skill
891			var err error
892			if m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil {
893				rows, err = m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), locals)
894			} else {
895				rows, err = m.actions.ReloadSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills))
896			}
897			if err != nil && rows == nil {
898				return skillsMsg{generation: generation, valid: false, loaded: true, inventoryErr: err, err: err}
899			}
900			verified := false
901			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil {
902				for i := range rows {
903					candidateName := rows[i].Name
904					if rows[i].Lock != nil {
905						candidateName = rows[i].Lock.Name
906					}
907					if candidateName == lockName && rows[i].Scope == scope && rows[i].Checkout == checkout {
908						checked := m.actions.CheckSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), []agentskill.Skill{rows[i]})
909						if len(checked) == 1 {
910							rows[i] = checked[0]
911							verified = true
912						}
913						break
914					}
915				}
916			}
917			status := "updated " + name
918			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil && !verified {
919				status += "; matching row was not found for source verification"
920			}
921			return skillsMsg{
922				generation: generation, rows: rows, valid: snapshotValid(rows, err), loaded: true,
923				checked: verified, status: status, inventoryErr: err, err: err,
924			}
925		}
926	}

942	func (m Model) reloadAfterConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
943		if m.actions.Local.Start != nil {
944			local := m.startLocalLoad()
945			if refreshRemote {
946				return tea.Batch(local, m.reloadRemote())
947			}
948			return local
949		}
950		return func() tea.Msg {
951			ctx := m.viewContext(ViewTasks)
952			out := reloadMsg{
953				forceSizes:       m.forceSizeReload,
954				rowsGeneration:   m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
955				reposGeneration:  m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
956				triesGeneration:  m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
957				remoteGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).generation,
958			}
959			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
960				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTasks, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTasks})
961				out.rows, out.rowsErr = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
962				out.rowsSet, out.rowsValid = true, snapshotValid(out.rows, out.rowsErr)
963				finish(traceOutcome(out.rowsErr))
964			}
965			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
966				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRepos, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos})
967				out.repos, out.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
968				out.reposSet, out.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(out.repos, out.reposErr)
969				finish(traceOutcome(out.reposErr))
970			}
971			if m.actions.Tries.Reload != nil {
972				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTries, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTries})
973				out.tries, out.triesErr = m.actions.Tries.Reload(ctx, m.showAllTries)
974				out.triesSet, out.triesValid = true, snapshotValid(out.tries, out.triesErr)
975				finish(traceOutcome(out.triesErr))
976			}
977			if refreshRemote && m.actions.ReloadRemote != nil {
978				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRemote, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRemote})
979				out.remotes, out.remoteErr = m.actions.ReloadRemote(ctx)
980				out.remoteSet, out.remoteValid = true, snapshotValid(out.remotes, out.remoteErr)
981				finish(traceOutcome(out.remoteErr))
982			}
983			return out
984		}
985	}

987	// visibleTasks applies the state filter and the text query.
988	func (m Model) visibleTasks() []inventory.Row {
989		var out []inventory.Row
990		for _, r := range m.rows {
991			if len(m.states) > 0 {
992				if !containsState(m.states, r.Task.State) {
993					continue
994				}
995			} else if r.Task.State == task.Done && !m.showDone {
996				continue
997			}
998			if !matches(taskSearchText(r), m.filter) {
999				continue
1000			}
1001			out = append(out, r)
1002		}
1003		return out
1004	}
1005	
1006	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
1007	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
1008	// for, not alphabetical order.
1009	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1010		var out []RepoRow
1011		for _, r := range m.repos {
1012			if r.IsTry() || !r.matches(m.filter) {
1013				continue
1014			}
1015			out = append(out, r)
1016		}
1017		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1018		if sortBy == "" {
1019			sortBy = "activity"
1020		}
1021		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1022			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1023			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1024				return cmp > 0
1025			}
1026			return cmp < 0
1027		})
1028		return out
1029	}
1030	
1031	// visibleTries applies structured experiment filters and keeps sorting local to
1032	// the view so repository ordering remains independent.
1033	func (m Model) visibleTries() []TryRow {
1034		out := make([]TryRow, 0, len(m.tries))
1035		for _, row := range m.tries {
1036			if row.matches(m.filter) {
1037				out = append(out, row)
1038			}
1039		}
1040		sortBy := m.trySort
1041		if sortBy == "" {
1042			sortBy = "activity"
1043		}
1044		sortTryRows(out, sortBy, m.tryReverse)
1045		return out
1046	}
1047	
1048	type repoItem struct {
1049		Repo          RepoRow
1050		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
1051	}
1052	
1053	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
1054	
1055	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
1056		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
1057			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1058		}
1059		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
1060	}
1061	
1062	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1063	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1064	// from the repository they belong to.
1065	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1066		repos := m.visibleRepos()
1067		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
1068		for _, r := range repos {
1069			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
1070			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1071				continue
1072			}
1073			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
1074				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1075			}
1076		}
1077		return out
1078	}
1079	
1080	func repoKey(r RepoRow) string {
1081		if r.Repo.CommonDir != "" {
1082			return r.Repo.CommonDir
1083		}
1084		return r.Repo.Path
1085	}
1086	
1087	func (m Model) repoExpanded(r RepoRow) bool {
1088		key := repoKey(r)
1089		for _, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
1090			if expanded == key {
1091				return true
1092			}
1093		}
1094		return false
1095	}
1096	
1097	func (m *Model) toggleRepo(r RepoRow) {
1098		key := repoKey(r)
1099		for i, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
1100			if expanded == key {
1101				m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos[:i]...), m.expandedRepos[i+1:]...)
1102				return
1103			}
1104		}
1105		m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos...), key)
1106	}
1107	
1108	// visibleRemotes filters the combined forge inventory. Local clones sort
1109	// first, then recently updated repositories.
1110	func (m Model) visibleRemotes() []RemoteRow {
1111		var out []RemoteRow
1112		for _, r := range m.remotes {
1113			if r.matches(m.filter) {
1114				out = append(out, r)
1115			}
1116		}
1117		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1118			if out[i].Cloned() != out[j].Cloned() {
1119				return out[i].Cloned()
1120			}
1121			if !out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
1122				return out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
1123			}
1124			return out[i].Repo.Label() < out[j].Repo.Label()
1125		})
1126		return out
1127	}
1128	
1129	func (m Model) visibleFleet() []FleetRow {
1130		var out []FleetRow
1131		for _, row := range m.fleet {
1132			if row.Local && !m.showLocalFleet {
1133				continue
1134			}
1135			if matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
1136				out = append(out, row)
1137			}
1138		}
1139		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1140			leftName, rightName := "", ""
1141			if out[i].Repository != nil {
1142				leftName = strings.ToLower(out[i].Repository.Display)
1143			}
1144			if out[j].Repository != nil {
1145				rightName = strings.ToLower(out[j].Repository.Display)
1146			}
1147			if leftName != rightName {
1148				return leftName < rightName
1149			}
1150			return out[i].Host < out[j].Host
1151		})
1152		return out
1153	}

1155	func (m Model) fleetCount() int {

1157		for _, row := range m.fleet {

1159				count++
1160			}
1161		}
1162		return count
1163	}

1165	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1166	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1167	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1168	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1169	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1170		if row.Task == nil {
1171			return ""
1172		}
1173		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1174			return "dev sweep"
1175		}
1176		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1177			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1178		}
1179		return ""
1180	}
1181	
1182	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1183		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1184		if command == "" {
1185			return nil
1186		}
1187		switch {
1188		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1189			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1190		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1191			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1192		default:
1193			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1194		}
1195	}

1198		var out []agentskill.Skill
1199		for _, row := range m.skills {
1200			if skillMatches(row, m.filter) {
1201				out = append(out, row)
1202			}
1203		}
1204		return out

1207	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1208		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1209		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1210			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1211			if structured {
1212				switch key {
1213				case "scope":
1214					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1215						return false
1216					}
1217					continue
1218				case "agent":
1219					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1220					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1221						return false
1222					}
1223					continue
1224				case "update":
1225					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1226						return false
1227					}
1228					continue
1229				case "repo":
1230					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1231						return false
1232					}
1233					continue
1234				case "presence":
1235					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1236						return false
1237					}
1238					continue
1239				case "integrity":
1240					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1241						return false
1242					}
1243					continue
1244				}
1245			}
1246			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1247				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1248				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1249				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1250				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1251			}, " "))
1252			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1253				return false
1254			}
1255		}
1256		return true
1257	}
1258	
1259	func (m Model) visibleMCP() []agentmcp.Declaration {
1260		var out []agentmcp.Declaration
1261		for _, row := range m.mcp {
1262			if mcpMatches(row, m.filter) {
1263				out = append(out, row)
1264			}
1265		}
1266		return out
1267	}
1268	
1269	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1270		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1271		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1272			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1273			if structured {
1274				var field string
1275				switch key {
1276				case "repo":
1277					field = row.Repository
1278				case "agent":
1279					field = string(row.Agent)
1280				case "scope":
1281					field = string(row.Scope)
1282				case "transport":
1283					field = string(row.Transport)
1284				case "managed":
1285					field = string(row.Source)
1286				case "state":
1287					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1288				default:
1289					field = ""
1290				}
1291				if field != "" {
1292					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1293						return false
1294					}
1295					continue
1296				}
1297			}
1298			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1299				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1300				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1301				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1302			}, " "))
1303			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1304				return false
1305			}
1306		}
1307		return true
1308	}
1309	
1310	func mcpDeclarationState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
1311		if row.Enabled == nil {
1312			return "configured"
1313		}
1314		if *row.Enabled {
1315			return "enabled"
1316		}
1317		return "disabled"
1318	}
1319	
1320	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1321	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1322		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1323		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1324			switch {
1325			case x > y:
1326				return -1
1327			case x < y:
1328				return 1
1329			default:
1330				return 0
1331			}
1332		}
1333		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1334			if x == y {
1335				return 0
1336			}
1337			if x {
1338				return -1
1339			}
1340			return 1
1341		}
1342		latest := func() int {
1343			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1344				return 0
1345			}
1346			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1347				return -1
1348			}
1349			return 1
1350		}
1351	
1352		switch sortBy {
1353		case "name":
1354			return nameCmp
1355		case "latest":
1356			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1357				return c
1358			}
1359		case "git":
1360			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1361				return c
1362			}
1363			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1364				return c
1365			}
1366		case "size":
1367			switch {
1368			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1369				return -1
1370			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1371				return 1
1372			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1373				return -1
1374			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1375				return 1
1376			}
1377		case "tasks":
1378			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1379				return c
1380			}
1381			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1382				return c
1383			}
1384		default: // activity
1385			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1386				return c
1387			}
1388			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1389				return c
1390			}
1391			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1392				return c
1393			}
1394			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1395				return c
1396			}
1397			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1398				return c
1399			}
1400		}
1401		return nameCmp
1402	}
1403	
1404	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
1405		for _, v := range list {
1406			if v == s {
1407				return true
1408			}
1409		}
1410		return false
1411	}

1413	// count is how many rows the current view has.
1414	func (m Model) count() int {
1415		switch m.view {
1416		case ViewRepos:
1417			return len(m.visibleRepoItems())
1418		case ViewFleet:
1419			return len(m.visibleFleet())
1420		case ViewTries:
1421			return len(m.visibleTries())
1422		case ViewRemote:
1423			return len(m.visibleRemotes())
1424		case ViewSkills:
1425			return len(m.visibleSkills())
1426		case ViewMCP:
1427			return len(m.visibleMCP())
1428		default:
1429			return len(m.visibleTasks())
1430		}
1431	}

1433	// at is the cursor position in the current view.
1434	func (m Model) at() int {
1435		switch m.view {
1436		case ViewRepos:
1437			return m.repoCursor
1438		case ViewFleet:
1439			return m.fleetCursor
1440		case ViewTries:
1441			return m.tryCursor
1442		case ViewRemote:
1443			return m.remoteCursor
1444		case ViewSkills:
1445			return m.skillCursor
1446		case ViewMCP:
1447			return m.mcpCursor
1448		default:
1449			return m.taskCursor
1450		}
