1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	`AGENTS.md` is the canonical repository guidance file. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to it; edit this file rather than replacing the symlink.
6	
7	## Toolchain and commands
8	
9	- Go 1.26.4 (from `go.mod`) builds the CLI. Python 3.11+ and `uv` are used only for the documentation site.
10	- `make` / `make all` runs `fmt -> vet -> test -> build`. `make fmt` runs `gofmt -w .` and therefore modifies files.
11	- There is no working `make lint` recipe even though `lint` appears in `.PHONY`. The repository's static gates are formatting and `go vet`.
12	
13	```bash
14	make build                         # build ./dev with git-derived version metadata
15	make test                          # go test ./...
16	go test -race ./...                # CI test command
17	go test ./internal/gitx -run '^TestAddWorktreeUsesExplicitBase$'  # one test
18	go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestName/Subtest$'                  # one subtest
19	make vet                           # go vet ./...
20	files="$(gofmt -l .)" && test -z "$files"  # format check that preserves gofmt failures
21	make e2e                           # real CLI lifecycle in an isolated temporary HOME
22	make skill-sync                    # regenerate command docs, then rebuild embedded skill
23	make skill-check                   # fail when command tree and generated skill reference drift
24	make install                       # binary under PREFIX; skill in user agent directories
25	```
26	
27	Documentation uses the same sequence as CI:
28	
29	```bash
30	uv sync --frozen --extra docs
31	uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source
32	uv run mkdocs build --strict
33	uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --site site
34	```
35	
36	If generated `docs/llms*.txt` files drift, regenerate them with `uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source --generate-llms` and then rerun the documentation checks.
37	
38	## Architecture
39	
40	The executable path is deliberately shallow:
41	
42	```text
43	cmd/dev/main.go
44	  -> cli.Execute()
45	  -> cli.NewRootCommandWithIO()
46	  -> App.Load()
47	  -> Cobra command handler
48	  -> domain package(s)
49	```
50	
51	`internal/cli` assembles commands, parses flags, invokes services, and renders output. Keep policy out of command handlers; it belongs in independently testable domain packages:
52	
53	- `config` owns defaults, TOML overlays, validation, and XDG paths.
54	- `gitx` is the Git porcelain boundary and canonicalizes repository identity through the shared Git common directory.
55	- `task` persists only human intent Git cannot derive: task mode/state, owner, next action, and runtime hints.
56	- `wt` owns managed linked-worktree creation, placement, provisioning plans, and safe removal. Runtimes never create or manage Git worktrees; they surface checkout or experiment paths selected and validated by the calling `dev` flow, including managed, external, or adopted worktrees and non-Git Try directories.
57	- `runtime` abstracts Herdr, tmux, Zellij, and the no-multiplexer backend. Handles are backend-qualified hints and must be checked against live checkout coverage before reuse.
58	- `repo` discovers and deduplicates repositories; `inventory` joins repositories, Git state, tasks, worktrees, and live runtime data. CLI listings and the TUI consume this joined view.
59	- `catalog` stores stable repository/Try identity and personal metadata. `experiment` owns Try creation, archive/restore, and graduation, including intent records and rollback/reconciliation around moves.
60	- `note` stores multiple repository thoughts as durable Markdown keyed by catalog ID and maintains a rebuildable SQLite FTS index. It is distinct from task context and the catalog's single metadata summary.
61	- `tui` owns Bubble Tea state/rendering only. `internal/cli/tui.go` injects callbacks to the same services used by non-interactive commands.
62	- `stats` is durable SQLite data; `diskusage`, note FTS, and forge/gitignore data are regenerable caches. Do not treat stats as cache.
63	- `forge` wraps optional `gh`, `glab`, and Azure CLI integrations and must degrade to local Git behavior when they are unavailable.
64	
65	The principal task flow spans `internal/cli/start.go`, `start_flow.go`, `gitx`/`wt`, `runtime`, and `task`: resolve the canonical repository and explicit base, create or select the checkout, provision/open it, then persist and annotate the task. Lifecycle behavior lives in `park.go`, `resume.go`, `done.go`, and `sweep.go`; preserve their report-before-apply and no-data-loss ordering.
66	
67	State is split intentionally:
68	
69	- Git remotes/branches are durable code truth.
70	- Worktrees are disposable local checkouts.
71	- Runtime sessions are per-host and re-derivable.
72	- Task TOML and catalog assets hold only intent/identity that Git cannot answer.
73	- Repository quick-note Markdown is durable sidecar data; `notes.db` is only its disposable search index.
74	- `stats.db` is durable observation data; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/*` is disposable.
75	
76	## Behavioral contracts
77	
78	- Task modes are `worktree`, `branch`, and `direct`; lifecycle states are `hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done`.
79	- Use an explicit base for branch/worktree creation. Do not infer a safe base from whichever branch happens to be checked out.
80	- Never nest a managed worktree inside a repository. Removing a worktree does not remove its branch, and dirty removal stays opt-in.
81	- Cold parking requires committed, pushed, reconstructible work before runtime/worktree cleanup.
82	- Reconciliation flows such as `sweep`, `adopt`, and bootstrap organization plans report before applying changes. Direct actions such as `wt rm`, `tries archive`, and `cache clear` mutate immediately after their own safety checks; do not treat them as previews.
83	- A recognized agent in a canonical checkout occupies it regardless of whether its status is working, idle, done, or unknown. Shared-writer overrides require coordinated disjoint ownership.
84	- A parallel launch target is only the exact root pane returned for a newly created first-class Herdr worktree; reused/fallback/unverified surfaces fail closed.
85	- `dev ls --json` is an external automation contract. Add fields rather than renaming/removing existing fields; apply the same compatibility care to other documented structured output.
86	- Quick notes attach to the canonical repository through catalog identity. Markdown is durable, note deletion requires confirmation, and clearing/rebuilding note FTS must never delete source files.
87	- Filesystem transitions must retain path traversal/symlink, same-filesystem, source revalidation, and rollback/reconciliation checks.
88	
89	## Versioning and changelog
90	
91	The current published baseline is `v0.2.3` (2026-09-01). The CLI version authority is an immutable `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` Git tag:
92	
93	- `Makefile` derives development builds with `git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*' --always --dirty` and injects `internal/cli.Version` through `-ldflags`. The `--match` filter is load-bearing: any other tag in the repository (a `backup/` or `rescue/` marker, say) must never become `--version`.
94	- `go install ...@version` recovers the module version from Go build information.
95	- `pyproject.toml` version `0.0.0` belongs only to the MkDocs environment and is not the CLI version.
96	
97	Every user-visible feature must be added to `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` as part of the feature change. Do not publish or describe a feature build under an older release's version; a release containing new compatible behavior must receive a newer version. Decide from public compatibility impact rather than blindly from the commit type.
98	
99	**When to release.** A tag is not an occasional ceremony; it is how a downstream binary learns it is stale. `go install ...@latest` resolves to the newest tag, so anything merged but untagged is invisible outside this repository.
100	
101	- A landed branch that stands alone is released immediately: bump the patch during `0.x` (`v0.1.x`) and tag it as the last step of landing.
102	- A landed branch belonging to an announced milestone accumulates in `[Unreleased]`; the milestone closes with a minor bump (`v0.2.0`).
103	- Never let `[Unreleased]` grow past one milestone's worth of work. `v0.1.0` to `v0.1.11` were tagged retroactively on 2026-08-29 precisely because 38 commits accumulated with no release.
104	
105	**What downstream gets.** Every release from `v0.2.0` forward publishes platform binaries and `SHA256SUMS` alongside the GitHub release, and `dev doctor` reports the running version so a user can compare without leaving the terminal. A release that ships neither leaves `dev --version` as the only signal, which is what the freshness work exists to fix.
106	
107	For a release:
108	
109	1. Move the relevant `[Unreleased]` entries into `## [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD` and update comparison links.
110	2. Update version-pinned install examples when the documented recommended release changes.
111	3. Push `main` first. `release.yml` asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`, so a tag pushed ahead of its branch fails validation.
112	4. Tag the exact commit on `main` as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; never move or reuse a published tag. Never push `backup/*` or `rescue/*` tags — a tag reachable from a commit that predates the `--match` filter breaks the workflow's `./dev --version` assertion.
113	5. Let `.github/workflows/release.yml` run CI, verify `./dev --version`, build the platform matrix, create the GitHub release, and publish the matching Homebrew formula. The repository secret `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` must be a fine-grained token with Contents write access to `daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap`; a tap publication failure fails the release job so it can be retried instead of leaving Homebrew users stale.
114	
115	If the Homebrew step needs a retry or an older stable release needs a one-time backfill, run `gh workflow run publish-homebrew.yml -f version=vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. The manual workflow verifies that the release exists and republishes only the formula; it does not create or move a tag or GitHub release.
116	
117	Stable release tags only are accepted by the current workflow; prerelease tags are not supported.
118	
119	## Keep implementation, skill, and docs aligned
120	
121	`internal/skill/dev-cli/` is shipped product surface, not incidental prose: `internal/skill/skill.go` embeds the entire tree in the binary. A code change is incomplete when the bundled skill or public documentation still describes old behavior.
122	
123	| Change | Required synchronization |
124	|---|---|
125	| Cobra command name, `Use`, `Short`, flag, or global option | Run `make skill-sync`, inspect `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/commands.md`, then run `make skill-check`. Never edit the generated block by hand. |
126	| Task modes/states/defaults or lifecycle preconditions | Update `SKILL.md`, `references/task-lifecycle.md`, README, embedded help, relevant English and zh-TW workflow/mental-model/compatibility pages, and transition tests. |
127	| Worktree placement, provisioning, include rules, strategies, or safety checks | Update `references/worktree-ownership.md`, README/public worktree docs, config examples, and focused `wt` tests. |
128	| Runtime protocol, fallback order, activation, agent collision, exact-pane launch, or cleanup behavior | Update `references/runtime-herdr.md`, `references/parallel-agents.md`, compatibility docs, and runtime/lifecycle tests. Keep the boundary clear: `dev start` prepares a checkout/runtime surface; it does not launch an agent. |
129	| Bootstrap scan/layout/index/move behavior | Update `references/bootstrap.md`, public bootstrap docs, and bootstrap tests. |
130	| Config fields/defaults or structured output | Update generated command help where applicable, authored reference pages and both locales, examples, and compatibility tests. |
131	| Quick-note storage, identity, search, structured output, or TUI behavior | Update README, embedded help, `SKILL.md`, `references/notes.md`, and paired English/zh-TW mental-model, workflow, TUI, commands/config, compatibility, and freshness pages. |
132	| Any user-visible feature or fix | Update `CHANGELOG.md`; update README/help/MkDocs/skill wherever they make the affected claim. |
133	
134	`make skill-check` proves only that generated command syntax matches the Cobra tree. It cannot detect drift in lifecycle semantics, JSON schemas, safety claims, examples, README, embedded help, or authored skill references; review those manually. Because the skill is compiled with `go:embed`, rebuild after any skill edit before testing the bundled output.
135	
136	English and zh-TW MkDocs pages are maintained as a pair. Run the strict documentation checks above after changing either locale, navigation, snippets, or freshness metadata.

179	// Result is a complete non-mutating native inventory.
180	type Result struct {
181		Skills          []Skill
182		Diagnostics     []Diagnostic
183		RegistrySource  string
184		RegistryVersion string
185	}
186	
187	// ListOptions selects scopes and the opt-in network freshness check. With no
188	// scope selected both are returned.
189	type ListOptions struct {
190		Project bool
191		Global  bool
192		Check   bool
193	}
194	
195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}
207	
208	// Inventory scans cwd's current target and the requested global scope.
209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}
216	
217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}
262	
263	// ScanTargets is an explicit compatibility name for Scan.
264	func ScanTargets(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
265		return Scan(ctx, targets, options)
266	}
267	
268	// List preserves the original row-only API. Native diagnostics are available
269	// through Inventory or Scan and never turn a malformed neighboring scope into a
270	// fatal whole-scan error.
271	func List(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) ([]Skill, error) {
272		result, err := Inventory(ctx, cwd, options)
273		return result.Skills, err
274	}
275	
276	// ManagedName returns the canonical lock key for one unambiguous provider-
277	// managed skill. Direct-managed dev-cli and option-like keys are never handed
278	// to the external update command.
279	func directManagedSkillName(name string) bool {
280		return reservedSkillNameKey(name) == reservedSkillNameKey(skill.Name)
281	}
282	
283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}
298	
299	func lockUpdateable(entry LockMetadata) bool {
300		if entry.SkillPath == "" || !safeProviderSkillName(entry.Name) {
301			return false
302		}
303		switch entry.SourceType {
304		case "local", "node_modules":
305			return false
306		default:
307			return true
308		}
309	}
310	
311	// CanUpdate reports whether a listed row has enough safe lock metadata for the
312	// external provider's named update flow.
313	func CanUpdate(row Skill) bool {
314		return row.ManagedBy == ManagedBySkills && row.Lock != nil && lockUpdateable(*row.Lock) &&
315			!directManagedSkillName(row.Lock.Name)
316	}
317	
318	func ManagedName(ctx context.Context, cwd, name string, scope Scope) (string, bool) {
319		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
320			return "", false
321		}
322		root := ProjectRoot(ctx, cwd)
323		var document lockDocument
324		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
325			document = readGlobalLock(globalLockPath())
326		} else {
327			document = readProjectLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
328		}
329		entry, ok := document.find(name)
330		if !ok || !lockUpdateable(entry) {
331			return "", false
332		}
333		return entry.Name, true
334	}
335	
336	// Managed reports whether name has an update-safe upstream lock entry.
337	func Managed(ctx context.Context, cwd, name string, scope Scope) bool {
338		_, ok := ManagedName(ctx, cwd, name, scope)
339		return ok
340	}
341	
342	// FindProject returns one installed project-scoped skill by exact or normalized
343	// name. An exact name wins when normalized filesystem names collide.
344	func FindProject(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string) (Skill, error) {
345		rows, err := List(ctx, projectRoot, ListOptions{Project: true})
346		if err != nil {
347			return Skill{}, err
348		}
349		for _, row := range rows {
350			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && row.Name == name {
351				return row, nil
352			}
353		}
354		want := normalizedName(name)
355		var matches []Skill
356		for _, row := range rows {
357			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
358				matches = append(matches, row)
359			}
360		}
361		if len(matches) == 1 {
362			return matches[0], nil
363		}
364		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
365	}
366	
367	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
368	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
369	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
370		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
371		for _, result := range results {
372			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
373			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
374			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
375				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
376			}
377			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
378				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
379			}
380		}
381		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
382		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
383		return merged
384	}
385	
386	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
387		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
388			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
389			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
390				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
391			}
392			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
393				return left.Repository < right.Repository
394			}
395			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
396				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
397			}
398			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
399			if leftName != rightName {
400				return leftName < rightName
401			}
402			if left.Name != right.Name {
403				return left.Name < right.Name
404			}
405			return left.Path < right.Path
406		})
407	}
408	
409	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
410		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
411			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
412			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
413				return left.Repository < right.Repository
414			}
415			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
416				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
417			}
418			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
419				return left.Scope < right.Scope
420			}
421			if left.Path != right.Path {
422				return left.Path < right.Path
423			}
424			if left.Name != right.Name {
425				return left.Name < right.Name
426			}
427			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
428				return left.Kind < right.Kind
429			}
430			return left.Message < right.Message
431		})
432	}
433	
434	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {
435		if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
436			return false
437		}
438		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
439			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
440		})
441	}
442	
443	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
444		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
445		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)
455		}
456		sort.Strings(out)
457		return out
458	}
459	
460	func homeDirectory() string {
461		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
462		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
463			return ""
464		}
465		return home
466	}

124	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
125	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
126	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
127	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
128		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
129		for _, location := range input {
130			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
131			current := byLogical[path]
132			if current == nil {
133				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
134				byLogical[path] = &copy
135				current = &copy
136			}
137			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
138		}
139		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
140		for path := range byLogical {
141			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
142		}
143		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
144	
145		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
146		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
147			logical := *byLogical[path]
148			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)
149			physical := path
150			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
151				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
152			}
153			group := byPhysical[physical]
154			if group == nil {
155				group = &physicalScanLocation{Path: physical}
156				byPhysical[physical] = group
157			}
158			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
159		}
160		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
161		for path := range byPhysical {
162			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
163		}
164		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
165		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
166		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
167			group := byPhysical[path]
168			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
169			result = append(result, *group)
170		}
171		return result
172	}

269	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {

273		}
274		if err != nil {
275			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
276				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
277				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),

279		}
280		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
281	
282		var skills []scannedSkill
283		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
284		for _, entry := range entries {
285			if ctx.Err() != nil {
286				break
287			}
288			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
289			info, err := os.Stat(child)
290			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
291				continue
292			}
293			if err != nil {
294				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
295					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
296					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
297				}, target))
298				continue
299			}
300			if !info.IsDir() {
301				continue
302			}
303			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
304			if !present {

306			}
307			if err != nil {

309					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
310					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),

313			}
314			physical := child
315			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
316				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
317			}
318			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
319			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
320				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
321				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
322			}
323			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)

337	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
338		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
339		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340			return "", false, nil
341		}
342		if err != nil {
343			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not inspect SKILL.md: %w", err)
344		}
345		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
346			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
347		}
348		file, err := os.Open(filename)
349		if err != nil {
350			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
351		}
352		defer file.Close()
353		if openedInfo, err := file.Stat(); err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
354			return "", true, errors.New("opened SKILL.md is not a regular file")
355		}
356	
357		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
358		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
359		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
360		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
361		consumed := int64(len(first))
362		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
363			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
364		}
365		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
366		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
367			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
368		}
369		var frontmatter strings.Builder
370		closed := false
371		for {
372			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
373			consumed += int64(len(line))
374			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
375				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376			}
377			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
378				closed = true
379				break
380			}
381			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
382			if lineErr != nil {
383				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
384					break
385				}
386				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
387			}
388		}
389		if !closed {
390			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
391		}
392		var metadata struct {
393			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
394			Description string `yaml:"description"`
395		}
396		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
397			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
398		}
399		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
400		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
401		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
402			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
403		}
404		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
405			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
406		}
407		return metadata.Name, true, nil
408	}

410	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
411		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))
412		for _, installation := range group.Installations {
413			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
414			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
415			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
416			installations = append(installations, *installation)
417		}
418		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
419			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
420				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
421			}
422			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
423		})
424		var agents []string
425		for _, installation := range installations {
426			agents = append(agents, installation.AgentIDs...)
427		}
428		agentIDs := uniqueSorted(agents)
429		agents = agentDisplayNames(agentIDs)
430		row := Skill{
431			Name: name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot,
432			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
433			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
434			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
435			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
436			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,
437			UpdateDetail: "not tracked by the skills CLI",
438		}
439		if len(installations) > 0 {
440			row.Path = installations[0].Path
441		}
442		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
443			if name == skill.Name {
444				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
445				row.Source = "dev binary"
446				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
447				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
448			} else {

450			}
451			return row
452		}
453		if matched {
454			copy := lock
455			row.Lock = &copy
456			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills
457			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnchecked
458			row.UpdateDetail = ""
459			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)
460			row.SourceType = safeSourceType(lock.SourceType)
461			return row
462		}
463		if len(candidates) > 1 {
464			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
465		}
466		return row
467	}

497	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
498		files, err := skill.Files()
499		if err != nil {
500			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
501			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
502			return
503		}
504		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
505		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
506		for index := range row.Installations {
507			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
508			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
509			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
510			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
511				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
512				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
513			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
514				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
515				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
516			}
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
521		for relative, want := range files {
522			got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
523			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
524				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
525			}
526		}
527		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
528	}

530	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
531	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
532	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
533		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
534			return UpdateCurrent, detail
535		}
536		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
537			return UpdateAvailable, detail
538		}
539		return UpdateFailed, detail
540	}

542	func sourceDisplay(value string) string {
543		if value == "" {
544			return ""
545		}
546		if !safeDisplayValue(value) {
547			return "[redacted]"
548		}
549		value = repo.RedactCloneRef(value)
550		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
551		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
552			parsed.User = nil
553			parsed.RawQuery = ""
554			parsed.ForceQuery = false
555			parsed.Fragment = ""
556			return parsed.String()
557		}
558		return value
559	}

561	func safeSourceType(value string) string {
562		if value == "" || safeDisplayValue(value) {
563			return value
564		}
565		return "[redacted]"
566	}

573		result := make([]Diagnostic, len(input))
574		for index, diagnostic := range input {
575			result[index] = decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic, target)

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}

209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}

217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}

283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}

305			return false

371		for _, result := range results {

386	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
387		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
388			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
389			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
390				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
391			}
392			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
393				return left.Repository < right.Repository
394			}
395			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
396				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
397			}
398			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
399			if leftName != rightName {
400				return leftName < rightName
401			}
402			if left.Name != right.Name {
403				return left.Name < right.Name
404			}
405			return left.Path < right.Path
406		})
407	}

409	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
410		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
411			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
412			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
413				return left.Repository < right.Repository
414			}
415			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
416				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
417			}
418			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
419				return left.Scope < right.Scope
420			}
421			if left.Path != right.Path {
422				return left.Path < right.Path
423			}
424			if left.Name != right.Name {
425				return left.Name < right.Name
426			}
427			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
428				return left.Kind < right.Kind
429			}
430			return left.Message < right.Message
431		})
432	}
433	
434	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {
435		if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
436			return false
437		}
438		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
439			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
440		})
441	}
442	
443	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
444		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
445		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)
455		}
456		sort.Strings(out)
457		return out
458	}

460	func homeDirectory() string {
461		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
462		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
463			return ""
464		}
465		return home
466	}

57	func readLockDocument(filename string, scope Scope, minimumVersion, maximumVersion int) lockDocument {

186	func lockDiagnostic(kind DiagnosticKind, scope Scope, filename, message string) Diagnostic {
187		return Diagnostic{Kind: kind, Scope: scope, Path: filename, Message: message}

190	func (document lockDocument) buildNamesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
191		groups := map[string][]string{}
192		for name, entry := range document.Entries {
193			normalized := entry.NormalizedName
194			if normalized == "" {
195				normalized = normalizedName(name)
196			}
197			groups[normalized] = append(groups[normalized], name)
198		}
199		for normalized := range groups {
200			sort.Strings(groups[normalized])
201		}
202		return groups
203	}
204	
205	func (document lockDocument) namesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
206		if document.normalized != nil {
207			return document.normalized
208		}
209		return document.buildNamesByNormalized()
210	}
211	
212	func (document lockDocument) collisionDiagnostics() []Diagnostic {
213		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
214		groups := document.namesByNormalized()
215		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
216		for normalized := range groups {
217			keys = append(keys, normalized)
218		}
219		sort.Strings(keys)
220		for _, normalized := range keys {
221			names := groups[normalized]
222			if normalized != "" && len(names) < 2 {
223				continue
224			}
225			message := fmt.Sprintf("lock names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized)
226			if normalized == "" {
227				message = fmt.Sprintf("lock name %s has no usable normalized name", strings.Join(names, ", "))
228			}
229			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
230				Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: document.Scope, Path: document.Path,
231				Name: normalized, Message: message,
232			})
233		}
234		return diagnostics
235	}

237	// find applies deterministic lock matching: exact spelling wins; a normalized
238	// spelling is accepted only when it identifies one lock entry.
239	func (document lockDocument) find(name string) (LockMetadata, bool) {
240		if entry, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
241			return entry, true
242		}
243		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalizedName(name)]
244		if len(names) != 1 {
245			return LockMetadata{}, false
246		}
247		entry, ok := document.Entries[names[0]]
248		return entry, ok
249	}

252		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalized]
253		entries := make([]LockMetadata, 0, len(names))
254		for _, name := range names {
255			entries = append(entries, document.Entries[name])
256		}
257		return entries
258	}

261		if stateHome := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("XDG_STATE_HOME")); filepath.IsAbs(stateHome) {
262			return filepath.Join(filepath.Clean(stateHome), "skills", ".skill-lock.json")
263		}
264		home := homeDirectory()
265		if home == "" {
266			return ""
267		}
268		return filepath.Join(home, ".agents", ".skill-lock.json")
269	}

271	// GlobalLockPath returns the native global lock location. Relative
272	// XDG_STATE_HOME values are ignored as required by the XDG specification.
273	func GlobalLockPath() string { return globalLockPath() }

275	func normalizedName(value string) string {
276		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
277		var builder strings.Builder
278		lastDash := false
279		for _, character := range value {
280			valid := character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '_'
281			if valid {
282				builder.WriteRune(character)
283				lastDash = false
284			} else if !lastDash {
285				builder.WriteByte('-')
286				lastDash = true
287			}
288		}
289		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
290	}

16	type provider struct {

18		label string
19	}
20	
21	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
22	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
23	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
24	type MutationProvider struct {
25		Available bool
26		Command   string
27		Path      string
28		Detail    string
29	}
30	
31	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
32	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
33	// or project code.
34	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
35		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
36	}
37	
38	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
39	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
40	// mutates it.
41	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
42		if path, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
43			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
44				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
45			}
46			return MutationProvider{Path: path, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside a repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
47		}
48		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
49			return MutationProvider{
50				Path:   path,
51				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
52			}
53		}
54		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
55	}
56	
57	func trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot string) (string, bool) {
58		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
59			return "", false
60		}
61		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
62		if pathUsesNodeModulesBin(clean) || projectRoot != "" && lexicalPathInside(projectRoot, clean) {
63			return "", false
64		}
65		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(clean)
66		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) || pathUsesNodeModulesBin(resolved) {
67			return "", false
68		}
69		resolved = filepath.Clean(resolved)
70		if projectRoot != "" {
71			inside, err := pathx.Contains(projectRoot, resolved)
72			if err != nil || inside {
73				return "", false
74			}
75		}
76		return resolved, true
77	}
78	
79	func pathUsesNodeModulesBin(path string) bool {
80		parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(path), "/")
81		for index := 0; index+1 < len(parts); index++ {
82			if parts[index] == "node_modules" && parts[index+1] == ".bin" {
83				return true
84			}
85		}
86		return false
87	}
88	
89	func interactiveProvider(projectRoot string) (provider, error) {
90		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot)
91		if !status.Available {
92			return provider{}, errors.New(status.Detail)
93		}
94		return provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}, nil
95	}
96	
97	func (p provider) command(ctx context.Context, cwd string, args ...string) *exec.Cmd {
98		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, p.bin, args...)
99		cmd.Dir = cwd
100		return cmd
101	}
102	
103	func canonicalMutationRoot(root string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
104		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
105		if err != nil {
106			return "", err
107		}
108		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
109		if err != nil {
110			if allowMissing && os.IsNotExist(err) {
111				return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
112			}
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve skill mutation root: %w", err)
114		}
115		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
116		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
117			return "", errors.New("skill mutation root is not a directory")
118		}
119		return filepath.Clean(resolved), nil
120	}
121	
122	func lexicalPathInside(root, candidate string) bool {
123		root, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
124		candidate, candidateErr := filepath.Abs(candidate)
125		if rootErr != nil || candidateErr != nil {
126			return false
127		}
128		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(root), filepath.Clean(candidate))
129		return err == nil && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != ".." &&
130			!strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
131	}
132	
133	func safeProviderSkillName(name string) bool {
134		return name == strings.TrimSpace(name) && !strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") && safeDisplayValue(name)
135	}
136	
137	func safeProviderArgument(value string) bool {
138		return value == strings.TrimSpace(value) && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "-") && safeDisplayValue(value)
139	}
140	
141	// AddCommand opens the upstream interactive installer in projectRoot.
142	func AddCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
143		if source == "" {
144			source = DefaultSource
145		}
146		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
147			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
148		}
149		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, err
152		}
153		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		return p.command(ctx, root, "add", source), nil
158	}
159	
160	// InstallCommand installs an explicit set of skills for explicit agents in
161	// project scope. The caller owns confirmation; --yes only suppresses the
162	// provider's duplicate prompt after that decision.
163	func InstallCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string, names, agents []string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
164		if source == "" {
165			source = DefaultSource
166		}
167		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
168			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
169		}
170		if len(names) == 0 {
171			return nil, errors.New("at least one skill is required")
172		}
173		for _, name := range names {
174			if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
175				return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
176			}
177		}
178		if len(agents) == 0 {
179			return nil, errors.New("at least one agent is required")
180		}
181		for _, agent := range agents {
182			if !safeProviderArgument(agent) {
183				return nil, errors.New("agent name is not safe to pass to the provider")
184			}
185		}
186		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		args := []string{"add", source, "--skill"}
191		args = append(args, names...)
192		args = append(args, "--agent")
193		args = append(args, agents...)
194		args = append(args, "--yes")
195		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(ProjectRoot(ctx, projectRoot), true)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
200	}
201	
202	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
203	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
204		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
205			return nil, errors.New("dev-cli is managed by the dev binary, not the skills provider")
206		}
207		if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
208			return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
209		}
210		if scope != ScopeProject && scope != ScopeGlobal {
211			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
212		}
213		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, err
216		}
217		args := []string{"update", "--yes"}
218		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
219			args = append(args, "--global")
220		} else {
221			args = append(args, "--project")
222		}
223		args = append(args, name)
224		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
229	}
230	
231	// ProviderVersion reports a directly installed skills executable. It never
232	// falls back to npx, even with --no-install, because version probes are reads.
233	func ProviderVersion(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (string, error) {
234		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(cwd)
235		if !status.Available {
236			return "", errors.New(status.Detail)
237		}
238		p := provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}
239		cmd := p.command(ctx, cwd, "--version")
240		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
241		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
242		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
243			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
244			if detail == "" {
245				detail = err.Error()
246			}
247			return "", fmt.Errorf("skills: %s", detail)
248		}
249		return "skills " + strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
250	}

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}
180	
181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {
182		switch base {
183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:
186			return home, ""
187		case baseConfigHome:
188			if value := absoluteEnvironment("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"); value != "" {
189				return value, "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
190			}
191			if home == "" {
192				return "", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
193			}
194			return filepath.Join(home, ".config"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
195		case baseCodexHome:
196			return environmentBase("CODEX_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".codex")), "CODEX_HOME"
197		case baseClaudeHome:
198			return environmentBase("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", filepath.Join(home, ".claude")), "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
199		case baseVibeHome:
200			return environmentBase("VIBE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".vibe")), "VIBE_HOME"
201		case baseHermesHome:
202			return environmentBase("HERMES_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".hermes")), "HERMES_HOME"
203		case baseAutohandHome:
204			return environmentBase("AUTOHAND_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".autohand")), "AUTOHAND_HOME"
205		case baseGrokHome:
206			return environmentBase("GROK_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".grok")), "GROK_HOME"
207		case baseOpenClawHome:
208			if home == "" {
209				return "", ""
210			}
211			for _, candidate := range []string{".openclaw", ".clawdbot", ".moltbot"} {
212				path := filepath.Join(home, candidate)
213				if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
214					return path, ""
215				}
216			}
217			return filepath.Join(home, ".openclaw"), ""
218		default:
219			return home, ""
220		}
221	}
222	
223	func environmentBase(name, fallback string) string {
224		if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); filepath.IsAbs(value) {
225			return filepath.Clean(value)
226		}
227		if filepath.IsAbs(fallback) {
228			return fallback
229		}
230		return ""
231	}
232	
233	func absoluteEnvironment(name string) string {
234		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
235		if filepath.IsAbs(value) {
236			return filepath.Clean(value)
237		}
238		return ""
239	}

61	// CheckUpdates compares lock-recorded content with current Git sources. Source
62	// URL and ref pairs are fetched once, execution is bounded, installed files are

64	func CheckUpdates(ctx context.Context, rows []Skill) []Skill {

66			clone: cloneSourceCheckout, check: checkOneResult, workers: defaultUpdateWorkers,

70	func checkUpdatesWith(ctx context.Context, rows []Skill, deps updateCheckDeps) []Skill {
71		out := append([]Skill(nil), rows...)
72		groupsByKey := map[string][]updateMember{}
73		for index := range out {
74			metadata := skillLock(out[index])
75			if out[index].ManagedBy != ManagedBySkills || metadata == nil {
76				continue
77			}
78			url, ok := sourceURL(*metadata)
79			if !ok || metadata.SkillPath == "" {
80				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
81				out[index].UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no checkable Git source and skill path"
82				continue
83			}
84			if _, safe := safeSkillFolder(metadata.SkillPath); !safe {
85				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
86				out[index].UpdateDetail = "invalid skill path in lock entry"
87				continue
88			}
89			normalized := *metadata
90			if normalized.RecordedHash == "" || normalized.HashKind == "" {
91				normalizeRecordedHash(&normalized)
92			}
93			if normalized.RecordedHash == "" || normalized.HashKind == "" {
94				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
95				out[index].UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
96				continue
97			}
98			key := url + "\x00" + metadata.Ref
99			groupsByKey[key] = append(groupsByKey[key], updateMember{index: index, url: url, ref: metadata.Ref})
100		}
101	
102		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groupsByKey))
103		for key := range groupsByKey {
104			keys = append(keys, key)
105		}
106		sort.Strings(keys)
107		groups := make([]updateGroup, 0, len(keys))
108		for _, key := range keys {
109			groups = append(groups, updateGroup{key: key, members: groupsByKey[key]})
110		}
111		if len(groups) == 0 {
112			return out
113		}
114		if deps.clone == nil {
115			deps.clone = cloneSourceCheckout
116		}
117		if deps.check == nil {
118			deps.check = checkOneResult
119		}
120		if deps.workers <= 0 {
121			deps.workers = defaultUpdateWorkers
122		}
123		if deps.workers > len(groups) {
124			deps.workers = len(groups)
125		}
126	
127		jobs := make(chan int, len(groups))
128		results := make(chan updateGroupResult, len(groups))
129		for position := range groups {
130			jobs <- position
131		}
132		close(jobs)
133	
134		var workers sync.WaitGroup
135		workers.Add(deps.workers)

149						detail := "could not fetch source"
150						if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
151							detail = "update check canceled: " + ctxErr.Error()
152						}
153						result.updates = failedGroup(group, detail)
154						results <- result
155						continue
156					}
157					func() {
158						if checkout.cleanup != nil {
159							defer checkout.cleanup()
160						}
161						cached := map[string]rowUpdate{}
162						for _, member := range group.members {
163							if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
164								result.updates = append(result.updates, rowUpdate{member.index, UpdateFailed, "update check canceled: " + err.Error()})
165								continue
166							}
167							metadata := *skillLock(out[member.index])
168							if metadata.RecordedHash == "" || metadata.HashKind == "" {
169								normalizeRecordedHash(&metadata)
170							}
171							cacheKey := metadata.SkillPath + "\x00" + metadata.HashKind + "\x00" + metadata.RecordedHash
172							if previous, ok := cached[cacheKey]; ok {
173								previous.index = member.index
174								result.updates = append(result.updates, previous)
175								continue
176							}
177							status, detail := deps.check(ctx, checkout.dir, out[member.index])
178							update := rowUpdate{member.index, status, detail}

215	func sourceURL(entry LockMetadata) (string, bool) {
216		if entry.SourceType == "local" || entry.SourceType == "node_modules" || entry.SourceType == "well-known" {
217			return "", false
218		}
219		if entry.SourceURL != "" {
220			return entry.SourceURL, true
221		}
222		if entry.SourceType == "github" {
223			parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(entry.Source, "/"), "/")
224			if len(parts) >= 2 {
225				return "https://github.com/" + parts[0] + "/" + parts[1] + ".git", true
226			}
227		}
228		if strings.Contains(entry.Source, "://") || strings.HasSuffix(entry.Source, ".git") {
229			return entry.Source, true
230		}
231		return "", false
232	}

234	func cloneSourceCheckout(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (sourceCheckout, error) {

236		if err != nil {
237			return sourceCheckout{}, err
238		}
239		parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
240		return sourceCheckout{dir: dir, cleanup: func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }}, nil
241	}

243	func cloneSource(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (string, error) {
244		if !safeFetchRef(ref) {
245			return "", errors.New("skill source ref is not safe to pass to Git")
246		}
247		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-skill-check-*")
248		if err != nil {
249			return "", err
250		}
251		dir := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
252		if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, "", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", "--", url, dir); err != nil {
253			_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
254			return "", err
255		}
256		if ref != "" {
257			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", "origin", ref); err != nil {
258				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
259				return "", err
260			}
261			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
262				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
263				return "", err
264			}
265		}
266		return dir, nil
267	}
268	
269	func safeFetchRef(ref string) bool {
270		if ref == "" {
271			return true
272		}
273		if strings.TrimSpace(ref) != ref || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "-") {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !strings.ContainsFunc(ref, func(r rune) bool {
277			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
278		})
279	}
280	
281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""
283		computed := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ComputedHash)
284		folder := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.SkillFolderHash)
285		content := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ContentHash)
286	
287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {
288			switch {
289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {
301				return
302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"
310			return
311		}
312		// Scope-less package tests and older callers may still supply either global
313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func validHexHash(value string, length int) bool {
323		if len(value) != length {
324			return false
325		}
326		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
327		return err == nil
328	}
329	
330	func checkOneResult(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
331		entry := skillLock(row)
332		if entry == nil {
333			return UpdateUnknown, "skill has no lock metadata"
334		}
335		folder, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath)
336		if !ok {
337			return UpdateUnknown, "invalid skill path in lock entry"
338		}
339		abs := filepath.Join(repoDir, filepath.FromSlash(folder))
340		info, err := os.Stat(abs)
341		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
342			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
343				return UpdateMissing, "skill path no longer exists upstream"
344			}
345			return UpdateFailed, "could not inspect upstream skill path"
346		}
347		if !insidePath(repoDir, abs) {
348			return UpdateUnknown, "skill path escapes the fetched source"
349		}
350	
351		expected, kind := entry.RecordedHash, entry.HashKind
352		if expected == "" {
353			copy := *entry
354			normalizeRecordedHash(&copy)
355			expected, kind = copy.RecordedHash, copy.HashKind
356		}
357		var actual string
358		var hashErr error
359		switch kind {
360		case "git-tree":
361			spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
362			if folder != "" {
363				spec = "HEAD:" + folder
364			}
365			actual, hashErr = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
366		case "sha256-folder":
367			actual, hashErr = folderHashContext(ctx, abs)
368		case "sha256-skill-file":
369			actual, hashErr = fileHashContext(ctx, filepath.Join(abs, "SKILL.md"))
370		}
371		if hashErr != nil {
372			if ctx.Err() != nil {
373				return UpdateFailed, "update check canceled"
374			}
375			return UpdateFailed, "could not compute upstream content hash"
376		}
377		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
378			return UpdateUnknown, "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
379		}
380		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
381			return UpdateCurrent, "matches the recorded upstream content"
382		}
383		return UpdateAvailable, "upstream content changed"
384	}
385	
386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}
411	
412	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
413		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
414	}
415	
416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

190	func (document lockDocument) buildNamesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
191		groups := map[string][]string{}
192		for name, entry := range document.Entries {
193			normalized := entry.NormalizedName
194			if normalized == "" {
195				normalized = normalizedName(name)
196			}
197			groups[normalized] = append(groups[normalized], name)
198		}

208		}

212	func (document lockDocument) collisionDiagnostics() []Diagnostic {
213		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
214		groups := document.namesByNormalized()
215		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
216		for normalized := range groups {
217			keys = append(keys, normalized)
218		}
219		sort.Strings(keys)
220		for _, normalized := range keys {
221			names := groups[normalized]
222			if normalized != "" && len(names) < 2 {
223				continue
224			}
225			message := fmt.Sprintf("lock names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized)
226			if normalized == "" {
227				message = fmt.Sprintf("lock name %s has no usable normalized name", strings.Join(names, ", "))
228			}
229			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
230				Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: document.Scope, Path: document.Path,
231				Name: normalized, Message: message,
232			})
233		}
234		return diagnostics
235	}

237	// find applies deterministic lock matching: exact spelling wins; a normalized
238	// spelling is accepted only when it identifies one lock entry.
239	func (document lockDocument) find(name string) (LockMetadata, bool) {
240		if entry, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
241			return entry, true
242		}
243		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalizedName(name)]
244		if len(names) != 1 {
245			return LockMetadata{}, false
246		}
247		entry, ok := document.Entries[names[0]]
248		return entry, ok
249	}

253		entries := make([]LockMetadata, 0, len(names))
254		for _, name := range names {

275	func normalizedName(value string) string {
276		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
277		var builder strings.Builder
278		lastDash := false
279		for _, character := range value {
280			valid := character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '_'
281			if valid {
282				builder.WriteRune(character)
283				lastDash = false
284			} else if !lastDash {
285				builder.WriteByte('-')
286				lastDash = true
287			}
288		}
289		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
290	}
