91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}
132	
133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}
143	
144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {
145		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Diagnostic, 0, len(rows))
146		for _, row := range rows {
147			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered
153	}
154	
155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}

231	func skillInstallLabel(row agentskill.Skill) string {

256	func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
257		if len(agents) == 0 {
258			return "—"
259		}
260		names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
261		sort.Strings(names)
262		if len(names) <= 3 {
263			return strings.Join(names, ", ")
264		}
265		return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
266	}

268	func shortUpdate(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
269		switch status {
270		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
271			return "update"
272		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
273			return "missing"
274		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
275			return "unknown"
276		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
277			return "failed"
278		default:
279			return string(status)
280		}

461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}

500			CloneRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, string, error) {
501				dest, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(appState.Current(), r.Repo.Name)
502				if err != nil {
503					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
504				}
505				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
506					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots or clone somewhere explicit",
507						config.Contract(dest))
508				}
509				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, filepath.Dir(dest), "clone", r.Repo.CloneURL, dest); err != nil {
510					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
511				}
512				opened, err := openResolved(ctx, dest, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
513				if err != nil {
514					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
515				}
516				if opened.Directory != "" {
517					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
518				} else {
519					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
520				}
521				return opened, dest, nil
522			},

524			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
525				active := appState.Current()
526				current, err := active.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
527				if err != nil {
528					return "", err
529				}
530				updated := *current
531				if next != "" {
532					updated.Next = next
533				}
534				runtimeForTask(active, &updated) // normalize empty handle/name provenance
535				if updated.RuntimeHandle != "" {
536					if _, _, err := closeTaskRuntime(ctx, active, &updated, checkoutOf(&updated)); err != nil {
537						return "", err
538					}
539				}
540				// The dashboard only parks warm: going cold removes a checkout,
541				// which is too consequential for a single keystroke.
542				updated.State, updated.Owner = task.Warm, config.Hostname()
543				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
544					return "", err
545				}
546				return updated.Title() + " parked warm — worktree and branch kept", nil
547			},

564			// Start is the bridge from "here are my repositories" to "here is what
565			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the

567			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
570				if err != nil {

572				}
573				actionApp := *active
574				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
575				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
576					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
577				})
578				if err != nil {
579					return "", err
580				}
581				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
582				if err != nil {

585				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil

588			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
589				active := appState.Current()
590				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
591				if err != nil {
592					return "", err
593				}
594				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
595					return "", err
596				}
597				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
598				if err != nil {
599					return "", err
600				}
601				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
602					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
603				}
604				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
605				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
606					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
607				}
608				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
609				if err != nil {
610					return "", err
611				}
612				t := &task.Task{
613					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
614					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
615					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
616				}
617				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
618				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
619					return "", err
620				}
621				annotate(active, rt, t)
622				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
623			},

625			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
626				active := appState.Current()
627				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
628				if err != nil {
629					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
630				}
631				defer store.Close()
632				until := time.Now()
633				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
634				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
635					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
636				})
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
639				}
640				seconds, days := 0, 0
641				for _, value := range totals {
642					seconds += value
643					if value > 0 {
644						days++
645					}
646				}
647				return tui.StatsPanel{
648					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
649					Since: since, Until: until,
650					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
651						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
652					}),
653				}, nil
654			},
655

688			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
689				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
690				if err != nil {
691					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
692				}
693				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
694				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
695				if err != nil {
696					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
697				}
698				status := "config + data reloaded"
699				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
700					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
701				}
702				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
703					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
704					Tools:       externalTools(next),
705					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
706					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
707					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
708				}, status, nil
709			},
710		}
711	
712		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
713		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
714		// while dozens of repos are probed.
715		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
716		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
717		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
718		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
719		cancelRun()
720		app.finishTrace()
721		if err != nil {
722			return err
723		}
724		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
725		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
726		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
727			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
728				return app.cdDirective(dir)
729			}
730			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
731				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
732				if resolveErr != nil {
733					return resolveErr
734				}
735				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
736			}
737		}
738		return nil
739	}

741	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
742		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
743		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
744	}
745	
746	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
747		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
748		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
749		if err != nil {
750			return nil, err
751		}
752		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
753		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
754		if !sessionsSet {
755			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
756		}
757		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
758		for _, item := range items {
759			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
760			if item.Entry != nil {
761				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
762					copy := location
763					row.Location = &copy
764				}
765			}
766			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
767			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
768				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
769					sizeRepo = &discovered
770				}
771			}
772			if sizeRepo != nil {
773				worktreeCount := 0
774				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
775					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
776				}
777				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
778			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
779				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
780			}
781			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
782				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
783			}
784			if item.Live.Present {
785				for _, session := range sessions {
786					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
787						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
788						row.Live = true
789						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
790						break
791					}
792				}
793			}
794			rows = append(rows, row)
795		}
796		return rows, listErr
797	}
798	
799	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
800		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
801		if err != nil {
802			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
803		}
804		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
805			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
806				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
807				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
808			})
809			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
810			return item, resolveErr
811		}
812		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
813			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
814				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
815			}
816			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
817			if openErr != nil {
818				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
819			}
820			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
821			if rt.Name() == "none" {
822				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
823			} else {
824				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
825				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
826			}
827			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
828				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
829			}
830			return result, nil
831		}
832	
833		switch request.Action {
834		case tui.TryOpen:
835			item, resolveErr := resolve()
836			if resolveErr != nil {
837				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
838			}
839			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
840	
841		case tui.TryCreate:
842			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
843				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
844			})
845			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
846			if created.InitWarning != nil {
847				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
848			}
849			if createErr != nil {
850				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
851			}
852			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
853			if created.Existing {
854				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
855			}
856			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
857			result.RefreshRepos = true
858			return result, openErr
859	
860		case tui.TryMark:
861			item, resolveErr := resolve()
862			if resolveErr != nil {
863				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
864			}
865			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
866			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
867			note := request.Note
868			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
869				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
870			})
871			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
872			return tui.TryActionResult{
873				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
874			}, patchErr
875	
876		case tui.TryDeprecate:
877			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
878			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
879			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
880	
881		case tui.TryReactivate:
882			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
883			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
884			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
885	
886		case tui.TryArchive:
887			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
888			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
889			return tui.TryActionResult{
890				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
891			}, transitionErr
892	
893		case tui.TryRestore:
894			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
895			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
896			return tui.TryActionResult{
897				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
898			}, transitionErr
899	
900		case tui.TryGraduate:
901			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
902				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
903			})
904			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
905			if graduateErr != nil {
906				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
907			}
908			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
909			result.RefreshRepos = true
910			return result, openErr
911		}
912		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
913	}
914	
915	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
916	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
917	type repoCollectOptions struct {
918		IncludeTries bool
919		Sessions     []runtime.Session
920		SessionsSet  bool
921		Tasks        []*task.Task
922		TasksSet     bool
923		Repos        []repo.Repo
924		ReposSet     bool
925		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
926	}
927	
928	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
929	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
930	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
931		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
932	}
933	
934	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
935		repos := options.Repos
936		var err error
937		if !options.ReposSet {
938			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
939			if err != nil {
940				return nil, err
941			}
942		}
943		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
944		if err != nil {
945			return nil, err
946		}
947		if !options.IncludeTries {
948			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
949			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
950			for index, repository := range repos {
951				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
952					continue
953				}
954				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
955				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
956			}
957			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
958		}
959		tasks := options.Tasks
960		if !options.TasksSet {
961			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
962			if err != nil {
963				return nil, err
964			}
965		}
966		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
967		for _, t := range tasks {
968			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
969		}
970		sessions := options.Sessions
971		if !options.SessionsSet {
972			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
973		}
974		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
975		if app.Notes != nil {
976			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
977			if noteErr != nil {
978				return nil, noteErr
979			}
980			for _, n := range allNotes {
981				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
982			}
983		}
984	
985		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
986		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
987		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
988		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
989		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
990		limiter := options.Limiter
991		if limiter == nil {
992			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
993		}
994		var wg sync.WaitGroup
995		for i, r := range repos {
996			wg.Add(1)
997			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
998				defer wg.Done()
999				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1000				if !ok {
1001					return
1002				}
1003				defer release()
1004	
1005				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1006				if row.Asset != nil {
1007					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1008					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1009					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1010						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1011					}
1012				}
1013				if r.HasGit {
1014					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1015				}
1016				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1017				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1018					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1019				}
1020				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1021				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1022				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1023				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1024					row.Status = main.Status
1025				}
1026				if !r.Bare {
1027					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1028				}
1029				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1030					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1031					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1032				}
1033				if r.HasGit {
1034					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1035						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1036						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1037					}, row.Worktrees)
1038				} else {
1039					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1040				}
1041				out[i] = row
1042			}(i, r)
1043		}
1044		wg.Wait()
1045		return out, ctx.Err()
1046	}
1047	
1048	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1049	//
1050	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1051	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1052	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1053	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1054		var out []tui.Tool
1055		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1056			run := t.Run
1057			name := t.Name
1058			if name == "" {
1059				name = firstWord(run)
1060			}
1061			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1062			if t.Interactive {
1063				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1064				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1065				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1066				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1067				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1068			}
1069			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1070				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1071				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1072			})
1073		}
1074		return out
1075	}
1076	
1077	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1078	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1079	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1080	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1081		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1082	}
1083	
1084	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1085		if ctx == nil {
1086			ctx = context.Background()
1087		}
1088		word := firstWord(run)
1089		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1090			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1091			if word == "" {
1092				return false
1093			}
1094			word = firstWord(word)
1095		}
1096		if word == "" {
1097			return false
1098		}
1099		if interactive {
1100			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1101			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1102			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1103			defer cancel()
1104			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1105				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1106			return probe.Run() == nil
1107		}
1108		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1109			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1110			return err == nil
1111		}
1112		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1113		return err == nil
1114	}
1115	
1116	func firstWord(s string) string {
1117		f := strings.Fields(s)
1118		if len(f) == 0 {
1119			return ""
1120		}
1121		return f[0]
1122	}
1123	
1124	func shellPath() string {
1125		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1126			return s
1127		}
1128		return "/bin/sh"
1129	}
1130	
1131	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1132	// of private repositories.
1133	func remoteCachePath() string {
1134		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1135	}
1136	
1137	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1138		parts := []string{
1139			"forge-source-v1",
1140			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1141			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1142			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1143		}
1144		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1145			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1146		}
1147		sort.Strings(parts)
1148		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1149		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1150	}
1151	
1152	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1153	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1154	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1155	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1156		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1157		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1158		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1159			return nil, false, false
1160		}
1161		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1162		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1163			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1164		}
1165		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1166	}
1167	
1168	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1169	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1170	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1171		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1172		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1173			return nil, false
1174		}
1175		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1176	}
1177	
1178	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1179		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1180		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1181		for _, r := range locals {
1182			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1183				continue
1184			}
1185			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1186			if ambiguous[key] {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1190				delete(byRemote, key)
1191				ambiguous[key] = true
1192				continue
1193			}
1194			byRemote[key] = r
1195		}
1196		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1197		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1198			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1199			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1200				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1201				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1202				if local.Asset != nil {
1203					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1204				}
1205			}
1206			out = append(out, row)
1207		}
1208		return out
1209	}
1210	
1211	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1212	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1213	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1214	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1215		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1216		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1217			return nil, false
1218		}
1219		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1220	}
1221	
1222	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1223		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1224		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1225			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1226		}
1227		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1228	}
1229	
1230	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1231	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1232	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1233	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1234		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1235		LocalsSet    bool
1236		Providers    []forge.Forge
1237		ProvidersSet bool
1238	}
1239	
1240	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1241		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1242	}
1243	
1244	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1245		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1246	}
1247	
1248	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1249		type result struct {
1250			kind  forge.Kind
1251			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1252			err   error
1253		}
1254		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1255		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1256			if options.LocalsSet {
1257				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1258			}
1259			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1260		}
1261		providers := options.Providers
1262		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1263			providers = configuredForges(app)
1264		}
1265		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1266		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1267		available := 0
1268		var unavailable []error
1269		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1270		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1271		for _, f := range providers {
1272			if !f.Available() {
1273				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1274				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1275				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1276					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1277					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1278					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1279				}
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1283			available++
1284			wg.Add(1)
1285			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1286				defer wg.Done()
1287				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1288				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1289			}(f)
1290		}
1291		wg.Wait()
1292		close(ch)
1293		if available == 0 {
1294			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1295				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1296				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1297					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1298				}
1299				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1300			}
1301			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1302				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1303			}
1304			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1305		}
1306	
1307		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1308		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1309			old = forge.Cache{}
1310		}
1311		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1312		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1313		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1314			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1315		}
1316		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1317			statuses[kind] = status
1318		}
1319		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1320		successful := 0
1321		now := time.Now().UTC()
1322		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1323			status := statuses[kind]
1324			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1325			statuses[kind] = status
1326		}
1327		for res := range ch {
1328			if res.err != nil {
1329				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1330				status := statuses[res.kind]
1331				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1332				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1333					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1334					status.FetchedAt = now
1335					status.Complete = false
1336				}
1337				statuses[res.kind] = status
1338				continue
1339			}
1340			successful++
1341			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1342			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1343		}
1344		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1345		complete := true
1346		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1347		for kind := range expected {
1348			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1349			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1350				complete = false
1351			}
1352			if ok {
1353				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1354			}
1355			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1356		}
1357		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1358		if successful > 0 {
1359			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1360				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1361				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1362			})
1363		}
1364		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1365	}
1366	
1367	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1368		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1369			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1370				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1371			}
1372			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1373		})
1374	}
1375	
1376	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1377		providers := forge.All()
1378		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1379			return providers
1380		}
1381		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1382		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1383			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1384				Organization: target.Organization,
1385				Project:      target.Project,
1386			})
1387		}
1388		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1389	}
1390	
1391	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1392		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1393		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1394		if assetErr != nil {
1395			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1396			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1397		}
1398		type localMatch struct {
1399			repository repo.Repo
1400			asset      *catalog.Entry
1401		}
1402		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1403		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1404		for index, r := range locals {
1405			if r.Bare {
1406				continue
1407			}
1408			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1409			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1410				continue
1411			}
1412			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1413			if ambiguous[key] {
1414				continue
1415			}
1416			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1417				delete(localByRemote, key)
1418				ambiguous[key] = true
1419				continue
1420			}
1421			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1422		}
1423		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1424		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1425			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1426			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1427				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1428				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1429				if local.asset != nil {
1430					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1431				}
1432			}
1433			out = append(out, row)
1434		}
1435		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1436		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1437		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1438		return out
1439	}
1440	
1441	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {

1452		}

1455		}
1456		host := config.Hostname()

1458		for _, entry := range entries {

1461				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {

1463			}

1473			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1474			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1475			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind

1485				return candidate
1486			}
1487		}

1489	}

1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1503			_ = os.Remove(path)

1529				}

1	package inventory
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
181		for i, component := range components {
182			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
184			}
185		}
186		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
187		if err != nil {
188			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
189		}
190		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
191	}
192	
193	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
194		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
195			return false
196		}
197		letter := component[0]
198		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
199	}
200	
201	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
202		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
203			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
204		}) {
205			if component == ".." {
206				return true
207			}
208		}
209		return false
210	}

184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}

194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {

196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)

206		}

208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))

213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return

231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)

234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)

258		}

262		}

409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}

37	func applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows []Declaration, enabled, disabled map[string]bool, enableAll *bool) {

39			explicitEnabled, isDisabled := enabled[rows[index].Name], disabled[rows[index].Name]
40			allEnabled := enableAll != nil && *enableAll
41			switch {
42			case explicitEnabled && isDisabled:
43				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
44				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
45				addCoverage(&rows[index], DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
46			case isDisabled:
47				value := false
48				rows[index].Enabled = &value
49				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
50			case explicitEnabled || allEnabled:
51				value := true
52				rows[index].Enabled = &value
53				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
54			}
55			finalizeDeclaration(&rows[index])
56		}
57	}

85	func parseClaudeUser(data []byte, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode, []Diagnostic) {
86		var document claudeDocument

88			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}, nil
89		}
90		rows, codes := convertClaudeServers(document.MCPServers, spec, nil)
91		if len(document.Projects) == 0 || len(targets) == 0 {
92			return rows, codes, nil
93		}
94		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
95	
96		projectKeys := make([]string, 0, len(document.Projects))
97		for projectPath := range document.Projects {
98			projectKeys = append(projectKeys, projectPath)
99		}
100		sort.Strings(projectKeys)
101		for _, projectPath := range projectKeys {
102			target, ok := matchClaudeTarget(projectPath, targets)
103			if !ok {
104				continue
105			}
106			localSpec := spec
107			localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
108			localSpec.repository = target.RepoDisplay
109			localSpec.repositoryPath = target.RepoPath
110			localSpec.checkout = target.CheckoutRoot
111			localSpec.projectRoot = ""
112			var project claudeProject
113			if code := decodeJSON(document.Projects[projectPath], &project); code != "" {
114				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
115				continue
116			}
117			state := &claudeProjectState{
118				enabled:  normalizeNameSet(project.EnabledMCPServers),
119				disabled: normalizeNameSet(project.DisabledMCPServers),
120			}
121			localRows, localCodes := convertClaudeServers(project.MCPServers, localSpec, state)
122			rows = append(rows, localRows...)
123			for _, code := range localCodes {
124				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
125			}
126		}
127		return rows, codes, diagnostics

150			if state != nil {
151				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
152				switch {
153				case enabled && disabled:
154					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
155					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
156					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157				case enabled:
158					value := true
159					row.Enabled = &value
160					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
161				case disabled:
162					value := false
163					row.Enabled = &value
164					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
165				}
166			}

173	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
174		setCommand(row, server.Command)
175		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
176		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
177		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
178		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
179		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
180		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
181			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
182		}
183		if server.OAuth != nil {
184			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
185			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
186			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
187			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
188		}
189	
190		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
191		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
192		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
193		if hasCommand && hasURL {
194			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
195		}
196		switch typeName {
197		case "stdio":
198			if hasCommand {
199				row.Transport = TransportStdio
200			}
201		case "http", "streamable-http":
202			if hasURL {
203				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
204			}
205		case "sse":
206			if hasURL {
207				row.Transport = TransportSSE
208			}
209		case "ws", "websocket":
210			if hasURL {
211				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
212			}
213		case "":
214			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
215				row.Transport = TransportStdio
216			}
217		}
218		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
220		}
221	}

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false
245		}
246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
247		if err != nil {
248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
251		candidateReal := candidate
252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}

274		if value == nil {
275			return nil
276		}
277		copy := *value
278		return &copy
279	}

81	func convertCodexServer(row *Declaration, server map[string]any) {
82		command, _ := stringField(server, "command")
83		url, _ := stringField(server, "url")
84		setCommand(row, command)
85		inspectArguments(row, stringSlice(server["args"]))
86		inspectEnvironment(row, stringMap(server["env"]))
87		inspectCodexEnvVars(row, server["env_vars"])
88		setEndpoint(row, url)
89		inspectHeaders(row, stringMap(server["http_headers"]))
90		inspectEnvironmentHeaders(row, stringMap(server["env_http_headers"]))
91		if helper, ok := stringField(server, "http_headers_helper"); ok {
92			inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(helper) != "")
93		}
94		if bearer, ok := stringField(server, "bearer_token_env_var"); ok {
95			inspectBearerEnvironment(row, bearer)
96		}
97		if enabled, ok := boolField(server, "enabled"); ok {
98			row.Enabled = &enabled
99		}
100		if required, ok := boolField(server, "required"); ok {
101			row.Required = &required
102		}
103		applyCodexPolicy(row, server)
104	
105		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(command) != ""
106		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(url) != ""
107		if hasCommand && hasURL {
108			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
109		}
110		switch {
111		case hasURL:
112			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
113		case hasCommand:
114			row.Transport = TransportStdio
115		default:
116			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
117		}
118	
119		if auth, ok := stringField(server, "auth"); ok && auth != "" {
120			switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)) {
121			case "oauth", "chatgpt":
122				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)), 0)
123			default:
124				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
125			}
126		}
127		if oauth := tableValue(server["oauth"]); len(oauth) > 0 {
128			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
129			for _, field := range []string{"client_id", "callback_url", "callback_port"} {
130				if value, ok := scalarString(oauth[field]); ok {
131					inspectOAuthValue(row, strings.ReplaceAll(field, "_", "-"), value)

137	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {
138		if enabled, ok := boolField(values, "enabled"); ok {

142			}

62			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
63				codes = append(codes, code)
64				continue
65			}
66			convertGeminiServer(&row, server)
67			isAllowed, isExcluded := allowed[row.Name], excluded[row.Name]
68			if isAllowed {
69				addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
70			}
71			if isExcluded {
72				addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
73			}
74			if isAllowed && isExcluded {
75				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
76			}
77			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
78			rows = append(rows, row)
79		}
80		return rows, codes
81	}

83	func convertGeminiServer(row *Declaration, server geminiServer) {
84		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
85		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
86		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
87		row.Trusted = copyBool(server.Trust)
88		if len(server.IncludeTools) > 0 {
89			addPolicy(row, PolicyIncludeTools, "", len(server.IncludeTools))
90		}
91		if len(server.ExcludeTools) > 0 {
92			addPolicy(row, PolicyExcludeTools, "", len(server.ExcludeTools))
93		}
94	
95		hasHTTP := strings.TrimSpace(server.HTTPURL) != ""
96		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
97		hasTCP := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP) != ""
98		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
99		transportFields := 0
100		for _, present := range []bool{hasHTTP, hasURL, hasTCP, hasCommand} {
101			if present {
102				transportFields++
103			}
104		}
105		if transportFields > 1 {
106			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticTransportPrecedence)
107		}
108		switch {
109		case hasHTTP:
110			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
111			setEndpoint(row, server.HTTPURL)
112		case hasTCP:
113			row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
114			endpoint := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP)
115			if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
116				endpoint = "tcp://" + endpoint
117			}
118			setEndpoint(row, endpoint)
119		case hasURL:
120			typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
121			switch typeName {
122			case "http", "streamable-http":
123				row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
124			case "sse":
125				row.Transport = TransportSSE
126			case "":
127				row.Transport = TransportRemote
128				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
129			default:
130				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
131				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
132			}
133			setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
134		case hasCommand:
135			row.Transport = TransportStdio
136			setCommand(row, server.Command)
137		default:
138			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
139		}
140	
141		if server.AuthProviderType != "" {
142			auth := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.AuthProviderType))
143			switch auth {
144			case "dynamic_discovery", "google_credentials", "service_account_impersonation":
145				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, auth, 0)
146			default:
147				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
148			}
149		}
150		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-audience", server.TargetAudience)
151		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-service-account", server.TargetServiceAccount)
152		if server.OAuth != nil {
153			if server.OAuth.Enabled != nil {
154				addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, *server.OAuth.Enabled)
155			} else {
156				addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
157			}
158			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
159			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", server.OAuth.ClientSecret)
160			inspectOAuthValue(row, "authorization-url", server.OAuth.AuthorizationURL)

166			}
167			for _, audience := range server.OAuth.Audiences {
168				inspectOAuthValue(row, "audience", audience)

170		}

31	func parseOpenCode(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
32		standard, err := hujson.Standardize(data)
33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument
37		if code := decodeJSON(standard, &document); code != "" {
38			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
39		}
40		var rows []Declaration
41		var codes []DiagnosticCode
42		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCP) {
43			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			var server openCodeServer
49			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCP[rawName], &server); code != "" {
50				codes = append(codes, code)
51				continue
52			}
53			convertOpenCodeServer(&row, server)
54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}
57		return rows, codes
58	}
59	
60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}

78	func convertOpenCodeServer(row *Declaration, server openCodeServer) {
79		row.Enabled = copyBool(server.Enabled)
80		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Environment)
81		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
82	
83		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {
87		case "local":
88			row.Transport = TransportLocal
89			if hasCommand {
90				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
91				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
92			} else {
93				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
94			}
95			if hasURL {
96				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {

115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {

119			}

122	}

124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}

136			return
137		}

139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)

237	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
238	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
239		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
240			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
241			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
242			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
243			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
244			return false
245		}
246		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
247			return false
248		}
249		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
250			return false
251		}
252		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
253			return false
254		}
255		return true
256	}

258	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
259	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
260		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
261		for _, row := range rows {
262			if f.Match(row) {
263				out = append(out, row)
264			}
265		}
266		return out

269	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
270	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
271		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
272			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
273			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
274			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
275			for n := range ak {
276				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
277					return ak[n] < bk[n]
278				}
279			}
280			return false
281		})
282	}

1	package agentmcp
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"context"
6		"errors"
7		"io"
8		"io/fs"
9		"os"
10		"path/filepath"
11		"strings"
12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14	)
15	
16	var errSymlinkLimit = errors.New("symlink limit reached")
17	
18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
91			}
92			if readErr != nil {
93				if !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
94					return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}
104	
105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}
