184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)
205			return result, err
206		}
207	
208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
209		jobs := make(chan int)
210		workers := s.options.Concurrency
211		if workers > len(targets) {
212			workers = len(targets)
213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return
230							}
231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
233							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)

266	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {
267		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
268			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
269		}
270		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
271			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
272		}
273		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
274			options.CodexHome = ""
275		}
276		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
277			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
278		}
279		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
280			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
281		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
282			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
283		}
284		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
285			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
286		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
287			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
288		}
289		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
290			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
291		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
292			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
293		}
294		return options
295	}

297	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
298		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
299		for _, target := range targets {
300			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
301				continue
302			}
303			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
304			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
305				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
306			}
307			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
308			if err != nil {
309				continue
310			}
311			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
312			if target.RepoPath == "" {
313				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
314			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
315				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
316			}
317			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
318			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
319				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
320			}
321			if target.CommonDir == "" {
322				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
323			}
324			out = append(out, target)
325		}
326		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
327	}

413				return nil, nil

442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)

447		case adapterGemini:

449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}

43				}

45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}

50					return err
51				}
52				project := len(scopeFilter) == 0 || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeProject] || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeLocal]

69				result.Diagnostics = filterMCPDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
70				if jsonOut {

72					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")

91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}

133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}
143	
144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {
145		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Diagnostic, 0, len(rows))
146		for _, row := range rows {
147			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered
153	}
154	
155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}

461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}

12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}

337	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
338		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
339		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340			return "", false, nil
341		}
342		if err != nil {
343			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not inspect SKILL.md: %w", err)
344		}
345		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
346			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
347		}
348		file, err := os.Open(filename)
349		if err != nil {
350			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
351		}
352		defer file.Close()
353		if openedInfo, err := file.Stat(); err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
354			return "", true, errors.New("opened SKILL.md is not a regular file")
355		}
356	
357		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
358		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
359		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
360		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
361		consumed := int64(len(first))
362		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
363			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
364		}
365		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
366		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
367			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
368		}
369		var frontmatter strings.Builder
370		closed := false
371		for {
372			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
373			consumed += int64(len(line))
374			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
375				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376			}
377			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
378				closed = true
379				break
380			}
381			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
382			if lineErr != nil {
383				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
384					break
385				}
386				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
387			}
388		}
389		if !closed {
390			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
391		}
392		var metadata struct {
393			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
394			Description string `yaml:"description"`
395		}
396		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
397			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
398		}
399		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
400		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
401		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
402			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
403		}
404		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
405			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
406		}
407		return metadata.Name, true, nil
408	}

410	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
411		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))
412		for _, installation := range group.Installations {
413			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
414			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
415			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
416			installations = append(installations, *installation)
417		}
418		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
419			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
420				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
421			}
422			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
423		})
424		var agents []string
425		for _, installation := range installations {
426			agents = append(agents, installation.AgentIDs...)
427		}
428		agentIDs := uniqueSorted(agents)
429		agents = agentDisplayNames(agentIDs)
430		row := Skill{
431			Name: name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot,
432			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
433			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
434			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
435			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
436			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,
437			UpdateDetail: "not tracked by the skills CLI",
438		}
439		if len(installations) > 0 {
440			row.Path = installations[0].Path
441		}
442		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
443			if name == skill.Name {
444				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
445				row.Source = "dev binary"
446				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
447				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
448			} else {

450			}
451			return row
452		}
453		if matched {
454			copy := lock
455			row.Lock = &copy
456			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills
457			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnchecked
458			row.UpdateDetail = ""
459			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)
460			row.SourceType = safeSourceType(lock.SourceType)
461			return row
462		}
463		if len(candidates) > 1 {
464			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
465		}
466		return row
467	}

497	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
498		files, err := skill.Files()
499		if err != nil {
500			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
501			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
502			return
503		}
504		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
505		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
506		for index := range row.Installations {
507			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
508			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
509			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
510			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
511				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
512				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
513			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
514				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
515				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
516			}
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
521		for relative, want := range files {
522			got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
523			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
524				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
525			}
526		}
527		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
528	}
529	
530	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
531	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
532	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
533		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
534			return UpdateCurrent, detail
535		}
536		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
537			return UpdateAvailable, detail
538		}
539		return UpdateFailed, detail
540	}

542	func sourceDisplay(value string) string {
543		if value == "" {
544			return ""
545		}
546		if !safeDisplayValue(value) {
547			return "[redacted]"
548		}
549		value = repo.RedactCloneRef(value)
550		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
551		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
552			parsed.User = nil
553			parsed.RawQuery = ""
554			parsed.ForceQuery = false
555			parsed.Fragment = ""
556			return parsed.String()
557		}
558		return value
559	}
560	
561	func safeSourceType(value string) string {
562		if value == "" || safeDisplayValue(value) {
563			return value
564		}
565		return "[redacted]"
566	}
567	
568	func registryAttribution(agentIDs []string) Attribution {
569		return Attribution{Registry: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, AgentIDs: uniqueSorted(agentIDs)}
570	}

572	func decorateDiagnostics(input []Diagnostic, target agenttarget.Target) []Diagnostic {
573		result := make([]Diagnostic, len(input))
574		for index, diagnostic := range input {
575			result[index] = decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic, target)
576		}
577		return result
578	}
579	
580	func decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic Diagnostic, target agenttarget.Target) Diagnostic {
581		diagnostic.Repository = target.RepoDisplay
582		diagnostic.RepositoryPath = target.RepoPath
583		diagnostic.Checkout = target.CheckoutRoot
584		return diagnostic
585	}

190	func (document lockDocument) buildNamesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
191		groups := map[string][]string{}
192		for name, entry := range document.Entries {
193			normalized := entry.NormalizedName
194			if normalized == "" {
195				normalized = normalizedName(name)
196			}
197			groups[normalized] = append(groups[normalized], name)
198		}
199		for normalized := range groups {
200			sort.Strings(groups[normalized])
201		}
202		return groups
203	}

206		if document.normalized != nil {

208		}

210	}

212	func (document lockDocument) collisionDiagnostics() []Diagnostic {
213		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
214		groups := document.namesByNormalized()
215		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
216		for normalized := range groups {
217			keys = append(keys, normalized)
218		}
219		sort.Strings(keys)
220		for _, normalized := range keys {
221			names := groups[normalized]
222			if normalized != "" && len(names) < 2 {
223				continue
224			}
225			message := fmt.Sprintf("lock names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized)
226			if normalized == "" {
227				message = fmt.Sprintf("lock name %s has no usable normalized name", strings.Join(names, ", "))
228			}
229			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
230				Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: document.Scope, Path: document.Path,
231				Name: normalized, Message: message,
232			})
233		}
234		return diagnostics
235	}

237	// find applies deterministic lock matching: exact spelling wins; a normalized
238	// spelling is accepted only when it identifies one lock entry.
239	func (document lockDocument) find(name string) (LockMetadata, bool) {
240		if entry, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
241			return entry, true
242		}
243		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalizedName(name)]
244		if len(names) != 1 {
245			return LockMetadata{}, false
246		}
247		entry, ok := document.Entries[names[0]]
248		return entry, ok
249	}

253		entries := make([]LockMetadata, 0, len(names))
254		for _, name := range names {
255			entries = append(entries, document.Entries[name])
256		}

262			return filepath.Join(filepath.Clean(stateHome), "skills", ".skill-lock.json")

272	// XDG_STATE_HOME values are ignored as required by the XDG specification.

275	func normalizedName(value string) string {
276		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
277		var builder strings.Builder
278		lastDash := false
279		for _, character := range value {
280			valid := character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '_'
281			if valid {
282				builder.WriteRune(character)
283				lastDash = false
284			} else if !lastDash {
285				builder.WriteByte('-')
286				lastDash = true
287			}
288		}
289		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
290	}

 // listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
 // render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
 // chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
 // Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
 func (m Model) listHeight() int {
 	// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
 	// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
 	// terminal width.
 	fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
 	h := m.height - fixed
 	if h < 3 {
 		return 3
 	}
 	// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
 	if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
 		h--
 	}
 	return h
 }

+func renderSkillDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentskill.Diagnostic) {

 func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
 	if len(agents) == 0 {
 		return "—"
 	}
 	names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
 	sort.Strings(names)
 	if len(names) <= 3 {
 		return strings.Join(names, ", ")
 	}
 	return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
 }
 
 func shortUpdate(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
 	switch status {
 	case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
 		return "update"
 	case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
 		return "missing"
 	case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
 		return "unknown"
 	case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
 		return "failed"
 	default:
 		return string(status)
 	}
 }

192	// Target is shared with native skill inventory so repository and linked-
193	// checkout identity cannot drift between the two domains.
194	type Target = agenttarget.Target
195	
196	// Coverage states the fixed limits of this static inventory. It is product
197	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.
198	type Coverage struct {
199		Agents                 []Agent  `json:"agents"`
200		StaticDeclarationsOnly bool     `json:"static_declarations_only"`
201		OmittedSources         []string `json:"omitted_sources"`
202	}
203	
204	// Result contains partial declarations and non-fatal per-source diagnostics.
205	type Result struct {
206		Declarations []Declaration `json:"servers"`
207		Diagnostics  []Diagnostic  `json:"diagnostics"`
208		Coverage     Coverage      `json:"coverage"`
209	}
210	
211	func defaultCoverage() Coverage {
212		return Coverage{
213			Agents:                 []Agent{AgentClaudeCode, AgentCodex, AgentCursor, AgentGeminiCLI, AgentOpenCode},
214			StaticDeclarationsOnly: true,
215			OmittedSources: []string{
216				"runtime health and command-line-only configuration",
217				"plugin caches and hosted connectors",
218				"remote organization configuration",
219				"inline OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT",
220			},
221		}
222	}
223	
224	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
225	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
226	type Filter struct {
227		Agent          Agent
228		Scope          Scope
229		Source         DeclarationSource
230		Transport      Transport
231		Repository     string
232		NameContains   string
233		Enabled        *bool
234		HasCredentials *bool
235	}
236	
237	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
238	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
239		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
240			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
241			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
242			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
243			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
244			return false
245		}
246		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
247			return false
248		}
249		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
250			return false
251		}
252		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
253			return false
254		}
255		return true
256	}
257	
258	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
259	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
260		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
261		for _, row := range rows {
262			if f.Match(row) {
263				out = append(out, row)
264			}
265		}
266		return out
267	}
268	
269	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
270	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
271		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
272			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
273			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
274			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
275			for n := range ak {
276				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
277					return ak[n] < bk[n]
278				}
279			}
280			return false
281		})
282	}
283	
284	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
285		switch scope {
286		case ScopeProject:
287			return "0-project"
288		case ScopeLocal:
289			return "1-local"
290		case ScopeUser:
291			return "2-user"
292		case ScopeCustom:
293			return "3-custom"
294		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
295			return "4-system-defaults"
296		case ScopeSystemOverride:
297			return "5-system-override"
298		case ScopeManaged:
299			return "6-managed"
300		default:
301			return "9-" + string(scope)
302		}
303	}
304	
305	func diagnosticMessage(code DiagnosticCode) string {
306		switch code {
307		case DiagnosticUnreadable:
308			return "configuration file could not be read"
309		case DiagnosticTooLarge:
310			return "configuration file exceeds the scan size limit"
311		case DiagnosticNotRegular:
312			return "configuration source is not a regular file"
313		case DiagnosticSymlinkLimit:
314			return "configuration symlink chain exceeds the scan limit"
315		case DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape:
316			return "project configuration resolves outside the checkout"
317		case DiagnosticMalformed:
318			return "configuration file could not be decoded"
319		case DiagnosticControlCharacter:
320			return "configuration contains an unsupported control character"
321		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
322			return "server declaration has an invalid field"
323		case DiagnosticInvalidName:
324			return "server declaration has an invalid name"
325		case DiagnosticUnknownTransport:
326			return "server transport cannot be determined statically"
327		case DiagnosticConflictingTransport:
328			return "server declaration contains conflicting transport fields"
329		case DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint:
330			return "server endpoint could not be represented safely"
331		case DiagnosticInvalidReference:
332			return "credential reference name is invalid"
333		case DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent:
334			return "plugin override does not include the plugin server definition"
335		case DiagnosticTransportPrecedence:
336			return "lower-precedence transport fields were ignored"
337		default:
338			return "configuration could not be fully represented"
339		}
340	}
341	
342	func coverage(code DiagnosticCode) CoverageDiagnostic {
343		return CoverageDiagnostic{Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code)}
344	}

171	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
172	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
173		options = normalizeOptions(options)
174		s := &Scanner{options: options}
175		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
176		return s

179	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
180	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
181		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
182	}

184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)
205			return result, err
206		}
207	
208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
209		jobs := make(chan int)
210		workers := s.options.Concurrency
211		if workers > len(targets) {
212			workers = len(targets)
213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return
230							}
231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
233							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)
250				return result, ctx.Err()
251			}
252		}
253		close(jobs)
254		wg.Wait()
255		for _, partial := range projectResults {
256			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
257			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
258		}
259		finalizeResult(&result)
260		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
261			return result, err
262		}
263		return result, nil
264	}

18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {

20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}

90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])

101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}

105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false
245		}
246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
247		if err != nil {
248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
251		candidateReal := candidate
252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}

60				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
61				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent)
62				if override, ok := servers[rawName].(map[string]any); ok {

81	func convertCodexServer(row *Declaration, server map[string]any) {
82		command, _ := stringField(server, "command")
83		url, _ := stringField(server, "url")
84		setCommand(row, command)
85		inspectArguments(row, stringSlice(server["args"]))
86		inspectEnvironment(row, stringMap(server["env"]))

88		setEndpoint(row, url)
89		inspectHeaders(row, stringMap(server["http_headers"]))
90		inspectEnvironmentHeaders(row, stringMap(server["env_http_headers"]))
91		if helper, ok := stringField(server, "http_headers_helper"); ok {
92			inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(helper) != "")
93		}
94		if bearer, ok := stringField(server, "bearer_token_env_var"); ok {
95			inspectBearerEnvironment(row, bearer)

97		if enabled, ok := boolField(server, "enabled"); ok {

137	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {

226		case []any:

46	func parseGemini(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
47		var document geminiDocument
48		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
49			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
50		}
51		allowed := normalizeNameSet(document.MCP.Allowed)
52		excluded := normalizeNameSet(document.MCP.Excluded)
53		var rows []Declaration
54		var codes []DiagnosticCode
55		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCPServers) {
56			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
57			if !ok {
58				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
59				continue
60			}
61			var server geminiServer
62			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
63				codes = append(codes, code)
64				continue
65			}
66			convertGeminiServer(&row, server)
67			isAllowed, isExcluded := allowed[row.Name], excluded[row.Name]
68			if isAllowed {
69				addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
70			}
71			if isExcluded {
72				addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
73			}
74			if isAllowed && isExcluded {
75				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
76			}
77			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
78			rows = append(rows, row)
79		}
80		return rows, codes
81	}

83	func convertGeminiServer(row *Declaration, server geminiServer) {
84		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
85		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
86		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
87		row.Trusted = copyBool(server.Trust)
88		if len(server.IncludeTools) > 0 {
89			addPolicy(row, PolicyIncludeTools, "", len(server.IncludeTools))
90		}
91		if len(server.ExcludeTools) > 0 {
92			addPolicy(row, PolicyExcludeTools, "", len(server.ExcludeTools))
93		}
94	
95		hasHTTP := strings.TrimSpace(server.HTTPURL) != ""
96		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
97		hasTCP := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP) != ""
98		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
99		transportFields := 0
100		for _, present := range []bool{hasHTTP, hasURL, hasTCP, hasCommand} {
101			if present {
102				transportFields++
103			}
104		}
105		if transportFields > 1 {
106			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticTransportPrecedence)
107		}
108		switch {
109		case hasHTTP:
110			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
111			setEndpoint(row, server.HTTPURL)
112		case hasTCP:
113			row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
114			endpoint := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP)
115			if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
116				endpoint = "tcp://" + endpoint
117			}
118			setEndpoint(row, endpoint)
119		case hasURL:
120			typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
121			switch typeName {
122			case "http", "streamable-http":
123				row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
124			case "sse":
125				row.Transport = TransportSSE
126			case "":
127				row.Transport = TransportRemote
128				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
129			default:
130				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
131				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
132			}
133			setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
134		case hasCommand:
135			row.Transport = TransportStdio
136			setCommand(row, server.Command)
137		default:
138			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
139		}
140	
141		if server.AuthProviderType != "" {
142			auth := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.AuthProviderType))
143			switch auth {
144			case "dynamic_discovery", "google_credentials", "service_account_impersonation":
145				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, auth, 0)
146			default:
147				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
148			}
149		}
150		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-audience", server.TargetAudience)
151		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-service-account", server.TargetServiceAccount)
152		if server.OAuth != nil {
153			if server.OAuth.Enabled != nil {
154				addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, *server.OAuth.Enabled)
155			} else {
156				addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
157			}
158			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
159			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", server.OAuth.ClientSecret)
160			inspectOAuthValue(row, "authorization-url", server.OAuth.AuthorizationURL)
161			inspectOAuthValue(row, "token-url", server.OAuth.TokenURL)
162			inspectOAuthValue(row, "redirect-uri", server.OAuth.RedirectURI)
163			inspectOAuthValue(row, "token-parameter", server.OAuth.TokenParamName)
164			for _, scope := range server.OAuth.Scopes {
165				inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", scope)
166			}
167			for _, audience := range server.OAuth.Audiences {
168				inspectOAuthValue(row, "audience", audience)
169			}
170		}

33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument

50				codes = append(codes, code)

54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}

60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}

84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {

94			}
95			if hasURL {

97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}

113			if hasCommand {

124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {

128		}

131			return

139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)

203			return repository.Root

205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)

212			return Result{}, err

214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)

218	// regardless of target count.

220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true

227

229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}

243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}

252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {

290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {

345		rows, err := List(ctx, projectRoot, ListOptions{Project: true})
346		if err != nil {
347			return Skill{}, err
348		}
349		for _, row := range rows {
350			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && row.Name == name {
351				return row, nil
352			}
353		}
354		want := normalizedName(name)
355		var matches []Skill
356		for _, row := range rows {
357			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
358				matches = append(matches, row)
359			}
360		}
361		if len(matches) == 1 {
362			return matches[0], nil
363		}
364		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
365	}

367	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
368	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
369	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
370		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
371		for _, result := range results {
372			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
373			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
374			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
375				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
376			}
377			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
378				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
379			}
380		}
381		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
382		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
383		return merged

386	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
387		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
388			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
389			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
390				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
391			}
392			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
393				return left.Repository < right.Repository
394			}
395			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
396				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
397			}
398			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
399			if leftName != rightName {
400				return leftName < rightName
401			}
402			if left.Name != right.Name {
403				return left.Name < right.Name
404			}
405			return left.Path < right.Path
406		})
407	}
408	
409	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
410		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
411			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
412			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
413				return left.Repository < right.Repository
414			}
415			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
416				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
417			}
418			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
419				return left.Scope < right.Scope
420			}
421			if left.Path != right.Path {
422				return left.Path < right.Path
423			}
424			if left.Name != right.Name {
425				return left.Name < right.Name
426			}
427			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
428				return left.Kind < right.Kind
429			}
430			return left.Message < right.Message
431		})
432	}

434	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {

437		}
438		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
439			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
440		})
441	}

443	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
444		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
445		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)
455		}
456		sort.Strings(out)
457		return out
458	}

464		}

16	var errSymlinkLimit = errors.New("symlink limit reached")
17	
18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
91			}
92			if readErr != nil {
93				if !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
94					return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}
104	
105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

110		if strings.Contains(lower, "sentinel") && (strings.Contains(lower, "secret") || strings.Contains(lower, "token") || strings.Contains(lower, "password")) {

112		}
113		if (strings.HasPrefix(lower, "sk-") || strings.HasPrefix(lower, "ghp_") || strings.HasPrefix(lower, "github_pat_")) && len(value) >= 16 {
114			return true
115		}
116		if len(value) >= 64 {
117			letters := 0
118			for _, r := range value {
119				if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) || strings.ContainsRune("_-/+=", r) {
120					letters++
121				}
122			}
123			if letters == len([]rune(value)) {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}

138			ConfigPath: spec.path, Source: spec.source, Transport: TransportUnknown,
139		}, true

241	func inspectReferences(row *Declaration, value string) {
242		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
243		patterns := []*regexp.Regexp{wholeOpenCodeEnvPattern}
244		for _, pattern := range patterns {
245			match := pattern.FindStringSubmatch(value)
246			if len(match) == 2 {
247				addCredential(row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialEnvironmentReference, Name: match[1]})
248				return
249			}
250		}
251	}

253	func validEnvironmentName(value string) bool {
254		return len(value) <= maximumReferenceBytes && environmentNamePattern.MatchString(value) && !looksSecretString(value)

257	func validHeaderName(value string) bool {
258		return len(value) <= maximumReferenceBytes && headerNamePattern.MatchString(value) && !looksSecretString(value)

261	func setCommand(row *Declaration, command string) {
262		command = strings.TrimSpace(command)
263		if command == "" {
264			return
265		}
266		inspectReferences(row, command)
267		if openCodeFilePattern.MatchString(command) {
268			inspectFileReference(row, command)
269			row.Command = "[dynamic]"
270			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
271			return
272		}
273		if strings.Contains(command, "${") || strings.Contains(command, "{env:") ||
274			dollarPattern.MatchString(command) || percentPattern.MatchString(command) {
275			row.Command = "[dynamic]"
276			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
277			return
278		}
279		normalized := strings.ReplaceAll(command, `\`, "/")
280		basename := path.Base(normalized)
281		if basename == "." || basename == "/" || basename == "" || len(basename) > maximumNameBytes ||
282			!executableNamePattern.MatchString(basename) || strings.ContainsFunc(command, unicode.IsSpace) ||
283			looksSecretString(basename) {
284			row.Command = "[redacted]"
285			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
286			addRedaction(row, RedactionArguments)
287			return
288		}
289		row.Command = basename
290		if basename != command {
291			addRedaction(row, RedactionCommandPath)
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func setEndpoint(row *Declaration, raw string) {
296		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
297		if raw == "" {
298			return
299		}
300		inspectReferences(row, raw)
301		if openCodeFilePattern.MatchString(raw) {
302			inspectFileReference(row, raw)
303			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
304			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
305			return
306		}
307		if dollarBracePattern.MatchString(raw) || dollarPattern.MatchString(raw) || percentPattern.MatchString(raw) || openCodeEnvPattern.MatchString(raw) {
308			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
309			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
310			return
311		}
312		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
313		if err != nil || parsed.Opaque != "" || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" || !schemePattern.MatchString(parsed.Scheme) || stringContainsControl(parsed.Host) || looksSecretString(parsed.Host) {
314			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint)
315			return
316		}
317		if parsed.User != nil {
318			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLUserinfo)
319		}
320		if parsed.RawQuery != "" || parsed.ForceQuery {
321			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLQuery)
322		}
323		if parsed.Fragment != "" {
324			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLFragment)
325		}
326		endpoint := strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) + "://" + strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
327		if parsed.EscapedPath() != "" && parsed.EscapedPath() != "/" {
328			endpoint += "/[path]"
329			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLPath)
330		} else if parsed.EscapedPath() == "/" {
331			endpoint += "/"
332		}
333		row.Endpoint = endpoint
334	}
335	
336	func addCredential(row *Declaration, credential CredentialReference) {
337		if credential.Name != "" && (!utf8.ValidString(credential.Name) || stringContainsControl(credential.Name) || len(credential.Name) > maximumReferenceBytes) {
338			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
339			return
340		}
341		for _, existing := range row.Credentials {
342			if existing == credential {
343				return
344			}
345		}
346		row.Credentials = append(row.Credentials, credential)
347	}
348	
349	func addRedaction(row *Declaration, redaction Redaction) {
350		for _, existing := range row.Redactions {
351			if existing == redaction {
352				return
353			}
354		}
355		row.Redactions = append(row.Redactions, redaction)
356	}
357	
358	func addCoverage(row *Declaration, code DiagnosticCode) {
359		for _, existing := range row.Coverage {
360			if existing.Code == code {
361				return
362			}
363		}
364		row.Coverage = append(row.Coverage, coverage(code))
365	}
366	
367	func addPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value string, count int) {
368		fact := PolicyFact{Kind: kind, Value: value, Count: count}
369		for _, existing := range row.Policies {
370			if existing == fact {
371				return
372			}
373		}
374		row.Policies = append(row.Policies, fact)
375	}
376	
377	func addBooleanPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value bool) {
378		addPolicy(row, kind, strconv.FormatBool(value), 0)
379	}
380	
381	func finalizeDeclaration(row *Declaration) {
382		sort.Slice(row.Credentials, func(i, j int) bool {
383			if row.Credentials[i].Kind != row.Credentials[j].Kind {
384				return row.Credentials[i].Kind < row.Credentials[j].Kind
385			}
386			return row.Credentials[i].Name < row.Credentials[j].Name
387		})
388		sort.Slice(row.Redactions, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Redactions[i] < row.Redactions[j] })
389		sort.Slice(row.Policies, func(i, j int) bool {
390			if row.Policies[i].Kind != row.Policies[j].Kind {
391				return row.Policies[i].Kind < row.Policies[j].Kind
392			}
393			if row.Policies[i].Value != row.Policies[j].Value {
394				return row.Policies[i].Value < row.Policies[j].Value
395			}
396			return row.Policies[i].Count < row.Policies[j].Count
397		})
398		sort.Slice(row.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Coverage[i].Code < row.Coverage[j].Code })
399	}

60	func projectScanLocations(root string, definitions []AgentDefinition, document lockDocument) []physicalScanLocation {

64				continue

82					continue
83				}

124	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
125	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
126	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
127	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
128		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
129		for _, location := range input {
130			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
131			current := byLogical[path]
132			if current == nil {
133				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
134				byLogical[path] = &copy
135				current = &copy
136			}
137			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
138		}
139		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
140		for path := range byLogical {
141			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
142		}
143		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
144	
145		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
146		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
147			logical := *byLogical[path]
148			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)
149			physical := path
150			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
151				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
152			}
153			group := byPhysical[physical]
154			if group == nil {
155				group = &physicalScanLocation{Path: physical}
156				byPhysical[physical] = group
157			}
158			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
159		}
160		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
161		for path := range byPhysical {
162			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
163		}
164		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
165		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
166		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
167			group := byPhysical[path]
168			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
169			result = append(result, *group)
170		}
171		return result
172	}

174	func scanScope(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, locations []physicalScanLocation, document lockDocument) ([]Skill, []Diagnostic) {
175		diagnostics := decorateDiagnostics(document.Diagnostics, target)

179				break

194			group.Names = append(group.Names, found.Name)

204				installation.LogicalPaths = append(installation.LogicalPaths, found.Installation.LogicalPaths...)
205				installation.AgentIDs = append(installation.AgentIDs, found.Installation.AgentIDs...)
206			}

208			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
209			if len(installation.LogicalPaths) > 0 {

212			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
213		}
214	
215		for normalized, names := range normalizedInstalled {
216			names = uniqueSorted(names)
217			normalizedInstalled[normalized] = names
218			if len(names) > 1 {
219				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
220					Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: scope, Name: normalized,
221					Message: fmt.Sprintf("installed skill names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized),

225		exactNames := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
226		for name := range groups {
227			exactNames = append(exactNames, name)

229		sort.Strings(exactNames)
230		consumedLocks := map[string]bool{}
231		rows := make([]Skill, 0, len(groups)+len(document.Entries))
232		for _, name := range exactNames {
233			group := groups[name]
234			normalized := normalizedName(name)
235			var lock LockMetadata
236			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
237			matched := false
238			if exact, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
239				lock, matched = exact, true
240			} else if len(normalizedInstalled[normalized]) == 1 && len(candidates) == 1 {
241				lock, matched = candidates[0], true
242			}
243			if matched {
244				consumedLocks[normalized] = true
245			}
246			rows = append(rows, buildPresentRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, name, group, lock, candidates, matched))
247		}
248	
249		lockGroups := document.namesByNormalized()
250		lockNormalized := make([]string, 0, len(lockGroups))
251		for normalized := range lockGroups {
252			lockNormalized = append(lockNormalized, normalized)
253		}
254		sort.Strings(lockNormalized)
255		for _, normalized := range lockNormalized {

329			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
330				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
331			}
332			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
333		}
