171	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
172	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
173		options = normalizeOptions(options)
174		s := &Scanner{options: options}
175		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
176		return s
177	}
178	
179	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
180	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
181		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
182	}
183	
184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
202		}
203		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
204			finalizeResult(&result)
205			return result, err
206		}
207	
208		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
209		jobs := make(chan int)
210		workers := s.options.Concurrency
211		if workers > len(targets) {
212			workers = len(targets)
213		}
214		var wg sync.WaitGroup
215		for range workers {
216			wg.Add(1)
217			go func() {
218				defer wg.Done()
219				for {
220					select {
221					case <-ctx.Done():
222						return
223					case index, ok := <-jobs:
224						if !ok {
225							return
226						}
227						for _, spec := range projectSources(targets[index]) {
228							if ctx.Err() != nil {
229								return
230							}
231							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil)
232							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
233							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
234						}
235					}
236				}
237			}()
238		}
239		for index := range targets {
240			select {
241			case jobs <- index:
242			case <-ctx.Done():
243				close(jobs)
244				wg.Wait()
245				for _, partial := range projectResults {
246					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
247					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
248				}
249				finalizeResult(&result)
250				return result, ctx.Err()
251			}
252		}
253		close(jobs)
254		wg.Wait()
255		for _, partial := range projectResults {
256			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
257			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
258		}
259		finalizeResult(&result)
260		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
261			return result, err
262		}
263		return result, nil
264	}

267		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
268			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
269		}
270		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
271			options.XDGConfigHome = ""

273		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
274			options.CodexHome = ""
275		}

277			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
278		}
279		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
280			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
281		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
282			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
283		}
284		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
285			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
286		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
287			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
288		}
289		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
290			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
291		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
292			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
293		}
294		return options
295	}

297	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
298		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
299		for _, target := range targets {
300			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
301				continue
302			}
303			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
304			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
305				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
306			}
307			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
308			if err != nil {
309				continue
310			}
311			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
312			if target.RepoPath == "" {
313				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
314			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
315				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
316			}
317			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
318			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
319				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
320			}
321			if target.CommonDir == "" {
322				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
323			}
324			out = append(out, target)
325		}
326		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
327	}

385		makeSpec := func(agent Agent, relative string, adapter adapterKind) sourceSpec {
386			spec := base
387			spec.agent = agent
388			spec.path = filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
389			spec.adapter = adapter
390			return spec
391		}
392		claude := makeSpec(AgentClaudeCode, ".mcp.json", adapterClaudeProject)
393		claude.approvalPaths = []string{
394			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.json"),
395			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.local.json"),
396		}
397		return []sourceSpec{
398			claude,
399			makeSpec(AgentCodex, ".codex/config.toml", adapterCodex),
400			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
401			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
402			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
403			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
404			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
405			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
406		}

408	
409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}

16	var errSymlinkLimit = errors.New("symlink limit reached")
17	
18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
91			}
92			if readErr != nil {
93				if !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
94					return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}
104	
105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

34	func decodeJSON(data []byte, target any) DiagnosticCode {
35		if !utf8.Valid(data) {
36			return DiagnosticMalformed
37		}
38		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, target); err != nil {

47	func containsControl(value any) bool {
48		return reflectContainsControl(reflect.ValueOf(value))
49	}

51	func reflectContainsControl(value reflect.Value) bool {
52		if !value.IsValid() {
53			return false
54		}
55		if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface || value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
56			if value.IsNil() {
57				return false
58			}
59			return reflectContainsControl(value.Elem())
60		}
61		switch value.Kind() {
62		case reflect.String:
63			return stringContainsControl(value.String())
64		case reflect.Map:
65			iter := value.MapRange()
66			for iter.Next() {
67				if reflectContainsControl(iter.Key()) || reflectContainsControl(iter.Value()) {
68					return true
69				}
70			}
71		case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
72			for index := range value.Len() {
73				if reflectContainsControl(value.Index(index)) {
74					return true
75				}
76			}
77		case reflect.Struct:
78			for index := range value.NumField() {
79				if reflectContainsControl(value.Field(index)) {
80					return true
81				}
82			}
83		}
84		return false
85	}

87	func stringContainsControl(value string) bool {
88		for _, r := range value {

90				return true
91			}
92		}
93		return false
94	}

108	func looksSecretString(value string) bool {
109		lower := strings.ToLower(value)
110		if strings.Contains(lower, "sentinel") && (strings.Contains(lower, "secret") || strings.Contains(lower, "token") || strings.Contains(lower, "password")) {
111			return true
112		}
113		if (strings.HasPrefix(lower, "sk-") || strings.HasPrefix(lower, "ghp_") || strings.HasPrefix(lower, "github_pat_")) && len(value) >= 16 {
114			return true
115		}
116		if len(value) >= 64 {
117			letters := 0
118			for _, r := range value {
119				if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) || strings.ContainsRune("_-/+=", r) {
120					letters++
121				}
122			}
123			if letters == len([]rune(value)) {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}

368		fact := PolicyFact{Kind: kind, Value: value, Count: count}
369		for _, existing := range row.Policies {
370			if existing == fact {
371				return
372			}
373		}
374		row.Policies = append(row.Policies, fact)
375	}
376	
377	func addBooleanPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value bool) {
378		addPolicy(row, kind, strconv.FormatBool(value), 0)
379	}
380	
381	func finalizeDeclaration(row *Declaration) {
382		sort.Slice(row.Credentials, func(i, j int) bool {
383			if row.Credentials[i].Kind != row.Credentials[j].Kind {
384				return row.Credentials[i].Kind < row.Credentials[j].Kind
385			}
386			return row.Credentials[i].Name < row.Credentials[j].Name
387		})
388		sort.Slice(row.Redactions, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Redactions[i] < row.Redactions[j] })
389		sort.Slice(row.Policies, func(i, j int) bool {
390			if row.Policies[i].Kind != row.Policies[j].Kind {
391				return row.Policies[i].Kind < row.Policies[j].Kind
392			}
393			if row.Policies[i].Value != row.Policies[j].Value {

395			}
396			return row.Policies[i].Count < row.Policies[j].Count
397		})
398		sort.Slice(row.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Coverage[i].Code < row.Coverage[j].Code })
399	}

174								result.updates = append(result.updates, previous)
175								continue
176							}
177							status, detail := deps.check(ctx, checkout.dir, out[member.index])
178							update := rowUpdate{member.index, status, detail}
179							cached[cacheKey] = update
180							result.updates = append(result.updates, update)
181						}
182					}()
183					results <- result
184				}
185			}()
186		}
187		go func() {
188			workers.Wait()
189			close(results)
190		}()
191	
192		orderedResults := make([]updateGroupResult, len(groups))
193		for result := range results {
194			orderedResults[result.position] = result
195		}
196		for _, result := range orderedResults {
197			for _, update := range result.updates {
198				out[update.index].UpdateStatus = update.status
199				out[update.index].UpdateDetail = update.detail
200			}
201		}
202		return out
203	}

206		updates := make([]rowUpdate, 0, len(group.members))
207		for _, member := range group.members {
208			updates = append(updates, rowUpdate{member.index, UpdateFailed, detail})

215	func sourceURL(entry LockMetadata) (string, bool) {
216		if entry.SourceType == "local" || entry.SourceType == "node_modules" || entry.SourceType == "well-known" {
217			return "", false
218		}
219		if entry.SourceURL != "" {
220			return entry.SourceURL, true
221		}
222		if entry.SourceType == "github" {
223			parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(entry.Source, "/"), "/")
224			if len(parts) >= 2 {
225				return "https://github.com/" + parts[0] + "/" + parts[1] + ".git", true
226			}
227		}
228		if strings.Contains(entry.Source, "://") || strings.HasSuffix(entry.Source, ".git") {
229			return entry.Source, true
230		}
231		return "", false
232	}

234	func cloneSourceCheckout(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (sourceCheckout, error) {
235		dir, err := cloneSource(ctx, url, ref)
236		if err != nil {
237			return sourceCheckout{}, err
238		}
239		parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
240		return sourceCheckout{dir: dir, cleanup: func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }}, nil
241	}
242	
243	func cloneSource(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (string, error) {
244		if !safeFetchRef(ref) {
245			return "", errors.New("skill source ref is not safe to pass to Git")
246		}
247		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-skill-check-*")
248		if err != nil {
249			return "", err
250		}
251		dir := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
252		if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, "", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", "--", url, dir); err != nil {
253			_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
254			return "", err
255		}
256		if ref != "" {
257			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", "origin", ref); err != nil {
258				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
259				return "", err
260			}
261			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
262				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
263				return "", err
264			}
265		}
266		return dir, nil
267	}
268	
269	func safeFetchRef(ref string) bool {
270		if ref == "" {
271			return true
272		}
273		if strings.TrimSpace(ref) != ref || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "-") {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !strings.ContainsFunc(ref, func(r rune) bool {
277			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
278		})
279	}

281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""
283		computed := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ComputedHash)
284		folder := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.SkillFolderHash)
285		content := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ContentHash)
286	
287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {
288			switch {
289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {
301				return
302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"
310			return
311		}
312		// Scope-less package tests and older callers may still supply either global
313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func validHexHash(value string, length int) bool {
323		if len(value) != length {
324			return false
325		}
326		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
327		return err == nil
328	}

330	func checkOneResult(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
331		entry := skillLock(row)
332		if entry == nil {
333			return UpdateUnknown, "skill has no lock metadata"
334		}
335		folder, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath)
336		if !ok {
337			return UpdateUnknown, "invalid skill path in lock entry"
338		}
339		abs := filepath.Join(repoDir, filepath.FromSlash(folder))
340		info, err := os.Stat(abs)
341		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
342			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
343				return UpdateMissing, "skill path no longer exists upstream"
344			}
345			return UpdateFailed, "could not inspect upstream skill path"
346		}
347		if !insidePath(repoDir, abs) {
348			return UpdateUnknown, "skill path escapes the fetched source"
349		}
350	
351		expected, kind := entry.RecordedHash, entry.HashKind
352		if expected == "" {
353			copy := *entry
354			normalizeRecordedHash(&copy)
355			expected, kind = copy.RecordedHash, copy.HashKind
356		}
357		var actual string
358		var hashErr error
359		switch kind {
360		case "git-tree":
361			spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
362			if folder != "" {
363				spec = "HEAD:" + folder
364			}
365			actual, hashErr = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
366		case "sha256-folder":
367			actual, hashErr = folderHashContext(ctx, abs)
368		case "sha256-skill-file":
369			actual, hashErr = fileHashContext(ctx, filepath.Join(abs, "SKILL.md"))
370		}
371		if hashErr != nil {
372			if ctx.Err() != nil {
373				return UpdateFailed, "update check canceled"
374			}
375			return UpdateFailed, "could not compute upstream content hash"
376		}
377		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
378			return UpdateUnknown, "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
379		}
380		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
381			return UpdateCurrent, "matches the recorded upstream content"
382		}
383		return UpdateAvailable, "upstream content changed"
384	}

386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}
411	
412	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
413		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
414	}
415	
416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}
293

```text
1	package inventory
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}
86

 # Remote repository fleet
 
 `dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
 
 ## What a fleet is
 
 A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
 
 This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
 which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
 the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
 machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
 
 ## Configure hosts
 
 ```bash
 dev fleet config init
 dev fleet config edit
 dev fleet config show
 dev fleet config path
 ```

461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}

197			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
198		}
199		return destination, nil
200	}

202	func runTUI(app *App) error {
203		app.traceTUI = true
204		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
205		defer cancelRun()
206		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
207		// --color, NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb governed every other surface but stopped
208		// at the dashboard, which resolved its own palette independently.
209		tui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
210		appState := newTUIAppState(app)
211		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
212		projectRootResolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(app.trace, runCtx)
213		localLoader := newTUILocalLoader(app, runtimeResolver)
214		localLoader.current = appState.Current

216		reload := func(ctx context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
217			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
218			if err != nil {
219				return nil, err
220			}
221			tasks, err := appState.Current().Tasks.List()
222			if err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			return inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{}), nil
226		}
227		reloadRepos := func(ctx context.Context) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
228			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
229			if err != nil {
230				return nil, err
231			}
232			// Keep Try repositories in the model's local snapshot so cached REMOTE
233			// rows can be matched and cleared correctly. The REPOS view filters them.
234			return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, repoCollectOptions{IncludeTries: true})
235		}
236		reloadRemote := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
237			return collectRemotesForRows(ctx, appState.Current(), locals)
238		}
239		reloadFleet := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
240			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
241			if err != nil {
242				return nil, err
243			}
244			snapshot := fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(locals, rt.Name())
245			results, _, err := collectFleet(ctx, appState.Current(), fleetCollectOptions{LocalSnapshot: &snapshot})
246			return fleetRows(results), err

248		capabilityTargets := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]agenttarget.Target, error) {
249			repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
250			for _, row := range locals {
251				if !row.IsTry() {
252					repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
253				}
254			}
255			targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
256			projectRoot, err := projectRootResolver.Resolve(ctx)
257			if err != nil {
258				return nil, err
259			}
260			current, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, projectRoot)
261			if err != nil {
262				return nil, err
263			}
264			return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current), nil
265		}
266		reloadSkills := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]agentskill.Skill, error) {
267			targets, err := capabilityTargets(ctx, locals)
268			if err != nil {
269				return nil, err
270			}
271			result, err := inventory.CollectAgentSkills(ctx, targets, inventory.AgentSkillOptions{})
272			if err != nil {
273				return result.Skills, err
274			}
275			if len(result.Diagnostics) > 0 {
276				return result.Skills, fmt.Errorf("%d skill inventory diagnostic(s); run `dev skill list --all` for details", len(result.Diagnostics))
277			}
278			return result.Skills, nil
279		}
280		reloadMCP := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
281			targets, err := capabilityTargets(ctx, locals)
282			if err != nil {
283				return nil, err
284			}
285			result, err := agentmcp.Scan(ctx, targets)
286			if err != nil {
287				return result.Declarations, err
288			}
289			if len(result.Diagnostics) > 0 {
290				return result.Declarations, fmt.Errorf("%d MCP inventory diagnostic(s); run `dev mcp list --all` for details", len(result.Diagnostics))
291			}

294		reloadTries := func(ctx context.Context, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {

301		openResolved := func(ctx context.Context, dir, label, statusLabel string) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
302			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)

318				RuntimeHandle: handle.Handle,

444			// cold worktree tasks before this callback so reconciliation and writer

477				active := appState.Current()
478				if row.Repository == nil {
479					return nil, fmt.Errorf("host %s has no repository selected", row.Host)
480				}
481				executable, err := os.Executable()
482				if err != nil {
483					return nil, err
484				}
485				args := []string{}
486				if active.configPath != "" {
487					args = append(args, "--config", active.configPath)
488				}
489				if active.remotesPath != "" {
490					args = append(args, "--remotes", active.remotesPath)
491				}
492				if row.Local {
493					args = append(args, "repo", "open", row.Repository.Path)
494				} else {
495					args = append(args, "fleet", "open", row.Host, row.Repository.Path)
496				}
497				return exec.CommandContext(ctx, executable, args...), nil
498			},

500			CloneRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, string, error) {
501				dest, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(appState.Current(), r.Repo.Name)
502				if err != nil {
503					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
504				}
505				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
506					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots or clone somewhere explicit",
507						config.Contract(dest))
508				}
509				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, filepath.Dir(dest), "clone", r.Repo.CloneURL, dest); err != nil {
510					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
511				}
512				opened, err := openResolved(ctx, dest, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
513				if err != nil {
514					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
515				}
516				if opened.Directory != "" {
517					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
518				} else {
519					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
520				}
521				return opened, dest, nil
522			},

524			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
525				active := appState.Current()
526				current, err := active.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
527				if err != nil {
528					return "", err
529				}
530				updated := *current
531				if next != "" {
532					updated.Next = next
533				}
534				runtimeForTask(active, &updated) // normalize empty handle/name provenance
535				if updated.RuntimeHandle != "" {
536					if _, _, err := closeTaskRuntime(ctx, active, &updated, checkoutOf(&updated)); err != nil {
537						return "", err
538					}
539				}
540				// The dashboard only parks warm: going cold removes a checkout,
541				// which is too consequential for a single keystroke.
542				updated.State, updated.Owner = task.Warm, config.Hostname()
543				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
544					return "", err
545				}
546				return updated.Title() + " parked warm — worktree and branch kept", nil
547			},

553					return err
554				}
555				updated := *current
556				updated.Next = next
557				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
558					return err
559				}
560				annotate(active, runtimeForTask(active, &updated), &updated)
561				return nil
562			},

564			// Start is the bridge from "here are my repositories" to "here is what
565			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the
566			// dashboard to type a command.
567			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
570				if err != nil {
571					return "", err
572				}
573				actionApp := *active
574				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
575				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
576					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
577				})
578				if err != nil {
579					return "", err
580				}
581				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
582				if err != nil {
583					return "", err
584				}
585				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil
586			},

588			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
589				active := appState.Current()
590				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
591				if err != nil {
592					return "", err
593				}
594				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
595					return "", err
596				}
597				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
598				if err != nil {
599					return "", err
600				}
601				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
602					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
603				}
604				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
605				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
606					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
607				}
608				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
609				if err != nil {
610					return "", err
611				}
612				t := &task.Task{
613					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
614					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
615					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
616				}
617				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
618				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
619					return "", err
620				}
621				annotate(active, rt, t)
622				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
623			},
624	
625			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
626				active := appState.Current()
627				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
628				if err != nil {
629					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
630				}
631				defer store.Close()
632				until := time.Now()
633				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
634				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
635					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
636				})
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
639				}
640				seconds, days := 0, 0
641				for _, value := range totals {
642					seconds += value
643					if value > 0 {
644						days++
645					}
646				}
647				return tui.StatsPanel{
648					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
649					Since: since, Until: until,
650					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
651						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
652					}),
653				}, nil
654			},
655	
656			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
657				active := appState.Current()
658				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, active.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoName)
659				if err != nil {
660					return err
661				}
662				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
663				if err != nil {
664					return err
665				}
666				defer store.Close()
667				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
668				return err
669			},

681			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
682			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.
683			ValidateFleetConfig: func() error {

688			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
689				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
690				if err != nil {
691					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
692				}
693				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
694				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
695				if err != nil {
696					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
697				}
698				status := "config + data reloaded"
699				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
700					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
701				}
702				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
703					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
704					Tools:       externalTools(next),
705					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
706					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
707					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
708				}, status, nil
709			},
710		}
711	
712		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
713		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
714		// while dozens of repos are probed.
715		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
716		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
717		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
718		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
719		cancelRun()
720		app.finishTrace()
721		if err != nil {
722			return err
723		}
724		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
725		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
726		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
727			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
728				return app.cdDirective(dir)
729			}
730			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
731				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
732				if resolveErr != nil {
733					return resolveErr
734				}
735				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
736			}
737		}
738		return nil
739	}
