21	| repository quick notes | `note add`, `note list`, `note show`, `note search`, `note edit`, `note delete`, `note path`, `note reindex` |
22	| machine inventory | `bootstrap`, `adopt`, `doctor` |
23	| experiments | `try`, `tries …`, `graduate` |
24	| terminal UI | `tui`, `tui tools` |
25	| configuration/shell | `config init/show/path/edit/trust`, `config scaffolds init/show/path/edit`, `shell-init`, completion |
26	| remote fleet | `fleet list`, `fleet status`, `fleet sync`, `fleet open`, `fleet config …` |
27	| agent skills | `skill list`, `skill add`, `skill update`, `skill install`, `skill sync`, `skill print` |
28	| static MCP declarations | `mcp list` |
29	| generated policy/assets | `gitignore`, `skill install/sync` |
30	| activity/data | `summary`, `journal`, `stats …`, `cache …` |
31	| help | `help [topic]` |
32	
33	Run `dev <command> --help` for the installed binary; this site describes the repository version identified in its freshness metadata.
34	
35	## High-value structured interfaces
36	
37	```bash
38	dev ls --json
39	dev repo list --json
40	dev repo context [repo]
41	dev repo remote --json
42	dev repo new NAME --json
43	dev repo clone <ref> --json
44	dev repo setup [repo-or-path] --preset PRESET --json
45	dev note list [repo] --json
46	dev note search <query> --json
47	dev note show <note-id> --json
48	dev skill list --all --json
49	dev mcp list --all --json
50	dev bootstrap --json
51	```
52	
53	Prefer JSON or the agent-ready Markdown context over parsing human tables. Tables are optimized for terminals and may change columns/width without changing the structured contract.
54	
55	`dev skill list --json` keeps its existing array and keys while adding repository, checkout, installation, presence/integrity, registry, and lock metadata. `dev mcp list --json` begins with a `servers`/`diagnostics`/`coverage` envelope; every server field is already sanitized, and declaration state must not be interpreted as health or effective precedence.
56	
57	Every `dev repo list --json` row includes `notes.count`. When a latest note exists, the same object adds `notes.latest_id`, `notes.latest_preview`, and `notes.latest_updated`; these optional fields are omitted when the count is zero. `dev note list --json` and `dev note search --json` return arrays of complete note records, while `dev note show --json` returns one complete record.
58	
59	## Repository bootstrap
60	
61	Repository setup remains separate from acquisition. For acquisition,
62	`new`/`create` distinguishes a plain repository name from a clear clone
63	reference:
64	
65	| Command | Behavior |
66	|---|---|
67	| `dev repo new` | interactive wizard; its first field accepts either a new name or a clone reference |
68	| `dev repo new NAME` / `dev repo create NAME` | create a new local repository; a clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/name instead routes to clone and preserves history/remote |
69	| `dev repo clone [owner/name\|url]` | clone into the configured destination, then optionally apply a preset; setup defaults off |
70	| `dev repo setup [repo-or-path]` | repeat-safely merge native initializers and preset files into an existing clean checkout; defaults to the current repository and does not commit unless requested |
71	
72	A clone-routed `new` retains the source `origin`; it therefore rejects
73	new-upstream creation flags. It also rejects `--template*`, whose explicit
74	meaning is “copy content into a fresh history.”
75	
76	Across these commands, controls include `--preset`, `--path`, typed input values through
77	`--set`, item selection through `--enable`/`--disable`, `--check-in
78	<auto|commit|stage|none>`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--json`, and `--handoff
79	<stay|cd|open|start>`. `repo new` additionally accepts `--template`,
80	`--template-ref`, and `--template-subdir`. JSON mode is non-interactive and
81	never changes directory or opens a runtime. Dry-run performs no target
82	repository mutation; clone setup can only be planned in detail after the clone
83	exists. Use the generated reference below for each command's exact flag
84	availability.
85	
86	The wizard renders the selected scaffold and workflow summary before target
87	repository mutation. The built-in presets are:
88	
89	- `minimal`: `main`, README, and an initial commit; this preserves existing
90	  scripted `repo new NAME` behavior.
91	- `agent-ready`: extends `minimal` with common ignores, starter `AGENTS.md`,
92	  and project-scoped `.claude/settings.json` plus `.claude/plans/`.
93	  `agent-history-hygiene` and `project-knowledge-harness` are offered but are
94	  not selected silently. When selected, dev installs them and runs reviewed
95	  built-in initializers for their project surfaces before the initial commit;
96	  downloaded skill scripts are not executed for these built-ins. Matching
97	  skills with the same source and identical agent targets share one installer
98	  invocation, while their setup phases still run per skill. The history
99	  initializer creates `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and `.gitleaks.toml`, then
100	  ensures `.specstory/.gitignore` contains rules for SpecStory's `.project.json`
101	  and `statistics.json`, never the trackable `.specstory/history/` directory.
102	  Existing custom ignore content and its mode are preserved; only missing
103	  managed rules are appended.
104	
105	After preset selection, the new-repository wizard asks “Customize preset and
106	template options?” with a default of no. The ordinary `agent-ready` flow uses
107	its reviewed template, file, input, and skill defaults without presenting each
108	question. Answer yes—or provide customization flags—to expand those controls.
109	
110	Presets can add typed `string`, `bool`, and `choice` inputs, text templates,
111	hooks, and project skills. Hooks run in fixed `before_commit`, `after_commit`,
112	and `after_remote` phases. The safe hook form is an argv `command`; a shell
113	`run` is explicit, and only `interactive = true` loads an interactive shell.
114	Required failures stop later commit/remote steps; optional failures are
115	reported as warnings. Produced local files are retained for recovery. Native
116	initializers and preset files are repeat-safe; custom hooks and skill setup are
117	responsible for their own idempotency.
118	
119	### Snapshot templates
120	
121	`dev repo new NAME --template SOURCE` seeds a fresh repository from a content
122	snapshot. `SOURCE` may be a local directory/repository, Git URL, or owner/name.
123	For a Git source, `--template-ref` selects an arbitrary branch, tag, or commit;
124	`--template-subdir` selects a clean relative directory as the new repository
125	root. Without a ref, a local Git working tree includes existing tracked files
126	plus untracked files that are not ignored by Git; ignored build/cache content
127	is omitted. A non-Git directory snapshots its complete current tree.
128	
129	The new repository does not inherit source history or remotes. Dev excludes
130	every source `.git` entry, rejects traversal, symlinks and special files,
131	preserves regular-file modes, and validates the complete snapshot before
132	creating the destination. Snapshot files take precedence when the selected
133	scaffold would write the same path; the scaffold still fills missing files and
134	runs the selected initializers. Source and destination traversal is performed
135	relative to held `os.Root` handles, and file bytes come from the already-open
136	validated source handle rather than a second mutable pathname lookup.
137	
138	Confirmation and human dry-run output show a bounded preview of selected paths
139	and warn when a local source is a live working-tree/directory snapshot rather
140	than a commit. Credential-bearing URL userinfo is removed from summaries,
141	structured output, and clone/template errors.
142	
143	Presets expose the same operation through scalar `template`, `template_ref`,
144	and `template_subdir` fields. They inherit normally and explicit CLI flags win,
145	which supports one starter catalog repository plus a child preset for each
146	subfolder.
147	
148	### Check-in policy
149	
150	The interactive wizard offers `commit`, `stage`, and `none`; scripts may also
151	pass `auto`. The behavior is:
152	
153	| Value | Behavior |
154	|---|---|
155	| `commit` | `git add -A`, commit with `--message`/the preset message, then run `after_commit` setup |
156	| `stage` | run `before_commit` setup, then `git add -A`; leave the checkout staged and do not run `after_commit` |
157	| `none` | leave generated changes unstaged and uncommitted |
158	| `auto` | for `repo new`, use `initial_check_in` and compatible `initial_commit`; clone/setup otherwise perform no automatic check-in |
159	
160	In `stage` mode, dev best-effort writes `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` in the exact
161	worktree Git directory. [Lazygit v0.59.0 reads this
162	file](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216)
163	as the initial message for lowercase `c`; uppercase `C` and Git itself do not use this integration. An
164	existing different draft is preserved and reported rather than overwritten.
165	This is an implementation-detail adapter, not `commit.template`.
166	
167	Staging is the durable outcome: if the optional lazygit draft cannot be
168	written, dev emits a warning and retains the staged index instead of rolling it
169	back.
170	
171	Staged setup cannot create an upstream, and `handoff=start` requires committed
172	setup because a new worktree would omit the staged files. `stay`, `cd`, and
173	`open` remain available for review. `repo setup --commit` is retained as a
174	compatibility alias for `--check-in=commit`; `--message` applies to both commit
175	and stage. Structured results retain `committed` and add `staged`,
176	`staged_paths`, `commit_message`, `commit_draft_provider`, and a content-free
177	`template` summary where applicable.
178	
179	### Upstream publishing
180	
181	Before offering publication, dev probes `gh` and `glab` without changing
182	state. A provider is offered only when its CLI is installed and authenticated;
183	otherwise the wizard gives the relevant installation or login guidance.
184	Local-only is the default, and a newly published repository defaults private.
185	
186	Publishing uses the local repository name and configured description, then asks
187	for the provider namespace/owner, visibility, and whether to push the
188	initial/current branch. Dev creates the empty GitHub or GitLab repository after
189	required local setup and commit steps succeed, then adds/verifies `origin` and
190	optionally pushes with upstream tracking. A
191	provider, name-conflict, or push failure never deletes the local checkout or
192	an upstream that was already created.
193	
194	Publishing from `repo setup` requires `--check-in=commit` (or the compatible
195	`--commit` flag), so the newly created upstream cannot omit the generated setup
196	changes. `--check-in=stage` is incompatible with any new upstream; for a new
197	repository, `none` may create an intentionally empty upstream only with
198	`--push=false`.
199	
200	### Handoff
201	
202	`stay` prints the result only. `cd` uses the trusted `shell-init` wrapper to
203	change the parent shell. `open` opens the configured Herdr/tmux/Zellij runtime
204	and falls back to `cd` when runtime is `none`. `start` continues into the
205	existing task wizard with the repository fixed, and is unavailable when setup
206	leaves uncommitted files that a new worktree would omit. Neither repository
207	bootstrap nor a default `dev start` launches a coding agent. Explicit
208	worktree-mode `dev start --run '<shell command>'` dispatches one command only
209	when a newly created first-class Herdr worktree returns its exact root pane;
210	`--focus` independently controls navigation afterward.
211	
212	All shared TTY text fields in the repository, task-start, and finish wizards
213	use an inline editor: Left/Right, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, insertion at the
214	cursor, and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation work as terminal actions rather than being
215	inserted as raw escape bytes. Buffered and piped non-TTY input retains its
216	line-oriented behavior.
217	
218	## `dev done` finish flags
219	
220	`dev done` for branch/worktree tasks integrates through exactly one of `--ff` (rebase onto the base, then fast-forward it) or `--pr` (push and open a pull/merge request). Omitting both opens the interactive finish wizard on a TTY — see [Change-stream workflow](../guides/change-stream-workflow.md) for the prompts.
221	
222	A dirty checkout is handled by `--dirty <auto|fail|commit|discard>` (default `auto`):
223	
224	| Value | Behavior |
225	|---|---|
226	| `auto` | interactive: prompts to commit or discard; non-interactive: fails, same as `fail` |
227	| `fail` | refuses to finish with a dirty checkout |
228	| `commit` | commits everything with `--message`/`-m` (prompted interactively if omitted) |
229	| `discard` | resets tracked changes and removes untracked files; destructive, requires `--yes` outside a TTY |
230	
231	`--yes`/`-y` confirms the selected finish plan; it is mandatory for a non-interactive `--dirty discard` and otherwise skips the interactive confirmation step. `--keep-worktree` keeps the worktree after `--ff` integration (default: removed once merged), `--push` also pushes the resulting branch, and `--delete-branch` deletes the branch once its commits are contained in the base — never a branch with unpushed commits.
232	
233	## Configuration
234	
235	```bash
236	dev config init
237	dev config show
238	dev config path
239	dev config scaffolds init
240	dev config scaffolds show
241	dev config scaffolds path
242	dev config scaffolds edit
243	```
244	
245	`config init` detects local roots and writes explicit defaults. A missing config file is allowed; the built-in defaults keep core Git behavior usable, but generated config is recommended because it makes machine policy reviewable.
246	
247	Key sections:
248	
249	| Section | Controls |
250	|---|---|
251	| `[paths]` | scan roots, project/tries/worktree roots, worktree template, state path |
252	| `[runtime]` | `auto`, Herdr, tmux, Zellij, or none plus metadata settings |
253	| `[worktree]` | ignored includes, linked dirs, setup commands, strategies, timeout |
254	| `[forge]` / `[[forge.azure_devops]]` | complete remote inventory cache TTL and opt-in Azure organization/project targets |
255	| `[bootstrap]` | recursion, symlink handling, index/layout policy |
256	| `[tui]` / `[[tui.tools]]` | columns, sorting, and external-tool bindings |
257	| `[stats]` | sampler and optional WakaTime import |
258	| `[update]` | `check` (default `true`) — allow the once-a-day "newer release available" hint and its background cache refresh; `DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` overrides it |
259	
260	`DEV_TUI_TRACE=/absolute/new-file.json` enables a one-run TUI startup/readiness
261	trace. The target must be absolute and must not exist; dev never overwrites it.
262	The private bounded document is written after TUI teardown and contains relative
263	categorical timings plus aggregate row counts rather than names, paths, or raw
264	payloads. It is not configuration,
265	cache, durable stats, stdout, or network telemetry. For TUI invocations, the
266	optional update-cache network refresh is also deferred until the initial view
267	has returned.
268	
269	Repository quick-note Markdown is durable under configured `paths.state_dir/notes`, which defaults to `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes`. The full-text index at `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is disposable and rebuilds from those files; changing `paths.state_dir` does not move the cache.
270	
271	### Scaffold presets
272	
273	Global repository recipes live at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/scaffolds.toml` (or
274	the root `--scaffolds` override). Every authored file declares `version = 1`.
275	A compact preset looks like:
276	
277	```toml
278	version = 1
279	default_preset = "team"
280	default_agents = ["claude-code", "codex"]
281	
282	[presets.team]
283	extends = "agent-ready"
284	handoff = "cd"
285	initial_check_in = "stage"
286	template = "acme/starter-catalog"
287	template_ref = "v2"
288	template_subdir = "services/go"
289	
290	[[presets.team.inputs]]
291	id = "deployment"
292	type = "choice"
293	choices = ["none", "docker"]
294	default = "none"
295	
296	[[presets.team.files]]
297	id = "service-readme"
298	source = "service/README.md" # templates/service/README.md beside this file
299	destination = "docs/service.md"
300	
301	[[presets.team.hooks]]
302	id = "verify"
303	phase = "before_commit"
304	command = ["make", "test"]
305	required = true
306	
307	[[presets.team.skills]]
308	id = "knowledge"
309	source = "daviddwlee84/agent-skills/skills"
310	name = "project-knowledge-harness"
311	agents = ["claude-code", "codex"]
312	default = true
313	
314	[presets.team.skills.setup]
315	phase = "before_commit"
316	interpreter = "bash"
317	script = "scripts/init.sh"
318	args = ["--target", "{{path}}", "--project-name", "{{name}}"]
319	required = true
320	```
321	
322	Skill setup normally names a project-local script inside the installed skill.
323	The shipped recommendations instead use `builtin = "agent-history-hygiene"` or
324	`builtin = "project-knowledge-harness"`; these fixed reviewed initializers do
325	not execute downloaded skill code.
326	
327	A preset may extend one parent. Scalars override; simple lists replace; files,
328	hooks, and skills merge by `id`, and an inherited item can be disabled with
329	`enabled = false`. A `[[presets.*.files]]` rendering source must remain in the
330	`templates/` tree next to its config source; that file-level mechanism is
331	separate from the repository snapshot `template` scalar above. Destinations
332	must remain inside the repository, and a skill setup script must remain inside
333	the installed skill directory. `initial_check_in` accepts `commit`, `stage`, or
334	`none`; the legacy `initial_commit` boolean remains readable, but a preset must
335	not set both.
336

63	## Repository bootstrap
64	
65	Repository setup 仍與 acquisition 分開。Acquisition 部分，`new`/`create` 會區分
66	plain repository name 與清楚的 clone reference：
67	
68	| Command | 行為 |
69	|---|---|
70	| `dev repo new` | interactive wizard；第一個欄位可輸入新 name 或 clone reference |
71	| `dev repo new NAME` / `dev repo create NAME` | 建立新的 local repository；若輸入清楚的 Git URL、local Git path 或 owner/name，則改走 clone 並保留 history/remote |
72	| `dev repo clone [owner/name\|url]` | clone 至 configured destination，再選擇是否套 preset；setup 預設關閉 |
73	| `dev repo setup [repo-or-path]` | repeat-safely merge native initializers 與 preset files 至既有 clean checkout；預設目前 repository，沒有明確要求時不 commit |
74	
75	改走 clone 的 `new` 會保留 source `origin`，因此拒絕 new-upstream creation flags；也會
76	拒絕 `--template*`，因為後者的明確語意是「把 content 複製進 fresh history」。
77	
78	這些 commands 的 controls 包含 `--preset`、`--path`、用 `--set` 傳入 typed input、用
79	`--enable`/`--disable` 選擇 item、`--check-in <auto|commit|stage|none>`、
80	`--dry-run`、`--yes`、`--json`，以及 `--handoff <stay|cd|open|start>`。
81	`repo new` 另支援 `--template`、`--template-ref`、`--template-subdir`。JSON mode
82	不互動，也不會改變 directory 或開啟 runtime。Dry-run 不會修改 target repository；
83	clone setup 必須等 clone 存在後才能產生詳細 plan。每個 command 實際支援的精確 flags
84	請看下方 generated reference。
85	
86	Wizard 會在 target repository mutation 前顯示 selected scaffold 與 workflow
87	summary。Built-in presets 為：
88	
89	- `minimal`：`main`、README 與 initial commit；保留既有 scripted
90	  `repo new NAME` behavior。
91	- `agent-ready`：在 `minimal` 上加入 common ignores、starter `AGENTS.md`，以及
92	  project-scoped `.claude/settings.json` 與 `.claude/plans/`。
93	  `agent-history-hygiene`、`project-knowledge-harness` 會出現在選項中，但不會靜默
94	  啟用。選取後 dev 會安裝 skill，並在 initial commit 前執行經 review 的內建
95	  initializer 來建立對應 project surfaces；這兩個 built-ins 不會執行剛下載的
96	  skill scripts。同一 source 且 agent targets 完全相同的 skills 會共用一次 installer
97	  invocation，各 skill 的 setup phase 仍分別執行。History initializer 會建立
98	  `.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`.gitleaks.toml`，再確保 `.specstory/.gitignore` 含有
99	  SpecStory 的 `.project.json`、`statistics.json` 規則，不會忽略應納入追蹤的
100	  `.specstory/history/`。既有 custom ignore content 與 mode 會保留，只補上缺少的
101	  managed rules。
102	
103	選完 preset 後，new-repository wizard 會詢問預設為 no 的「Customize preset and
104	template options?」。一般 `agent-ready` flow 會直接使用 reviewed template、file、input
105	與 skill defaults，不逐一顯示問題；回答 yes（或傳入 customization flags）才會展開。
106	
107	Preset 可加入 `string`、`bool`、`choice` typed inputs、text templates、hooks 與
108	project skills。Hooks 依固定 `before_commit`、`after_commit`、`after_remote` phases
109	執行。安全形式是 argv `command`；shell `run` 必須明確宣告，且只有
110	`interactive = true` 才載入 interactive shell。Required failure 會停止後續
111	commit/remote steps；optional failure 只回報 warning。已產生的 local files 會保留供
112	recovery。Native initializers 與 preset files 可 repeat-safe 套用；custom hooks 與
113	skill setup 必須自行保證 idempotency。
114	
115	### Snapshot templates
116	
117	`dev repo new NAME --template SOURCE` 會用 content snapshot 建立全新 repository。
118	`SOURCE` 可為 local directory/repository、Git URL 或 owner/name。Git source 可用
119	`--template-ref` 指定任意 branch、tag 或 commit；`--template-subdir` 則指定作為新
120	repository root 的乾淨 relative directory。未指定 ref 時，local Git working tree 會
121	包含現存 tracked files，以及未被 Git ignore 的 untracked files；ignored build/cache
122	content 會省略。Non-Git directory 則 snapshot 完整 current tree。
123	
124	新 repository 不會繼承 source history 或 remotes。Dev 會排除每個 source `.git`
125	entry、拒絕 traversal、symlink 與 special files、保留 regular-file modes，並在建立
126	destination 前驗證完整 snapshot。若 snapshot 與 selected scaffold 寫入同一路徑，
127	snapshot 優先；scaffold 仍會補齊缺少的 files 並執行 selected initializers。
128	Source 與 destination traversal 都相對於 held `os.Root` handles 進行；file bytes 來自
129	已開啟且驗證過的 source handle，不會再次依 mutable pathname lookup。
130	
131	Confirmation 與 human dry-run output 會顯示 bounded selected-path preview；local source
132	若是 live working-tree/directory snapshot 而非 commit，也會明確 warning。含 credential
133	的 URL userinfo 會從 summaries、structured output 與 clone/template errors 移除。
134	
135	Preset 可用 scalar `template`、`template_ref`、`template_subdir` 宣告同一操作。它們依
136	一般 inheritance 規則 resolve，explicit CLI flags 優先，因此可以一個 starter catalog
137	repository 搭配每個 subfolder 各一個 child preset。
138	
139	### Check-in policy
140	
141	Interactive wizard 提供 `commit`、`stage`、`none`；script 也可傳 `auto`：
142	
143	| 值 | 行為 |
144	|---|---|
145	| `commit` | `git add -A`，以 `--message`／preset message commit，再執行 `after_commit` setup |
146	| `stage` | 執行 `before_commit` setup 後 `git add -A`；保留 staged checkout，不執行 `after_commit` |
147	| `none` | generated changes 保持 unstaged、uncommitted |
148	| `auto` | `repo new` 使用 `initial_check_in` 與相容的 `initial_commit`；clone/setup 則不自動 check-in |
149	
150	`stage` mode 會 best-effort 在正確的 worktree Git directory 寫入
151	`LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT`。[Lazygit v0.59.0 會讀取此
152	file](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216)，並將它作為小寫 `c` 的 initial message；大寫
153	`C` 與 Git 本身不使用此 integration。不同內容的既有 draft 會保留並回報 warning，
154	不會被覆寫。這是 implementation-detail adapter，不是 `commit.template`。
155	
156	Staging 才是 durable outcome：optional lazygit draft 若無法寫入，dev 會發出 warning
157	並保留 staged index，不會 rollback。
158	
159	Staged setup 不能建立 upstream；`handoff=start` 也要求已 commit 的 setup，因為新
160	worktree 會漏掉 staged files。`stay`、`cd`、`open` 仍可供 review。`repo setup
161	--commit` 保留為 `--check-in=commit` 的 compatibility alias；`--message` 同時適用於
162	commit 與 stage。Structured result 保留 `committed`，並在適用時加入 `staged`、
163	`staged_paths`、`commit_message`、`commit_draft_provider` 與不含 file content 的
164	`template` summary。
165	
166	### Upstream publishing
167	
168	提供 publishing 選項前，dev 會以 read-only 方式 probe `gh` 與 `glab`。只有 CLI 已
169	安裝且完成 authentication 的 provider 才會出現；否則 wizard 顯示對應的安裝或 login
170	指引。預設 local-only，新 publish 的 repository 預設 private。
171	
172	Publishing 會沿用 local repository name 與 configured description，再詢問 provider
173	namespace/owner、visibility，以及是否 push initial/current branch。Dev 會在必要的
174	local setup 與 commit steps 成功後建立空的 GitHub 或 GitLab repository，再新增／驗證
175	`origin`，並可選擇以 upstream tracking push。Provider、name-conflict 或 push failure
176	絕不刪除 local checkout，也不會刪除已建立的 upstream。
177	
178	從 `repo setup` publish 時必須使用 `--check-in=commit`（或相容的 `--commit` flag），
179	避免新建 upstream 漏掉本次產生的 setup changes。`--check-in=stage` 與任何新 upstream
180	不相容；對新 repository 而言，`none` 只有搭配 `--push=false` 才能建立刻意保持空白的
181	upstream。
182	
183	### Handoff
184	
185	`stay` 只輸出結果；`cd` 透過受信任的 `shell-init` wrapper 改變 parent shell；
186	`open` 開啟 configured Herdr/tmux/Zellij runtime，runtime 為 `none` 時退回 `cd`；
187	`start` 會固定此 repository 並接續現有 task wizard。Setup 留下 uncommitted files、
188	導致新 worktree 會遺漏它們時，`start` 不可用。Repository bootstrap 與
189	預設的 `dev start` 都不會啟動 coding agent。明確使用 worktree mode 的
190	`dev start --run '<shell command>'` 時，只有本次新建 first-class Herdr worktree
191	回傳 exact root pane 才會 dispatch command；之後是否轉跳仍由 `--focus` 獨立控制。
192	
193	Repository、task-start 與 finish wizard 共用的 TTY text fields 都使用 inline editor：
194	Left/Right、Home/End、Delete/Backspace、cursor 位置插入與 Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation 會
195	被解讀為 terminal actions，不會成為 raw escape bytes。Buffered 或 piped non-TTY input
196	仍維持 line-oriented behavior。
197	
198	## `dev done` finish flags
199	
200	`dev done` 對 branch/worktree task 只透過下列其中一種方式 integrate：`--ff`（rebase 到 base 再 fast-forward）或 `--pr`（push 並開啟 pull/merge request）。兩者都省略時，在 TTY 上會開啟 interactive finish wizard —— 提示內容見[變更流工作流程](../guides/change-stream-workflow.zh-TW.md)。
201	
202	Dirty checkout 由 `--dirty <auto|fail|commit|discard>` 處理（預設 `auto`）：
203	
204	| 值 | 行為 |
205	|---|---|
206	| `auto` | interactive：提示 commit 或 discard；non-interactive：直接失敗，等同 `fail` |
207	| `fail` | dirty checkout 時拒絕 finish |
208	| `commit` | 用 `--message`/`-m` commit 全部變更（未指定時 interactive 會提示輸入） |
209	| `discard` | reset tracked 變更並移除 untracked files；具破壞性，沒有 TTY 時需要 `--yes` |
210	
211	`--yes`/`-y` 用來確認選定的 finish plan；non-interactive 的 `--dirty discard` 必須要有它，其他情況則是跳過 interactive 確認步驟。`--keep-worktree` 讓 `--ff` integration 後仍保留 worktree（預設 merge 後移除），`--push` 會一併 push 產生的 branch，`--delete-branch` 只在 branch 的 commits 已被 base 包含時才刪除它 —— 有 unpushed commits 的 branch 永遠不會被刪除。
212	
213	## Configuration
214	
215	```bash
216	dev config init
217	dev config show
218	dev config path
219	dev config scaffolds init
220	dev config scaffolds show
221	dev config scaffolds path
222	dev config scaffolds edit
223	```
224	
225	`config init` 偵測 local roots 並寫出 explicit defaults。Config file 不存在仍可運作；built-in defaults 讓核心 Git behavior 可用，但 generated config 能讓 machine policy 可 review，因此較推薦。
226	
227	主要 sections：
228	
229	| Section | 控制內容 |
230	|---|---|
231	| `[paths]` | scan roots、project/tries/worktree roots、worktree template、state path |
232	| `[runtime]` | `auto`、Herdr、tmux、Zellij 或 none，以及 metadata settings |
233	| `[worktree]` | ignored includes、linked dirs、setup commands、strategies、timeout |
234	| `[forge]` / `[[forge.azure_devops]]` | 完整 remote inventory 的 cache TTL，以及 opt-in Azure organization/project targets |
235	| `[bootstrap]` | recursion、symlink handling、index/layout policy |
236	| `[tui]` / `[[tui.tools]]` | columns、sorting 與 external-tool bindings |
237	| `[stats]` | sampler 與 optional WakaTime import |
238	| `[update]` | `check`（預設 `true`）— 允許每天一次的「有新版」提示與其背景 cache refresh；`DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` 可覆寫 |
239	
240	`DEV_TUI_TRACE=/absolute/new-file.json` 會啟用單次 TUI startup/readiness trace。
241	Target 必須是 absolute 且尚不存在；dev 絕不 overwrite。Private、bounded document
242	在 TUI teardown 後才寫入，只包含 relative categorical timings 與 aggregate row
243	counts，不包含 names、paths 或 raw payloads；它不是 configuration、cache、durable
244	stats、stdout 或 network telemetry。
245	TUI invocation 的 optional update-cache network refresh 也會延後到 initial view
246	return 之後。
247	
248	Repository quick-note Markdown 是 configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 下的 durable data；該路徑預設為 `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes`。`$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 的 full-text index 是 disposable，會從 Markdown 重建；調整 `paths.state_dir` 不會移動 cache。
249	
250	### Scaffold presets
251	
252	Global repository recipes 位於 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/scaffolds.toml`（或 root
253	`--scaffolds` override）。每個 authored file 都必須宣告 `version = 1`。精簡 preset
254	範例：
255	
256	```toml
257	version = 1
258	default_preset = "team"
259	default_agents = ["claude-code", "codex"]
260	
261	[presets.team]
262	extends = "agent-ready"
263	handoff = "cd"
264	initial_check_in = "stage"
265	template = "acme/starter-catalog"
266	template_ref = "v2"
267	template_subdir = "services/go"
268	
269	[[presets.team.inputs]]
270	id = "deployment"
271	type = "choice"
272	choices = ["none", "docker"]
273	default = "none"
274	
275	[[presets.team.files]]
276	id = "service-readme"
277	source = "service/README.md" # 此檔案旁的 templates/service/README.md
278	destination = "docs/service.md"
279	
280	[[presets.team.hooks]]
281	id = "verify"
282	phase = "before_commit"
283	command = ["make", "test"]
284	required = true
285	
286	[[presets.team.skills]]
287	id = "knowledge"
288	source = "daviddwlee84/agent-skills/skills"
289	name = "project-knowledge-harness"
290	agents = ["claude-code", "codex"]
291	default = true
292	
293	[presets.team.skills.setup]
294	phase = "before_commit"
295	interpreter = "bash"
296	script = "scripts/init.sh"
297	args = ["--target", "{{path}}", "--project-name", "{{name}}"]
298	required = true
299	```
300	
301	Skill setup 一般會指定 installed skill 內的 project-local script。內建推薦項目則使用
302	`builtin = "agent-history-hygiene"` 或
303	`builtin = "project-knowledge-harness"`；這些固定且經 review 的 initializer 不會執行
304	下載回來的 skill code。
305	
306	Preset 最多 extend 一個 parent。Scalar 會 override；simple lists 會 replace；files、
307	hooks 與 skills 依 `id` merge，inherited item 可用 `enabled = false` 停用。
308	`[[presets.*.files]]` 的 rendering source 必須留在 config source 旁的 `templates/`
309	tree；這個 file-level mechanism 與前述 repository snapshot `template` scalar 不同。
310	Destination 必須留在 repository 內，skill setup script 也必須位於 installed skill
311	directory 內。`initial_check_in` 接受 `commit`、`stage`、`none`；legacy
312	`initial_commit` boolean 仍可讀，但同一 preset 不可同時設定兩者。
313	
314	### Safe project overlays
315	
316	Repository 可 commit 兩個固定檔案：
317	
318	- `.dev-cli/config.toml`：allowlisted worktree provisioning 與 repository setup
319	  wizard defaults。
320	- `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml`：使用同一 versioned schema 的 project presets、
321	  templates、hooks 與 skill setup。
322	
323	```toml
324	# .dev-cli/config.toml
325	version = 1
326	
327	[worktree]
328	include = [".env.example"]
329	strategy = "reinstall"
330	
331	[repo.setup]
332	preset = "team"
333	handoff = "cd"
334	check_in = "stage"
335	```
336	
337	Effective precedence 由低至高為 built-ins、global config/scaffolds、legacy
338	`.dev.toml`、target repository 的 `.dev-cli/*`，最後是 explicit CLI 或 wizard
339	choices。`.dev.toml` 為相容性仍可讀；新的 project configuration 應使用
340	`.dev-cli/config.toml`。Global `default_preset` 與 project `[repo.setup]` 的 preset、
```

8	# Sources and freshness
9	
10	This site mixes product documentation, external specifications, fast-moving harness behavior, project policy, and history. Every page identifies which kind of statement it contains and when it was checked.
11	
12	## Authority order
13	
14	1. **dev-cli behavior:** repository code, tests, E2E, and generated command reference.
15	2. **Git semantics:** current `git-scm.com` manuals for the relevant installed Git version.
16	3. **GitHub collaboration:** current GitHub Docs.
17	4. **Claude Code behavior:** current Anthropic documentation, with preview/experimental/version labels.
18	5. **Standards:** named versioned specifications such as Conventional Commits 1.0.0 and SemVer 2.0.0.
19	6. **Historical context:** dated archives and older project essays, never a current operating rule.
20	7. **Project policy:** explicitly labeled recommendations; not presented as an upstream guarantee.
21	
22	A lower item may explain motivation but cannot override a higher authority's implementation claim.
23	
24	## Required page metadata
25	
26	```yaml

28	description: One sentence used by navigation and llms.txt.
29	authority: one value from the authority table below
30	status: one value from the status table below
31	verified_on: YYYY-MM-DD
32	minimum_version: optional
33	tested_with: optional
34	---
35	```

38	|---|---|
39	| `project` | code/test-defined dev-cli behavior |
40	| `project-policy` | this project's recommendation |
41	| `git-scm`, `github-docs`, `anthropic-docs` | one current upstream authority |
42	| `git-and-project-policy`, `anthropic-docs-and-project-policy` | upstream semantics plus a labeled local recommendation |
43	| `project-and-upstream` | compatibility page spanning implementation and upstream status |
44	
45	| `status` value | Meaning |
46	|---|---|
47	| `stable`, `maintained` | current project content with a maintenance expectation |
48	| `evolving` | current behavior likely to change |
49	| `official` | current upstream normative/documented behavior |
50	| `research-preview-partial` | page includes a research-preview surface |
51	| `experimental-and-versioned` | experimental feature with explicit version bounds |
52	| `generated-plus-authored` | generated reference embedded in authored guidance |
53	
54	`verified_on` must be a real ISO date no later than the current UTC calendar date. English/zh-TW siblings must match on authority, status, date, minimum version, and tested version. Pages backed by Anthropic docs or preview/experimental status must carry `minimum_version` or `tested_with`. The docs checker enforces these rules, nav membership, and bilingual file parity.

17		EnvFile string            `json:"envFile"`
18		URL     string            `json:"url"`
19		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
20		Auth    *cursorAuth       `json:"auth"`
21	}
22	
23	type cursorAuth struct {
24		ClientID     string   `json:"CLIENT_ID"`
25		ClientSecret string   `json:"CLIENT_SECRET"`
26		Scopes       []string `json:"scopes"`
27	}
28	
29	func parseCursor(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
30		var document cursorDocument
31		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
32			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
33		}
34		var rows []Declaration
35		var codes []DiagnosticCode
36		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCPServers) {
37			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
38			if !ok {
39				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
40				continue
41			}
42			var server cursorServer
43			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
44				codes = append(codes, code)
45				continue
46			}
47			setCommand(&row, server.Command)
48			inspectArguments(&row, server.Args)
49			inspectEnvironment(&row, server.Env)
50			if strings.TrimSpace(server.EnvFile) != "" {
51				addCredential(&row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialFile})
52				addRedaction(&row, RedactionFileReference)
53			}
54			setEndpoint(&row, server.URL)
55			inspectHeaders(&row, server.Headers)
56			if server.Auth != nil {
57				addPolicy(&row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
58				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-id", server.Auth.ClientID)
59				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-secret", server.Auth.ClientSecret)
60				for _, scope := range server.Auth.Scopes {
61					inspectOAuthValue(&row, "scope", scope)
62				}
63			}
64	
65			hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
66			hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
67			if hasCommand && hasURL {
68				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
69			} else if hasURL {
70				// Cursor's static URL form does not identify SSE versus streamable HTTP.
71				row.Transport = TransportRemote
72			} else if hasCommand {
73				row.Transport = TransportStdio
74			}
75			if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
76				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
77			}
78			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
79			rows = append(rows, row)
80		}
81		return rows, codes
82	}

44	}
45	
46	func parseGemini(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
47		var document geminiDocument
48		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
49			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
50		}
51		allowed := normalizeNameSet(document.MCP.Allowed)
52		excluded := normalizeNameSet(document.MCP.Excluded)
53		var rows []Declaration
54		var codes []DiagnosticCode
55		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCPServers) {
56			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
57			if !ok {
58				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
59				continue
60			}
61			var server geminiServer
62			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
63				codes = append(codes, code)
64				continue
65			}
66			convertGeminiServer(&row, server)
67			isAllowed, isExcluded := allowed[row.Name], excluded[row.Name]
68			if isAllowed {
69				addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
70			}
71			if isExcluded {
72				addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
73			}
74			if isAllowed && isExcluded {
75				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
76			}
77			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
78			rows = append(rows, row)
79		}
80		return rows, codes
81	}
82	
83	func convertGeminiServer(row *Declaration, server geminiServer) {
84		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
85		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
86		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
87		row.Trusted = copyBool(server.Trust)
88		if len(server.IncludeTools) > 0 {
89			addPolicy(row, PolicyIncludeTools, "", len(server.IncludeTools))
90		}
91		if len(server.ExcludeTools) > 0 {
92			addPolicy(row, PolicyExcludeTools, "", len(server.ExcludeTools))
93		}
94	
95		hasHTTP := strings.TrimSpace(server.HTTPURL) != ""
96		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
97		hasTCP := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP) != ""
98		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
99		transportFields := 0
100		for _, present := range []bool{hasHTTP, hasURL, hasTCP, hasCommand} {
101			if present {
102				transportFields++
103			}
104		}
105		if transportFields > 1 {
106			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticTransportPrecedence)
107		}
108		switch {
109		case hasHTTP:
110			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
111			setEndpoint(row, server.HTTPURL)
112		case hasTCP:
113			row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
114			endpoint := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP)
115			if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
116				endpoint = "tcp://" + endpoint
117			}
118			setEndpoint(row, endpoint)
119		case hasURL:
120			typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
121			switch typeName {
122			case "http", "streamable-http":
123				row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
124			case "sse":
125				row.Transport = TransportSSE
126			case "":
127				row.Transport = TransportRemote
128				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
129			default:
130				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
131				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
132			}
133			setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
134		case hasCommand:
135			row.Transport = TransportStdio
136			setCommand(row, server.Command)
137		default:
138			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
139		}
140	
141		if server.AuthProviderType != "" {
142			auth := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.AuthProviderType))
143			switch auth {
144			case "dynamic_discovery", "google_credentials", "service_account_impersonation":
145				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, auth, 0)
146			default:
147				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
148			}
149		}
150		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-audience", server.TargetAudience)
151		inspectOAuthValue(row, "target-service-account", server.TargetServiceAccount)
152		if server.OAuth != nil {
153			if server.OAuth.Enabled != nil {
154				addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, *server.OAuth.Enabled)
155			} else {
156				addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
157			}
158			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
159			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", server.OAuth.ClientSecret)
160			inspectOAuthValue(row, "authorization-url", server.OAuth.AuthorizationURL)
161			inspectOAuthValue(row, "token-url", server.OAuth.TokenURL)
162			inspectOAuthValue(row, "redirect-uri", server.OAuth.RedirectURI)
163			inspectOAuthValue(row, "token-parameter", server.OAuth.TokenParamName)
164			for _, scope := range server.OAuth.Scopes {
165				inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", scope)
166			}
167			for _, audience := range server.OAuth.Audiences {
168				inspectOAuthValue(row, "audience", audience)
169			}
170		}
171	}

15	type openCodeServer struct {
16		Type        string            `json:"type"`
17		Command     []string          `json:"command"`
18		Environment map[string]string `json:"environment"`

23	}

26		ClientID     string `json:"clientId"`
27		ClientSecret string `json:"clientSecret"`
28		Scope        string `json:"scope"`
29	}
30	
31	func parseOpenCode(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
32		standard, err := hujson.Standardize(data)
33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument
37		if code := decodeJSON(standard, &document); code != "" {
38			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
39		}
40		var rows []Declaration
41		var codes []DiagnosticCode
42		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCP) {
43			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			var server openCodeServer
49			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCP[rawName], &server); code != "" {
50				codes = append(codes, code)
51				continue
52			}
53			convertOpenCodeServer(&row, server)
54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}
57		return rows, codes
58	}
59	
60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}
77	
78	func convertOpenCodeServer(row *Declaration, server openCodeServer) {
79		row.Enabled = copyBool(server.Enabled)
80		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Environment)
81		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
82	
83		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {
87		case "local":
88			row.Transport = TransportLocal
89			if hasCommand {
90				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
91				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
92			} else {
93				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
94			}
95			if hasURL {
96				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {
114				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {
118				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
119			}
120		}
121		convertOpenCodeOAuth(row, server.OAuth)
122	}
123	
124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}
133		var oauth openCodeOAuth
134		if code := decodeJSON(raw, &oauth); code != "" {
135			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
136			return
137		}
138		addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)
141		inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", oauth.Scope)
142	}

615	func IsLocalSkillSource(source string) bool {

617		return source == "." || source == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(source) || filepath.VolumeName(source) != "" ||
618			strings.HasPrefix(source, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(source, ".\\") ||
619			strings.HasPrefix(source, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(source, "..\\") ||

623	func hashRegularFile(filename string) (string, error) {
624		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
625		if err != nil {
626			return "", err
627		}
628		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
629			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a regular file", filename)
630		}
631		data, err := os.ReadFile(filename)
632		if err != nil {
633			return "", err
634		}
635		hash := sha256.New()
636		fmt.Fprintf(hash, "mode:%04o\x00", info.Mode().Perm())
637		_, _ = hash.Write(data)
638		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
639	}
640	
641	func hashTree(root string) (string, error) {
642		info, err := os.Lstat(root)
643		if err != nil {
644			return "", err
645		}
646		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
647			return "", fmt.Errorf("local setup skill root must not be a symlink")
648		}
649		if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
650			return hashRegularFile(root)
651		}
652		if !info.IsDir() {
653			return "", fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source is not a directory or regular file")
654		}
655		hash := sha256.New()
656		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
657			if walkErr != nil {
658				return walkErr
659			}
660			if filename == root {
661				return nil
662			}
663			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
664			if err != nil {
665				return err
666			}
667			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
668				return fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source contains symlink %s", relative)
669			}
670			if entry.IsDir() {
671				return nil
672			}
673			info, err := entry.Info()
674			if err != nil {
675				return err
676			}
677			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
678				return fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source contains non-regular file %s", relative)
679			}
680			data, err := os.ReadFile(filename)
681			if err != nil {
682				return err
683			}
684			fmt.Fprintf(hash, "%s\x00%04o\x00", filepath.ToSlash(relative), info.Mode().Perm())
685			_, _ = hash.Write(data)
686			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte{0})
687			return nil
688		})
689		if err != nil {
690			return "", err
691		}
692		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
693	}

695	func extractExecutableScaffold(value any) (any, bool) {
696		switch typed := value.(type) {

37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})

9	// tuiAppState publishes complete App snapshots. Config reload builds a private
10	// copy and commits it only while its generation context is still current, so
11	// canceled callbacks can keep reading their old immutable snapshot safely.
12	type tuiAppState struct {
13		current atomic.Pointer[App]
14		reload  sync.Mutex
15	}
16	
17	func newTUIAppState(app *App) *tuiAppState {
18		state := &tuiAppState{}
19		state.current.Store(app)
20		return state
21	}
22	
23	func (s *tuiAppState) Current() *App { return s.current.Load() }
24	
25	func (s *tuiAppState) Prepare(ctx context.Context) (*App, error) {
26		if ctx == nil {
27			ctx = context.Background()
28		}
29		s.reload.Lock()
30		defer s.reload.Unlock()
31		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
32			return nil, err
33		}
34		next := *s.Current()
35		if err := next.Load(); err != nil {
36			return nil, err
37		}
38		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
39			return nil, err
40		}
41		return &next, nil
42	}
43	
44	func (s *tuiAppState) Commit(next *App) {
45		if next != nil {
46			s.current.Store(next)
47		}
48	}

36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}
86

2	// Events deliberately carry only fixed categorical fields and relative times:

39		TUIFirstKeyReceived     Name = "tui.first_key_received"
40		TUIKeyUpdate            Name = "tui.key_update"

55	// View is a fixed dashboard view name.
56	type View string

60		ViewRepos  View = "repos"

64		ViewSkills View = "skills"

70

92		FreshnessFresh Freshness = "fresh"
93		FreshnessStale Freshness = "stale"
94	)

96	// Outcome is a fixed terminal result class. Raw errors are intentionally absent.
97	type Outcome string
98	
99	const (
100		OutcomeSuccess    Outcome = "success"
101		OutcomePartial    Outcome = "partial"
102		OutcomeFailed     Outcome = "failed"
103		OutcomeCanceled   Outcome = "canceled"
104		OutcomeSuperseded Outcome = "superseded"

107	// Fields are the optional categorical dimensions accepted by a trace event.
108	type Fields struct {
109		View       View
110		Stage      Stage
111		Source     Source
112		Freshness  Freshness
113		Outcome    Outcome
114		Generation uint64
115		Rows       *int
116	}
117	
118	// Event is one immutable entry in the versioned trace.
119	type Event struct {
120		Sequence   uint64    `json:"sequence"`
121		AtMicros   int64     `json:"at_us"`
122		DurationUS int64     `json:"duration_us,omitempty"`
123		Name       Name      `json:"name"`
124		View       View      `json:"view,omitempty"`
125		Stage      Stage     `json:"stage,omitempty"`
126		Source     Source    `json:"source,omitempty"`
127		Freshness  Freshness `json:"freshness,omitempty"`
128		Outcome    Outcome   `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
129		Generation uint64    `json:"generation,omitempty"`
130		Rows       *int      `json:"rows,omitempty"`
131	}
132	
133	// Snapshot is the complete frozen on-disk document.
134	type Snapshot struct {
135		SchemaVersion int     `json:"schema_version"`
136		DroppedEvents uint64  `json:"dropped_events"`
137		Events        []Event `json:"events"`
138	}
139	
140	// Recorder is safe for concurrent producers. A nil recorder is a no-op.
141	type Recorder struct {
142		mu sync.Mutex
143	
144		clock  func() time.Time
145		origin time.Time
146		limit  int
147	
148		next    uint64
149		dropped uint64
150		events  []Event
151		once    map[Name]struct{}
152		frozen  bool
153	}
154	
155	// New starts a recorder at the current time.
156	func New(limit int) *Recorder {
157		return NewWithClock(time.Now, limit)
158	}
159	
160	// NewWithClock supplies deterministic time for tests.
161	func NewWithClock(clock func() time.Time, limit int) *Recorder {
162		if clock == nil {
163			clock = time.Now
164		}
165		if limit <= 0 {
166			limit = DefaultLimit
167		}
168		return &Recorder{
169			clock: clock, origin: clock(), limit: limit,
170			events: make([]Event, 0, min(limit, 64)), once: map[Name]struct{}{},
171		}
172	}
173	
174	// Mark records an instantaneous event.
175	func (r *Recorder) Mark(name Name, fields Fields) {
176		if r == nil {
177			return
178		}
179		r.record(name, fields, r.clock(), 0)
180	}
181	
182	// MarkOnce records only the first occurrence of name.
183	func (r *Recorder) MarkOnce(name Name, fields Fields) {
184		if r == nil {
185			return
186		}
187		r.mu.Lock()
188		if r.frozen {
189			r.mu.Unlock()
190			return
191		}
192		if _, exists := r.once[name]; exists {
193			r.mu.Unlock()
194			return
195		}
196		r.once[name] = struct{}{}
197		now := r.clock()
198		r.recordLocked(name, fields, now, 0)
199		r.mu.Unlock()
200	}
201	
202	// Start returns a closure that records one span. Calling the closure more than
203	// once is harmless.
204	func (r *Recorder) Start(name Name, fields Fields) func(Outcome) {
205		if r == nil {
206			return func(Outcome) {}
207		}
208		started := r.clock()
209		var once sync.Once
210		return func(outcome Outcome) {
211			once.Do(func() {
212				fields.Outcome = outcome
213				finished := r.clock()
214				duration := finished.Sub(started)
215				duration = max(duration, 0)
216				r.record(name, fields, started, duration)
217			})
218		}
219	}
220	
221	// Freeze stops the recorder and returns an independent snapshot. Late events are
222	// ignored so background Bubble Tea commands cannot race trace persistence.
223	func (r *Recorder) Freeze() Snapshot {
224		if r == nil {
225			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Events: []Event{}}
226		}
227		r.mu.Lock()
228		defer r.mu.Unlock()
229		r.frozen = true
230		return Snapshot{
231			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
232			DroppedEvents: r.dropped,
233			Events:        append([]Event(nil), r.events...),
234		}
235	}
236	
237	func (r *Recorder) record(name Name, fields Fields, at time.Time, duration time.Duration) {
238		r.mu.Lock()
239		defer r.mu.Unlock()
240		if r.frozen {
241			return
242		}
243		r.recordLocked(name, fields, at, duration)
244	}
245	
246	func (r *Recorder) recordLocked(name Name, fields Fields, at time.Time, duration time.Duration) {
247		if len(r.events) >= r.limit {
248			r.dropped++
249			return
250		}
251		r.next++
252		offset := max(at.Sub(r.origin), 0)
253		r.events = append(r.events, Event{
254			Sequence: r.next, AtMicros: offset.Microseconds(), DurationUS: duration.Microseconds(),
255			Name: name, View: fields.View, Stage: fields.Stage, Source: fields.Source,
256			Freshness: fields.Freshness, Outcome: fields.Outcome,
257			Generation: fields.Generation, Rows: fields.Rows,
258		})
259	}
260	
261	// WriteNew writes a trace without overwriting an existing path. Traces are
262	// diagnostics rather than durable state, so an interrupted write is removed.
263	func WriteNew(path string, snapshot Snapshot) error {
264		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
265			return errors.New("performance trace path must be absolute")
266		}
267		if snapshot.SchemaVersion == 0 {
268			snapshot.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
269		}
270		if snapshot.Events == nil {
271			snapshot.Events = []Event{}
272		}
273		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(snapshot, "", "  ")
274		if err != nil {
275			return fmt.Errorf("encode performance trace: %w", err)
276		}
277		data = append(data, '\n')
278	
279		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
280		if err != nil {
281			return fmt.Errorf("create performance trace: %w", err)
282		}
283		remove := true
284		defer func() {
285			if remove {
286				_ = os.Remove(path)
287			}
288		}()
289		if _, err := file.Write(data); err != nil {
290			_ = file.Close()
291			return fmt.Errorf("write performance trace: %w", err)
292		}
293		if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
294			_ = file.Close()
295			return fmt.Errorf("sync performance trace: %w", err)
296		}
297		if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
298			return fmt.Errorf("close performance trace: %w", err)
299		}
300		remove = false
301		return nil
302	}
303

88			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}, nil

135	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
136		var rows []Declaration
137		var codes []DiagnosticCode
138		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {

141				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
142				continue
143			}

146				codes = append(codes, code)
147				continue
148			}
149			convertClaudeServer(&row, server)
150			if state != nil {
151				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
152				switch {
153				case enabled && disabled:
154					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
155					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
156					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157				case enabled:

160					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
161				case disabled:
162					value := false
163					row.Enabled = &value
164					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
165				}
166			}
167			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
168			rows = append(rows, row)
169		}
170		return rows, codes
171	}

173	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
174		setCommand(row, server.Command)
175		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
176		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
177		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
178		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
179		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
180		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
181			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
182		}
183		if server.OAuth != nil {
184			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
185			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
186			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
187			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
188		}
189	
190		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
191		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
192		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
193		if hasCommand && hasURL {
194			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
195		}
196		switch typeName {
197		case "stdio":
198			if hasCommand {
199				row.Transport = TransportStdio
200			}
201		case "http", "streamable-http":
202			if hasURL {
203				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
204			}
205		case "sse":
206			if hasURL {
207				row.Transport = TransportSSE
208			}
209		case "ws", "websocket":
210			if hasURL {
211				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
212			}
213		case "":
214			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
215				row.Transport = TransportStdio
216			}
217		}
218		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
220		}
221	}

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false

246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)

248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)

252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}

274		if value == nil {

276		}

45				continue
46			}

48			inspectArguments(&row, server.Args)

52				addRedaction(&row, RedactionFileReference)

57				addPolicy(&row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
58				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-id", server.Auth.ClientID)
59				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-secret", server.Auth.ClientSecret)
60				for _, scope := range server.Auth.Scopes {
61					inspectOAuthValue(&row, "scope", scope)
62				}
63			}
64	
65			hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
66			hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
67			if hasCommand && hasURL {

77			}

97		hasTCP := strings.TrimSpace(server.TCP) != ""
98		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
99		transportFields := 0

105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {
114				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {
118				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
119			}
120		}
121		convertOpenCodeOAuth(row, server.OAuth)
122	}
123	
124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}
133		var oauth openCodeOAuth
134		if code := decodeJSON(raw, &oauth); code != "" {
135			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
136			return
137		}
138		addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)
141		inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", oauth.Scope)
142	}

34	func decodeJSON(data []byte, target any) DiagnosticCode {

51	func reflectContainsControl(value reflect.Value) bool {
52		if !value.IsValid() {

54		}
55		if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface || value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {

76			}

108	func looksSecretString(value string) bool {

261	func setCommand(row *Declaration, command string) {
262		command = strings.TrimSpace(command)

271			return
272		}
273		if strings.Contains(command, "${") || strings.Contains(command, "{env:") ||
274			dollarPattern.MatchString(command) || percentPattern.MatchString(command) {
275			row.Command = "[dynamic]"

277			return

279		normalized := strings.ReplaceAll(command, `\`, "/")
280		basename := path.Base(normalized)

286			addRedaction(row, RedactionArguments)
287			return
288		}
289		row.Command = basename

292		}
293	}

295	func setEndpoint(row *Declaration, raw string) {
296		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
297		if raw == "" {
298			return
299		}
300		inspectReferences(row, raw)
301		if openCodeFilePattern.MatchString(raw) {
302			inspectFileReference(row, raw)
303			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
304			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
305			return
306		}
307		if dollarBracePattern.MatchString(raw) || dollarPattern.MatchString(raw) || percentPattern.MatchString(raw) || openCodeEnvPattern.MatchString(raw) {
308			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
309			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
310			return
311		}
312		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
313		if err != nil || parsed.Opaque != "" || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" || !schemePattern.MatchString(parsed.Scheme) || stringContainsControl(parsed.Host) || looksSecretString(parsed.Host) {
314			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint)
315			return
316		}
317		if parsed.User != nil {
318			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLUserinfo)
319		}
320		if parsed.RawQuery != "" || parsed.ForceQuery {
321			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLQuery)
322		}
323		if parsed.Fragment != "" {
324			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLFragment)
325		}
326		endpoint := strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) + "://" + strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
327		if parsed.EscapedPath() != "" && parsed.EscapedPath() != "/" {
328			endpoint += "/[path]"
329			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLPath)
330		} else if parsed.EscapedPath() == "/" {
331			endpoint += "/"
332		}
333		row.Endpoint = endpoint
334	}

336	func addCredential(row *Declaration, credential CredentialReference) {
337		if credential.Name != "" && (!utf8.ValidString(credential.Name) || stringContainsControl(credential.Name) || len(credential.Name) > maximumReferenceBytes) {
338			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
339			return
340		}
341		for _, existing := range row.Credentials {
342			if existing == credential {
343				return
344			}
345		}
346		row.Credentials = append(row.Credentials, credential)
347	}
348	
349	func addRedaction(row *Declaration, redaction Redaction) {
350		for _, existing := range row.Redactions {
351			if existing == redaction {
352				return
353			}
354		}
355		row.Redactions = append(row.Redactions, redaction)
356	}
357	
358	func addCoverage(row *Declaration, code DiagnosticCode) {
359		for _, existing := range row.Coverage {
360			if existing.Code == code {
361				return
362			}
363		}
364		row.Coverage = append(row.Coverage, coverage(code))
365	}

367	func addPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value string, count int) {
368		fact := PolicyFact{Kind: kind, Value: value, Count: count}
369		for _, existing := range row.Policies {
370			if existing == fact {
371				return
372			}
373		}
374		row.Policies = append(row.Policies, fact)
375	}

377	func addBooleanPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value bool) {
378		addPolicy(row, kind, strconv.FormatBool(value), 0)
379	}
380	
381	func finalizeDeclaration(row *Declaration) {
382		sort.Slice(row.Credentials, func(i, j int) bool {
383			if row.Credentials[i].Kind != row.Credentials[j].Kind {
384				return row.Credentials[i].Kind < row.Credentials[j].Kind
385			}
386			return row.Credentials[i].Name < row.Credentials[j].Name
387		})
388		sort.Slice(row.Redactions, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Redactions[i] < row.Redactions[j] })
389		sort.Slice(row.Policies, func(i, j int) bool {
390			if row.Policies[i].Kind != row.Policies[j].Kind {
391				return row.Policies[i].Kind < row.Policies[j].Kind
392			}
393			if row.Policies[i].Value != row.Policies[j].Value {
394				return row.Policies[i].Value < row.Policies[j].Value
395			}
396			return row.Policies[i].Count < row.Policies[j].Count
397		})
398		sort.Slice(row.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Coverage[i].Code < row.Coverage[j].Code })
399	}

168		out := make([]skillJSON, 0, len(rows))

171			for _, installation := range row.Installations {
172				installations = append(installations, skillInstallationJSON{
173					Path: installation.Path, RealPath: installation.RealPath,
174					LogicalPaths: installation.LogicalPaths, AgentIDs: installation.AgentIDs,
175					Integrity: string(installation.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: installation.IntegrityDetail,
176				})
177			}
178			item := skillJSON{
179				Name: row.Name, Scope: string(row.Scope), ScopeRoot: row.ScopeRoot,
180				Path: row.Path, Agents: row.Agents, Source: row.Source,
181				SourceURL: row.SourceURL, SourceType: row.SourceType,
182				ManagedBy: string(row.ManagedBy), UpdateStatus: string(row.UpdateStatus),
183				UpdateDetail: row.UpdateDetail, Repo: row.Repository, RepoPath: row.RepositoryPath,
184				Checkout: row.Checkout, Installations: installations, Presence: string(row.Presence),
185				Integrity: string(row.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: row.IntegrityDetail,
186				AgentIDs: row.Attribution.AgentIDs, RegistrySource: row.Attribution.Registry,
187				RegistryVersion: row.RegistryVersion,
188			}
189			if row.Lock != nil {
190				item.LockVersion, item.Ref, item.SkillPath = row.Lock.Version, row.Lock.Ref, row.Lock.SkillPath
191				item.Plugin, item.InstalledAt, item.UpdatedAt = row.Lock.PluginName, row.Lock.InstalledAt, row.Lock.UpdatedAt
192				item.WellKnownDigest = row.Lock.WellKnownDigest
193			}
194			out = append(out, item)
195		}
196		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
197		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
198		return enc.Encode(out)
199	}

231	func skillInstallLabel(row agentskill.Skill) string {
232		if row.Presence == agentskill.PresenceMissing {
233			return "missing"
234		}
235		switch row.Integrity {

237			return "verified"

239			return "drifted"

256	func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
257		if len(agents) == 0 {
258			return "—"
259		}
260		names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
261		sort.Strings(names)
262		if len(names) <= 3 {
263			return strings.Join(names, ", ")
264		}
265		return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
266	}

407	Re-running is a no-op when nothing changed, so this is safe to call from a
408	dotfiles bootstrap on every apply.`,
409			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
410			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
411				target := dir

413					target = skill.DefaultDir()
414				}
415				res, err := skill.Install(config.Expand(target), !noLink)
416				if err != nil {
417					return err
418				}
419				switch {
420				case len(res.Written) == 0:

422				default:
423					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "installed %d file(s) to %s\n", len(res.Written), config.Contract(res.Dir))

436		f.BoolVar(&noLink, "no-link", false, "do not symlink into per-tool skill directories")

440	func newSkillSyncCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
441		var check bool
442		cmd := &cobra.Command{
443			Use:   "sync",
444			Short: "Regenerate the skill's command reference from the live command tree",
445			Long: `Rewrite the generated section of the skill's command reference from this
446	binary's actual command tree, so the documented flags can never drift from the
447	implemented ones.
448	
449	With --check, report drift and exit non-zero instead of writing — the form to
450	wire into CI or a pre-push hook.`,
451			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
452			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
453				generated := generateCommandReference(cmd.Root())
454				return syncCommandReference(app, generated, check)
455			},
456		}
457		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&check, "check", false, "report drift and exit non-zero instead of writing")
458		return cmd
459	}
460	
461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}

1	package inventory
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}
86

42	func newDoctorCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

45			Short: "Check dependencies, paths and runtime backends",
46			Long: `Report what dev can and cannot do on this machine.
47	
48	Only git is required. Everything else — a multiplexer, a forge CLI — enables
49	extra behaviour and degrades cleanly when missing, so a warning here is not a
50	problem to fix unless you want that capability.`,
51			Args: cobra.NoArgs,

54			},
55		}
56	}
57	
58	func runDoctor(app *App) error {
59		ctx := ctxOf()
60		var checks []check
61	
62		// What am I running? A build several commits past its last release behaves
63		// differently from that release, and `dev --version` alone does not say so.
64		checks = append(checks, check{"dev", checkOK, versionSummary()})
65	
66		// Windows has no tmux/Zellij/Herdr, so a warning against those backends
67		// below is expected rather than something to fix.
68		if goruntime.GOOS == "windows" {
69			checks = append(checks, check{"platform", checkWarn,
70				"windows — tmux, Zellij and Herdr are unavailable; dev uses the no-multiplexer backend"})
71		}
72	
73		// Required.
74		if v, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "--version").Output(); err == nil {
75			checks = append(checks, check{"git", checkOK, strings.TrimSpace(string(v))})
76		} else {
77			checks = append(checks, check{"git", checkFail, "not found — dev cannot work without it"})
78		}
79	
80		// Runtime backends.
81		active := app.Runtime().Name()
82		for _, rt := range runtime.All() {
83			name := rt.Name()
84			detail := "not available"
85			st := checkWarn
86			if rt.Available() {
87				st, detail = checkOK, "available"
88				if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil && len(sessions) > 0 {
89					detail = fmt.Sprintf("available, %d live session(s)", len(sessions))
90				}
91			}
92			if name == "none" {
93				st, detail = checkOK, "always available (prints a cd directive)"
94			}
95			if name == active {
96				detail += "  ← selected"
97			}
98			checks = append(checks, check{"runtime/" + name, st, detail})
99		}
100	
101		// Optional forge CLIs.

108			} else {

110			}

122		}
123		mutationDetail := mutation.Detail
124		if mutation.Command == "skills" {

127				mutationDetail = "skills executable found but current directory is unavailable"

195		sample, err := app.Cfg.WorktreePathFor("example", "/repo/example", "feat/demo", "")
196		if err != nil {
197			checks = append(checks, check{"worktree path", checkFail, err.Error()})
198		} else {
199			checks = append(checks, check{"worktree path", checkOK,
200				config.Contract(sample) + fmt.Sprintf("  (root %s, %s)", config.Contract(wtRoot), writableNote(wtRoot))})
201		}
202	
203		// Render.
204		failures := 0
205		style := app.outStyle()
206		for _, c := range checks {
207			if c.status == checkFail {
208				failures++
209			}
210			icon := c.status.icon()
211			detail := c.detail
212			switch c.status {
213			case checkOK:
214				icon = style.success(icon)
215			case checkWarn:
216				icon, detail = style.warning(icon), style.warning(detail)
217			case checkFail:
218				icon, detail = style.danger(icon), style.danger(detail)
219			}
220			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s %s\n", icon, style.label(fmt.Sprintf("%-16s", c.name)), detail)
221		}
222		if failures > 0 {
223			return fmt.Errorf("%d required check(s) failed", failures)
224		}
225		return nil
226	}
227	
228	func pathCheck(p string) (checkStatus, string) {
229		info, err := os.Stat(p)
230		switch {
231		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
232			return checkOK, config.Contract(p)
233		case os.IsNotExist(err):
234			return checkWarn, config.Contract(p) + " (will be created on first use)"
235		case err != nil:
236			return checkFail, err.Error()
237		default:
238			return checkFail, config.Contract(p) + " is not a directory"
239		}
240	}
241	
242	// writableNote reports whether dev could actually create a worktree under the
243	// configured root, walking up to the nearest existing ancestor. A root on an
244	// unmounted volume or a read-only mount is the failure this catches early,
245	// before a `dev wt create` gets halfway through.
246	func writableNote(root string) string {
247		dir := root
248		for {
249			if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
250				if !info.IsDir() {
251					return "not a directory"
252				}
253				if dirWritable(dir) {
254					return "writable"
255				}
256				return "NOT WRITABLE"
257			}
258			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
259			if parent == dir {
260				return "unreachable"
261			}
262			dir = parent
263		}
264	}
265	
266	// dirWritable probes by creating and removing a temp file. There is no
267	// portable stdlib permission check, and the mode bits alone would lie about
268	// read-only mounts and ACLs.
269	func dirWritable(dir string) bool {
270		f, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".dev-write-probe-*")
271		if err != nil {
272			return false
273		}
274		name := f.Name()
275		f.Close()
276		os.Remove(name)
277		return true
278	}

145		long := cmd.Long

153			long = strings.TrimRight(long, "\n") + fmt.Sprintf("\n\nSee also: dev help %s", topic)

155		if long != cmd.Long {
156			cmd.Long = long
157		}
