```text
+func skillInstallState(row agentskill.Skill) string {
+	if row.Presence == agentskill.PresenceMissing {
+		return "missing"
+	}
+	switch row.Integrity {
+	case agentskill.IntegrityVerified:
+		return "verified"
+	case agentskill.IntegrityDrifted:
+		return "drifted"
+	default:
+		return "present"
+	}
+}
+
+func (m Model) renderMCP() string {
+	state := m.viewLoad(ViewMCP)
+	rows := m.visibleMCP()
+	if state.loading && len(m.mcp) == 0 {
+		return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading static MCP declarations…") + "\n"
+	}
+	if len(rows) == 0 {
+		if !state.hasSnapshot {
+			return "  " + styleDim.Render("MCP declarations load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
+		}
+		if m.filter != "" {
+			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No MCP declaration matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
+		}
+		return "  " + styleDim.Render("No MCP server declarations found.") + "\n"
+	}
+
+	var headers []string
+	var values func(agentmcp.Declaration) []string
+	switch {
+	case m.width >= 112:
+		repoW, scopeW, agentW, transportW, stateW, sourceW := 16, 12, 12, 16, 10, 14
+		serverW := max(18, m.width-94)
+		headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("AGENT", agentW), fitCell("SERVER", serverW), fitCell("TRANSPORT", transportW), fitCell("STATE", stateW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}
+		values = func(row agentmcp.Declaration) []string {
+			return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(string(row.Agent), agentW), fitCell(row.Name, serverW), fitCell(string(row.Transport), transportW), fitCell(mcpDeclarationState(row), stateW), fitCell(mcpSource(row), sourceW)}
+		}
+	case m.width >= 94:
+		repoW, scopeW, agentW, transportW, stateW := 16, 12, 12, 16, 10
+		serverW := max(16, m.width-78)
+		headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("AGENT", agentW), fitCell("SERVER", serverW), fitCell("TRANSPORT", transportW), fitCell("STATE", stateW)}
+		values = func(row agentmcp.Declaration) []string {
+			return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(string(row.Agent), agentW), fitCell(row.Name, serverW), fitCell(string(row.Transport), transportW), fitCell(mcpDeclarationState(row), stateW)}
+		}
+	default:
+		repoW, agentW, stateW := 14, 12, 10
+		serverW := max(12, m.width-44)
+		headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("AGENT", agentW), fitCell("SERVER", serverW), fitCell("STATE", stateW)}
+		values = func(row agentmcp.Declaration) []string {
+			return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Agent), agentW), fitCell(row.Name, serverW), fitCell(mcpDeclarationState(row), stateW)}
+		}
+	}
+
+	var b strings.Builder
+	if state.loading {
+		b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing MCP declarations while refreshing…") + "\n")
+	}
+	b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
+	from, to := m.window(len(rows))
+	for i := from; i < to; i++ {
+		row := rows[i]
+		line := strings.Join(values(row), "  ")
+		styled := line
+		if row.Enabled != nil && !*row.Enabled {
+			styled = styleDim.Render(line)
+		} else if row.Enabled != nil && *row.Enabled {
+			styled = styleLive.Render(line)
+		}
+		b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
+	}
+	b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
+	return b.String()
+}
+
+func mcpSource(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
+	source := string(row.Source)
+	if row.Plugin != "" {
+		source += ":" + row.Plugin
+	}
+	return source
+}
+
+func dashCell(value string) string {
+	if value == "" {
+		return "—"
+	}
+	return value
+}
+
+func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
+	parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
+	for _, policy := range row.Policies {
+		part := string(policy.Kind)
+		if policy.Value != "" {
+			part += ":" + policy.Value
+		}
+		if policy.Count > 0 {
+			part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
+		}
+		parts = append(parts, part)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
+}
+
+func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
+	parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
+	for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
+		part := string(credential.Kind)
+		if credential.Name != "" {
+			part += ":" + credential.Name
+		}
+		parts = append(parts, part)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
+}

 func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
 	var parts []string
 	for _, item := range []struct {
 		label string
 		n     int
 	}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
 		if item.n > 0 {
 			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
 		}
 	}
 	if len(parts) == 0 {
 		return "—"
 	}
 	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
 }

 // wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
 // rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
 func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
 	if width < 20 {
```

```text
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)

40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
181		for i, component := range components {
182			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
184			}
185		}
186		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
187		if err != nil {
188			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
189		}
190		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
191	}
192	
193	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
194		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
195			return false
196		}
197		letter := component[0]
198		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
199	}
200	
201	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
202		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
203			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
204		}) {
205			if component == ".." {
206				return true
207			}
208		}
209		return false
210	}
```

```text
646	 // setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
647	 func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
648	 	n := m.count()
649	 	switch {
650	 	case n == 0:
651	 		i = 0
652	 	case i >= n:
653	 		i = n - 1
654	 	case i < 0:
655	 		i = 0
656	 	}
657	 	switch m.view {
658	 	case ViewRepos:
659	 		m.repoCursor = i
660	 	case ViewFleet:
661	 		m.fleetCursor = i
662	 	case ViewTries:
663	 		m.tryCursor = i
664	 	case ViewRemote:
665	 		m.remoteCursor = i
666	 	case ViewSkills:
667	 		m.skillCursor = i
668	+	case ViewMCP:
669	+		m.mcpCursor = i
670	 	default:
671	 		m.taskCursor = i
672	 	}
673	 }
```

```text
 // window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
 // it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
 func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
 	h := m.listHeight()
 	if n <= h {
 		return 0, n
 	}
 	from = m.at() - h/2
 	if from < 0 {
 		from = 0
 	}
 	if from+h > n {
 		from = n - h
 	}
 	return from, from + h
 }

+func mcpSource(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

+func dashCell(value string) string {
+	if value == "" {

+	return value

+func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
+	parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
+	for _, policy := range row.Policies {
+		part := string(policy.Kind)
+		if policy.Value != "" {
+			part += ":" + policy.Value
+		}
+		if policy.Count > 0 {
+			part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
+		}
+		parts = append(parts, part)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
+}

+		if credential.Name != "" {
+			part += ":" + credential.Name
+		}
+		parts = append(parts, part)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
+}
```

```text
173	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
174		setCommand(row, server.Command)
175		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
176		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
177		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
178		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
179		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
180		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
181			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
182		}
183		if server.OAuth != nil {
184			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
185			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
186			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
187			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
188		}
189	
190		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
191		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
192		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
193		if hasCommand && hasURL {
194			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
195		}
196		switch typeName {
197		case "stdio":
198			if hasCommand {
199				row.Transport = TransportStdio
200			}
201		case "http", "streamable-http":
202			if hasURL {
203				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
204			}
205		case "sse":
206			if hasURL {
207				row.Transport = TransportSSE
208			}
209		case "ws", "websocket":
210			if hasURL {
211				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
212			}
213		case "":
214			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
215				row.Transport = TransportStdio
216			}
217		}
218		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
220		}
221	}

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false
245		}
246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
247		if err != nil {
248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
251		candidateReal := candidate
252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}
272

275			return nil
276		}
277		copy := *value
278		return &copy
279	}
```

```text
11	func parseCodex(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
12		if !utf8.Valid(data) {
13			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
14		}
15		var document map[string]any
16		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &document); err != nil {
17			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
18		}
19		if containsControl(document) {
20			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
21		}
22	
23		var rows []Declaration
24		var codes []DiagnosticCode
25		for _, rawName := range sortedTableKeys(tableValue(document["mcp_servers"])) {
26			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
27			if !ok {
28				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
29				continue
30			}
31			server, ok := tableValue(document["mcp_servers"])[rawName].(map[string]any)
32			if !ok {
33				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
34				continue
35			}
36			convertCodexServer(&row, server)
37			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
38			rows = append(rows, row)
39		}
40	
41		plugins := tableValue(document["plugins"])
42		for _, rawPlugin := range sortedTableKeys(plugins) {
43			plugin, ok := normalizedPlugin(rawPlugin)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			pluginTable := tableValue(plugins[rawPlugin])
49			pluginEnabled, hasPluginEnabled := boolField(pluginTable, "enabled")
50			servers := tableValue(pluginTable["mcp_servers"])
51			for _, rawName := range sortedTableKeys(servers) {
52				rowSpec := spec
53				rowSpec.source = SourcePlugin
54				row, ok := newDeclaration(rowSpec, rawName)
55				if !ok {
56					codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
57					continue
58				}
59				row.Plugin = plugin
60				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
61				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent)
62				if override, ok := servers[rawName].(map[string]any); ok {
63					applyCodexPolicy(&row, override)
64				} else {
65					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
66				}
67				if hasPluginEnabled {
68					addBooleanPolicy(&row, PolicyPluginEnabled, pluginEnabled)
69					if !pluginEnabled || row.Enabled == nil {

94		if bearer, ok := stringField(server, "bearer_token_env_var"); ok {

97		if enabled, ok := boolField(server, "enabled"); ok {

100		if required, ok := boolField(server, "required"); ok {
101			row.Required = &required
102		}
103		applyCodexPolicy(row, server)

105		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(command) != ""
106		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(url) != ""
107		if hasCommand && hasURL {
108			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
109		}
110		switch {
111		case hasURL:
112			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
113		case hasCommand:
114			row.Transport = TransportStdio
115		default:

117		}

119		if auth, ok := stringField(server, "auth"); ok && auth != "" {

123			default:

125			}
126		}

129			for _, field := range []string{"client_id", "callback_url", "callback_port"} {

137	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {
138		if enabled, ok := boolField(values, "enabled"); ok {

187			return table
188		}
189		return nil
190	}

193		keys := make([]string, 0, len(table))
194		for key := range table {

196		}
197		sort.Strings(keys)

212		switch value := value.(type) {

214			return value, true
215		case int64:

217		default:

222	func stringSlice(value any) []string {
223		switch values := value.(type) {
224		case []string:
225			return append([]string(nil), values...)
226		case []any:
227			out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
228			for _, value := range values {

230					out = append(out, text)

232			}
233			return out

236		}

240		table := tableValue(value)
241		if len(table) == 0 {
242			return nil
243		}
244		out := make(map[string]string, len(table))
245		for key, value := range table {
```

```text
29	func parseCursor(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {

40				continue
41			}
42			var server cursorServer
43			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
44				codes = append(codes, code)
45				continue
46			}
47			setCommand(&row, server.Command)
48			inspectArguments(&row, server.Args)
49			inspectEnvironment(&row, server.Env)
50			if strings.TrimSpace(server.EnvFile) != "" {
51				addCredential(&row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialFile})
52				addRedaction(&row, RedactionFileReference)
53			}
54			setEndpoint(&row, server.URL)
55			inspectHeaders(&row, server.Headers)
56			if server.Auth != nil {
57				addPolicy(&row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
58				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-id", server.Auth.ClientID)
59				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-secret", server.Auth.ClientSecret)
60				for _, scope := range server.Auth.Scopes {
61					inspectOAuthValue(&row, "scope", scope)
62				}
63			}
64	
65			hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
66			hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
67			if hasCommand && hasURL {
68				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
69			} else if hasURL {
70				// Cursor's static URL form does not identify SSE versus streamable HTTP.
71				row.Transport = TransportRemote
72			} else if hasCommand {
73				row.Transport = TransportStdio
74			}

76				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
77			}
```

```text
1605			}

1611			for _, raw := range []string{m.remotes[i].Repo.CloneURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.SSHURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.URL} {
1612				if identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
1613					break
1614				}
1615			}
1616			repository, repoOK := byRemote[key]
1617			try, tryOK := triesByIdentity[identity]
1618			sameCheckout := repoOK && tryOK && remotePathsOverlap(repository, try)
1619			if ambiguous[key] || ambiguousTry[identity] || (repoOK && tryOK && !sameCheckout) {

1621				continue
1622			}
1623			if repoOK {
1624				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = repository.Repo.Path
1625				m.remotes[i].LocalName = repository.Repo.Display()
1626				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1627				if repository.Asset != nil {
1628					m.remotes[i].LocalKind = repository.Asset.Kind
1629				}
1630				continue
1631			}
1632			if tryOK {
1633				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = try.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1634				m.remotes[i].LocalName = try.Item.DisplayName()
1635				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindTry
1636				continue
1637			}
1638			m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1639		}

1642	func remotePathsOverlap(repository RepoRow, try TryRow) bool {
1643		for _, left := range []string{repository.Repo.Path, repository.Repo.RealPath} {
1644			for _, right := range []string{try.Item.Live.CurrentPath, try.Item.Live.RealPath} {
1645				if left != "" && right != "" && filepath.Clean(left) == filepath.Clean(right) {
1646					return true
1647				}
1648			}
1649		}
1650		return false
1651	}

1653	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
1654	// tools and for the cd directive.
1655	func (m Model) currentDir() string {

1658				return r.Checkout
1659			}
1660			return ""
1661		}
1662		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
1663			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
1664				if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
1665					return checkout.Worktree.Path

1667				return ""
1668			}
1669			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
1670		}
1671		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Present() {
1672			return r.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1673		}
1674		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
1675			return r.LocalPath
1676		}
1677		return ""
1678	}
```

```text
307	func isolateAgentEnvironment(t *testing.T) string {
308		t.Helper()
309		home := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "home")
310		mustMkdir(t, home)
311		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
312		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
313		t.Setenv("XDG_STATE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".state"))
314		for name, directory := range map[string]string{
315			"CODEX_HOME": ".codex", "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR": ".claude", "VIBE_HOME": ".vibe",
316			"HERMES_HOME": ".hermes", "AUTOHAND_HOME": ".autohand", "GROK_HOME": ".grok",
317		} {
318			t.Setenv(name, filepath.Join(home, directory))
319		}
320		return home
321	}

363		t.Helper()

365			t.Fatal(err)

369	func mustRun(t *testing.T, directory, binary string, args ...string) string {
370		t.Helper()
371		command := exec.Command(binary, args...)
372		command.Dir = directory
373		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
374		if err != nil {
375			t.Fatalf("%s %v: %v\n%s", binary, args, err, output)
376		}
377		return string(output)
378	}
379	
380	func skillsByName(rows []Skill) map[string]Skill {
381		result := make(map[string]Skill, len(rows))
382		for _, row := range rows {
383			result[row.Name] = row
384		}
385		return result
386	}

388	func contains(values []string, want string) bool {
389		for _, value := range values {
390			if value == want {
391				return true
392			}
393		}
394		return false
395	}
```

```text
14	func TestCheckUpdatesGroupsSourcesBoundsWorkersPreservesOrderAndCleans(t *testing.T) {
15		rows := []Skill{
16			managedUpdateRow("first", "https://example.test/shared.git", "main"),
17			managedUpdateRow("second", "https://example.test/other.git", ""),
18			managedUpdateRow("third", "https://example.test/shared.git", "main"),
19			{Name: "external", ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown},
20		}
21		rows[2].Lock.SkillPath = rows[0].Lock.SkillPath
22		var active, maximum, cleanups, checks atomic.Int32
23		calls := map[string]int{}
24		var callsMu sync.Mutex
25		clone := func(_ context.Context, url, ref string) (sourceCheckout, error) {
26			callsMu.Lock()
27			calls[url+"\x00"+ref]++
28			callsMu.Unlock()
29			current := active.Add(1)
30			for {
31				old := maximum.Load()
32				if current <= old || maximum.CompareAndSwap(old, current) {
33					break
34				}
35			}
36			return sourceCheckout{dir: url, cleanup: func() {
37				active.Add(-1)
38				cleanups.Add(1)
39			}}, nil
40		}
41		check := func(_ context.Context, _ string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
42			checks.Add(1)
43			time.Sleep(15 * time.Millisecond)
44			return UpdateCurrent, "checked " + row.Name
45		}
46	
47		got := checkUpdatesWith(context.Background(), rows, updateCheckDeps{clone: clone, check: check, workers: 2})
```

```text
1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
38		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
39		GitDir    string
40		CommonDir string
41		MainRoot  string
42		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
43		Bare bool
44		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
45		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
46		// initialise them.
47		HasGit bool
48	}
49	
50	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
51	func (r Repo) Display() string {
52		if r.Category == "" {
53			return r.Name
54		}
55		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
56	}
57	
58	// Options tunes discovery.
59	type Options struct {
60		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
61		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
62		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
63		MaxDepth int
64		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
65		IncludeNonRepos bool
66		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
67		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
68		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
69		Fast bool
70	}
71	
72	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
73	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
74	
75	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
76	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
77	
78	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
79	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
80	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
81		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
82		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
83		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
84		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
85	}
86	
87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101	
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108	
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134	
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141	
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
149					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
150						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})
181					}
182					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
183					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
184					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
185					return filepath.SkipDir
186				}
187				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
188					return filepath.SkipDir
189				}
190				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
191					if !seen[path] {
192						seen[path] = true
193						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
194					}
195				}
196				return nil
197			})
198			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
199				return out, ctx.Err()
200			}
201		}
202	
203		for i := range out {
204			if out[i].Category == "." {
205				out[i].Category = ""
206			}
207		}
208		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
209			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
210				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
211			}
212			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
213		})
214		return out, nil
215	}
216	
217	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
218	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
219	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
220		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
221			return true
222		}
223		return isBareDir(path)
224	}
225	
226	func gitEntryIsFile(path string) bool {
227		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git"))
228		return err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular()
229	}
230	
231	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
232	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
233		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
234			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
235				return false
236			}
237		}
238		return true
239	}
240	
241	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
242	//
243	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
247		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
248	}
249	
250	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
251	// process per repository in the scan roots.
252	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
253		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())
254	}
255	
256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}
297	
298	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
299	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
300	
301	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
302	
303	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
304	type AmbiguousError struct {
305		Ref        string
306		Candidates []Repo
307	}
308	
309	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
310		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
311		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
312			names[i] = c.Display()
313		}
314		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
315	}
```

```text
1	package inventory

3	import "context"
4	
5	// Limiter bounds expensive local enrichment across collectors that would
6	// otherwise each create their own worker pool.
7	type Limiter struct {
8		permits chan struct{}
9	}
10	
11	// NewLimiter returns a context-aware concurrency bound.
12	func NewLimiter(limit int) *Limiter {
13		if limit <= 0 {
14			limit = 8
15		}
16		return &Limiter{permits: make(chan struct{}, limit)}
17	}
18	
19	// Acquire waits for one permit and returns a matching release function.
20	func (l *Limiter) Acquire(ctx context.Context) (func(), bool) {
21		if l == nil {
22			return func() {}, true
23		}
24		if ctx == nil {
25			ctx = context.Background()
26		}
27		select {
28		case l.permits <- struct{}{}:
29			return func() { <-l.permits }, true
30		case <-ctx.Done():
31			return nil, false
```

```text
index 6f06541..9c72114 100644
--- a/internal/cli/tldr.go
+++ b/internal/cli/tldr.go
@@ -13,136 +13,146 @@ import (
 // default task loop in workflowTLDR.
 //
 // ASCII only, like workflowTLDR: this text lands in terminals whose encoding
 // dev does not control. assertASCIIDiagram enforces it.
 var familyTLDR = map[string]string{
 	"dev repo": `TL;DR: acquire the checkout, then choose how ready it should be
 
   dev repo new/create --> scaffold --> optional upstream --> cd/open/start
   dev repo clone      --> checkout --> optional setup    --> cd/open/start
   dev repo setup      --> idempotent files/skills/hooks --> review or commit
 
   Local-only is the default. Project-owned executable config must be trusted
   by its exact content hash before dev runs it.`,
 
 	"dev wt": `TL;DR: the checkout is disposable, the branch is not
 
   dev start --mode worktree --> paths.worktree_path/<repo>/<branch>
                                   |
                                   +-- dev wt list       what exists, and how dirty
                                   +-- dev wt open       attach a runtime to one
                                   +-- dev wt provision  re-run installs after a pull
                                   |
   dev done --ff --> MERGED --> dev retire --> checkout gone, branch kept
 
   dev wt rm removes a checkout. It never removes a branch or its commits.`,
 
 	"dev tries": `TL;DR: the experiment keeps its identity after the directory moves
 
   dev try <name> --> a dated scratch directory  (create or open)
                        |
                        +-- dev tries mark       tags and a note
                        +-- dev tries archive    hide it, keep the ID
                        +-- dev tries restore    bring it back into view
                        +-- dev graduate         promote it to a real project
 
   The catalog ID survives archive, restore and graduation. The path does not.`,
 
 	"dev note": `TL;DR: thoughts that outlive the checkout
 
   dev note add <repo> -m "..."  --> Markdown under the state dir  (durable)
                                       |
                                       +-- dev note list / show
                                       +-- dev note search    <- SQLite full text
                                       +-- dev note edit / delete
 
   Markdown is the truth. The search index is disposable: dev note reindex.`,
 
 	"dev fleet": `TL;DR: read other machines without sharing their filesystem
 
   remotes.toml --> dev fleet status   can each host be reached?
                      |
                      +-- dev fleet list    repos, tasks and runtimes per host
                      +-- dev fleet sync    fast-forward clean matching checkouts
                      +-- dev fleet open    Herdr, or an SSH login shell
 
   Every host runs its own dev with its own config and its own paths. A host
   that is unreachable degrades to its cached snapshot; the fleet still answers.`,
 
 	"dev skill": `TL;DR: what the agents on this machine already know
 
-  dev skill list     project and global skills, their agents and update state
-  dev skill add      install one through the external skills provider
-  dev skill update   refresh a skill that provider manages
+  dev skill list        current checkout and global native inventory
+  dev skill list --all  every canonical repository, then global once
+  dev skill add/update  explicit mutation through a direct skills executable
 
   dev's own bundled skill ships inside the binary and updates with dev itself,
   never through the provider.`,
 
+	"dev mcp": `TL;DR: declared capabilities, not live connections
+
+  dev mcp list         current checkout plus user/system declarations
+  dev mcp list --all   every canonical repository, then user/system once
+  dev mcp list --json  sanitized servers, diagnostics and coverage
+
+  Static inventory never starts a server, runs a helper, resolves credentials,
+  or claims that a declaration is connected, healthy or effective.`,
+
 	"dev retire": `TL;DR: integrate, exit, then clean up from outside
 
   dev done --ff --> MERGED   (runtime and worktree deliberately kept)
                       |
     the agent exits,  |  dev prepare arms its transcript to finalize later
     or another shell  v
   dev retire <task> --> close runtime --> remove worktree --> keep the branch
 
   dev retire refuses to run inside the workspace it would delete, and refuses
   a live agent, dirty state, or an unfinalized artifact.`,
 }
 
 // helpTopics links a command family to the quick-reference page behind it.
 // Cobra help documents syntax; `dev help <topic>` documents when and why.
 // Before this map neither one mentioned the other.
 var helpTopics = map[string]string{
 	"dev wt":        "worktrees",
 	"dev repo":      "repositories",
 	"dev note":      "notes",
 	"dev fleet":     "fleet",
 	"dev journal":   "journal",
 	"dev summary":   "summary",
 	"dev retire":    "retirement",
 	"dev artifact":  "retirement",
 	"dev prepare":   "retirement",
 	"dev done":      "retirement",
 	"dev bootstrap": "bootstrap",
 	"dev adopt":     "adopting",
 	"dev park":      "parking",
 	"dev resume":    "parking",
 	"dev cache":     "storage",
 	"dev config":    "storage",
 	"dev tui":       "tui",
 	"dev start":     "branching",
 	"dev tries":     "tries",
 	"dev try":       "tries",
 	"dev skill":     "skills",
+	"dev mcp":       "mcp",
 	"dev status":    "git-status",
 }
 
 // topicForCommand resolves a bare command name or alias to its help topic, so
 // `dev help wt` reaches the worktrees page instead of failing a filename match.
 func topicForCommand(name string) (string, bool) {
 	topic, ok := helpTopics["dev "+name]
 	return topic, ok
 }
 
 // annotateHelp attaches the family diagram and the topic cross-reference to
 // each command's Long text. Doing it in one pass over the assembled tree keeps
 // the pointers from drifting out of sync with the map above.
 func annotateHelp(cmd *cobra.Command) {
 	for _, child := range cmd.Commands() {
 		annotateHelp(child)
 	}
 	path := cmd.CommandPath()
 	long := cmd.Long
 	if long == "" {
 		long = cmd.Short
 	}
 	if diagram, ok := familyTLDR[path]; ok {
 		long = strings.TrimRight(long, "\n") + "\n\n" + diagram
 	}
 	if topic, ok := helpTopics[path]; ok {
 		long = strings.TrimRight(long, "\n") + fmt.Sprintf("\n\nSee also: dev help %s", topic)
 	}
 	if long != cmd.Long {
 		cmd.Long = long
 	}
 }

 // Package perftrace records opt-in, process-local performance diagnostics.
 // Events deliberately carry only fixed categorical fields and relative times:

 import (

 const (
 	// SchemaVersion is the on-disk trace format.
 	SchemaVersion = 1
 	// DefaultLimit bounds memory use when a dashboard is refreshed repeatedly.
 	DefaultLimit = 4096
 )
 
 // Name identifies one stable trace boundary.
 type Name string
 
 const (
 	CLIExecuteBegin         Name = "cli.execute_begin"
 	CLIRootBuild            Name = "cli.root_build"
 	AppLoad                 Name = "app.load"
 	TUISetup                Name = "tui.setup"

 	TUIRuntimeList          Name = "tui.runtime_list"
 	TUIProjectRootResolve   Name = "tui.project_root_resolve"
 	TUICacheRemoteRead      Name = "tui.cache.remote_read"
 	TUICacheFleetRead       Name = "tui.cache.fleet_read"
 	TUIProgramRunBegin      Name = "tui.program_run_begin"
 	TUIInitialViewReturned  Name = "tui.initial_view_returned"
 	TUIFirstKeyReceived     Name = "tui.first_key_received"
 	TUIKeyUpdate            Name = "tui.key_update"
 	TUIProducerTasks        Name = "tui.producer.tasks"
 	TUIProducerRepos        Name = "tui.producer.repos"
 	TUIProducerTries        Name = "tui.producer.tries"
 	TUIProducerRemote       Name = "tui.producer.remote"
 	TUIProducerFleet        Name = "tui.producer.fleet"
 	TUIProducerSkills       Name = "tui.producer.skills"
+	TUIProducerMCP          Name = "tui.producer.mcp"
 	TUIProducerTools        Name = "tui.producer.tools"
 	TUIViewLoadRequested    Name = "tui.view.load_requested"
 	TUIViewSnapshotAccepted Name = "tui.view.snapshot_accepted"
 	TUIViewLoadFinished     Name = "tui.view.load_finished"
 	TUIViewResultDiscarded  Name = "tui.view.result_discarded"
 )
 
 // View is a fixed dashboard view name.
 type View string
 
 const (
 	ViewTasks  View = "tasks"
 	ViewRepos  View = "repos"
 	ViewFleet  View = "fleet"
 	ViewTries  View = "try"
 	ViewRemote View = "remote"
 	ViewSkills View = "skills"
+	ViewMCP    View = "mcp"
 )
 
 // Stage is a categorical lifecycle stage.
 type Stage string
 
 const (
 	StageRequested        Stage = "requested"
 	StageCacheAccepted    Stage = "cache_accepted"
 	StageSnapshotAccepted Stage = "snapshot_accepted"
 	StageFirstEnrichment  Stage = "first_enrichment"
 	StageFinished         Stage = "finished"
 	StageDiscarded        Stage = "discarded"
 )
 
 // Source identifies where a result came from.
 type Source string
 
 const (
 	SourceCache Source = "cache"
 	SourceLive  Source = "live"
 )
 
 // Freshness classifies a usable snapshot without making it authoritative.
 type Freshness string
 
 const (
 	FreshnessFresh Freshness = "fresh"
 	FreshnessStale Freshness = "stale"
 )
 
 // Outcome is a fixed terminal result class. Raw errors are intentionally absent.
 type Outcome string
 
 const (
 	OutcomeSuccess    Outcome = "success"
 	OutcomePartial    Outcome = "partial"
 	OutcomeFailed     Outcome = "failed"
 	OutcomeCanceled   Outcome = "canceled"
 	OutcomeSuperseded Outcome = "superseded"
 )
 
 // Fields are the optional categorical dimensions accepted by a trace event.
 type Fields struct {
 	View       View
 	Stage      Stage
 	Source     Source
 	Freshness  Freshness
 	Outcome    Outcome
 	Generation uint64
 	Rows       *int
 }
 
 // Event is one immutable entry in the versioned trace.
 type Event struct {
 	Sequence   uint64    `json:"sequence"`
 	AtMicros   int64     `json:"at_us"`
 	DurationUS int64     `json:"duration_us,omitempty"`
 	Name       Name      `json:"name"`
 	View       View      `json:"view,omitempty"`
```

```text
47	func containsControl(value any) bool {
48		return reflectContainsControl(reflect.ValueOf(value))

51	func reflectContainsControl(value reflect.Value) bool {
52		if !value.IsValid() {
53			return false
54		}
55		if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface || value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
56			if value.IsNil() {
57				return false
58			}
59			return reflectContainsControl(value.Elem())
60		}
61		switch value.Kind() {
62		case reflect.String:
63			return stringContainsControl(value.String())
64		case reflect.Map:
65			iter := value.MapRange()
66			for iter.Next() {
67				if reflectContainsControl(iter.Key()) || reflectContainsControl(iter.Value()) {
68					return true
69				}
70			}
71		case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
72			for index := range value.Len() {
73				if reflectContainsControl(value.Index(index)) {
74					return true
75				}
76			}
77		case reflect.Struct:
78			for index := range value.NumField() {
79				if reflectContainsControl(value.Field(index)) {
80					return true
81				}
82			}
83		}
84		return false
85	}

108	func looksSecretString(value string) bool {
```

```text
261	func setCommand(row *Declaration, command string) {
262		command = strings.TrimSpace(command)
263		if command == "" {
264			return
265		}
266		inspectReferences(row, command)
267		if openCodeFilePattern.MatchString(command) {
268			inspectFileReference(row, command)
269			row.Command = "[dynamic]"
270			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
271			return
272		}
273		if strings.Contains(command, "${") || strings.Contains(command, "{env:") ||
274			dollarPattern.MatchString(command) || percentPattern.MatchString(command) {
275			row.Command = "[dynamic]"
276			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
277			return
278		}
279		normalized := strings.ReplaceAll(command, `\`, "/")
280		basename := path.Base(normalized)
281		if basename == "." || basename == "/" || basename == "" || len(basename) > maximumNameBytes ||
282			!executableNamePattern.MatchString(basename) || strings.ContainsFunc(command, unicode.IsSpace) ||
283			looksSecretString(basename) {
284			row.Command = "[redacted]"
285			addRedaction(row, RedactionDynamicCommand)
286			addRedaction(row, RedactionArguments)
287			return
288		}
289		row.Command = basename
290		if basename != command {
291			addRedaction(row, RedactionCommandPath)
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func setEndpoint(row *Declaration, raw string) {
296		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
297		if raw == "" {
298			return
299		}
300		inspectReferences(row, raw)
301		if openCodeFilePattern.MatchString(raw) {
302			inspectFileReference(row, raw)
303			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
304			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
305			return
306		}
307		if dollarBracePattern.MatchString(raw) || dollarPattern.MatchString(raw) || percentPattern.MatchString(raw) || openCodeEnvPattern.MatchString(raw) {
308			addRedaction(row, RedactionEndpointTemplate)
309			row.Endpoint = "[dynamic]"
310			return
311		}
312		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
313		if err != nil || parsed.Opaque != "" || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" || !schemePattern.MatchString(parsed.Scheme) || stringContainsControl(parsed.Host) || looksSecretString(parsed.Host) {
314			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint)
315			return
316		}
317		if parsed.User != nil {
318			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLUserinfo)
319		}
320		if parsed.RawQuery != "" || parsed.ForceQuery {
321			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLQuery)
322		}
323		if parsed.Fragment != "" {
324			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLFragment)
325		}
326		endpoint := strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) + "://" + strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
327		if parsed.EscapedPath() != "" && parsed.EscapedPath() != "/" {
328			endpoint += "/[path]"
329			addRedaction(row, RedactionURLPath)
330		} else if parsed.EscapedPath() == "/" {
331			endpoint += "/"
332		}
333		row.Endpoint = endpoint
334	}

336	func addCredential(row *Declaration, credential CredentialReference) {
337		if credential.Name != "" && (!utf8.ValidString(credential.Name) || stringContainsControl(credential.Name) || len(credential.Name) > maximumReferenceBytes) {
338			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
339			return
340		}
341		for _, existing := range row.Credentials {
342			if existing == credential {
343				return
344			}
345		}
346		row.Credentials = append(row.Credentials, credential)
347	}
348	
349	func addRedaction(row *Declaration, redaction Redaction) {
350		for _, existing := range row.Redactions {
351			if existing == redaction {
352				return
353			}
354		}
355		row.Redactions = append(row.Redactions, redaction)
356	}
357	
358	func addCoverage(row *Declaration, code DiagnosticCode) {
359		for _, existing := range row.Coverage {
360			if existing.Code == code {
361				return
362			}
363		}
364		row.Coverage = append(row.Coverage, coverage(code))
365	}
366	
367	func addPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value string, count int) {
368		fact := PolicyFact{Kind: kind, Value: value, Count: count}
369		for _, existing := range row.Policies {
370			if existing == fact {
371				return
372			}
373		}
374		row.Policies = append(row.Policies, fact)
375	}
376	
377	func addBooleanPolicy(row *Declaration, kind PolicyKind, value bool) {
378		addPolicy(row, kind, strconv.FormatBool(value), 0)
379	}
380	
381	func finalizeDeclaration(row *Declaration) {
382		sort.Slice(row.Credentials, func(i, j int) bool {
383			if row.Credentials[i].Kind != row.Credentials[j].Kind {
384				return row.Credentials[i].Kind < row.Credentials[j].Kind
385			}
386			return row.Credentials[i].Name < row.Credentials[j].Name
387		})
388		sort.Slice(row.Redactions, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Redactions[i] < row.Redactions[j] })
389		sort.Slice(row.Policies, func(i, j int) bool {
390			if row.Policies[i].Kind != row.Policies[j].Kind {
391				return row.Policies[i].Kind < row.Policies[j].Kind
392			}
393			if row.Policies[i].Value != row.Policies[j].Value {
394				return row.Policies[i].Value < row.Policies[j].Value
395			}
396			return row.Policies[i].Count < row.Policies[j].Count
397		})
398		sort.Slice(row.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return row.Coverage[i].Code < row.Coverage[j].Code })
399	}
```

```text
8	type cursorDocument struct {

12	type cursorServer struct {
13		Type    string            `json:"type"`
14		Command string            `json:"command"`
15		Args    []string          `json:"args"`
16		Env     map[string]string `json:"env"`
17		EnvFile string            `json:"envFile"`
18		URL     string            `json:"url"`
19		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
20		Auth    *cursorAuth       `json:"auth"`
21	}
22	
23	type cursorAuth struct {
24		ClientID     string   `json:"CLIENT_ID"`
25		ClientSecret string   `json:"CLIENT_SECRET"`
26		Scopes       []string `json:"scopes"`
27	}
28	
29	func parseCursor(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
30		var document cursorDocument
31		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
32			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
33		}
34		var rows []Declaration
35		var codes []DiagnosticCode
36		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCPServers) {
37			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
38			if !ok {
39				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
40				continue
41			}
42			var server cursorServer
43			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
44				codes = append(codes, code)
45				continue
46			}
47			setCommand(&row, server.Command)
48			inspectArguments(&row, server.Args)
49			inspectEnvironment(&row, server.Env)
50			if strings.TrimSpace(server.EnvFile) != "" {
51				addCredential(&row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialFile})
52				addRedaction(&row, RedactionFileReference)
53			}
54			setEndpoint(&row, server.URL)
55			inspectHeaders(&row, server.Headers)
56			if server.Auth != nil {
57				addPolicy(&row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
58				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-id", server.Auth.ClientID)
59				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-secret", server.Auth.ClientSecret)
60				for _, scope := range server.Auth.Scopes {
61					inspectOAuthValue(&row, "scope", scope)
62				}
63			}
64	
65			hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
66			hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
67			if hasCommand && hasURL {
68				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
69			} else if hasURL {
70				// Cursor's static URL form does not identify SSE versus streamable HTTP.
71				row.Transport = TransportRemote
72			} else if hasCommand {
73				row.Transport = TransportStdio
74			}
75			if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
76				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
77			}
78			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
79			rows = append(rows, row)
80		}
81		return rows, codes
82	}
```

```text
11	type openCodeDocument struct {
12		MCP map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"mcp"`
13	}
14	
15	type openCodeServer struct {
16		Type        string            `json:"type"`
17		Command     []string          `json:"command"`
18		Environment map[string]string `json:"environment"`
19		URL         string            `json:"url"`
20		Headers     map[string]string `json:"headers"`
21		Enabled     *bool             `json:"enabled"`
22		OAuth       json.RawMessage   `json:"oauth"`
23	}

25	type openCodeOAuth struct {
26		ClientID     string `json:"clientId"`
27		ClientSecret string `json:"clientSecret"`
28		Scope        string `json:"scope"`
29	}
30	
31	func parseOpenCode(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
32		standard, err := hujson.Standardize(data)
33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument
37		if code := decodeJSON(standard, &document); code != "" {
38			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
39		}
40		var rows []Declaration
41		var codes []DiagnosticCode
42		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCP) {
43			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			var server openCodeServer
49			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCP[rawName], &server); code != "" {
50				codes = append(codes, code)
51				continue
52			}
53			convertOpenCodeServer(&row, server)
54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}
57		return rows, codes
58	}
59	
60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}
77	
78	func convertOpenCodeServer(row *Declaration, server openCodeServer) {
79		row.Enabled = copyBool(server.Enabled)
80		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Environment)
81		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
82	
83		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {
87		case "local":
88			row.Transport = TransportLocal
89			if hasCommand {
90				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
91				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
92			} else {
93				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
94			}
95			if hasURL {
96				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {
114				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {
118				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
119			}
120		}
121		convertOpenCodeOAuth(row, server.OAuth)
122	}
123	
124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}
133		var oauth openCodeOAuth
134		if code := decodeJSON(raw, &oauth); code != "" {
135			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
136			return
137		}
138		addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)
141		inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", oauth.Scope)
142	}
```

```text
188	
189	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
190	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
191	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
192	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
196		if generation != state.generation {
197			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
214				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
219			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
220		}
221		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
222		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
223			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
224			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
225			Generation: generation,
226		})
227		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
228			cancel()
229			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
230			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
231		}
232		return true
233	}
234	
235	func resultFreshness(err error) perftrace.Freshness {
236		if err != nil {
237			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
238		}
239		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
240	}
241	
242	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
243		switch {
244		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
245			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
246		case err != nil && valid:
247			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
248		case err != nil || !valid:
249			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
250		default:
251			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
252		}
253	}
254	
255	func (m Model) viewLoad(view View) viewLoadState { return m.loads[int(view)] }
256	
257	func (m Model) viewNeedsLoad(view View) bool {
258		state := m.viewLoad(view)
259		if state.loading {
260			return false
261		}
262		if state.hasSnapshot && state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh {
263			return false
264		}
265		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
266	}
267	
268	func (m *Model) setViewStatus(view View, status string) {
269		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = status
270	}
271	
272	func (m Model) viewError(view View) error { return m.viewErrors[int(view)] }
273	
274	func (m Model) viewStatus(view View) string { return m.viewStatuses[int(view)] }
275	
276	func (v View) traceView() perftrace.View { return perftrace.View(v.String()) }
277
```

```text
2675	func (m Model) updateCopy(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2676		if msg.String() == "esc" {

2682			m.mode = modeList
2683			return m, nil
2684		}
2685		checkoutIndex := -1
2686		if item.child() {
2687			checkoutIndex = item.CheckoutIndex
2688		}
2689	
2690		var payload, label string
2691		switch msg.String() {
2692		case "y":
2693			payload = inventory.FormatRepoContext(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2694			if item.child() {
2695				label = "worktree context"
2696			} else {
2697				label = "repo context"
2698			}
2699		case "p":
2700			label = "checkout path"

2702				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Worktree.Path
2703			} else {
2704				payload = item.Repo.Repo.Path
2705			}
2706		case "b":
2707			label = "branch"
2708			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
2709				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Branch()
2710			} else if main, found := item.Repo.Context.Main(); found {
2711				payload = main.Branch()
2712			} else {
2713				payload = item.Repo.Status.Branch
2714			}
2715			if payload == "" {
2716				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("selected checkout has detached HEAD")
2717				return m, nil
2718			}
2719		case "s":
2720			label = "runtime sessions"
2721			payload = inventory.FormatSessions(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2722			if payload == "" {
2723				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no live runtime sessions to copy")
2724				return m, nil
2725			}
2726		case "w":
2727			label = "worktree paths"
2728			payload = inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(item.Repo.Context)
2729			if payload == "" {
2730				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no linked worktrees to copy")
2731				return m, nil
2732			}
2733		default:
2734			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown copy key %q", msg.String())
2735			return m, nil
2736		}
2737	
2738		m.mode = modeList
2739		if m.actions.Copy == nil {
2740			m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable; use `dev repo context`")
2741			return m, nil
2742		}
2743		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2744			err := m.actions.Copy(payload)
2745			if err != nil {
2746				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w; use `dev repo context` as a fallback", label, err)}
2747			}
2748			return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
2749		}

2873	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
2874		fresh := valid && err == nil
2875		var commands []tea.Cmd
2876		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
2877			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2878				continue
2879			}
2880			state := m.viewLoad(view)
2881			if state.loading || (m.view == view && state.hasSnapshot) {
2882				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
2883				if fresh {
2884					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
2885					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
2886					continue
2887				}
2888				dependencyErr := err
2889				if dependencyErr == nil {
2890					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
2891				}
2892				current := m.viewLoad(view)
2893				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
2894				continue
2895			}
2896			if state.hasSnapshot {
2897				m.invalidateView(view)
2898			}
2899		}
2900		return batchCommands(commands...)
2901	}

2903	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads optional inventories only when their view is
2904	// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
2905	// CLI, or Node tooling.
2906	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {

2908		switch m.view {
2909		case ViewFleet:

2911				m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadVisit)
2912				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewFleet); err != nil {
2913					fleet := m.viewLoad(ViewFleet)
2914					m.applyViewResult(ViewFleet, fleet.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
2915					return m, nil
2916				}
2917				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewFleet) {
2918					m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "waiting for local repositories…")
2919					return m, nil
2920				}
2921				m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "loading configured dev hosts…")
2922				return m, m.reloadFleet()
2923			}
2924		case ViewRemote:
2925			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewRemote) {
2926				m.beginViewLoad(ViewRemote, loadVisit)
2927				m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "refreshing remote repositories…")
2928				return m, m.reloadRemote()
2929			}
2930		case ViewSkills:
2931			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewSkills) {
2932				m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadVisit)
2933				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewSkills); err != nil {
2934					state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
2935					m.applyViewResult(ViewSkills, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
2936					return m, nil
2937				}
2938				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewSkills) {
2939					m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "waiting for local repositories…")

2941				}
```

```text
351		}

353			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
354		}
355		return m
356	}
```

```text
1137	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1138		parts := []string{
1139			"forge-source-v1",
1140			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1141			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1142			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1143		}
1144		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1145			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1146		}
1147		sort.Strings(parts)
1148		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1149		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1150	}

1152	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or

1162		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {

1178	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1179		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1180		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}

1183				continue

1185			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1186			if ambiguous[key] {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1190				delete(byRemote, key)
1191				ambiguous[key] = true
1192				continue
1193			}
1194			byRemote[key] = r
1195		}
1196		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1197		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1198			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1199			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1200				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1201				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1202				if local.Asset != nil {
1203					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1204				}
1205			}
1206			out = append(out, row)
1207		}
1208		return out
1209	}

1248	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1249		type result struct {
1250			kind  forge.Kind
1251			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1252			err   error
1253		}
1254		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1255		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1256			if options.LocalsSet {
1257				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1258			}
1259			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1260		}
1261		providers := options.Providers
1262		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1263			providers = configuredForges(app)
1264		}
1265		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1266		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1267		available := 0
1268		var unavailable []error
1269		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1270		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1271		for _, f := range providers {
1272			if !f.Available() {
1273				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1274				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1275				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1276					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1277					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1278					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1279				}
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1283			available++
1284			wg.Add(1)
1285			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1286				defer wg.Done()
1287				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1288				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1289			}(f)
1290		}
1291		wg.Wait()
1292		close(ch)
1293		if available == 0 {
1294			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1295				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1296				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1297					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1298				}
1299				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1300			}
1301			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1302				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1303			}
1304			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1305		}
1306	
1307		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1308		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1309			old = forge.Cache{}
1310		}
1311		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1312		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1313		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1314			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1315		}
1316		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1317			statuses[kind] = status
1318		}
1319		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1320		successful := 0
1321		now := time.Now().UTC()
1322		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1323			status := statuses[kind]
1324			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1325			statuses[kind] = status
1326		}
1327		for res := range ch {
1328			if res.err != nil {
1329				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1330				status := statuses[res.kind]
1331				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1332				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1333					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1334					status.FetchedAt = now
1335					status.Complete = false
1336				}
1337				statuses[res.kind] = status
1338				continue
1339			}
1340			successful++
1341			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1342			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1343		}
1344		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1345		complete := true
1346		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1347		for kind := range expected {
1348			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1349			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1350				complete = false
1351			}
1352			if ok {
1353				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1354			}
1355			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1356		}
1357		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1358		if successful > 0 {
1359			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1360				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1361				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1362			})
1363		}
1364		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1365	}

1367	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1368		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1369			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1370				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1371			}
1372			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1373		})
1374	}

1391	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {

1414				continue
1415			}
1416			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1417				delete(localByRemote, key)
1418				ambiguous[key] = true
1419				continue
1420			}
1421			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1422		}
1423		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1424		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1425			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}

1427				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1428				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1429				if local.asset != nil {
1430					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1431				}
1432			}

1435		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project

1441	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1442		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1443			return
1444		}
1445		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1446		if err != nil {
1447			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1448			return
1449		}
1450		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1451			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1452		}
1453		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1454			return
1455		}
1456		host := config.Hostname()
1457		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1458		for _, entry := range entries {
1459			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1460			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1461				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1462				continue
1463			}
1464			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1465		}
1466		for index := range rows {
1467			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1468			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1469			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1470				continue
1471			}
1472			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1473			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1474			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1475			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1476		}
1477	}
1478	
1479	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1480		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1481			if candidate == "" {
1482				continue
1483			}
1484			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1485				return candidate
1486			}
1487		}
1488		return ""
1489	}

1491	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {

1493		if err != nil {
1494			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1495		}
1496		path := tmp.Name()
1497		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1498			_ = tmp.Close()
1499			_ = os.Remove(path)
1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1503			_ = os.Remove(path)
1504			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1505		}
1506		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1507		if err != nil {
1508			_ = os.Remove(path)
1509			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1510		}
1511		return tui.NoteEdit{
1512			Command: proc,
1513			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1514				if runErr != nil {
1515					_ = os.Remove(path)
1516					return runErr
1517				}
1518				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1519				if err != nil {
1520					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1521				}
1522				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1523					_ = os.Remove(path)
1524					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1525				}
1526				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1527				if err != nil {
1528					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1529				}
```
