331	// New builds the dashboard.
332	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
333		in := textinput.New()
334		in.CharLimit = 200
335	
336		m := Model{
337			actions:        actions,
338			rows:           rows,
339			repos:          repos,
340			input:          in,
341			width:          100,
342			height:         30,
343			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
344			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
345		}
346		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
347			m.toolGeneration = 1
348		}
349		if rows != nil {
350			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
351		}
352		if repos != nil {
353			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
354		}
355		return m
356	}
357	
358	// WithTrace observes performance boundaries without controlling model state.
359	func (m Model) WithTrace(trace *perftrace.Recorder) Model {
360		m.trace = trace
361		return m
362	}
363	
364	// WithContext bounds asynchronous read/probe commands to one dashboard run.
365	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
366		m.runContext = ctx
367		return m
368	}
369	
370	// WithRemotes seeds the lazy forge view from a fresh on-disk cache. The first
371	// switch is then instant; r still refreshes explicitly.
372	func (m Model) WithRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) Model {
373		m.remotes = rows
374		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRemote, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
375		return m
376	}
377

379	func (m Model) WithFleet(rows []FleetRow) Model {
380		m.fleet = rows
381		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewFleet, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessStale, true)
382		return m
383	}
384	
385	// WithRemotesStale marks seeded rows for background refresh on first visit.
386	func (m Model) WithRemotesStale(stale bool) Model {
387		if stale {
388			m.loads[int(ViewRemote)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
389		}
390		return m
391	}
392	
393	// WithTries seeds the Try view, primarily for tests and embedded callers. The
394	// production dashboard loads it with the other local inventories in Init.
395	func (m Model) WithTries(rows []TryRow) Model {
396		m.tries = rows
397		m.matchRemoteLocals()
398		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTries, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
399		return m

403	// the alternate screen appear immediately instead of blocking on dozens of Git
404	// probes before Bubble Tea starts.

406		m.initialLoad = true

408		return m

170	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
171		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
172		if generation != state.generation {
173			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
174				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
175				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
176			})
177			return false
178		}
179		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
180		count := rows
181		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
182			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
183			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
184			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
185		})
186		return true
187	}
188	
189	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
190	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
191	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
192	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
196		if generation != state.generation {
197			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
214				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
219			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
220		}
221		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
222		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
223			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
224			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
225			Generation: generation,
226		})
227		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
228			cancel()
229			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
230			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
231		}
232		return true
233	}
234	
235	func resultFreshness(err error) perftrace.Freshness {
236		if err != nil {
237			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
238		}
239		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
240	}
241	
242	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
243		switch {
244		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
245			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
246		case err != nil && valid:
247			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
248		case err != nil || !valid:
249			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
250		default:
251			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
252		}
253	}
254

257	func (m Model) viewNeedsLoad(view View) bool {
258		state := m.viewLoad(view)
259		if state.loading {
260			return false
261		}
262		if state.hasSnapshot && state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh {
263			return false
264		}
265		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
266	}

1070			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1071				continue
1072			}
1073			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {

1076		}

1078	}

11	func parseCodex(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
12		if !utf8.Valid(data) {
13			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
14		}
15		var document map[string]any
16		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &document); err != nil {
17			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
18		}
19		if containsControl(document) {
20			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
21		}
22	
23		var rows []Declaration
24		var codes []DiagnosticCode
25		for _, rawName := range sortedTableKeys(tableValue(document["mcp_servers"])) {
26			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
27			if !ok {
28				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
29				continue
30			}
31			server, ok := tableValue(document["mcp_servers"])[rawName].(map[string]any)
32			if !ok {
33				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
34				continue
35			}
36			convertCodexServer(&row, server)
37			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
38			rows = append(rows, row)
39		}
40	
41		plugins := tableValue(document["plugins"])
42		for _, rawPlugin := range sortedTableKeys(plugins) {
43			plugin, ok := normalizedPlugin(rawPlugin)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			pluginTable := tableValue(plugins[rawPlugin])
49			pluginEnabled, hasPluginEnabled := boolField(pluginTable, "enabled")
50			servers := tableValue(pluginTable["mcp_servers"])
51			for _, rawName := range sortedTableKeys(servers) {
52				rowSpec := spec
53				rowSpec.source = SourcePlugin
54				row, ok := newDeclaration(rowSpec, rawName)
55				if !ok {
56					codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
57					continue
58				}
59				row.Plugin = plugin
60				row.Transport = TransportUnknown
61				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent)
62				if override, ok := servers[rawName].(map[string]any); ok {
63					applyCodexPolicy(&row, override)
64				} else {
65					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
66				}
67				if hasPluginEnabled {
68					addBooleanPolicy(&row, PolicyPluginEnabled, pluginEnabled)
69					if !pluginEnabled || row.Enabled == nil {
70						value := pluginEnabled
71						row.Enabled = &value
72					}
73				}
74				finalizeDeclaration(&row)
75				rows = append(rows, row)
76			}
77		}
78		return rows, codes
79	}
80	
81	func convertCodexServer(row *Declaration, server map[string]any) {
82		command, _ := stringField(server, "command")
83		url, _ := stringField(server, "url")
84		setCommand(row, command)
85		inspectArguments(row, stringSlice(server["args"]))
86		inspectEnvironment(row, stringMap(server["env"]))
87		inspectCodexEnvVars(row, server["env_vars"])
88		setEndpoint(row, url)
89		inspectHeaders(row, stringMap(server["http_headers"]))
90		inspectEnvironmentHeaders(row, stringMap(server["env_http_headers"]))
91		if helper, ok := stringField(server, "http_headers_helper"); ok {
92			inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(helper) != "")
93		}
94		if bearer, ok := stringField(server, "bearer_token_env_var"); ok {
95			inspectBearerEnvironment(row, bearer)
96		}
97		if enabled, ok := boolField(server, "enabled"); ok {
98			row.Enabled = &enabled
99		}
100		if required, ok := boolField(server, "required"); ok {
101			row.Required = &required
102		}
103		applyCodexPolicy(row, server)
104	
105		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(command) != ""
106		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(url) != ""
107		if hasCommand && hasURL {
108			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
109		}
110		switch {
111		case hasURL:
112			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
113		case hasCommand:
114			row.Transport = TransportStdio
115		default:
116			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
117		}
118	
119		if auth, ok := stringField(server, "auth"); ok && auth != "" {
120			switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)) {
121			case "oauth", "chatgpt":
122				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)), 0)
123			default:
124				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
125			}
126		}
127		if oauth := tableValue(server["oauth"]); len(oauth) > 0 {
128			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
129			for _, field := range []string{"client_id", "callback_url", "callback_port"} {
130				if value, ok := scalarString(oauth[field]); ok {
131					inspectOAuthValue(row, strings.ReplaceAll(field, "_", "-"), value)
132				}
133			}
134		}
135	}
136	
137	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {
138		if enabled, ok := boolField(values, "enabled"); ok {
139			row.Enabled = &enabled
140			if row.Source == SourcePlugin {
141				addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyPluginEnabled, enabled)
142			}
143		}
144		if tools := stringSlice(values["enabled_tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
145			addPolicy(row, PolicyEnabledTools, "", len(tools))
146		}
147		if tools := stringSlice(values["disabled_tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
148			addPolicy(row, PolicyDisabledTools, "", len(tools))
149		}
150		if mode, ok := stringField(values, "default_tools_approval_mode"); ok && mode != "" {
151			mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mode))
152			switch mode {
153			case "auto", "prompt", "writes", "approve":
154				addPolicy(row, PolicyApprovalMode, mode, 0)
155			default:
156				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157			}
158		}
159		if tools := tableValue(values["tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
160			addPolicy(row, PolicyApprovalMode, "per-tool", len(tools))
161		}
162	}
163	
164	func inspectCodexEnvVars(row *Declaration, value any) {
165		items, ok := value.([]map[string]any)
166		if ok {
167			for _, item := range items {
168				if name, ok := stringField(item, "name"); ok && validEnvironmentName(name) {
169					addCredential(row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialEnvironmentReference, Name: name})
170				} else {
171					addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
172				}
173			}
174			return
175		}
176		for _, name := range stringSlice(value) {
177			if validEnvironmentName(name) {
178				addCredential(row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialEnvironmentReference, Name: name})
179			} else {
180				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
181			}
182		}
183	}
184	
185	func tableValue(value any) map[string]any {
186		if table, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
187			return table
188		}
189		return nil
190	}
191	
192	func sortedTableKeys(table map[string]any) []string {
193		keys := make([]string, 0, len(table))
194		for key := range table {
195			keys = append(keys, key)
196		}
197		sort.Strings(keys)
198		return keys
199	}
200	
201	func stringField(table map[string]any, key string) (string, bool) {
202		value, ok := table[key].(string)
203		return value, ok
204	}
205	
206	func boolField(table map[string]any, key string) (bool, bool) {
207		value, ok := table[key].(bool)
208		return value, ok
209	}
210	
211	func scalarString(value any) (string, bool) {
212		switch value := value.(type) {
213		case string:
214			return value, true
215		case int64:
216			return "configured", true
217		default:
218			return "", false
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func stringSlice(value any) []string {
223		switch values := value.(type) {
224		case []string:
225			return append([]string(nil), values...)
226		case []any:
227			out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
228			for _, value := range values {
229				if text, ok := value.(string); ok {
230					out = append(out, text)
231				}
232			}
233			return out
234		default:
235			return nil
236		}
237	}
238	
239	func stringMap(value any) map[string]string {
240		table := tableValue(value)
241		if len(table) == 0 {
242			return nil
243		}
244		out := make(map[string]string, len(table))
245		for key, value := range table {
246			if text, ok := value.(string); ok {
247				out[key] = text
248			}
249		}
250		return out
251	}

29	func parseClaudeProjectApproval(data []byte) (map[string]bool, map[string]bool, *bool, DiagnosticCode) {
30		var approval claudeProjectApproval
31		if code := decodeJSON(data, &approval); code != "" {

36	
37	func applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows []Declaration, enabled, disabled map[string]bool, enableAll *bool) {
38		for index := range rows {
39			explicitEnabled, isDisabled := enabled[rows[index].Name], disabled[rows[index].Name]
40			allEnabled := enableAll != nil && *enableAll
41			switch {
42			case explicitEnabled && isDisabled:
43				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
44				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
45				addCoverage(&rows[index], DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
46			case isDisabled:
47				value := false
48				rows[index].Enabled = &value
49				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
50			case explicitEnabled || allEnabled:
51				value := true
52				rows[index].Enabled = &value
53				addPolicy(&rows[index], PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
54			}
55			finalizeDeclaration(&rows[index])
56		}
57	}

85	func parseClaudeUser(data []byte, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode, []Diagnostic) {

125			}
126		}

135	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
136		var rows []Declaration
137		var codes []DiagnosticCode
138		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {
139			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
140			if !ok {
141				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
142				continue
143			}
144			var server claudeServer
145			if code := decodeJSON(raw[rawName], &server); code != "" {
146				codes = append(codes, code)
147				continue
148			}
149			convertClaudeServer(&row, server)
150			if state != nil {
151				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
152				switch {
153				case enabled && disabled:
154					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
155					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
156					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157				case enabled:
158					value := true
159					row.Enabled = &value
160					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
161				case disabled:
162					value := false
163					row.Enabled = &value
164					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
165				}
166			}
167			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
168			rows = append(rows, row)
169		}
170		return rows, codes
171	}

173	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
174		setCommand(row, server.Command)
175		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
176		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
177		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
178		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
179		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
180		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
181			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
182		}
183		if server.OAuth != nil {
184			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
185			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
186			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
187			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
188		}
189	
190		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
191		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
192		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
193		if hasCommand && hasURL {
194			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
195		}
196		switch typeName {
197		case "stdio":
198			if hasCommand {
199				row.Transport = TransportStdio
200			}
201		case "http", "streamable-http":
202			if hasURL {
203				row.Transport = TransportHTTP

212			}
213		case "":
214			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
215				row.Transport = TransportStdio
216			}
217		}
218		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
220		}

223	func normalizeNameSet(names []string) map[string]bool {
224		set := map[string]bool{}

233	func sortedRawNames(values map[string]json.RawMessage) []string {
234		names := make([]string, 0, len(values))

237		}
238		sort.Strings(names)

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false
245		}
246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
247		if err != nil {
248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
251		candidateReal := candidate
252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}

273	func copyBool(value *bool) *bool {
274		if value == nil {
275			return nil
276		}
277		copy := *value
278		return &copy
279	}

1269	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1270		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1271		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1272			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1273			if structured {
1274				var field string
1275				switch key {
1276				case "repo":
1277					field = row.Repository
1278				case "agent":
1279					field = string(row.Agent)
1280				case "scope":
1281					field = string(row.Scope)
1282				case "transport":
1283					field = string(row.Transport)
1284				case "managed":
1285					field = string(row.Source)
1286				case "state":
1287					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1288				default:
1289					field = ""
1290				}
1291				if field != "" {
1292					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1293						return false
1294					}
1295					continue
1296				}
1297			}
1298			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1299				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1300				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1301				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1302			}, " "))
1303			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1304				return false
1305			}
1306		}
1307		return true
1308	}

1320	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1321	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1322		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1323		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1324			switch {
1325			case x > y:
1326				return -1
1327			case x < y:
1328				return 1
1329			default:
1330				return 0
1331			}
1332		}
1333		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1334			if x == y {
1335				return 0
1336			}
1337			if x {
1338				return -1
1339			}
1340			return 1
1341		}
1342		latest := func() int {
1343			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1344				return 0
1345			}
1346			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1347				return -1
1348			}
1349			return 1
1350		}
1351	
1352		switch sortBy {
1353		case "name":
1354			return nameCmp
1355		case "latest":
1356			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1357				return c
1358			}
1359		case "git":
1360			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1361				return c
1362			}
1363			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1364				return c
1365			}
1366		case "size":
1367			switch {
1368			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1369				return -1
1370			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1371				return 1
1372			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1373				return -1
1374			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1375				return 1
1376			}
1377		case "tasks":
1378			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1379				return c
1380			}
1381			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1382				return c
1383			}
1384		default: // activity
1385			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1386				return c
1387			}
1388			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1389				return c
1390			}
1391			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1392				return c
1393			}
1394			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1395				return c
1396			}
1397			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1398				return c
1399			}
1400		}
1401		return nameCmp
1402	}

1573	// matchRemoteLocals fills cached remote rows from the freshly loaded local
1574	// inventory without another scan.
1575	func (m *Model) matchRemoteLocals() {
1576		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
1577		byRemote := map[string]RepoRow{}
1578		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1579		for _, r := range m.repos {
1580			if r.RemoteName == "" {
1581				continue
1582			}
1583			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1584			if ambiguous[key] {
1585				continue
1586			}
1587			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1588				delete(byRemote, key)
1589				ambiguous[key] = true
1590				continue
1591			}
1592			byRemote[key] = r
1593		}
1594		triesByIdentity := map[string]TryRow{}
1595		ambiguousTry := map[string]bool{}
1596		for _, row := range m.tries {
1597			identity := row.Item.RemoteIdentity
1598			if !row.Present() || identity == "" || ambiguousTry[identity] {
1599				continue
1600			}
1601			if _, exists := triesByIdentity[identity]; exists {
1602				delete(triesByIdentity, identity)
1603				ambiguousTry[identity] = true
1604				continue
1605			}
1606			triesByIdentity[identity] = row
1607		}
1608		for i := range m.remotes {
1609			key := string(m.remotes[i].Repo.Forge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName)
1610			identity := ""
1611			for _, raw := range []string{m.remotes[i].Repo.CloneURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.SSHURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.URL} {
1612				if identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
1613					break
1614				}
1615			}
1616			repository, repoOK := byRemote[key]
1617			try, tryOK := triesByIdentity[identity]
1618			sameCheckout := repoOK && tryOK && remotePathsOverlap(repository, try)
1619			if ambiguous[key] || ambiguousTry[identity] || (repoOK && tryOK && !sameCheckout) {
1620				m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1621				continue
1622			}
1623			if repoOK {
1624				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = repository.Repo.Path
1625				m.remotes[i].LocalName = repository.Repo.Display()
1626				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1627				if repository.Asset != nil {
1628					m.remotes[i].LocalKind = repository.Asset.Kind
1629				}
1630				continue
1631			}
1632			if tryOK {
1633				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = try.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1634				m.remotes[i].LocalName = try.Item.DisplayName()
1635				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindTry
1636				continue
1637			}
1638			m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1639		}
1640	}

1642	func remotePathsOverlap(repository RepoRow, try TryRow) bool {

1644			for _, right := range []string{try.Item.Live.CurrentPath, try.Item.Live.RealPath} {
1645				if left != "" && right != "" && filepath.Clean(left) == filepath.Clean(right) {
1646					return true
1647				}
1648			}

1651	}

2133	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2134		n := m.count()
2135		page := m.listHeight() / 2
2136		if page < 1 {
2137			page = 1
2138		}
2139	
2140		switch msg.String() {
2141		case "q", "ctrl+c":
2142			m.quitting = true
2143			return m, tea.Quit
2144		case "esc":
2145			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
2146			// becomes the meaning of the key.
2147			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
2148				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
2149				m.setAt(0)
2150				return m, nil
2151			}
2152			m.quitting = true
2153			return m, tea.Quit
2154	
2155		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
2156		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
2157			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
2158		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
2159			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
2160		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
2161			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
2162		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
2163			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
2164		case "g", "home":
2165			m.setAt(0)
2166		case "G", "end":
2167			m.setAt(n - 1)
2168	
2169		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
2170		// no horizontal axis of its own.
2171		case "tab", "l", "right":
2172			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
2173			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2174		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
2175			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]
2176			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2177	
2178		case "/":

2283			if m.view == ViewTasks {
2284				m.showDone, m.states = !m.showDone, nil
2285				m.setAt(0)
2286			}
2287	
2288		case "enter", "o":
2289			return m, m.openSelected()
2290	
2291		case " ":
2292			if m.view == ViewRepos {
2293				item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
2294				if !ok || item.Repo.Worktrees == 0 {
2295					return m, nil
2296				}
2297				if item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
2298					m.err = item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr
2299					return m, nil
2300				}
2301				if item.child() {
2302					// The parent is the nearest preceding non-child item.
2303					for i := m.repoCursor - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
2304						if !m.visibleRepoItems()[i].child() {
2305							m.repoCursor = i
2306							break
2307						}
2308					}
2309				}
2310				m.toggleRepo(item.Repo)
2311				return m, nil
2312			}
2313			if row, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
2314				return m.openTryMenu(row), nil
2315			}
2316			return m, nil
2317	
2318		case "m":
2319			if row, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
2320				return m.openRepoForm(row)
2321			}
2322			return m, nil
2323	
2324		case "y":
2325			if _, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); !ok {
2326				return m, nil
2327			}
2328			m.mode, m.err, m.status = modeCopy, nil, ""
2329			return m, nil
2330	
2331		case "p":
2332			if _, ok := m.currentTask(); !ok {
2333				return m, nil
2334			}
2335			return m.prompt(modeConfirmPark, "", "what to do when you come back")
2336	
2337		case "c":
2338			if m.view == ViewSkills {
2339				state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
2340				if state.loading || !state.hasSnapshot {
2341					m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "wait for local agent skills to finish loading")
2342					return m, nil
2343				}
2344				m.err = nil
2345				m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadRefresh)
2346				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "checking skill sources…")
2347				m.skillsChecking = true
2348				return m, m.checkSkills(append([]agentskill.Skill(nil), m.skills...))
2349			}
2350			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
2351				return m.prompt(modeEditNext, row.Task.Next, "next action")
2352			}
2353			if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && !row.Cloned() {
2354				return m.prompt(modeConfirmClone, row.Repo.FullName,
2355					"enter to clone; esc to cancel")
2356			}
2357			return m, nil
2358	
2359		case "s":
2360			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
2361				return m, nil
2362			}
2363			return m.prompt(modeStartTask, "", "name for the new worktree task")
2364	
2365		case "d":
2366			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
2367				return m, nil
2368			}
2369			return m.prompt(modeStartDirect, "", "name for direct work on current branch")
2370	
2371		case "u":
2372			if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading {
2373				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "wait for the current skill reload/check to finish")
2374				return m, nil
2375			}
2376			row, ok := m.currentSkill()
2377			if !ok {
2378				return m, nil
2379			}
2380			if !agentskill.CanUpdate(row) {
2381				m.err = fmt.Errorf("%s has no update-safe provider lock", row.Name)
2382				return m, nil
2383			}
2384			m.skillUpdateTarget = row
2385			m.mode = modeConfirmSkillUpdate
2386			return m, nil
2387	
2388		case "e":
2389			if m.view == ViewFleet {
2390				if m.actions.EditFleetConfig == nil {
2391					return m, nil
2392				}
2393				proc, err := m.actions.EditFleetConfig()
2394				if err != nil {
2395					m.err = err
2396					return m, nil
2397				}
2398				m.status = "editing remotes.toml…"
2399				return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
2400					return fleetConfigEditedMsg{err: err}
2401				})
2402			}
2403			if m.view == ViewMCP {
2404				return m, nil
2405			}
2406			if m.actions.EditConfig == nil {
2407				return m, nil
2408			}
2409			proc, err := m.actions.EditConfig()
2410			if err != nil {
2411				m.err = err
2412				return m, nil
2413			}
2414			m.status = "editing config…"
2415			return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
2416				return configEditedMsg{err: err}
2417			})
2418	
2419		case "O":
2420			switch m.view {
2421			case ViewRepos:
2422				orders := []string{"activity", "latest", "name", "git", "size", "tasks"}
2423				m.actions.RepoSort = nextSort(m.actions.RepoSort, orders)
2424				m.status = "repo sort: " + m.actions.RepoSort
2425			case ViewTries:
2426				m.trySort = nextSort(m.trySort, []string{"activity", "name", "phase", "size"})
2427				m.status = "Try sort: " + m.trySort
2428			default:
2429				return m, nil
2430			}
2431			m.setAt(0)
2432			return m, nil
2433	
2434		case "R":
2435			switch m.view {
2436			case ViewRepos:
2437				m.actions.RepoReverse = !m.actions.RepoReverse
2438				m.status = fmt.Sprintf("repo sort reversed: %v", m.actions.RepoReverse)
2439			case ViewTries:
2440				m.tryReverse = !m.tryReverse
2441				m.status = fmt.Sprintf("Try sort reversed: %v", m.tryReverse)
2442			default:
2443				return m, nil
2444			}
2445			m.setAt(0)
2446			return m, nil
2447	
2448		case "H":
2449			repo := m.selectedRepoName()
2450			if repo == "" || m.actions.LoadStats == nil {
2451				return m, nil
2452			}
2453			m.mode, m.stats, m.status = modeStats, nil, "loading activity…"
2454			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
2455	
2456		default:
2457			if cmd := m.launchTool(msg.String()); cmd != nil {
2458				return m, cmd
2459			}
2460		}
2461		m.setAt(m.at())
2462		return m, nil
2463	}

2497	func (m Model) openNotes(target NoteTarget) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2498		m.noteTarget, m.noteQuery = target, ""
2499		m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = 0, false
2500		m.mode, m.noteLoading, m.err = modeNoteBrowse, true, nil
2501		return m.beginNoteLoad(false)

2503	
2504	func (m Model) beginNoteLoad(refreshRepos bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
2505		m.noteRequest++
2506		request, targetKey, target := m.noteRequest, m.noteTarget.Key(), m.noteTarget
2507		reposGeneration := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation
2508		if refreshRepos {
2509			reposGeneration = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadAction)
2510		}
2511		query := m.noteQuery
2512		m.noteLoading = true
2513		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2514			if m.actions.Notes.List == nil {
2515				return noteListMsg{request: request, targetKey: targetKey, reposGeneration: reposGeneration}
2516			}
2517			var (
2518				notes []*note.Note
2519				err   error
2520			)
2521			if query != "" && m.actions.Notes.Search != nil {
2522				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.Search(m.baseContext(), target, query)
2523			} else {
2524				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.List(m.baseContext(), target)
2525			}
2526			msg := noteListMsg{
2527				notes: notes, request: request, targetKey: targetKey, err: err,
2528				reposGeneration: reposGeneration,
2529			}
2530			if refreshRepos && m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
2531				msg.repos, msg.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(m.viewContext(ViewRepos))
2532				msg.reposSet, msg.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(msg.repos, msg.reposErr)
2533			}
2534			return msg
2535		}
2536	}

2538	func (m Model) currentNote() (*note.Note, bool) {
2539		if m.noteCursor < 0 || m.noteCursor >= len(m.notes) {
2540			return nil, false
2541		}
2542		return m.notes[m.noteCursor], true
2543	}
2544	
2545	func (m *Model) clampNoteCursor() {
2546		switch {
2547		case len(m.notes) == 0:
2548			m.noteCursor = 0
2549		case m.noteCursor >= len(m.notes):
2550			m.noteCursor = len(m.notes) - 1
2551		case m.noteCursor < 0:
2552			m.noteCursor = 0
2553		}
2554	}
2555	
2556	func (m Model) updateNotes(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2557		switch m.mode {
2558		case modeNoteBrowse:
2559			switch msg.String() {
2560			case "esc", "N", "q":
2561				m.mode, m.notes, m.noteQuery, m.err = modeList, nil, "", nil
2562				m.noteRequest++
2563				return m, nil
2564			case "j", "down":
2565				m.noteCursor++
2566				m.noteExpanded = false
2567				m.clampNoteCursor()
2568			case "k", "up":
2569				m.noteCursor--
2570				m.noteExpanded = false
2571				m.clampNoteCursor()
2572			case "g", "home":
2573				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = 0, false
2574			case "G", "end":
2575				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = len(m.notes)-1, false
2576				m.clampNoteCursor()
2577			case "enter":
2578				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
2579					m.noteExpanded = !m.noteExpanded
2580				}
2581			case "a", "n":
2582				return m.openNoteAdd(m.noteTarget, true)
2583			case "/":
2584				m.mode = modeNoteSearch
2585				m.input.SetValue(m.noteQuery)
2586				m.input.Placeholder = "search body, tags, repo"
2587				m.input.CursorEnd()
2588				return m, m.input.Focus()
2589			case "d":
2590				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
2591					m.mode = modeNoteConfirmDelete
2592				}
2593			case "e":
2594				n, ok := m.currentNote()
2595				if !ok || m.actions.Notes.Edit == nil {
2596					return m, nil
2597				}
2598				edit, err := m.actions.Notes.Edit(n)
2599				if err != nil {
2600					m.err = err
2601					return m, nil
2602				}
2603				return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
2604					if edit.Complete != nil {
2605						runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
2606					}
2607					return noteActionMsg{status: "updated note " + n.ID[:8], returnBrowse: true, err: runErr}
2608				})
2609			}
2610			return m, nil
2611	
2612		case modeNoteAdd:
2613			switch msg.String() {
2614			case "esc":
2615				m.input.Blur()
2616				if m.noteReturnToBrowse {
2617					m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
2618				} else {
2619					m.mode = modeList
2620				}
2621				return m, nil
2622			case "enter":
2623				body := strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
2624				if body == "" {
2625					m.err = fmt.Errorf("note body is empty")
2626					return m, nil
2627				}
2628				m.input.Blur()
2629				returnBrowse := m.noteReturnToBrowse
2630				return m, func() tea.Msg {
2631					status, err := m.actions.Notes.Add(context.Background(), m.noteTarget, body)
2632					return noteActionMsg{status: status, returnBrowse: returnBrowse, err: err}
2633				}
2634			}
2635			input, cmd := m.input.Update(msg)
2636			m.input = input
2637			return m, cmd
2638	
2639		case modeNoteSearch:
2640			switch msg.String() {
2641			case "esc":
2642				m.input.Blur()
2643				m.noteQuery, m.mode, m.noteLoading = "", modeNoteBrowse, true
2644				return m.beginNoteLoad(false)
2645			case "enter":
2646				m.noteQuery = strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
2647				m.input.Blur()
2648				m.mode, m.noteLoading, m.noteCursor = modeNoteBrowse, true, 0
2649				return m.beginNoteLoad(false)
2650			}
2651			input, cmd := m.input.Update(msg)
2652			m.input = input
2653			return m, cmd
2654	
2655		case modeNoteConfirmDelete:
2656			switch msg.String() {
2657			case "esc", "n":
2658				m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
2659			case "y", "Y":
2660				n, ok := m.currentNote()
2661				if !ok || m.actions.Notes.Delete == nil {
2662					m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
2663					return m, nil
2664				}
2665				return m, func() tea.Msg {
2666					status, err := m.actions.Notes.Delete(context.Background(), n)
2667					return noteActionMsg{status: status, returnBrowse: true, err: err}
2668				}
2669			}
2670			return m, nil
2671		}
2672		return m, nil
2673	}
2674	
2675	func (m Model) updateCopy(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2676		if msg.String() == "esc" {
2677			m.mode = modeList
2678			return m, nil
2679		}
2680		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
2681		if !ok {
2682			m.mode = modeList
2683			return m, nil
2684		}
2685		checkoutIndex := -1
2686		if item.child() {
2687			checkoutIndex = item.CheckoutIndex
2688		}
2689	
2690		var payload, label string
2691		switch msg.String() {
2692		case "y":
2693			payload = inventory.FormatRepoContext(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2694			if item.child() {
2695				label = "worktree context"
2696			} else {
2697				label = "repo context"
2698			}
2699		case "p":
2700			label = "checkout path"
2701			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
2702				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Worktree.Path
2703			} else {
2704				payload = item.Repo.Repo.Path
2705			}
2706		case "b":
2707			label = "branch"
2708			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
2709				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Branch()
2710			} else if main, found := item.Repo.Context.Main(); found {
2711				payload = main.Branch()
2712			} else {
2713				payload = item.Repo.Status.Branch
2714			}
2715			if payload == "" {
2716				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("selected checkout has detached HEAD")
2717				return m, nil
2718			}
2719		case "s":
2720			label = "runtime sessions"
2721			payload = inventory.FormatSessions(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2722			if payload == "" {
2723				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no live runtime sessions to copy")
2724				return m, nil
2725			}
2726		case "w":
2727			label = "worktree paths"
2728			payload = inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(item.Repo.Context)
2729			if payload == "" {
2730				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no linked worktrees to copy")
2731				return m, nil
2732			}
2733		default:
2734			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown copy key %q", msg.String())
2735			return m, nil
2736		}
2737	
2738		m.mode = modeList
2739		if m.actions.Copy == nil {
2740			m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable; use `dev repo context`")
2741			return m, nil
2742		}
2743		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2744			err := m.actions.Copy(payload)
2745			if err != nil {
2746				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w; use `dev repo context` as a fallback", label, err)}
2747			}
2748			return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
2749		}
2750	}
2751	
2752	func (m Model) selectedRepoName() string {
2753		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
2754			return r.Task.Repo
2755		}
2756		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
2757			return item.Repo.Repo.Name
2758		}
2759		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Item.Live.Repo != nil {
2760			return r.Item.Live.Repo.Name
2761		}
2762		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
2763			if r.LocalName != "" {
2764				return filepath.Base(r.LocalName)
2765			}
2766			return r.Repo.Name
2767		}
2768		return ""
2769	}

2772		return func() tea.Msg {

2774			return statsMsg{panel: panel, err: err}

2777	
2778	func (m Model) updateStats(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2779		switch msg.String() {
2780		case "q", "ctrl+c":
2781			m.quitting = true
2782			return m, tea.Quit
2783		case "esc", "H":
2784			m.mode, m.stats, m.err, m.status = modeList, nil, nil, ""
2785			return m, nil
2786		case "r":
2787			repo := ""
2788			if m.stats != nil {
2789				repo = m.stats.Repo
2790			}
2791			if repo == "" {
2792				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
2793			}
2794			m.stats, m.status = nil, "loading activity…"
2795			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
2796		case "b":
2797			repo := ""
2798			if m.stats != nil {
2799				repo = m.stats.Repo
2800			}
2801			if repo == "" {
2802				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
2803			}
2804			if repo == "" || m.actions.BackfillStats == nil {
2805				return m, nil
2806			}
2807			m.status = "backfilling this repository from Git history…"
2808			return m, func() tea.Msg {
2809				err := m.actions.BackfillStats(context.Background(), repo)
2810				return statsBackfilledMsg{repo: repo, err: err}
2811			}
2812		}
2813		return m, nil
2814	}

2816	func (m Model) viewUsesRepos(view View) bool {
2817		switch view {
2818		case ViewFleet:
2819			return m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil
2820		case ViewSkills:
2821			return m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil
2822		case ViewMCP:
2823			return m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil
2824		default:
2825			return false
2826		}
2827	}
2828	
2829	func (m Model) viewWaitsForRepos(view View) bool {
2830		return m.viewUsesRepos(view) && m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading
2831	}
2832	
2833	func (m Model) dependentReposUnavailable(view View) error {
2834		if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2835			return nil
2836		}
2837		repos := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
2838		if repos.loading || (repos.hasSnapshot && repos.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh) {
2839			return nil
2840		}
2841		if err := m.viewError(ViewRepos); err != nil {
2842			return fmt.Errorf("local repository inventory: %w", err)
2843		}
2844		return errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
2845	}
2846	
2847	func dependentLoadingStatus(view View) string {
2848		switch view {
2849		case ViewFleet:
2850			return "loading configured dev hosts…"
2851		case ViewSkills:
2852			return "loading agent skills across repositories…"
2853		case ViewMCP:
2854			return "loading MCP declarations across repositories…"
2855		default:
2856			return "loading…"
2857		}
2858	}
2859	
2860	func (m Model) reloadDependentView(view View) tea.Cmd {
2861		switch view {
2862		case ViewFleet:
2863			return m.reloadFleet()
2864		case ViewSkills:
2865			return m.reloadSkills()
2866		case ViewMCP:
2867			return m.reloadMCP()
2868		default:
2869			return nil
2870		}
2871	}
2872	
2873	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
2874		fresh := valid && err == nil
2875		var commands []tea.Cmd
2876		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
2877			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2878				continue
2879			}
2880			state := m.viewLoad(view)
2881			if state.loading || (m.view == view && state.hasSnapshot) {
2882				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
2883				if fresh {
2884					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
2885					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
2886					continue
2887				}
2888				dependencyErr := err

14	func newMCPCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		cmd := &cobra.Command{
16			Use:   "mcp",
17			Short: "Inspect static agent MCP server declarations",
18			Long: `Inventory MCP declarations without starting servers or contacting endpoints.
19	
20	MCP rows are static, scope-qualified configuration declarations. They do not
21	claim that a declaration is the effective merged config, connected, healthy, or
22	authenticated. Secret-bearing values are redacted before rows are returned.`,
23		}
24		cmd.AddCommand(newMCPListCmd(app))
25		return cmd
26	}
27	
28	func newMCPListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
29		var (
30			all     bool
31			repoRef string
32			agents  []string
33			scopes  []string
34			jsonOut bool
35		)
36		cmd := &cobra.Command{
37			Use:   "list",
38			Short: "List configured MCP server declarations",
39			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
40			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
41				if all && repoRef != "" {
42					return fmt.Errorf("choose at most one of --all or --repo")
43				}
44				agentFilter, err := parseMCPAgents(agents)
45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				scopeFilter, err := parseMCPScopes(scopes)
49				if err != nil {
50					return err
51				}
52				project := len(scopeFilter) == 0 || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeProject] || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeLocal]
53				if !project && (all || repoRef != "") {
54					return fmt.Errorf("--all and --repo require project or local scope")
55				}
56				cwd, err := os.Getwd()
57				if err != nil {
58					return err
59				}
60				targets, err := resolveAgentTargets(cmd.Context(), app, cwd, all, repoRef, project)
61				if err != nil {
62					return err
63				}
64				result, err := agentmcp.Scan(cmd.Context(), targets)
65				if err != nil {
66					return err
67				}
68				result.Declarations = filterMCPDeclarations(result.Declarations, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
69				result.Diagnostics = filterMCPDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
70				if jsonOut {
71					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
72					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
73					return encoder.Encode(result)
74				}
75				renderMCPDiagnostics(app, result.Diagnostics)
76				return renderMCPTable(app, result.Declarations)
77			},
78		}
79		flags := cmd.Flags()
80		flags.BoolVar(&all, "all", false, "scan every configured canonical repository")
81		flags.StringVarP(&repoRef, "repo", "r", "", "scan one repository or explicit checkout path")
82		flags.StringSliceVar(&agents, "agent", nil, "agent format: claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, opencode")
83		flags.StringSliceVar(&scopes, "scope", nil, "declaration scope: project, local, user, custom, system-defaults, system-override, managed")
84		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit a stable sanitized JSON envelope")
85		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "repo", completeRepoFlag(app))
86		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "agent", fixedCompletions("claude-code", "codex", "cursor", "gemini-cli", "opencode"))
87		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "scope", fixedCompletions("project", "local", "user", "custom", "system-defaults", "system-override", "managed"))
88		return cmd
89	}
90	
91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}
132	
133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}
143	
144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {
145		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Diagnostic, 0, len(rows))
146		for _, row := range rows {
147			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered
153	}
154	
155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}

21	func newSkillCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

23			Use:   "skill",
24			Short: "Inspect agent skills and manage dev's bundled skill",
25			Long: `dev ships the agent skill that documents it.
26	
27	Keeping the skill inside the binary is what stops the two drifting: an agent
28	reading a stale command list is worse than one reading none. The same content
29	is available as "dev --skill", so a dotfiles installer can sync it without
30	vendoring a copy.`,
31		}
32		cmd.AddCommand(
33			newSkillListCmd(app),
34			newSkillAddCmd(app),
35			newSkillUpdateCmd(app),
36			newSkillPrintCmd(app),
37			newSkillInstallCmd(app),
38			newSkillSyncCmd(app),
39		)
40		return cmd
41	}
42	
43	func newSkillListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
44		var (
45			projectOnly bool
46			globalOnly  bool
47			check       bool
48			jsonOut     bool
49			all         bool
50			repoRef     string
51		)
52		cmd := &cobra.Command{
53			Use:     "list",
54			Aliases: []string{"ls", "status"},
55			Short:   "List project and global agent skills",
56			Long: `List installed agent skills directly from documented agent paths and lock files.
57	
58	With no scope flags, project and global skills remain separate rows. Project
59	scope defaults to the exact current checkout, including a linked worktree.
60	--all scans each configured canonical repository; --repo selects one repository
61	or explicit checkout path. Listing never runs Node, npm, npx, or agent code.
62	
63	--check is the only form that contacts skill sources. It compares lock-recorded
64	content without writing installed skills or either lock file.`,
65			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
66			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
67				if all && repoRef != "" {
68					return fmt.Errorf("choose at most one of --all or --repo")
69				}
70				project := projectOnly || !globalOnly
71				if !project && (all || repoRef != "") {
72					return fmt.Errorf("--all and --repo require project scope")
73				}
74				cwd, err := os.Getwd()
75				if err != nil {
76					return err
77				}

79				if err != nil {

81				}

106	func resolveAgentTargets(ctx context.Context, app *App, cwd string, all bool, repoRef string, project bool) ([]agenttarget.Target, error) {

461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}

1	package inventory

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"

7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}

13	func resolverOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
14		if err != nil {

16		}
17		return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
18	}
19	
20	// tuiRuntimeResolver moves runtime auto-detection off the first-view path while
21	// sharing exactly one result across inventory loads and actions.
22	type tuiRuntimeResolver struct {
23		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
24		resolve func() runtime.Runtime
25		once    sync.Once
26		ready   chan struct{}
27		rt      runtime.Runtime
28	}
29	
30	func newTUIRuntimeResolver(app *App) *tuiRuntimeResolver {
31		snapshot := *app
32		return &tuiRuntimeResolver{
33			trace: app.trace, resolve: snapshot.Runtime, ready: make(chan struct{}),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
41				r.rt = r.resolve()
42				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
43				close(r.ready)
44			}()
45		})
46		if ctx == nil {
47			ctx = context.Background()
48		}
49		select {
50		case <-ctx.Done():
51			return nil, ctx.Err()
52		case <-r.ready:
53			return r.rt, nil
54		}
55	}
56	
57	// tuiProjectRootResolver keeps Git project-root discovery lazy and shared by
58	// SKILLS reads/actions.
59	type tuiProjectRootResolver struct {
60		trace       *perftrace.Recorder
61		ctx         context.Context
62		getwd       func() (string, error)

64		once        sync.Once
65		ready       chan struct{}

68	}

71		if ctx == nil {
72			ctx = context.Background()
73		}

75			trace: trace, ctx: ctx, getwd: os.Getwd, projectRoot: agentskill.ProjectRoot,
76			ready: make(chan struct{}),
77		}
78	}

80	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
81		r.once.Do(func() {
82			go func() {
83				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProjectRootResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
84				cwd, err := r.getwd()
85				if err == nil {
86					r.root = r.projectRoot(r.ctx, cwd)
87				}
88				r.err = err
89				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
90				close(r.ready)
91			}()
92		})
93		if ctx == nil {
94			ctx = context.Background()
95		}
96		select {
97		case <-ctx.Done():
98			return "", ctx.Err()
99		case <-r.ready:
100			return r.root, r.err
101		}
102	}

105		select {

108		default:

110		}
111	}

28	func newMCPListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}

133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}
143	
144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {
145		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Diagnostic, 0, len(rows))
146		for _, row := range rows {
147			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered
153	}

155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}

188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {

167	func renderSkillJSON(app *App, rows []agentskill.Skill) error {
168		out := make([]skillJSON, 0, len(rows))
169		for _, row := range rows {
170			installations := make([]skillInstallationJSON, 0, len(row.Installations))
171			for _, installation := range row.Installations {
172				installations = append(installations, skillInstallationJSON{
173					Path: installation.Path, RealPath: installation.RealPath,
174					LogicalPaths: installation.LogicalPaths, AgentIDs: installation.AgentIDs,
175					Integrity: string(installation.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: installation.IntegrityDetail,
176				})
177			}
178			item := skillJSON{
179				Name: row.Name, Scope: string(row.Scope), ScopeRoot: row.ScopeRoot,
180				Path: row.Path, Agents: row.Agents, Source: row.Source,
181				SourceURL: row.SourceURL, SourceType: row.SourceType,
182				ManagedBy: string(row.ManagedBy), UpdateStatus: string(row.UpdateStatus),
183				UpdateDetail: row.UpdateDetail, Repo: row.Repository, RepoPath: row.RepositoryPath,
184				Checkout: row.Checkout, Installations: installations, Presence: string(row.Presence),
185				Integrity: string(row.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: row.IntegrityDetail,
186				AgentIDs: row.Attribution.AgentIDs, RegistrySource: row.Attribution.Registry,
187				RegistryVersion: row.RegistryVersion,
188			}
189			if row.Lock != nil {
190				item.LockVersion, item.Ref, item.SkillPath = row.Lock.Version, row.Lock.Ref, row.Lock.SkillPath
191				item.Plugin, item.InstalledAt, item.UpdatedAt = row.Lock.PluginName, row.Lock.InstalledAt, row.Lock.UpdatedAt
192				item.WellKnownDigest = row.Lock.WellKnownDigest
193			}
194			out = append(out, item)
195		}
196		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
197		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
198		return enc.Encode(out)
199	}

201	func renderSkillTable(app *App, rows []agentskill.Skill, targets []agenttarget.Target, project, global bool) error {
202		if !project && !global {
203			project = true
204		}
205		if project {
206			if len(targets) == 1 {
207				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "project root  %s\n\n", config.Contract(targets[0].CheckoutRoot))
208			} else {
209				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "project roots  %d repositories\n\n", len(targets))
210			}
211		}
212		if len(rows) == 0 {
213			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No agent skills found.")
214			return nil
215		}
216		style := app.outStyle()
217		t := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "SKILL", "INSTALL", "UPDATE", "AGENTS", "SOURCE", "PATH")
218		for _, row := range rows {
219			path := "—"
220			if row.Path != "" {
221				path = config.Contract(row.Path)
222			}
223			t.Add(dash(row.Repository), style.dim(string(row.Scope)), row.Name,
224				style.updateState(skillInstallLabel(row)), style.updateState(shortUpdate(row.UpdateStatus)),
225				compactAgents(row.Agents), dash(row.Source), path)
226		}
227		t.Render(app.Out)
228		return nil
229	}

231	func skillInstallLabel(row agentskill.Skill) string {
232		if row.Presence == agentskill.PresenceMissing {
233			return "missing"
234		}
235		switch row.Integrity {
236		case agentskill.IntegrityVerified:
237			return "verified"
238		case agentskill.IntegrityDrifted:
239			return "drifted"
240		default:
241			return "present"
242		}
243	}

250			}
251			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: skill inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
252				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.Path), diagnostic.Message)
253		}

256	func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
257		if len(agents) == 0 {
258			return "—"
259		}
260		names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
261		sort.Strings(names)
262		if len(names) <= 3 {
263			return strings.Join(names, ", ")
264		}
265		return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
266	}
267	
268	func shortUpdate(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
269		switch status {
270		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
271			return "update"
272		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
273			return "missing"
274		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
275			return "unknown"
276		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
277			return "failed"
278		default:
279			return string(status)
280		}
281	}

457		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&check, "check", false, "report drift and exit non-zero instead of writing")
458		return cmd
459	}
460	
461	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
462	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
463	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
464		var b strings.Builder
465		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
466		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
467			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
468			b.WriteString(flags)
469			b.WriteString("\n")
470		}
471		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
472		return b.String()
473	}
474	
475	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
476		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
477			return
478		}
479		if depth > 0 {
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
481			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
482				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
483			}
484			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
485				b.WriteString(flags)
486				b.WriteString("\n")
487			}
488		}
489		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
490			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
495		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
499		var b strings.Builder
500		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
501			if f.Hidden {
502				return
503			}
504			name := "--" + f.Name
505			if f.Shorthand != "" {
506				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
507			}
508			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
509		})
510		return b.String()
511	}
512	
513	func firstLine(s string) string {
514		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
515			return s[:i]
516		}
517		return s
518	}
519

 func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
 	if len(agents) == 0 {
 		return "—"
 	}
 	names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
 	sort.Strings(names)
 	if len(names) <= 3 {
 		return strings.Join(names, ", ")
 	}
 	return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
 }
 
 func shortUpdate(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
 	switch status {
 	case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
 		return "update"
 	case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
 		return "missing"
 	case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
 		return "unknown"
 	case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
 		return "failed"
 	default:
 		return string(status)
 	}
 }

 				return err
 			}
 			proc.Stdin, proc.Stdout, proc.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
 			return proc.Run()

 func newSkillInstallCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
 	var (
 		dir    string
 		noLink bool
 	)
 	cmd := &cobra.Command{
 		Use:   "install",
 		Short: "Install the skill into the agent skills directory",
 		Long: `Write the bundled skill to ~/.agents/skills/dev-cli and symlink it into the
 per-tool skill directories that exist on this machine (~/.claude/skills).
 
 Re-running is a no-op when nothing changed, so this is safe to call from a
 dotfiles bootstrap on every apply.`,
 		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
 			target := dir
 			if target == "" {
 				target = skill.DefaultDir()
 			}
 			res, err := skill.Install(config.Expand(target), !noLink)
 			if err != nil {
 				return err
 			}
 			switch {
 			case len(res.Written) == 0:
 				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "skill already current at %s\n", config.Contract(res.Dir))
 			default:
 				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "installed %d file(s) to %s\n", len(res.Written), config.Contract(res.Dir))
 				for _, f := range res.Written {
 					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s\n", f)
 				}
 			}
 			for _, l := range res.Links {
 				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   linked %s\n", config.Contract(l))
 			}
 			return nil
 		},
 	}
 	f := cmd.Flags()
 	f.StringVar(&dir, "dir", "", "install directory (default: ~/.agents/skills/dev-cli)")
 	f.BoolVar(&noLink, "no-link", false, "do not symlink into per-tool skill directories")
 	return cmd
 }

39	func installRepoSkills(ctx context.Context, app *App, root string, specs []repoSkillSpec) (repoSkillResult, error) {
40		var result repoSkillResult
41		type installGroup struct {
42			source string
43			agents []string
44			names  []string
45		}
46		var groups []installGroup
47		for _, spec := range specs {
48			key := spec.Source + "\x00" + strings.Join(spec.Agents, "\x00")
49			groupIndex := -1
50			for index := range groups {
51				if groups[index].source+"\x00"+strings.Join(groups[index].agents, "\x00") == key {
52					groupIndex = index
53					break
54				}
55			}
56			if groupIndex < 0 {
57				groups = append(groups, installGroup{source: spec.Source, agents: append([]string(nil), spec.Agents...)})
58				groupIndex = len(groups) - 1
59			}
60			groups[groupIndex].names = append(groups[groupIndex].names, spec.Name)
61		}
62		for _, group := range groups {
63			process, err := agentskill.InstallCommand(ctx, root, group.source, group.names, group.agents)
64			if err != nil {
65				return result, fmt.Errorf("prepare skills %s install: %w", strings.Join(group.names, ", "), err)
66			}
67			process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
68			if err := process.Run(); err != nil {
69				return result, fmt.Errorf("install skills %s: %w", strings.Join(group.names, ", "), err)
70			}
71			result.Installed = append(result.Installed, group.names...)
72		}
73		return result, nil
74	}

76	func runRepoSkillSetups(ctx context.Context, app *App, root string, phase repoHookPhase, specs []repoSkillSpec) (repoSkillResult, error) {
77		var result repoSkillResult
78		for _, spec := range specs {
79			if spec.Setup == nil || spec.Setup.Phase != phase ||
80				(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Setup.Script) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(spec.Setup.Builtin) == "") {
81				continue
82			}
83			if err := runRepoSkillSetup(ctx, app, root, spec.Name, *spec.Setup); err != nil {
84				if spec.Setup.Required {
85					return result, fmt.Errorf("set up skill %s: %w", spec.Name, err)
86				}
87				warning := fmt.Sprintf("skill %s setup: %v", spec.Name, err)
88				result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, warning)
89				app.warnf("%s", warning)
90				continue
91			}
92			result.Setup = append(result.Setup, spec.Name)
93		}
94		return result, nil
95	}

97	func runRepoSkillSetup(ctx context.Context, app *App, root, name string, setup repoSkillSetup) error {
98		if setup.Timeout <= 0 {
99			setup.Timeout = 10 * time.Minute
100		}
101		commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, setup.Timeout)
102		defer cancel()
103		if setup.Builtin != "" {
104			return runBuiltinRepoSkillSetup(commandCtx, app, root, setup.Builtin, setup.Args)
105		}
106		skill, err := agentskill.FindProject(ctx, root, name)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		skillRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(skill.Path)
111		if err != nil {
112			return err
113		}
114		script, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(skillRoot, filepath.Join(skillRoot, filepath.FromSlash(setup.Script)))
115		if err != nil {
116			return fmt.Errorf("setup entrypoint must stay within installed skill: %w", err)
117		}
118		command := setup.Interpreter
119		args := append([]string{script}, setup.Args...)
120		if command == "" {
121			command = script
122			args = setup.Args
123		}
124		if _, err := exec.LookPath(command); err != nil {
125			return fmt.Errorf("interpreter/executable %q is unavailable", command)
126		}
127		process := exec.CommandContext(commandCtx, command, args...)
128		process.Dir = root
129		process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
130		if err := process.Run(); err != nil {
131			if commandCtx.Err() != nil {
132				return commandCtx.Err()
133			}
134			return err
135		}
136		return nil
137	}

487	func validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest, yes bool) error {
488		if request.JSON && request.Handoff != repoHandoffStay {
489			return errors.New("--json requires --handoff=stay")
490		}
491		if request.Handoff == repoHandoffStart && !app.interactive() {
492			return errors.New("--handoff=start requires an interactive terminal")
493		}
494		if request.JSON && request.BrowseSkills {
495			return errors.New("--json cannot open the interactive upstream skills installer")
496		}
497		if request.BrowseSkills && !app.interactive() {
498			return errors.New("--browse-skills requires an interactive terminal")
499		}
500		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew && request.Publish != nil && request.Publish.Push {
501			if request.CheckIn != repoCheckInCommit {
502				return errors.New("pushing a new upstream requires --check-in=commit; use --push=false to create an empty upstream")
503			}
504		}
505		if request.Publish != nil && request.CheckIn == repoCheckInStage {
506			return errors.New("--check-in=stage cannot create an upstream; review and commit locally before publishing")
507		}
508		if request.Handoff == repoHandoffStart && request.CheckIn != repoCheckInCommit &&
509			(request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew || request.Scaffold.Preset != "" || request.Prepared.Plan.Root != "") {
510			return errors.New("--handoff=start requires --check-in=commit when repository setup changes files")
511		}
512		if request.Kind != repo.AcquireNew && request.Publish != nil {
513			remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(request.Publish.RemoteName)
514			if remoteName == "" {
515				remoteName = "origin"
516			}
517			if current := gitx.Remote(ctxOf(), request.Destination, remoteName); current != "" {
518				return fmt.Errorf("remote %s already points to %s; omit --remote or remove it explicitly before publishing", remoteName, current)
519			}
520		}
521		if !app.interactive() && !yes && (len(request.Prepared.Plan.Hooks) > 0 || len(request.Prepared.Plan.Skills) > 0 || request.BrowseSkills) {
522			return errors.New("non-interactive hooks or skill setup require --yes")
523		}
524		for _, skill := range request.Prepared.Plan.Skills {
525			if _, err := agentskill.InstallCommand(ctxOf(), request.Destination, skill.Source, []string{skill.Name}, skill.Agents); err != nil {
526				return fmt.Errorf("skill %s cannot be installed: %w", skill.Name, err)
527			}
528			if skill.Setup == nil || skill.Setup.Builtin != "" || skill.Setup.Interpreter == "" {
529				continue
530			}
531			if _, err := exec.LookPath(skill.Setup.Interpreter); err != nil && skill.Setup.Required {
532				return fmt.Errorf("skill %s setup requires unavailable interpreter %q", skill.Name, skill.Setup.Interpreter)
533			}
534		}
535		for _, hook := range request.Prepared.Plan.Hooks {
536			if runtime.GOOS == "windows" && strings.TrimSpace(hook.Run) != "" {
537				return fmt.Errorf("hook %s uses a POSIX shell expression, which is unsupported on Windows; use command = [...]", hook.ID)
538			}
539			if len(hook.Command) > 0 && hook.Required && !isRepoLocalExecutable(request.Destination, hook.Command[0]) {
540				if _, err := exec.LookPath(hook.Command[0]); err != nil {
541					return fmt.Errorf("hook %s requires unavailable executable %q", hook.ID, hook.Command[0])
542				}
543			}
544		}
545		return nil
546	}
547	
548	func isRepoLocalExecutable(root, executable string) bool {
549		if !filepath.IsAbs(executable) {
550			return strings.ContainsAny(executable, `/\\`)
551		}
552		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, executable)
553		return err == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
554	}

/Users/david/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-mcp-skill-update/docs/guides/remote-fleet.md:92:FLEET is one of the TUI's seven views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, `MCP`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — no live probe starts until the view is first opened — but its cache is decoded in the background after the initial TASKS view so a valid snapshot still within `defaults.cache_ttl` can seed the table. 885				return skillsMsg{

887					inventoryErr: m.skillsInventoryErr, err: m.skillsInventoryErr,
888				}
889			}
890			var rows []agentskill.Skill

899			}
900			verified := false

904					if rows[i].Lock != nil {

908						checked := m.actions.CheckSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), []agentskill.Skill{rows[i]})
909						if len(checked) == 1 {
910							rows[i] = checked[0]
911							verified = true
912						}
913						break
914					}
915				}
916			}
917			status := "updated " + name
918			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil && !verified {
919				status += "; matching row was not found for source verification"
920			}
921			return skillsMsg{
922				generation: generation, rows: rows, valid: snapshotValid(rows, err), loaded: true,
923				checked: verified, status: status, inventoryErr: err, err: err,
924			}
925		}
