13	 
14	 # Remote repository fleet
15	 
16	 `dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
17	 
18	 ## What a fleet is
19	 
20	 A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
21	 
22	 This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
23	 which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
24	 the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
25	 machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
26	 
27	 ## Configure hosts
28	 
29	 ```bash
30	 dev fleet config init
31	 dev fleet config edit
32	 dev fleet config show
33	 dev fleet config path
34	 ```
35	 
36	 Hosts live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` (override the path with the global `--remotes <path>` flag). `config init` writes a starter file (`--force` to overwrite, `--stdout` to print without writing); `config edit` opens it in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` (`--editor` overrides); `config show` prints the effective configuration with any plaintext password redacted; `config path` prints the resolved path.
37	 
38	 ```toml
39	 schema_version = 1
40	 
41	 [defaults]
42	 connect_timeout = "15s"
43	 command_timeout = "5m"
44	 cache_ttl = "15m"
45	 max_parallel = 4
46	 dev_path = "auto"
47	 
48	 [[hosts]]
49	 name = "lab"
50	 ssh_alias = "lab"
51	 
52	 [[hosts]]
53	 name = "vps"
54	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
55	 user = "dev"
56	 port = 22
57	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
58	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
59	 ```
60	 
61	 `schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
62	 
63	 ## `dev fleet` commands
64	 
65	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
66	 |---|---|---|
67	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--repo <query>`, `--json`, `--cached`, `--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
68	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
69	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`, `--remote <name>`, `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
70	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
71	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`, `--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
72	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
73	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
74	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
75	 
76	 `--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
77	 
78	 `dev fleet` also registers four hidden commands (`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, `_shell`) that exist only to be invoked by `dev fleet` itself on the far end of an SSH connection — they are the wire protocol, not a user-facing surface.
79	 
80	 ## Transport and authentication
81	 
82	 Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. `dev fleet open` additionally allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
83	 
84	 If that attempt is rejected with "permission denied" and the host defines a `ssh_login_password_source`, `dev` retries once with password authentication. The password itself never touches argv or the environment: `dev` re-executes itself as a one-shot `SSH_ASKPASS` helper, and the secret is handed to that helper over an inherited file descriptor. `prompt` reads a hidden password from `/dev/tty` at run time; `plain` and `bitwarden` resolve it from the config file or from `bw get password <item>` respectively.
85	 
86	 On the remote side, `dev_path = "auto"` (the default) searches common install locations (`~/.local/bin`, `~/go/bin`, mise shims, Homebrew/Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`) and then `PATH`, exiting `127` if no `dev` is found; an explicit absolute `dev_path` skips that search and execs it directly.
87	 
88	 ## What's cached vs. durable
89	 
90	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` is durable, user-authored configuration, on the same footing as `config.toml` — `dev fleet config init`/`edit` manage it, and nothing regenerates it automatically.
91	 
92	 Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `port`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. Oversized snapshots, future timestamps, invalid counts, and oversized/NUL-containing identity or path fields are ignored rather than displayed. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
93	 
94	 The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.
95	 
96	 ## Fleet in the TUI
97	 
98	-FLEET is one of the TUI's six views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — no live probe starts until the view is first opened — but its cache is decoded in the background after the initial TASKS view so a valid snapshot still within `defaults.cache_ttl` can seed the table. The TUI hides this machine by default because REPOS already provides its richer local inventory; `a` includes/hides local rows. The local-host snapshot reuses the current accepted REPOS generation instead of running repository/task/runtime discovery again; if that generation is still loading, FLEET keeps cached rows visible and says it is waiting. `r` supersedes an older request and forces a live reload of every configured host. The non-interactive `dev fleet list` output remains local plus remote.
99	+FLEET is one of the TUI's seven views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, `MCP`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — no live probe starts until the view is first opened — but its cache is decoded in the background after the initial TASKS view so a valid snapshot still within `defaults.cache_ttl` can seed the table. The TUI hides this machine by default because REPOS already provides its richer local inventory; `a` includes/hides local rows. The local-host snapshot reuses the current accepted REPOS generation instead of running repository/task/runtime discovery again; if that generation is still loading, FLEET keeps cached rows visible and says it is waiting. `r` supersedes an older request and forces a live reload of every configured host. The non-interactive `dev fleet list` output remains local plus remote.
100	 
101	 Its table shows `HOST`, `STATE`, `REPO`, `BRANCH`, `GIT`, `LIVE`, `TASKS`, and `PATH`. `enter` opens the selected repository: an explicitly revealed local host row uses an ordinary local open; for a remote row `dev` prefers native Herdr remoting when that host's snapshot reports the `herdr` runtime and the host connects through `ssh_alias` with no password step, and otherwise falls back to an interactive SSH login shell in the repository's directory. Git changes are read-only in this view — FLEET is for inspecting and opening work, not editing it in place.
102	 
103	 `e` opens `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` — the file this view is about, rather than dev's own `config.toml`, which `e` opens everywhere else. On leaving the editor `dev` reparses the file before using it. A parse failure, an unknown field, or a permissions problem on a file holding a plaintext password is reported and the previous rows are kept, so a typo cannot silently drop a host from the fleet. A file that parses triggers an immediate live reload of every configured host.
104	 
105	 ## Degrading gracefully
106	 
107	 Every host is probed independently, so one bad host never fails the fleet as a whole. Per-host states are `ok`, `stale` (cache reused, optionally with an error explaining why), `no-dev` (the remote has no `dev` on its `PATH` — reported, not an error), `unreachable` (SSH itself failed), `timeout`, `incompatible` (an old or unrecognized remote `dev`), and `invalid-response` (malformed snapshot JSON). `ok` and a clean `no-dev` never fail `--strict`; every other state does, including a `stale` result that carries an error.
108	 
109	 Separately, forge integration is optional: `gh` and `glab` enable GitHub/GitLab
110	 inventory, publication, and pull/merge requests, while `az` enables Azure
111	 DevOps inventory and pull requests. `dev doctor` reports missing CLIs as
112	 warnings. Local Git workflows remain available, but an explicit non-interactive
113	 publication request fails with login/install guidance instead of silently
114	 changing its meaning. Azure DevOps inventory is additionally opt-in and stays
115	 disabled until `forge.azure_devops` targets are configured.

147	 # Remote repository fleet
148	 
149	 !!! note "術語規則"
150	     有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
151	 
152	 `dev fleet` 透過 SSH 連到其他執行自己 `dev` 的機器，讓你能查看並開啟它們的 repository、安全地傳播 branch，而不會把它們各自獨立的設定合併進這台機器的視角。
153	 
154	 ## Fleet 是什麼
155	 
156	 Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。`dev fleet` 從不集中管理或取得那份 state 的 ownership，它只會透過 SSH 向每個 host 的 `dev` 要一份 read-only snapshot，並回報收到的結果。沒有安裝 `dev` 的 host，或無法連線的 host，只會讓那一列 degrade；不會擋住 fleet 其餘部分。
157	 
158	 這與 REMOTE TUI view 及 publishing/PR flow 是不同概念——GitHub/GitLab
159	 repository publishing 與 PR 使用 `gh` 或 `glab`，Azure DevOps inventory 與 PR
160	 則使用 Azure CLI。Fleet 溝通的對象是*你自己的機器*上*你自己的 local
161	 checkout*。
162	 
163	 ## 設定 hosts
164	 
165	 ```bash
166	 dev fleet config init
167	 dev fleet config edit
168	 dev fleet config show
169	 dev fleet config path
170	 ```
171	 
172	 Host 設定放在 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml`（可用全域 `--remotes <path>` flag 覆寫路徑）。`config init` 會寫入一份 starter file（`--force` 覆寫既有檔案、`--stdout` 只印出不寫入）；`config edit` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟它（`--editor` 可覆寫）；`config show` 印出目前生效的設定，明文密碼會被遮蔽；`config path` 印出解析後的路徑。
173	 
174	 ```toml
175	 schema_version = 1
176	 
177	 [defaults]
178	 connect_timeout = "15s"
179	 command_timeout = "5m"
180	 cache_ttl = "15m"
181	 max_parallel = 4
182	 dev_path = "auto"
183	 
184	 [[hosts]]
185	 name = "lab"
186	 ssh_alias = "lab"
187	 
188	 [[hosts]]
189	 name = "vps"
190	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
191	 user = "dev"
192	 port = 22
193	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
194	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
195	 ```
196	 
197	 `schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。
198	 
199	 ## `dev fleet` 指令
200	 
201	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
202	 |---|---|---|
203	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>`（可重複）、`--repo <query>`、`--json`、`--cached`、`--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
204	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`、`--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
205	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`、`--remote <name>`、`--host <name>`（可重複）、`--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
206	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
207	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`、`--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
208	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
209	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
210	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
211	 
212	 `list` 的 `--repo` 會依 name、remote identity、branch 或 path 過濾；`--cached` 完全依最後一次儲存的 snapshot 回答，不會有任何 network activity；`--strict` 會讓 `list` 與 `status` 在 host 為 unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid 時回傳非零結果。`sync <repo>` 對 `<repo>` 的解析方式與其他 repository reference 相同；沒有 `--push` 時，其 `HEAD` 必須已等於 fetch 後的 upstream；`--remote` 決定用哪個 Git remote 在各 host 間識別這個 repository（預設：branch 的 upstream remote，其次是 `origin`）。
213	 
214	 `dev fleet` 還註冊了四個 hidden command（`_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr`、`_shell`），它們的存在只是為了讓 `dev fleet` 在 SSH 連線的另一端自行呼叫——這是 wire protocol，不是給使用者直接使用的介面。
215	 
216	 ## Transport 與認證
217	 
218	 每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。`dev fleet open` 另外會為它的 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
219	 
220	 若該次嘗試因 "permission denied" 被拒絕，且該 host 設定了 `ssh_login_password_source`，`dev` 會再重試一次、改用密碼驗證。密碼本身不會出現在 argv 或環境變數中：`dev` 會把自己重新以一次性的 `SSH_ASKPASS` helper 執行，密碼透過一個繼承的 file descriptor 交給那個 helper。`prompt` 會在執行當下從 `/dev/tty` 讀取隱藏輸入；`plain` 與 `bitwarden` 則分別從設定檔或 `bw get password <item>` 取得。
221	 
222	 在遠端那一側，預設的 `dev_path = "auto"` 會搜尋常見安裝位置（`~/.local/bin`、`~/go/bin`、mise shims、Homebrew/Linuxbrew、`/usr/local/bin`、`/snap/bin`）再查 `PATH`，找不到 `dev` 就以 `127` 結束；明確指定絕對路徑的 `dev_path` 則會跳過搜尋，直接 exec 該路徑。
223	 
224	 ## 哪些是 cache、哪些是 durable
225	 
226	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` 是 durable、由使用者撰寫的設定，與 `config.toml` 地位相同——由 `dev fleet config init`/`edit` 管理，不會被自動重新產生。
227	 
228	 每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`port`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。Oversized snapshot、future timestamp、invalid count，以及過大或含 NUL 的 identity/path field 都會被忽略，不會顯示。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
229	 
230	 這份 cache 存在的目的，是讓 unreachable、timeout、incompatible 或 invalid-response 的 host 仍能回報上一次已知的狀態（標記為 `stale`，並設定 `FromCache`），而不是直接從清單消失；`--cached` 只會使用這份 cache，完全不連網路。每個 remote host 自己的 `config.toml`、task registry 與 repository path，在該 host 上仍是唯一權威來源——cache 只保存它們的 read-only snapshot。
231	 
232	 ## TUI 中的 FLEET
233	 
234	-FLEET 是 TUI 六個 view 之一（`TASKS`、`REPOS`、`FLEET`、`TRY`、`REMOTE`、`SKILLS`，用 `tab`/`h`/`l` 切換）。與 REMOTE 一樣採延遲載入——view 第一次開啟前不會開始 live probe——但 cache 會在初始 TASKS view 後於背景 decode，讓仍在 `defaults.cache_ttl` 期限內的 valid snapshot 先填入 table。TUI 預設隱藏本機，因為 REPOS 已提供較完整的 local inventory；`a` 可顯示或隱藏 local rows。Local-host snapshot 會重用目前已接受的 REPOS generation，不再重跑 repository/task/runtime discovery；若該 generation 仍在 loading，FLEET 會保留 cached rows 並顯示 waiting。`r` 會 supersede 舊 request，並強制對所有已設定的 host 做一次 live reload。Non-interactive 的 `dev fleet list` 仍會同時列出本機與 remote hosts。
235	+FLEET 是 TUI 七個 view 之一（`TASKS`、`REPOS`、`FLEET`、`TRY`、`REMOTE`、`SKILLS`、`MCP`，用 `tab`/`h`/`l` 切換）。與 REMOTE 一樣採延遲載入——view 第一次開啟前不會開始 live probe——但 cache 會在初始 TASKS view 後於背景 decode，讓仍在 `defaults.cache_ttl` 期限內的 valid snapshot 先填入 table。TUI 預設隱藏本機，因為 REPOS 已提供較完整的 local inventory；`a` 可顯示或隱藏 local rows。Local-host snapshot 會重用目前已接受的 REPOS generation，不再重跑 repository/task/runtime discovery；若該 generation 仍在 loading，FLEET 會保留 cached rows 並顯示 waiting。`r` 會 supersede 舊 request，並強制對所有已設定的 host 做一次 live reload。Non-interactive 的 `dev fleet list` 仍會同時列出本機與 remote hosts。
236	 
237	 它的表格欄位是 `HOST`、`STATE`、`REPO`、`BRANCH`、`GIT`、`LIVE`、`TASKS`、`PATH`。`enter` 會開啟選取的 repository：明確顯示出來的 local host row 使用一般的 local open；remote row 則在該 host 的 snapshot 回報 `herdr` runtime，且透過 `ssh_alias` 連線、不需要密碼步驟時，優先使用原生 Herdr remoting，否則退回在該 repository 目錄下開啟 interactive SSH login shell。這個 view 中 Git 的變更是唯讀的——FLEET 是用來檢視與開啟工作，不是在原地編輯它。
238	 
239	 `e` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟 `remotes.toml`——也就是這個 view 實際對應的檔案，而不是其他 view 中 `e` 所開啟的 dev 自身 `config.toml`。離開編輯器後，`dev` 會先重新解析該檔案才使用它。解析失敗、出現未知欄位，或含有明文密碼的檔案權限有問題時，都會被回報並保留原本的資料列，因此打錯字不會安靜地讓某台 host 從 fleet 中消失。檔案解析成功則會立即對所有已設定的 host 觸發一次 live reload。
240	 
241	 ## 優雅降級
242	 
243	 每個 host 都是獨立探測的，所以一個壞掉的 host 不會讓整個 fleet 失敗。每個 host 的狀態有 `ok`、`stale`（重用 cache，可能附帶說明原因的 error）、`no-dev`（remote 的 `PATH` 上沒有 `dev`——僅回報，不視為 error）、`unreachable`（SSH 本身失敗）、`timeout`、`incompatible`（remote 的 `dev` 版本過舊或無法辨識）與 `invalid-response`（snapshot JSON 格式不正確）。`ok` 與乾淨的 `no-dev` 不會讓 `--strict` 失敗；其餘狀態都會，包括帶有 error 的 `stale` 結果。
244	 
245	 另一方面，forge integration 是 optional：`gh` 與 `glab` 提供 GitHub/GitLab
246	 inventory、publishing 與 pull/merge request；`az` 提供 Azure DevOps inventory 與
247	 pull request。缺少 CLI 時，`dev doctor` 只回報 warning，local Git workflow 仍可用；
248	 但 explicit non-interactive publication request 會附 login/install 指引失敗，不會靜默
249	 改變操作意義。Azure DevOps inventory 還額外是 opt-in：未設定
250	 `forge.azure_devops` targets 前一律停用。
251

283	 # TUI, repositories, quick notes, and bootstrap
284	 
285	 Bare `dev` opens an interactive dashboard when standard input/output are terminals. When piped, it prints the plain task listing so shell composition remains predictable.
286	 
287	-## Six views
288	+## Seven views
289	 
290	 | View | Question | Source |
291	 |---|---|---|
292	 | TASKS | What am I working on? | task registry plus live Git/runtime facts |
293	 | REPOS | What durable repositories exist here? | configured scan roots and local catalog |
294	 | FLEET | What exists and is active on configured machines? | accepted local REPOS snapshot plus remote `dev` snapshots over SSH |
295	 | TRY | Which experiments can I resume, archive, or graduate? | experiment catalog plus live facts |
296	 | REMOTE | What can I open or clone? | authenticated `gh`/`glab` inventories and cache |
297	-| SKILLS | Which agent skills are installed locally and globally? | upstream `skills` JSON plus project/global locks |
298	+| SKILLS | Which agent skills are installed across repositories and globally? | native versioned 77-agent path registry plus project/global locks |
299	+| MCP | Which MCP servers are declared for supported agents? | sanitized static configuration for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode |
300	 
301	 The initial TASKS frame is built before runtime auto-detection, project-root
302	 lookup, cache decoding, shell tool probes, or the optional release refresh can
303	 finish. TASKS, REPOS, and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
304	-cycle. REMOTE, FLEET, and SKILLS stay lazy. Each requested view has a generation:
305	+cycle. REMOTE, FLEET, SKILLS, and MCP stay lazy. Each requested view has a generation:
306	 `r` supersedes the previous read, late results are ignored, failed refreshes keep
307	 usable rows visible, and a successful empty result removes obsolete rows. Cache
308	 acceptance and current live completion are distinct; there is no all-tabs-ready
309	 state for optional views that may never be opened.
310	 
311	 Use an absolute path that does not exist for a one-run diagnostic trace:
312	 
313	 ```bash
314	 DEV_TUI_TRACE=/tmp/dev-tui-trace.json dev
315	 ```
316	 
317	 The private, bounded JSON is written after the alternate screen is restored. It
318	 contains relative timings, aggregate row counts, and categorical
319	 view/generation/outcome fields, never repository/task/host/tool names, paths,
320	 commands, key values, URLs, handles, or
321	 raw errors. It is not `stats.db` and is never sent anywhere.
322	 `tui.initial_view_returned` means the Bubble Tea view string was built, not that
323	 the terminal rasterized it.
324	 
325	 Switch with `tab`, `h`/`l`, or arrows. Use `j`/`k`, `g`/`G`, `ctrl+d`/`ctrl+u`, `/` to filter, `?` for help, and `esc`/`q` to leave the current mode.
326	 
327	 ## Common actions
328	 
329	 ### TASKS
330	 
331	 ```text
332	 enter/o   open the selected task
333	 p         park warm and enter the next action
334	 c         edit the next action
335	 n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
336	 1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
337	 ```
338	 
339	-A COLD worktree task must be rebuilt with `dev resume`; the TUI does not silently recreate it through a generic open action. A missing or unregistered worktree points to `dev sweep` first, so unique agent artifacts are reported for salvage before the task is resumed or reaped. Enter never opens an abandoned artifact-only directory.
340	+A COLD worktree task must be rebuilt with `dev resume`; the TUI does not silently recreate it through a generic open action. A missing or unregistered worktree points to `dev sweep` first, so unique agent artifacts are reported for salvage before the task is resumed or reaped. Enter never opens an abandoned artifact-only directory. At 97 or more terminal cells the TASKS table includes a display-width-aware `REPO` column; narrower layouts retain the previous columns and show repo/path in detail.
341	 
342	 ### REPOS
343	 
344	 ```text
345	 enter/o   ad-hoc open without creating a task
346	 space     expand linked worktrees
347	 m         edit repository tags/summary
348	 n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
349	 d         track direct work on the current branch
350	 s         start isolated work: branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
351	 H         open the repository activity heatmap
352	 y         open copy/context actions
353	 ```
354	 
355	 Expanded rows explain every linked worktree, including harness-owned `(ephemeral)` and otherwise unmanaged `(external)` checkouts. The LIVE column shows runtime activity separately from task state.
356	 
357	 `dev repo context [repo]` emits the same agent-ready Markdown context available from the TUI copy menu, including paths, Git/worktree/runtime facts, and tasks.
358	 
359	 ### TRY and REMOTE
360	 
361	 TRY handles low-cost experiments, reversible archive/restore, marking, and graduation. Archive is organization, not deletion or disk reclamation.
362	 
363	 REMOTE loads lazily so startup does not wait for the network. Its private XDG
364	 cache is decoded after the first view and holds the complete paginated inventory.
365	 Fresh rows require no network; stale rows stay searchable while background
366	 refresh runs. Oversized/malformed payloads and caches fingerprinted for another
367	 configured GH/GL host or Azure target are ignored. GitLab uses explicit
368	 `GITLAB_HOST`/`GLAB_HOST` (default `gitlab.com`) instead of inferring a host from
369	 cwd; successful empty inventories clear old rows. Enter opens a local clone; `c` confirms before
370	 cloning an absent repository into a path-confined `project_root`; `r` forces a
371	 refresh.
372	 Use `/vis:private` for an exact visibility filter. Notes are enabled only after
373	 a REMOTE row resolves to a local clone. TRY keeps lowercase `n` for creating a
374	 new Try rather than a repository note.
375	 
376	 ### FLEET
377	 
378	 FLEET also loads lazily. It keeps valid cached rows usable while waiting for the
379	 current REPOS generation to be accepted, reuses that snapshot for the local host
380	 instead of scanning repositories again, and then fans out to configured SSH
381	 hosts. This machine is hidden by default because REPOS already provides the
382	 richer local inventory; press `a` to include/hide local rows. Press `r` to
383	 supersede an older request and force a live reload. Changing any endpoint field,
384	 including SSH port, invalidates that host's cache. None of this changes
385	 `dev fleet list`, whose non-interactive output continues to include this machine.
386	 
387	 ## Repository quick notes
388	 
389	 On TASKS and REPOS, lowercase `n` opens a one-line quick-add prompt and uppercase `N` opens the selected repository's notes overlay. A child worktree resolves to the same canonical repository through catalog identity.
390	 
391	 ```text
392	 j/k       move
393	 /         search body, tags, and repository
394	 Enter     expand or collapse the Markdown body
395	 a or n    add another note
396	 e         edit the body in VISUAL/EDITOR
397	 d         enter confirmation; y deletes
398	 Esc       return without changing data
399	 ```
400	 
401	 The optional REPOS column `notes` shows a count. It is off by default because the table is width-constrained. Repository detail shows the count and latest preview when notes exist; task detail does so when the task resolves to a loaded repository row.
402	 
403	 The same source-of-truth workflow is available without the TUI:
404	 
405	 ```bash
406	 dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
407	 dev note list api
408	 dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
409	 dev note show <id-or-prefix>
410	 dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
411	 dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # confirms
412	 dev note path api
413	 dev note reindex
414	 ```
415	 
416	 A note ID prefix must be unique and at least eight characters.
417	 
418	 Markdown under configured `paths.state_dir/notes` is durable; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only a rebuildable search index. See the [complete generated command reference](../reference/commands-config.md#complete-generated-command-reference) for exact flags.
419	 
420	-SKILLS also loads lazily, so dashboard startup does not invoke Node. It keeps
421	-same-named project and global skills as separate rows and shows their target
422	-agents, source, path, manager, and update state. `r` reloads only local state;
423	-after that local snapshot is ready, `c` explicitly performs a read-only source
424	-check (an earlier `c` waits instead of canceling inventory); `a` opens the upstream
425	-interactive installer with `daviddwlee84/agent-skills/skills` as its default
426	-source; `u` confirms before updating only the selected lock-managed skill.
427	-Structured filters include `scope:`, `agent:`, and `update:`.
428	+SKILLS and MCP both load lazily after the current REPOS generation is accepted.
429	+They scan each canonical repository and add the exact startup checkout when it is
430	+a distinct linked worktree; global/user sources are read once. Refreshes keep
431	+usable rows visible.
432	+
433	+SKILLS reads the versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry and lock files
434	+natively—no Node, `skills`, npm, `npx`, agent detector, or project code runs.
435	+Same-named project/global/repository rows remain distinct. Presence and embedded
436	+`dev-cli` integrity are local facts; update state is a separate lock-recorded
437	+upstream comparison. `c` is the explicit grouped Git source check, `a` opens the
438	+upstream interactive installer, and `u` confirms before updating only the
439	+selected lock-managed skill in that row's checkout. Mutations require a directly
440	+installed `skills` executable; `dev` never resolves it through repository-local
441	+npm bins. Filters include `repo:`, `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`, `presence:`,
442	+and `integrity:`.
443	+
444	+MCP reads static declarations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and
445	+OpenCode. It preserves file/scope rows instead of guessing effective precedence;
446	+configured/enabled/disabled never means connected or healthy. Environment,
447	+header and OAuth values, raw arguments, URL credentials/path/query/fragment, and
448	+indirect file content are discarded before rows enter the model. The scanner
449	+never runs a server, helper, URL, or agent MCP command. Filters include `repo:`,
450	+`agent:`, `scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`; `r` only rereads
451	+static files.
452	 
453	 ## External tools
454	 
455	 ```bash
456	 dev tui tools
457	 ```
458	 
459	 Configured tools run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout while the alternate screen is suspended. `interactive = true` uses `$SHELL -lic` so local aliases/functions can resolve; use a real executable on `PATH` when the binding must be portable. Availability probes run in a bounded background load after the first view; rendering never starts a login shell, and unresolved bindings fail closed.
460	 
461	 ```toml
462	 [[tui.tools]]
463	 key = "L"
464	 name = "lazygit"
465	 run = "lazygit"
466	 ```
467	 
468	 Keys are case-sensitive and cannot shadow dashboard-owned bindings. Returning from an editor can reload most config; switching runtime backend requires restarting the TUI.
469	 
470	 ## Inventory an existing machine
471	 
472	 Start with a report:
473	 
474	 ```bash
475	 dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
476	 dev bootstrap ~/code --json
477	 ```
478	 
479	 The scanner identifies canonical checkouts, linked worktrees, bare repositories, and symlink aliases, then deduplicates them by Git identity.
480	 
481	 The recommended organization layer is a non-destructive symlink index:
482	 
483	 ```bash
484	 dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
485	 dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
486	 ```
487	 
488	 Physical moves are a separate, stricter mode. A move plan blocks dirty repositories, linked worktrees, live sessions/current working directories, aliases that would break, occupied destinations, and cross-filesystem renames. If any row is blocked, apply moves none.
489	 
490	 ## Adopt work already in flight
491	 
492	 Bootstrap answers **where repositories are**. Adoption answers **which existing branches, worktrees, and sessions are active work**:
493	 
494	 ```bash
495	 dev adopt
496	 dev adopt --apply
497	 ```
498	 
499	 Adopt reports by default and only writes task entries after `--apply` plus confirmation. It does not move, rename, or delete checkouts, and it excludes recognized harness-ephemeral worktrees.

575	 ## 常用 actions
576	 
577	 ### TASKS
578	 
579	 ```text
580	 enter/o   開啟選取的 task
581	 p         park warm 並輸入 next action
582	 c         編輯 next action
583	 n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
584	 1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
585	 ```
586	 
587	-COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。
588	+COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。Terminal 寬度至少 97 cells 時，TASKS table 會顯示 display-width-aware `REPO` column；更窄時保留原 columns，並在 detail 顯示 repo/path。
589	 
590	 ### REPOS
591	 
592	 ```text
593	 enter/o   ad-hoc open，不建立 task
594	 space     展開 linked worktrees
595	 m         編輯 repository tags/summary
596	 n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
597	 d         追蹤目前 branch 的 direct work
598	 s         啟動 isolated work：branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
599	 H         開啟 repository activity heatmap
600	 y         開啟 copy/context actions
601	 ```
602	 
603	 展開後會顯示每個 linked worktree，包括 harness-owned `(ephemeral)` 與未受管理的 `(external)` checkout。LIVE column 將 runtime activity 與 task state 分開。
604	 
605	 `dev repo context [repo]` 會輸出 TUI copy menu 相同的 agent-ready Markdown context，包含 paths、Git/worktree/runtime facts 與 tasks。
606	 
607	 ### TRY 與 REMOTE
608	 
609	 TRY 管理低成本 experiment、可逆 archive/restore、mark 與 graduation。Archive 是整理，不是 deletion 或 disk reclamation。
610	 
611	 REMOTE 延遲載入，因此 startup 不等待 network。Private XDG cache 會在 first
612	 view 後 decode，並保存完整 paginated inventory；fresh rows 不需要 network，
613	 stale rows 仍可搜尋並在背景 refresh。Oversized／malformed payload，以及
614	 fingerprint 屬於其他 configured GH/GL host 或 Azure target 的 cache 都會被忽略。
615	 GitLab 使用 explicit `GITLAB_HOST`／`GLAB_HOST`（預設 `gitlab.com`），不從 cwd
616	 推測 host；成功但為空的 inventory 會清除舊 rows。Enter 開啟 local clone；`c` 在
617	 clone 缺少的 repository 前確認，且 destination 受限於 `project_root`；`r`
618	 強制更新 forge inventories。使用 `/vis:private` 可精確過濾 visibility。只有 REMOTE
619	 row 能解析到 local clone 時才能使用 notes。TRY 保留 lowercase `n` 建立新 Try，
620	 不會改成 repository note。
621	 
622	 ### FLEET
623	 
624	 FLEET 同樣延遲載入。等待目前的 REPOS generation 被接受時，仍可使用 valid
625	 cached rows；接受後會重用該 snapshot 作為 local host 資料，不再重掃
626	 repositories，接著才 fan out 到設定的 SSH hosts。它預設隱藏本機，因為 REPOS
627	 已提供較完整的 local inventory；按 `a` 可顯示或隱藏 local rows。按 `r` 會
628	 supersede 舊 request 並強制執行 live reload。任何 endpoint field（包含 SSH
629	 port）改變都會讓該 host cache 失效。這不會改變 `dev fleet list`：其
630	 non-interactive output 仍包含本機與所有已設定的 remote hosts。
631	 
632	 ## Repository quick notes
633	 
634	 在 TASKS 與 REPOS，lowercase `n` 開啟單行 quick-add prompt，uppercase `N` 開啟選取 repository 的 notes overlay。Child worktree 會透過 catalog identity 解析到同一個 canonical repository。
635	 
636	 ```text
637	 j/k       移動
638	 /         搜尋 body、tags 與 repository
639	 Enter     展開或收合 Markdown body
640	 a or n    新增另一則 note
641	 e         用 VISUAL/EDITOR 編輯 body
642	 d         進入確認；y 才刪除
643	 Esc       不改資料並返回
644	 ```
645	 
646	 可選的 REPOS column `notes` 顯示數量。Table 寬度有限，因此預設不啟用。Notes 存在時，repository detail 顯示數量與最新 preview；task 能解析到已載入 repository row 時，task detail 才會顯示。
647	 
648	 不使用 TUI 也能操作同一份 source of truth：
649	 
650	 ```bash
651	 dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
652	 dev note list api
653	 dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
654	 dev note show <id-or-prefix>
655	 dev note edit <id-or-prefix>

59	 Prefer JSON or the agent-ready Markdown context over parsing human tables. Tables are optimized for terminals and may change columns/width without changing the structured contract.
60

When a latest note exists, the same object adds `notes.latest_id`, `notes.latest_preview`, and `notes.latest_updated`; these optional fields are omitted when the count is zero. `dev note list --json` and `dev note search --json` return arrays of complete note records, while `dev note show --json` returns one complete record.

65	 ## Repository bootstrap
66	 
67	 Repository setup remains separate from acquisition. For acquisition,
68	 `new`/`create` distinguishes a plain repository name from a clear clone
69	 reference:
70	 
71	 | Command | Behavior |
72	 |---|---|
73	 | `dev repo new` | interactive wizard; its first field accepts either a new name or a clone reference |
74	 | `dev repo new NAME` / `dev repo create NAME` | create a new local repository; a clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/name instead routes to clone and preserves history/remote |
75	 | `dev repo clone [owner/name\|url]` | clone into the configured destination, then optionally apply a preset; setup defaults off |
76	 | `dev repo setup [repo-or-path]` | repeat-safely merge native initializers and preset files into an existing clean checkout; defaults to the current repository and does not commit unless requested |
77	 
78	 A clone-routed `new` retains the source `origin`; it therefore rejects
79	 new-upstream creation flags. It also rejects `--template*`, whose explicit
80	 meaning is “copy content into a fresh history.”
81	 
82	 Across these commands, controls include `--preset`, `--path`, typed input values through
83	 `--set`, item selection through `--enable`/`--disable`, `--check-in
84	 <auto|commit|stage|none>`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--json`, and `--handoff
85	 <stay|cd|open|start>`. `repo new` additionally accepts `--template`,
86	 `--template-ref`, and `--template-subdir`. JSON mode is non-interactive and
87	 never changes directory or opens a runtime. Dry-run performs no target
88	 repository mutation; clone setup can only be planned in detail after the clone
89	 exists. Use the generated reference below for each command's exact flag
90	 availability.
91	 
92	 The wizard renders the selected scaffold and workflow summary before target
93	 repository mutation. The built-in presets are:
94	 
95	 - `minimal`: `main`, README, and an initial commit; this preserves existing
96	   scripted `repo new NAME` behavior.
97	 - `agent-ready`: extends `minimal` with common ignores, starter `AGENTS.md`,
98	   and project-scoped `.claude/settings.json` plus `.claude/plans/`.
99	   `agent-history-hygiene` and `project-knowledge-harness` are offered but are
100	   not selected silently. When selected, dev installs them and runs reviewed
101	   built-in initializers for their project surfaces before the initial commit;
102	   downloaded skill scripts are not executed for these built-ins. Matching
103	   skills with the same source and identical agent targets share one installer
104	   invocation, while their setup phases still run per skill. The history
105	   initializer creates `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and `.gitleaks.toml`, then
106	   ensures `.specstory/.gitignore` contains rules for SpecStory's `.project.json`
107	   and `statistics.json`, never the trackable `.specstory/history/` directory.
108	   Existing custom ignore content and its mode are preserved; only missing
109	   managed rules are appended.
110	 
111	 After preset selection, the new-repository wizard asks “Customize preset and
112	 template options?” with a default of no. The ordinary `agent-ready` flow uses
113	 its reviewed template, file, input, and skill defaults without presenting each
114	 question. Answer yes—or provide customization flags—to expand those controls.
115	 
116	 Presets can add typed `string`, `bool`, and `choice` inputs, text templates,
117	 hooks, and project skills. Hooks run in fixed `before_commit`, `after_commit`,
118	 and `after_remote` phases. The safe hook form is an argv `command`; a shell
119	 `run` is explicit, and only `interactive = true` loads an interactive shell.
120	 Required failures stop later commit/remote steps; optional failures are
121	 reported as warnings. Produced local files are retained for recovery. Native
122	 initializers and preset files are repeat-safe; custom hooks and skill setup are
123	 responsible for their own idempotency.
124	 
125	 ### Snapshot templates
126	 
127	 `dev repo new NAME --template SOURCE` seeds a fresh repository from a content
128	 snapshot. `SOURCE` may be a local directory/repository, Git URL, or owner/name.
129	 For a Git source, `--template-ref` selects an arbitrary branch, tag, or commit;
130	 `--template-subdir` selects a clean relative directory as the new repository
131	 root. Without a ref, a local Git working tree includes existing tracked files
132	 plus untracked files that are not ignored by Git; ignored build/cache content
133	 is omitted. A non-Git directory snapshots its complete current tree.
134	 
135	 The new repository does not inherit source history or remotes. Dev excludes
136	 every source `.git` entry, rejects traversal, symlinks and special files,
137	 preserves regular-file modes, and validates the complete snapshot before
138	 creating the destination. Snapshot files take precedence when the selected
139	 scaffold would write the same path; the scaffold still fills missing files and
140	 runs the selected initializers. Source and destination traversal is performed
141	 relative to held `os.Root` handles, and file bytes come from the already-open
142	 validated source handle rather than a second mutable pathname lookup.

266	 `SOURCE` 可為 local directory/repository、Git URL 或 owner/name。Git source 可用
267	 `--template-ref` 指定任意 branch、tag 或 commit；`--template-subdir` 則指定作為新
268	 repository root 的乾淨 relative directory。未指定 ref 時，local Git working tree 會
269	 包含現存 tracked files，以及未被 Git ignore 的 untracked files；ignored build/cache
270	 content 會省略。Non-Git directory 則 snapshot 完整 current tree。
271	 
272	 新 repository 不會繼承 source history 或 remotes。Dev 會排除每個 source `.git`
273	 entry、拒絕 traversal、symlink 與 special files、保留 regular-file modes，並在建立
274	 destination 前驗證完整 snapshot。若 snapshot 與 selected scaffold 寫入同一路徑，
275	 snapshot 優先；scaffold 仍會補齊缺少的 files 並執行 selected initializers。
276	 Source 與 destination traversal 都相對於 held `os.Root` handles 進行；file bytes 來自
277	 已開啟且驗證過的 source handle，不會再次依 mutable pathname lookup。
278	 
279	 Confirmation 與 human dry-run output 會顯示 bounded selected-path preview；local source
280	 若是 live working-tree/directory snapshot 而非 commit，也會明確 warning。含 credential
281	 的 URL userinfo 會從 summaries、structured output 與 clone/template errors 移除。
282	 
283	 Preset 可用 scalar `template`、`template_ref`、`template_subdir` 宣告同一操作。它們依
284	 一般 inheritance 規則 resolve，explicit CLI flags 優先，因此可以一個 starter catalog
285	 repository 搭配每個 subfolder 各一個 child preset。
286	 
287	 ### Check-in policy
288

303	 # Compatibility and known limitations
304	 
305	 This page separates graceful degradation from real limitations. Reverify it whenever command/runtime code or version-sensitive Claude Code documentation changes.
306	 
307	 ## dev-cli capability matrix
308	 
309	 | Capability | Dependency | Without it |
310	 |---|---|---|
311	 | core repository/task/worktree operations | Git | unavailable; Git is the only hard runtime dependency |
312	 | rich grouped runtime and agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` tries tmux, then Zellij, then none |
313	 | named terminal session | tmux or compatible Zellij | `none` preserves core behavior and shell navigation |
314	 | GitHub pull requests/remotes | `gh` authenticated | branch still pushes when Git works; browser/manual flow may be needed |
315	 | GitLab merge requests/remotes | `glab` authenticated | same graceful fallback |
316	 | repository bootstrap publishing | authenticated `gh` or `glab` | local repository/scaffold still works; the wizard explains how to log in |
317	 | remote repository snapshot template | Git plus network/authentication for the source | validation fails before the destination is created and rendered URL userinfo is redacted; local templates still work |
318	+| native skill inventory | local filesystem plus the versioned `skills@1.5.23` path registry | always available; explicit add/update requires a directly installed `skills` executable and may use the network; repository-local npm bins are never provider candidates |
319	+| static MCP inventory | readable supported agent config files | missing sources are empty; malformed/unsupported sources produce partial diagnostics, and runtime health is intentionally unavailable |
320	 | setup-capable project skills | skills provider plus the entrypoint interpreter | unselected skills are skipped; selected required setup fails before scaffold mutation when its interpreter is unavailable; a clone acquired first is retained |
321	 | staged lazygit message prefill | a lazygit version that reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` | files remain staged and dev prints the suggested message; normal Git commit remains available |
322	 | worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager (`uv`, npm, Cargo, etc.) | plan reports the missing tool and keeps the checkout |
323	 | interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | bare `dev` prints the plain task list when piped |
324	 | repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` with FTS5 | no external `sqlite3` executable is required |
325	 | terminal multiplexing on Windows | tmux/Zellij/Herdr (POSIX only) | Windows always uses the `none` backend; `dev shell-init powershell` still moves the shell |
326	 | in-place self-update | standalone install (not Homebrew/Scoop/`go install`) | `dev upgrade` prints the package manager's upgrade command instead |
327	 
328	 ## Confirmed project limitations
329	 
330	+### MCP inventory is static and intentionally incomplete
331	+
332	+`dev mcp list` reads documented static files for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. It does not start servers, execute helpers, contact endpoints, query health, resolve credentials, or reproduce each agent's runtime merge. Plugin caches, hosted connectors, remote organization configuration, inline `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`, and command-line-only inputs are omitted. Keep the JSON `coverage` object and scope-qualified duplicate rows when automating against this inventory.
333	+
334	 ### Note search and filesystem durability vary by text and platform
335	 
336	 Latin note queries use term-wise prefix FTS and SQLite ranking. Non-ASCII queries use literal term-wise substring matching because SQLite's `unicode61` tokenizer does not segment arbitrary CJK substrings; those results do not use the same FTS ranking.
337	 
338	 Note writes sync the file and atomically rename it on every supported platform. Unix also syncs the containing directory after rename/delete. The Windows implementation cannot provide that directory-fsync step, so a sudden power loss has a narrower durability guarantee there. Concurrent mutations by cooperating `dev` processes are serialized and each Markdown replacement is atomic; arbitrary external writers do not participate in that lock.
339	 
340	 ### Pull-request completion is not tracked automatically
341	 
342	 `dev done --pr` pushes and opens a pull/merge request, then leaves the task, runtime, and worktree unchanged because review owns integration. Current `dev sweep` does not query the forge to infer that a request later merged. Verify integration and finish/reconcile deliberately; do not assume remote merge implies local DONE.
343	 
344	 ### Agent session capture is reserved, not wired
345	 
346	 The task schema has an `AgentSession` field and Herdr inventory can expose live agent session IDs. The production start/park/resume path does not yet capture or attach that ID. Treat the field and live inventory as observability/future integration, not a promise that `dev resume` restores the coding-agent conversation.
347	 
348	 ### Built-in forge cache TTL differs from generated config
349	 
350	 `dev config init` writes `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`. With no config file, the current built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` zero value means an existing valid cache is not rejected by age; explicit `r` refresh still replaces it. Freshness also requires a source fingerprint matching the configured GH/GL hosts and Azure targets, so an endpoint change is never hidden by the zero TTL. Legacy source-less caches remain available only through explicit `--cached` and are reported stale. Run `config init` or set the TTL when freshness matters.
351	 
352	 Older generated configs may contain `forge.remote_limit = 100`. The field is
353	 still accepted, but complete forge inventories are now paginated and it no
354	 longer caps synchronization. `dev config init` no longer writes it. The
355	 `--limit` flag on `dev repo remote` limits rendered matches after the complete
356	 inventory has been searched.
357	 
358	 ### Lazygit staged-message prefill is best effort
359	 
360	 `repo --check-in=stage` writes a pending message in the exact worktree Git
361	 directory. [Lazygit v0.59.0 uses that file for lowercase
362	 `c`](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216), but it is a
363	 lazygit implementation detail rather than a Git interface; uppercase `C` and
364	 plain `git commit` do not consume it. Dev never overwrites a different existing
365	 draft. A draft-write failure is warning-only: staging remains successful and
366	 is never rolled back. If the integration changes upstream, the staged index
367	 and printed message remain the recovery path.
368	 
369	 ### Windows is a build target, not a full-feature platform
370	 
371	 `dev` compiles and runs on `windows/amd64` and `windows/arm64`, and every release ships a `.zip` for each. Core repository, task and worktree operations work. What differs:
372	 
373	 - There is no tmux, Zellij or Herdr, so the runtime backend is always `none`. Grouped runtime/agent activity and named sessions are unavailable; the `cd` directive and PowerShell wrapper still work.
374	 - Shell integration is `dev shell-init powershell`. POSIX shells hand the directory back on file descriptor 3; PowerShell cannot inherit it, so the wrapper passes a temp-file path in `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` instead.
375	 - `dev fleet open` starts a child shell (`%COMSPEC%`) rather than replacing the process, because Windows has no `exec(2)`.
376	 - The domain test suites still assume a POSIX filesystem in places, so Windows CI runs the tests advisory-only while compilation, `go vet` and the build are enforced.
377	 
378	 ### Direct mode has a smaller lifecycle
379	 
380	 A direct task uses the canonical checkout and cannot go COLD, because cold cleanup would remove a directory the repository needs. Use branch-only or worktree mode for cross-machine reconstruction.
381	 
382	 ## Current behaviors that are implemented
383	 
384	 These were historical gaps and should not be reintroduced as limitations:
385	 
386	 - `dev repo new|create`, `repo clone`, and `repo setup` share a preset-driven bootstrap pipeline. A plain explicit `repo new NAME` remains minimal, while a clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/name routes through clone acquisition and preserves source history/remote. The no-argument wizard detects the same reference in its first field; for a new repository, a default-no customization gate keeps the normal `agent-ready` flow concise. Text fields use a TTY inline editor, so cursor keys edit rather than inserting raw escape bytes; non-TTY readers retain line-oriented behavior.
387	 - `repo new` can snapshot a local directory/repository or Git source at an optional branch, tag, or commit and confined subdirectory into a fresh history. An unpinned local Git tree includes tracked plus untracked non-ignored files; a non-Git directory includes its full current tree. Source `.git` metadata is excluded, URL userinfo is redacted, unsafe file types/paths fail before destination creation, and held root/file handles confine mutable-path races. Human plans preview paths and warn when the snapshot is live; presets can select catalog-repository subfolders.
388	 - Repository setup supports `--check-in=commit|stage|none` (`auto` for preset compatibility). Staged setup runs before-commit setup and `git add -A` without an `after_commit` phase, cannot publish or hand off to `start`, and may prefill lazygit lowercase `c` as described above.
389	 - Selected skills with matching source and agent targets share one installer invocation. The `agent-history-hygiene` initializer writes pre-commit/gitleaks policy and merges missing machine-local `.project.json`/`statistics.json` rules into `.specstory/.gitignore`; custom content and transcript history remain trackable.
390	 - Project `.dev-cli/config.toml` and `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` are constrained to portable setup policy. Executable project configuration is keyed to the canonical Git common directory and an exact content hash; a changed hash is untrusted until approved again.
391	 
392	 - `dev start --focus` activates the runtime after non-JSON creation.
393	 - `dev start --run '<shell command>'` dispatches only to an exact root pane from
394	   a newly created first-class Herdr worktree. It is incompatible with `--json`,
395	   non-worktree modes, and non-Herdr runtimes, and does not wait for command exit.
396	 - TUI navigation refuses to open a missing COLD checkout and directs the user to `dev resume`.
397	 - `DEV_TUI_TRACE` starts at `cli.Execute`; it cannot include OS process loading. `tui.initial_view_returned` measures model construction, not renderer flush or physical terminal paint. Use it for same-profile comparisons rather than universal hardware/network guarantees.
398	 - Runtime handles now record backend provenance and are revalidated before cleanup.
399	 - `auto` runtime selection includes Zellij between tmux and none.
400	 
401	 - `dev done` opens an interactive finish wizard on a TTY when `--ff`/`--pr` are both omitted, analyzing a dirty checkout against the base (commit, discard, or cancel) instead of rejecting any uncommitted change outright; a non-interactive caller still passes an explicit `--dirty` policy and `--yes` for a destructive discard.
402	 - Human-readable output now carries semantic color (`--color auto|always|never`), automatically disabled when `NO_COLOR` is set, `TERM=dumb`, or stdout/stderr is not a terminal.
403	 - `dev done` records MERGED only: it never closes the invoking runtime, removes a worktree, or deletes a branch. Cleanup moved to `dev retire`, which runs from outside the target workspace, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, and revalidates Git state after every runtime closure. `dev done --delete-branch` is now an error pointing at `dev retire --delete-branch`, and `--keep-worktree` warns as a no-op.
404	 - `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` enumerates linked worktrees from Git rather than from the task registry, so unmanaged worktrees whose branches are contained in the base become retirable. Containment alone is never permission; dirty state, unfinalized artifacts, in-progress Git operations, and runtime refusals all still block it, and branches survive unless `--delete-branches` is passed.
405	 - `dev sweep` reports a branch-backed task whose branch Git no longer has as dead and offers to reap the record. Such a task cannot be finished, resumed, or retired, because every one of those paths resolves the branch first; the suggestion stays report-only until `--apply`.
406	 - An unknown command is reported instead of discarded. `dev` silences cobra's own error printing and previously also skipped printing anything whose message began with `unknown command`, so a mistyped command produced no output at all on either stream. The message, cobra's "Did you mean this?" suggestions, and a pointer to `--help` are now printed to stderr with exit status 1.
407	 - A stray argument to a command family is an error rather than a silent help render. `dev wt bogus` used to print `dev wt` help and exit 0 because a family has no `Run` of its own; every family node now reports the unknown subcommand and exits 1, while a bare family still prints its help and exits 0.
408	 - Argument-count and flag errors print the failing command's usage block. `--color` still governs whether that block is colorized.
409	 - Each command family's help carries an ASCII orientation diagram and a `See also: dev help <topic>` pointer, and `dev help <command>` resolves a command name or alias to its topic, so `dev help wt` reaches the worktrees page.
410	 - Semantic color covers every human-readable surface, including the interactive dashboard: `dev --color never`, `NO_COLOR` and `TERM=dumb` now disable dashboard color too, which they previously did not.
411	 - `dev sweep` reaps a task whose repository directory no longer exists. Such a record was unreachable by every command in the binary: `done`, `resume`, `park` and `retire` all resolve the repository first, the dead-branch rule excludes direct mode, and the stale-worktree rule requires a recorded worktree path. A live runtime session rules the suggestion out, and reaping removes only dev's record of intent.
412	 - `dev sweep` reports a task-recorded checkout that exists but Git does not register and that holds nothing but agent artifact directories. Removal is offered only when every file inside is byte-identical to one already in the repository; anything else is reported as salvage work and is never removed, including under `--apply`.
413	 - `dev sweep` acts on a cold task whose worktree is still on disk. Inventory has always computed that drift for `dev ls` and the dashboard, but sweep never consulted it, so it was displayed and not actionable.

430	 
431	 !!! note "術語規則"
432	     有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
433	 
434	 這頁把 graceful degradation 與真正 limitation 分開。Command/runtime code 或 version-sensitive Claude Code 文件變動時必須重新驗證。
435	 
436	 ## dev-cli capability matrix
437	 
438	 | Capability | Dependency | 缺少時 |
439	 |---|---|---|
440	 | 核心 repository/task/worktree 操作 | Git | 無法使用；Git 是唯一 hard runtime dependency |
441	 | grouped runtime 與 agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` 改試 tmux、Zellij，最後 none |
442	 | named terminal session | tmux 或相容 Zellij | `none` 保留核心 behavior 與 shell navigation |
443	 | GitHub pull requests/remotes | authenticated `gh` | Git 可用時 branch 仍能 push，可能需 browser/manual flow |
444	 | GitLab merge requests/remotes | authenticated `glab` | 同樣 graceful fallback |
445	 | repository bootstrap publishing | authenticated `gh` 或 `glab` | local repository/scaffold 仍可使用；wizard 會說明如何 login |
446	 | remote repository snapshot template | Git，加上 source 所需的 network/authentication | validation 會在建立 destination 前失敗，rendered URL userinfo 會 redact；local template 仍可使用 |
447	+| native skill inventory | local filesystem 加 versioned `skills@1.5.23` path registry | 永遠可用；explicit add/update 需要直接安裝的 `skills` executable，且可能使用 network；repository-local npm bins 絕不作為 provider candidate |
448	+| static MCP inventory | 可讀取的 supported agent config files | 缺少 source 代表 empty；malformed/unsupported source 產生 partial diagnostics，runtime health 刻意不提供 |
449	 | setup-capable project skills | skills provider 與 entrypoint interpreter | 未選取的 skill 會跳過；selected required setup 若缺少 interpreter，會在 scaffold mutation 前失敗；先取得的 clone 會保留 |
450	 | staged lazygit message prefill | 會讀取 `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` 的 lazygit version | files 仍保持 staged，dev 會印出建議 message；一般 Git commit 仍可使用 |
451	 | worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager（`uv`、npm、Cargo 等） | plan 回報 missing tool 並保留 checkout |
452	 | interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | 透過 pipe 執行 bare `dev` 時輸出 plain task list |
453	 | repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` 與 FTS5 | 不需要外部 `sqlite3` executable |
454	 | Windows 上的 terminal multiplexing | tmux/Zellij/Herdr（僅 POSIX） | Windows 一律使用 `none` backend；`dev shell-init powershell` 仍能移動 shell |
455	 | in-place self-update | standalone install（非 Homebrew/Scoop/`go install`） | `dev upgrade` 改為印出對應套件管理器的升級指令 |

457	 ## 已確認的專案限制
458	 
459	+### MCP inventory 是 static 且刻意不完整
460	+
461	+`dev mcp list` 會讀取 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 與 OpenCode 的 documented static files；不會啟動 server、執行 helper、連線 endpoint、查詢 health、解析 credentials，或重現每個 agent 的 runtime merge。Plugin caches、hosted connectors、remote organization config、inline `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` 與 command-line-only inputs 都會省略。對 inventory 做 automation 時必須保留 JSON `coverage` object 與 scope-qualified duplicate rows。
462	+
463	 ### Note search 與 filesystem durability 依文字及平台而異
464	 
465	 Latin note query 使用 term-wise prefix FTS 與 SQLite ranking。Non-ASCII query 改用 literal term-wise substring matching，因為 SQLite 的 `unicode61` tokenizer 不會切分任意 CJK substrings；這些結果不使用相同的 FTS ranking。
466	 
467	 所有支援平台的 note write 都會 sync file 並 atomic rename。Unix 也會在 rename/delete 後 sync containing directory。Windows implementation 無法提供 directory-fsync 步驟，因此 sudden power loss 時的 durability guarantee 較窄。Cooperating `dev` processes 的 concurrent mutations 會被 serialized，且每次 Markdown replacement 都是 atomic；任意 external writer 不會參與這個 lock。
468	 
469	 ### Pull request completion 不會自動追蹤
470	 
471	 `dev done --pr` push 並建立 pull/merge request，之後保留 task、runtime 與 worktree，因為 integration 由 review 負責。目前 `dev sweep` 不會 query forge 推斷 request 後來已 merge。請驗證 integration 後再刻意 finish/reconcile；不能假設 remote merge 代表 local DONE。
472	 
473	 ### Agent session capture 只有保留欄位，尚未接線
474	 
475	 Task schema 有 `AgentSession`，Herdr inventory 也能顯示 live agent session ID；production start/park/resume path 尚未 capture 或 attach 該 ID。這個欄位與 live inventory 只能視為 observability/future integration，不能承諾 `dev resume` 會恢復 coding-agent conversation。
476	 
477	 ### Built-in forge cache TTL 與 generated config 不同
478	 
479	 `dev config init` 會寫 `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`。沒有 config file 時，目前 built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` 的 zero value 代表既有 valid cache 不會因 age 被拒絕；explicit `r` 仍會 refresh。Freshness 也要求 source fingerprint 符合 configured GH/GL hosts 與 Azure targets，因此 endpoint change 不會被 zero TTL 隱藏。Legacy source-less cache 只能透過 explicit `--cached` 使用，並會標為 stale。Freshness 重要時請執行 `config init` 或設定 TTL。
480	 
481	 較舊的 generated config 可能包含 `forge.remote_limit = 100`。此欄位仍可解析，
482	 但 forge inventory 現在會完整 pagination，因此不再限制 synchronization。
483	 `dev config init` 不再寫入它；`dev repo remote --limit` 只在完整 inventory 搜尋
484	 完成後限制 rendered matches。
485	 
486	 ### Lazygit staged-message prefill 是 best effort
487	 
488	 `repo --check-in=stage` 會在正確的 worktree Git directory 寫入 pending message。
489	 [Lazygit v0.59.0 的小寫 `c` 會使用該
490	 檔案](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216)，但這是 lazygit implementation detail，不是 Git
491	 interface；大寫 `C` 與一般 `git commit` 不會讀取它。Dev 不會覆寫內容不同的既有
492	 draft。Draft write failure 只會產生 warning；staging 仍視為成功且不會 rollback。若
493	 upstream integration 日後改變，staged index 與已印出的 message 仍是 recovery path。
494	 
495	 ### Windows 是 build target，不是 full-feature 平台
496	 
497	 `dev` 可在 `windows/amd64` 與 `windows/arm64` 編譯並執行，每個 release 都會附各自的 `.zip`。核心的 repository、task 與 worktree 操作可用。差異：
498	 
499	 - 沒有 tmux、Zellij 或 Herdr，因此 runtime backend 一律是 `none`。Grouped runtime/agent activity 與 named session 無法使用；`cd` 指令與 PowerShell wrapper 仍可運作。
500	 - Shell integration 是 `dev shell-init powershell`。POSIX shell 透過 file descriptor 3 回傳目錄；PowerShell 無法繼承它，wrapper 改用 `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` 傳入 temp-file path。
501	 - `dev fleet open` 會啟動子 shell（`%COMSPEC%`），而非取代 process，因為 Windows 沒有 `exec(2)`。
502	 - Domain test suites 仍有部分假設 POSIX filesystem，因此 Windows CI 的 test 僅供參考，compilation、`go vet` 與 build 則為強制項。
503	 
504	 ### Direct mode 的 lifecycle 較小
505	 
506	 Direct task 使用 canonical checkout，不能進入 COLD，因為 cold cleanup 會移除 repository 必需的 directory。需要跨機器 reconstruction 時使用 branch-only 或 worktree mode。
507	 
508	 ## 已實作、不能再列為 limitation 的 behavior
509	 
510	 以下是歷史缺口，現行版本已實作：
511	 
512	 - `dev repo new|create`、`repo clone` 與 `repo setup` 共用 preset-driven bootstrap pipeline。Plain explicit `repo new NAME` 仍維持 minimal；清楚的 Git URL、local Git path 或 owner/name 會改走 clone acquisition，保留 source history/remote。無參數 wizard 的第一個欄位也會偵測同樣 reference；建立新 repository 時，預設為 no 的 customization gate 讓正常 `agent-ready` flow 保持精簡。Text fields 使用 TTY inline editor，因此 cursor keys 會編輯內容，不會插入 raw escape bytes；non-TTY reader 維持 line-oriented behavior。
513	 - `repo new` 可從 local directory/repository 或 Git source 的 optional branch、tag、commit 與 confined subdirectory 建立 fresh-history snapshot。未 pin 的 local Git tree 包含 tracked 加 untracked non-ignored files；non-Git directory 包含完整 current tree。Source `.git` metadata 會排除、URL userinfo 會 redact，不安全的 file types/paths 會在 destination 建立前失敗，held root/file handles 會限制 mutable-path races。Human plan 會預覽 paths 並警告 live snapshot，preset 也可選擇 catalog-repository subfolder。
514	 - Repository setup 支援 `--check-in=commit|stage|none`（`auto` 用於 preset compatibility）。Staged setup 會執行 before-commit setup 與 `git add -A`，但不執行 `after_commit` phase；它不能 publish 或 handoff 到 `start`，並可依前述方式預填 lazygit 小寫 `c`。
515	 - Source 與 agent targets 相同的 selected skills 會共用一次 installer invocation。`agent-history-hygiene` initializer 會寫入 pre-commit/gitleaks policy，並將缺少的 machine-local `.project.json`／`statistics.json` 規則 merge 進 `.specstory/.gitignore`；custom content 與 transcript history 都保持可追蹤。
516	 - Project `.dev-cli/config.toml` 與 `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` 僅能保存 portable setup policy。Executable project configuration 會綁定 canonical Git common directory 與 exact content hash；hash 改變後必須重新信任。
517	 
518	 - `dev start --focus` 會在 non-JSON creation 後 activate runtime。
519	 - `dev start --run '<shell command>'` 只會 dispatch 到本次新建 first-class Herdr
520	   worktree 的 exact root pane。它不能與 `--json`、non-worktree modes 或 non-Herdr
521	   runtimes 併用，也不等待 command exit。
522	 - TUI navigation 會拒絕開啟 checkout 不存在的 COLD task，並要求使用 `dev resume`。
523	 - `DEV_TUI_TRACE` 從 `cli.Execute` 起算，無法涵蓋 OS process loading。`tui.initial_view_returned` 量測 model construction，不是 renderer flush 或 physical terminal paint；它適合同 profile 比較，不是跨硬體／network 的 universal guarantee。
524	 - Runtime handle 現在保存 backend provenance，cleanup 前會重新驗證。
525	 - `auto` runtime selection 已在 tmux 與 none 之間加入 Zellij。
526	 
527	 - `dev done` 在省略 `--ff`/`--pr` 且為 TTY 時會開啟 interactive finish wizard，把 dirty checkout 拿去跟 base 比較（commit、discard 或 cancel），不再直接拒絕任何 uncommitted change；non-interactive caller 仍須明確傳入 `--dirty` policy，且 destructive discard 需要 `--yes`。
528	 - Human-readable output 現在具備 semantic color（`--color auto|always|never`），在 `NO_COLOR` 已設定、`TERM=dumb`，或 stdout/stderr 不是 terminal 時會自動停用。
529	 - `dev done` 只記錄 MERGED：它不會關閉呼叫端 runtime、移除 worktree 或刪除 branch。Cleanup 已移交 `dev retire`，後者必須從目標 workspace 之外執行，會拒絕 active agent 與 mixed-purpose workspace，並在每次關閉 runtime 之後重新驗證 Git state。`dev done --delete-branch` 現在會直接報錯並指向 `dev retire --delete-branch`，`--keep-worktree` 則以 no-op 警告。
530	 - `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` 直接從 Git 列舉 linked worktrees，而非從 task registry，因此 branch 已被 base 包含的 unmanaged worktree 也能被 retire。Containment 本身絕不等於許可；dirty state、未 finalize 的 artifact、進行中的 Git operation 與 runtime 拒絕條件都仍會阻擋，且未加 `--delete-branches` 時 branch 一律保留。
531	 - `dev sweep` 會把 branch 已不存在於 Git 的 branch-backed task 視為 dead，並提供 reap 該 record 的建議。這種 task 無法 finish、resume 或 retire，因為這些路徑都必須先解析 branch；在 `--apply` 之前該建議仍只是報告。
532	 - 未知 command 會被回報，而不是被丟棄。`dev` 關閉了 cobra 自己的 error 輸出，先前又額外略過所有訊息開頭為 `unknown command` 的 error，因此打錯 command 時兩個 stream 都沒有任何輸出。現在會把訊息、cobra 的「Did you mean this?」建議，以及指向 `--help` 的提示寫到 stderr，exit status 為 1。
533	 - 對 command family 傳入多餘的 argument 現在是 error，而不是安靜地印出 help。`dev wt bogus` 過去會印出 `dev wt` help 並 exit 0，因為 family 本身沒有 `Run`；現在每個 family node 都會回報未知 subcommand 並 exit 1，而單獨執行 family 仍會印出 help 並 exit 0。
534	 - Argument 數量與 flag 錯誤會印出該 command 的 usage block。該 block 是否上色仍由 `--color` 決定。
535	 - 每個 command family 的 help 都附上 ASCII orientation diagram 與 `See also: dev help <topic>` 指引，且 `dev help <command>` 會把 command 名稱或 alias 解析成對應 topic，因此 `dev help wt` 會連到 worktrees 頁面。
536	 - Semantic color 已覆蓋所有 human-readable 介面，包含 interactive dashboard：`dev --color never`、`NO_COLOR` 與 `TERM=dumb` 現在也會關閉 dashboard 的顏色，先前並不會。
537	 - `dev sweep` 會 reap repository 目錄已不存在的 task。這種 record 先前無法被 binary 中任何 command 觸及：`done`、`resume`、`park` 與 `retire` 都會先解析 repository，dead-branch 規則排除 direct mode，stale-worktree 規則又需要有記錄的 worktree path。若有 live runtime session 則不會提出此建議，且 reap 只移除 dev 的 intent record。
538	 - `dev sweep` 會回報 task 記錄中存在、但 Git 未註冊，且只包含 agent artifact 目錄的 checkout。只有在其中每個檔案都與 repository 既有檔案 byte-identical 時才提議移除；其餘一律回報為 salvage 工作，即使加上 `--apply` 也絕不移除。
539	 - `dev sweep` 會處理 worktree 仍在磁碟上的 cold task。Inventory 一直有為 `dev ls` 與 dashboard 計算這項 drift，但 sweep 從未讀取它，因此只能顯示、無法處理。
540	 - `dev retire <path>` 會 reap 對應的 task record。先前只有 by-task 形式會設定 task identity，因此以 path 退休同一個 checkout 會留下 record；DONE 狀態與 identity 檢查維持不變。
541	 - `dev version` 會回報目前執行的 build 是否為已發布的 release，`dev doctor` 也帶有同一行資訊。先前工具中沒有任何地方能回答「我是不是最新的？」，而 `go install ...@latest` 只會解析到最新的 tag，因此未 tag 的 feature 對安裝者而言等同不存在。
542	 - Release 會發布各平台 archive 與 `SHA256SUMS`，並以 `CHANGELOG.md` 對應段落作為 release notes。先前的 release 只產生 GitHub release 物件，因此那些版本本來就沒有附加檔案。

556	 # Sources and freshness
557	 
558	 This site mixes product documentation, external specifications, fast-moving harness behavior, project policy, and history. Every page identifies which kind of statement it contains and when it was checked.
559	 
560	 ## Authority order
561	 
562	 1. **dev-cli behavior:** repository code, tests, E2E, and generated command reference.
563	 2. **Git semantics:** current `git-scm.com` manuals for the relevant installed Git version.
564	 3. **GitHub collaboration:** current GitHub Docs.
565	 4. **Claude Code behavior:** current Anthropic documentation, with preview/experimental/version labels.
566	 5. **Standards:** named versioned specifications such as Conventional Commits 1.0.0 and SemVer 2.0.0.
567	 6. **Historical context:** dated archives and older project essays, never a current operating rule.
568	 7. **Project policy:** explicitly labeled recommendations; not presented as an upstream guarantee.
569	 
570	 A lower item may explain motivation but cannot override a higher authority's implementation claim.
571	 
572	 ## Required page metadata
573	 
574	 ```yaml
575	 ---
576	 description: One sentence used by navigation and llms.txt.
577	 authority: one value from the authority table below
578	 status: one value from the status table below
579	 verified_on: YYYY-MM-DD
580	 minimum_version: optional
581	 tested_with: optional
582	 ---
583	 ```
584	 
585	 | `authority` value | Meaning |
586	 |---|---|
587	 | `project` | code/test-defined dev-cli behavior |
588	 | `project-policy` | this project's recommendation |
589	 | `git-scm`, `github-docs`, `anthropic-docs` | one current upstream authority |
590	 | `git-and-project-policy`, `anthropic-docs-and-project-policy` | upstream semantics plus a labeled local recommendation |
591	 | `project-and-upstream` | compatibility page spanning implementation and upstream status |
592	 
593	 | `status` value | Meaning |
594	 |---|---|
595	 | `stable`, `maintained` | current project content with a maintenance expectation |
596	 | `evolving` | current behavior likely to change |
597	 | `official` | current upstream normative/documented behavior |
598	 | `research-preview-partial` | page includes a research-preview surface |
599	 | `experimental-and-versioned` | experimental feature with explicit version bounds |
600	 | `generated-plus-authored` | generated reference embedded in authored guidance |
601	 
602	 `verified_on` must be a real ISO date no later than the current UTC calendar date. English/zh-TW siblings must match on authority, status, date, minimum version, and tested version. Pages backed by Anthropic docs or preview/experimental status must carry `minimum_version` or `tested_with`. The docs checker enforces these rules, nav membership, and bilingual file parity.
603

632	 ## Historical sources
633	 
634	 - [`githubflow.github.io`](https://githubflow.github.io/) preserves the early “default branch is always deployable” model.
635	 - The [2019 Wayback snapshot](https://web.archive.org/web/20191104103724/https://guides.github.com/introduction/flow/) preserves an older deploy-before-merge guide.
636	 
637	 They disagree about deploy/merge order and use older `master` terminology. They are cited only in historical sections; the current GitHub Docs page owns present-day GitHub Flow claims.
638	 
639	 ## Adapted local material
640	 
641	 The local `agent-skills/skills/local/git-workflow/` collection informed topic discovery for branch hygiene, Conventional Commits, releases, and worktree recovery. Its content mixes upstream rules with house policy, contains known stale claims, and has no clear repository-level license grant. This site independently rewrites verified ideas and cites public upstream specifications instead of copying that skill.
642	 
643	 ## Refresh procedure
644	 
645	 When code or an upstream feature changes:
646	 
647	 1. Re-read the implementation/test or current official page.
648	 2. Update the English claim and its zh-TW sibling in the same change.
649	 3. Change `verified_on`, `tested_with`, status, and this matrix when applicable.
650	 4. Run the source checker and strict site build.
651	 5. Review any historical wording to ensure it did not become normative.
652	 6. Record unresolved uncertainty as a limitation instead of guessing.
653

681	 
682	 !!! note "術語規則"
683	     有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
684	 
685	 本站同時包含 product documentation、external specification、快速變動的 harness behavior、project policy 與 history。每頁都要標明 statement 類型與查核日期。
686	 
687	 ## Authority 順序
688	 
689	 1. **dev-cli behavior：**repository code、tests、E2E 與 generated command reference。
690	 2. **Git semantics：**符合 installed Git version 的現行 `git-scm.com` manual。
691	 3. **GitHub collaboration：**現行 GitHub Docs。
692	 4. **Claude Code behavior：**現行 Anthropic 文件，並標示 preview/experimental/version。
693	 5. **Standards：**具名且有版本的規格，例如 Conventional Commits 1.0.0、SemVer 2.0.0。
694	 6. **Historical context：**有日期的 archives 與舊 project essays，絕不當成 current operating rule。
695	 7. **Project policy：**明確標籤的建議，不冒充 upstream guarantee。
696	 
697	 較低層 authority 可解釋 motivation，但不能覆蓋較高層 implementation claim。

313	 
314	 Choose the lightest mode that preserves the boundary you need:
315	 
316	 ```bash
317	 # No task, no branch, no worktree: just open the canonical repo for ad-hoc work.

322	 
323	 # Use a short-lived branch in the canonical checkout, but no linked worktree.
324	 dev start api --task "small feature" --branch-only --base main

330	 Direct work can be parked WARM and resumed, but cannot go COLD because the
331	 canonical checkout cannot be removed. `dev done` on a clean direct task needs

333	 
334	 Start direct for one change stream, then create a normal worktree task later
335	 when real parallelism appears. A new worktree starts from committed HEAD; dirty
336	 main changes are deliberately not smuggled into it, so checkpoint first when

339	 ### Guarded Git transactions
340	 
341	 `dev git` wraps only operations that need durable receipts or failure recovery;
342	 it does not replace ordinary Git aliases:
343	 
344	 ```bash
345	 dev git uncommit              # soft reset; save old OID/message receipt
346	 dev git recommit              # commit -C the receipt, then clear it
347	 dev git pull-rebase           # exact stash OID + --index restore; never stash@{0}
348	 dev git amend-all             # add -A + amend --no-edit, with normal hooks
349	 dev git amend-all --exclude-agent-artifacts
350	 dev git setup --print         # print optional aliases; never edit config
351	 ```
352	 
353	 Published commit rewrites require `--rewrite-published`. `amend-all` includes
354	 agent artifacts by default only when a project scanner is present (or the user
355	 explicitly accepts `--allow-unscanned-artifacts`).
356	 
357	 For automation, `dev start … --json` emits one pure creation object with absolute
358	 paths and transient runtime facts. Only a newly created first-class Herdr
359	 worktree with a non-empty exact `root_pane_id` is a launch target; reuse,
360	 fallback, Tmux, none, or missing pane data fails closed. Worktree starts use the
361	 same `repo/branch` label as `dev wt create` and pins the Git-derived parent
362	 checkout with Herdr `--cwd`, preserving native nested repository/worktree

658	 ## Multiple machines
659	 
660	 Do not sync worktrees or runtime state. Sync branches, and let the remote be
661	 the handoff boundary:
662	 
663	 ```bash
664	 dev park --cold --push      # on the machine holding the work
665	 dev resume <task> --fetch   # on the machine picking it up
666	 ```
667	 
668	 `dev` records an owner host per task and refuses to resume someone else's
669	 without `--force`. Two machines committing to one branch is the reliable way
670	 to produce a conflict here; the ownership check prevents it.
671	 
672	 Configure SSH machines separately from host-local paths:
673	 
674	 ```toml
675	 # $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml
676	 schema_version = 1
677	 
678	 [defaults]
679	 connect_timeout = "15s"
680	 command_timeout = "5m"
681	 cache_ttl = "15m"
682	 max_parallel = 4
683	 dev_path = "auto"
684	 
685	 [[hosts]]
686	 name = "jingle"
687	 ssh_alias = "jingle-235"
688	 ```

691	 host-local. Missing `dev` installations are reported as `no-dev`; unreachable
692	 hosts can fall back to the last private XDG snapshot. Cache identity includes the

218	 g / G                top / bottom

226	 The `/` query applies to the current view and matches whitespace-separated
227	 terms independently. Structured local filters include `tag:important`,
228	 `remote:none`, `size:>1GiB`, `phase:deprecated` and `where:archived` where
229	 applicable. `gitlab auth` still finds a GitLab repo whose name/description also
230	 contains auth, regardless of word order.

384

409	 `$SHELL` in the selected row's checkout, so arguments, environment variables
410	 and executable scripts work. `interactive = true` runs through `$SHELL -lic`
411	 and deliberately evaluates the command *after* rc loading, so this machine's
412	 `vibe` alias and `claude-plans-here` function work. Prefer a real script on PATH
413	 when the binding should be portable to machines with different shell configs.
414	 The dashboard resolves availability in a bounded background load after the first
415	 view; rendering itself never launches the shell. Unknown or missing bindings are
416	 hidden and fail closed until the current config generation has been checked.
417	 
418	 Keys are case-sensitive. A tool cannot take one the dashboard owns; config
419	 loading reports the collision instead of silently shadowing movement or quit.
