```text
741	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
742		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
743		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
744	}
745	
746	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
747		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
748		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
749		if err != nil {
750			return nil, err
751		}
752		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
753		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
754		if !sessionsSet {
755			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
756		}
757		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
758		for _, item := range items {
759			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
760			if item.Entry != nil {
761				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
762					copy := location
763					row.Location = &copy
764				}
765			}
766			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
767			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
768				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
769					sizeRepo = &discovered
770				}
771			}
772			if sizeRepo != nil {
773				worktreeCount := 0
774				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
775					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
776				}
777				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
778			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
779				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
780			}
781			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
782				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
783			}
784			if item.Live.Present {
785				for _, session := range sessions {
786					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
787						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
788						row.Live = true
789						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
790						break
791					}
792				}
793			}
794			rows = append(rows, row)
795		}
796		return rows, listErr
797	}
798	
799	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
800		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
801		if err != nil {
802			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
803		}
804		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
805			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
806				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
807				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
808			})
809			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
810			return item, resolveErr
811		}
812		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
813			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
814				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
815			}
816			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
817			if openErr != nil {
818				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
819			}
820			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
821			if rt.Name() == "none" {
822				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
823			} else {
824				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
825				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
826			}
827			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
828				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
829			}
830			return result, nil
831		}
832	
833		switch request.Action {
834		case tui.TryOpen:
835			item, resolveErr := resolve()
836			if resolveErr != nil {
837				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
838			}
839			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
840	
841		case tui.TryCreate:
842			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
843				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
844			})
845			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
846			if created.InitWarning != nil {
847				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
848			}
849			if createErr != nil {
850				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
851			}
852			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
853			if created.Existing {
854				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
855			}
856			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
857			result.RefreshRepos = true
858			return result, openErr
859	
860		case tui.TryMark:
861			item, resolveErr := resolve()
862			if resolveErr != nil {
863				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
864			}
865			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
866			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
867			note := request.Note
868			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
869				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
870			})
871			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
872			return tui.TryActionResult{
873				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
874			}, patchErr
875	
876		case tui.TryDeprecate:
877			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
878			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
879			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
880	
881		case tui.TryReactivate:
882			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
883			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
884			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
885	
886		case tui.TryArchive:
887			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
888			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
889			return tui.TryActionResult{
890				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
891			}, transitionErr
892	
893		case tui.TryRestore:
894			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
895			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
896			return tui.TryActionResult{
897				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
898			}, transitionErr
899	
900		case tui.TryGraduate:
901			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
902				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
903			})
904			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
905			if graduateErr != nil {
906				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
907			}
908			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
909			result.RefreshRepos = true
910			return result, openErr
911		}
912		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
913	}
914	
915	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
916	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
917	type repoCollectOptions struct {
918		IncludeTries bool
919		Sessions     []runtime.Session
920		SessionsSet  bool
921		Tasks        []*task.Task
922		TasksSet     bool
923		Repos        []repo.Repo
924		ReposSet     bool
925		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
926	}
927	
928	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
929	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
930	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
931		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
932	}
933	
934	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
935		repos := options.Repos
936		var err error
937		if !options.ReposSet {
938			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
939			if err != nil {
940				return nil, err
941			}
942		}
943		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
944		if err != nil {
945			return nil, err
946		}
947		if !options.IncludeTries {
948			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
949			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
950			for index, repository := range repos {
951				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
952					continue
953				}
954				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
955				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
956			}
957			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
958		}
959		tasks := options.Tasks
960		if !options.TasksSet {
961			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
962			if err != nil {
963				return nil, err
964			}
965		}
966		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
967		for _, t := range tasks {
968			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
969		}
970		sessions := options.Sessions
971		if !options.SessionsSet {
972			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
973		}
974		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
975		if app.Notes != nil {
976			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
977			if noteErr != nil {
978				return nil, noteErr
979			}
980			for _, n := range allNotes {
981				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
982			}
983		}
984	
985		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
986		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
987		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
988		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
989		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
990		limiter := options.Limiter
991		if limiter == nil {
992			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
993		}
994		var wg sync.WaitGroup
995		for i, r := range repos {
996			wg.Add(1)
997			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
998				defer wg.Done()
999				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1000				if !ok {
1001					return
1002				}
1003				defer release()
1004	
1005				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1006				if row.Asset != nil {
1007					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1008					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1009					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1010						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1011					}
1012				}
1013				if r.HasGit {
1014					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1015				}
1016				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1017				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1018					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1019				}
1020				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1021				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1022				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1023				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1024					row.Status = main.Status
1025				}
1026				if !r.Bare {
1027					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1028				}
1029				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1030					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1031					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1032				}
1033				if r.HasGit {
1034					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1035						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1036						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1037					}, row.Worktrees)
1038				} else {
1039					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1040				}
1041				out[i] = row
1042			}(i, r)
1043		}
1044		wg.Wait()
1045		return out, ctx.Err()
1046	}
1047	
1048	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1049	//
1050	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1051	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1052	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1053	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1054		var out []tui.Tool
1055		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1056			run := t.Run
1057			name := t.Name
1058			if name == "" {
1059				name = firstWord(run)
1060			}
1061			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1062			if t.Interactive {
1063				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1064				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1065				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1066				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1067				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1068			}
1069			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1070				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1071				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1072			})
1073		}
1074		return out
1075	}
1076	
1077	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1078	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1079	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1080	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1081		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1082	}
1083	
1084	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1085		if ctx == nil {
1086			ctx = context.Background()
1087		}
1088		word := firstWord(run)
1089		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1090			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1091			if word == "" {
1092				return false
1093			}
1094			word = firstWord(word)
1095		}
1096		if word == "" {
1097			return false
1098		}
1099		if interactive {
1100			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1101			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1102			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1103			defer cancel()
1104			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1105				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1106			return probe.Run() == nil
1107		}
1108		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1109			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1110			return err == nil
1111		}
1112		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1113		return err == nil
1114	}
1115	
1116	func firstWord(s string) string {
1117		f := strings.Fields(s)
1118		if len(f) == 0 {
1119			return ""
1120		}
1121		return f[0]
1122	}
1123	
1124	func shellPath() string {
1125		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1126			return s
1127		}
1128		return "/bin/sh"
1129	}
1130	
1131	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1132	// of private repositories.
1133	func remoteCachePath() string {
1134		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1135	}
1136	
1137	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1138		parts := []string{
1139			"forge-source-v1",
1140			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1141			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1142			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1143		}
1144		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1145			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1146		}
1147		sort.Strings(parts)
1148		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1149		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1150	}
1151	
1152	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1153	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1154	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1155	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1156		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1157		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1158		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1159			return nil, false, false
1160		}
1161		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1162		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1163			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1164		}
1165		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1166	}
1167	
1168	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1169	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1170	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1171		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1172		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1173			return nil, false
1174		}
1175		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1176	}
1177	
1178	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1179		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1180		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1181		for _, r := range locals {
1182			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1183				continue
1184			}
1185			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1186			if ambiguous[key] {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1190				delete(byRemote, key)
1191				ambiguous[key] = true
1192				continue
1193			}
1194			byRemote[key] = r
1195		}
1196		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1197		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1198			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1199			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1200				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1201				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1202				if local.Asset != nil {
1203					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1204				}
1205			}
1206			out = append(out, row)
1207		}
1208		return out
1209	}
1210	
1211	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1212	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1213	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1214	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1215		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1216		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1217			return nil, false
1218		}
1219		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1220	}
1221	
1222	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1223		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1224		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1225			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1226		}
1227		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1228	}
1229	
1230	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1231	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1232	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1233	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1234		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1235		LocalsSet    bool
1236		Providers    []forge.Forge
1237		ProvidersSet bool
1238	}
1239	
1240	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1241		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1242	}
1243	
1244	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1245		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1246	}
1247	
1248	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1249		type result struct {
1250			kind  forge.Kind
1251			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1252			err   error
1253		}
1254		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1255		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1256			if options.LocalsSet {
1257				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1258			}
1259			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1260		}
1261		providers := options.Providers
1262		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1263			providers = configuredForges(app)
1264		}
1265		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1266		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1267		available := 0
1268		var unavailable []error
1269		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1270		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1271		for _, f := range providers {
1272			if !f.Available() {
1273				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1274				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1275				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1276					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1277					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1278					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1279				}
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1283			available++
1284			wg.Add(1)
1285			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1286				defer wg.Done()
1287				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1288				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1289			}(f)
1290		}
1291		wg.Wait()

1335					status.Complete = false
1336				}
1337				statuses[res.kind] = status

1341			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos

1367	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1368		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1369			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1370				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1371			}
1372			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1373		})
1374	}

1376	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1377		providers := forge.All()
1378		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1379			return providers
1380		}
1381		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1382		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1383			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{

1386			})

1391	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1392		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1393		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1394		if assetErr != nil {
1395			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1396			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1397		}
1398		type localMatch struct {
1399			repository repo.Repo
1400			asset      *catalog.Entry
1401		}
1402		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1403		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1404		for index, r := range locals {
1405			if r.Bare {
1406				continue
1407			}
1408			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1409			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1410				continue
1411			}
1412			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1413			if ambiguous[key] {
1414				continue
1415			}
1416			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1417				delete(localByRemote, key)
1418				ambiguous[key] = true
1419				continue
1420			}
1421			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1422		}
1423		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1424		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1425			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1426			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1427				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1428				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1429				if local.asset != nil {
1430					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1431				}
1432			}
1433			out = append(out, row)
1434		}
1435		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1436		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1437		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1438		return out
1439	}
1440	
1441	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1442		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1443			return
1444		}
1445		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1446		if err != nil {
1447			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1448			return
1449		}
1450		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1451			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1452		}
1453		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1454			return
1455		}
1456		host := config.Hostname()
1457		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1458		for _, entry := range entries {
1459			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1460			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1461				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1462				continue
1463			}
1464			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1465		}
1466		for index := range rows {
1467			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1468			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1469			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1470				continue
1471			}
1472			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1473			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1474			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1475			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1476		}
1477	}
1478	
1479	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1480		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1481			if candidate == "" {
1482				continue
1483			}
1484			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1485				return candidate
1486			}
1487		}
1488		return ""
1489	}
1490	
1491	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1492		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1493		if err != nil {
1494			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1495		}
1496		path := tmp.Name()
1497		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1498			_ = tmp.Close()
1499			_ = os.Remove(path)
1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1503			_ = os.Remove(path)
1504			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1505		}
1506		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1507		if err != nil {
1508			_ = os.Remove(path)
1509			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1510		}
1511		return tui.NoteEdit{
1512			Command: proc,
1513			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1514				if runErr != nil {
1515					_ = os.Remove(path)
1516					return runErr
1517				}
1518				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1519				if err != nil {
1520					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1521				}
1522				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1523					_ = os.Remove(path)
1524					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1525				}
1526				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1527				if err != nil {
1528					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1529				}
1530				_ = os.Remove(path)
1531				return nil
1532			},
1533		}, nil
1534	}
```

```text
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {

215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
```

```text
193	// checkout identity cannot drift between the two domains.
194	type Target = agenttarget.Target
195	
196	// Coverage states the fixed limits of this static inventory. It is product
197	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.
198	type Coverage struct {
199		Agents                 []Agent  `json:"agents"`
200		StaticDeclarationsOnly bool     `json:"static_declarations_only"`
201		OmittedSources         []string `json:"omitted_sources"`
202	}

205	type Result struct {

207		Diagnostics  []Diagnostic  `json:"diagnostics"`
208		Coverage     Coverage      `json:"coverage"`

211	func defaultCoverage() Coverage {
212		return Coverage{
213			Agents:                 []Agent{AgentClaudeCode, AgentCodex, AgentCursor, AgentGeminiCLI, AgentOpenCode},
214			StaticDeclarationsOnly: true,
215			OmittedSources: []string{
216				"runtime health and command-line-only configuration",
217				"plugin caches and hosted connectors",
218				"remote organization configuration",
219				"inline OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT",
220			},
221		}
222	}
223	
224	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
225	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
226	type Filter struct {
227		Agent          Agent
228		Scope          Scope
229		Source         DeclarationSource
230		Transport      Transport
231		Repository     string
232		NameContains   string
233		Enabled        *bool
234		HasCredentials *bool
235	}
236	
237	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
238	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
239		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
240			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
241			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
242			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
243			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
244			return false
245		}
246		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
247			return false
248		}
249		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
250			return false
251		}
252		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
253			return false
254		}
255		return true
256	}
257	
258	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
259	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
260		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
261		for _, row := range rows {
262			if f.Match(row) {
263				out = append(out, row)
264			}
265		}
266		return out
267	}
268	
269	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
270	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
271		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
272			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
273			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
274			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
275			for n := range ak {
276				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
277					return ak[n] < bk[n]
278				}
279			}
280			return false
281		})
282	}
283	
284	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
285		switch scope {
286		case ScopeProject:
287			return "0-project"
288		case ScopeLocal:
289			return "1-local"
290		case ScopeUser:
291			return "2-user"
292		case ScopeCustom:
293			return "3-custom"
294		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
295			return "4-system-defaults"
296		case ScopeSystemOverride:
297			return "5-system-override"
298		case ScopeManaged:
299			return "6-managed"
300		default:
301			return "9-" + string(scope)
302		}
303	}
304	
305	func diagnosticMessage(code DiagnosticCode) string {
306		switch code {
307		case DiagnosticUnreadable:
308			return "configuration file could not be read"
309		case DiagnosticTooLarge:
310			return "configuration file exceeds the scan size limit"
311		case DiagnosticNotRegular:
312			return "configuration source is not a regular file"
313		case DiagnosticSymlinkLimit:
314			return "configuration symlink chain exceeds the scan limit"
315		case DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape:
316			return "project configuration resolves outside the checkout"
317		case DiagnosticMalformed:
318			return "configuration file could not be decoded"
319		case DiagnosticControlCharacter:
320			return "configuration contains an unsupported control character"
321		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
322			return "server declaration has an invalid field"
323		case DiagnosticInvalidName:
324			return "server declaration has an invalid name"
325		case DiagnosticUnknownTransport:
326			return "server transport cannot be determined statically"
327		case DiagnosticConflictingTransport:
328			return "server declaration contains conflicting transport fields"
329		case DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint:
330			return "server endpoint could not be represented safely"
331		case DiagnosticInvalidReference:
332			return "credential reference name is invalid"
333		case DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent:
334			return "plugin override does not include the plugin server definition"
335		case DiagnosticTransportPrecedence:
336			return "lower-precedence transport fields were ignored"
337		default:
338			return "configuration could not be fully represented"
339		}
340	}
341	
342	func coverage(code DiagnosticCode) CoverageDiagnostic {
343		return CoverageDiagnostic{Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code)}
344	}
```

```text
14	func newMCPCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

17			Short: "Inspect static agent MCP server declarations",
18			Long: `Inventory MCP declarations without starting servers or contacting endpoints.
19	
20	MCP rows are static, scope-qualified configuration declarations. They do not
21	claim that a declaration is the effective merged config, connected, healthy, or
22	authenticated. Secret-bearing values are redacted before rows are returned.`,
23		}
24		cmd.AddCommand(newMCPListCmd(app))
25		return cmd
26	}

28	func newMCPListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
29		var (
30			all     bool
31			repoRef string
32			agents  []string
33			scopes  []string
34			jsonOut bool
35		)
36		cmd := &cobra.Command{
37			Use:   "list",
38			Short: "List configured MCP server declarations",
39			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
40			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
41				if all && repoRef != "" {
42					return fmt.Errorf("choose at most one of --all or --repo")
43				}
44				agentFilter, err := parseMCPAgents(agents)
45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				scopeFilter, err := parseMCPScopes(scopes)
49				if err != nil {
50					return err
51				}
52				project := len(scopeFilter) == 0 || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeProject] || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeLocal]
53				if !project && (all || repoRef != "") {
54					return fmt.Errorf("--all and --repo require project or local scope")
55				}
56				cwd, err := os.Getwd()

58					return err

61				if err != nil {
62					return err
63				}
64				result, err := agentmcp.Scan(cmd.Context(), targets)
65				if err != nil {
66					return err
67				}
68				result.Declarations = filterMCPDeclarations(result.Declarations, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
69				result.Diagnostics = filterMCPDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
70				if jsonOut {
71					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
72					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")

91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {

127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil

133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}

148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered

155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}
```

```text
46	func scanProjectScope(ctx context.Context, target agenttarget.Target, definitions []AgentDefinition) ([]Skill, []Diagnostic) {
47		root := target.CheckoutRoot
48		document := readProjectLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
49		locations := projectScanLocations(root, definitions, document)
50		return scanScope(ctx, ScopeProject, root, target, locations, document)

54		home := homeDirectory()

56		locations := globalScanLocations(definitions)
57		return scanScope(ctx, ScopeGlobal, home, agenttarget.Target{}, locations, document)
58	}

60	func projectScanLocations(root string, definitions []AgentDefinition, document lockDocument) []physicalScanLocation {
61		logical := make([]logicalScanLocation, 0, len(definitions))
62		for _, definition := range definitions {
63			if definition.ProjectSkillsDir == "" {
64				continue
65			}
66			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
67				Path: filepath.Join(root, definition.ProjectSkillsDir), AgentIDs: []string{definition.ID},
68			})
69		}
70		subagents := map[string]bool{}
71		for _, entry := range document.Entries {
72			for _, subagent := range entry.Subagents {
73				if safePathComponent(subagent) {
74					subagents[subagent] = true
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		subagentRoot := filepath.Join(root, "agent", "subagents")
79		if entries, err := os.ReadDir(subagentRoot); err == nil {
80			for _, entry := range entries {
81				if !safePathComponent(entry.Name()) {
82					continue
83				}
84				if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(subagentRoot, entry.Name())); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
85					subagents[entry.Name()] = true
86				}
87			}
88		}
89		for subagent := range subagents {
90			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
91				Path:     filepath.Join(subagentRoot, subagent, "skills"),
92				AgentIDs: []string{"eve"},
93			})
94		}
95		return dedupeScanLocations(logical)
96	}

98	func safePathComponent(value string) bool {
99		return pathx.ValidateComponent(value) == nil && safeDisplayValue(value)

102	func globalScanLocations(definitions []AgentDefinition) []physicalScanLocation {
103		logical := make([]logicalScanLocation, 0, len(definitions)+1)
104		var sharedAgentIDs []string
105		for _, definition := range definitions {
106			if definition.ProjectSkillsDir == filepath.Join(".agents", "skills") {
107				sharedAgentIDs = append(sharedAgentIDs, definition.ID)
108			}
109			if definition.GlobalSkillsDir == "" {
110				continue
111			}
112			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
113				Path: definition.GlobalSkillsDir, AgentIDs: []string{definition.ID},
114			})
115		}
116		if home := homeDirectory(); home != "" {
117			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
118				Path: filepath.Join(home, ".agents", "skills"), AgentIDs: uniqueSorted(sharedAgentIDs),
119			})
120		}
121		return dedupeScanLocations(logical)
122	}

124	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
125	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
126	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
127	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
128		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
129		for _, location := range input {
130			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
131			current := byLogical[path]
132			if current == nil {
133				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
134				byLogical[path] = &copy
135				current = &copy
136			}
137			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
138		}
139		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
140		for path := range byLogical {
141			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
142		}
143		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
144	
145		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
146		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
147			logical := *byLogical[path]
148			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)
149			physical := path
150			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
151				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
152			}
153			group := byPhysical[physical]
154			if group == nil {
155				group = &physicalScanLocation{Path: physical}
156				byPhysical[physical] = group
157			}
158			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
159		}
160		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
161		for path := range byPhysical {
162			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
163		}
164		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
165		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
166		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
167			group := byPhysical[path]
168			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
169			result = append(result, *group)
170		}
171		return result
172	}
173	
174	func scanScope(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, locations []physicalScanLocation, document lockDocument) ([]Skill, []Diagnostic) {
175		diagnostics := decorateDiagnostics(document.Diagnostics, target)
176		var scanned []scannedSkill
177		for _, location := range locations {
178			if ctx.Err() != nil {
179				break
180			}
181			found, foundDiagnostics := scanLocation(ctx, scope, target, location)
182			scanned = append(scanned, found...)
183			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, foundDiagnostics...)
184		}
185	
186		groups := map[string]*skillAggregate{}
187		normalizedInstalled := map[string][]string{}
188		for _, found := range scanned {
189			group := groups[found.Name]
190			if group == nil {
191				group = &skillAggregate{Installations: map[string]*Installation{}}
192				groups[found.Name] = group
193			}
194			group.Names = append(group.Names, found.Name)
195			normalized := normalizedName(found.Name)
196			normalizedInstalled[normalized] = append(normalizedInstalled[normalized], found.Name)
197			physical := found.Installation.RealPath
198			installation := group.Installations[physical]
199			if installation == nil {
200				copy := found.Installation
201				group.Installations[physical] = &copy
202				installation = &copy
203			} else {
204				installation.LogicalPaths = append(installation.LogicalPaths, found.Installation.LogicalPaths...)
205				installation.AgentIDs = append(installation.AgentIDs, found.Installation.AgentIDs...)
206			}
207			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
208			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
209			if len(installation.LogicalPaths) > 0 {
210				installation.Path = installation.LogicalPaths[0]
211			}
212			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
213		}
214	
215		for normalized, names := range normalizedInstalled {
216			names = uniqueSorted(names)
217			normalizedInstalled[normalized] = names
218			if len(names) > 1 {
219				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
220					Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: scope, Name: normalized,
221					Message: fmt.Sprintf("installed skill names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized),
222				}, target))
223			}
224		}
225		exactNames := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
226		for name := range groups {
227			exactNames = append(exactNames, name)
228		}
229		sort.Strings(exactNames)
230		consumedLocks := map[string]bool{}
231		rows := make([]Skill, 0, len(groups)+len(document.Entries))
232		for _, name := range exactNames {
233			group := groups[name]
234			normalized := normalizedName(name)
235			var lock LockMetadata
236			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
237			matched := false
238			if exact, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
239				lock, matched = exact, true
240			} else if len(normalizedInstalled[normalized]) == 1 && len(candidates) == 1 {
241				lock, matched = candidates[0], true
242			}
243			if matched {
244				consumedLocks[normalized] = true
245			}
246			rows = append(rows, buildPresentRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, name, group, lock, candidates, matched))
247		}
248	
249		lockGroups := document.namesByNormalized()
250		lockNormalized := make([]string, 0, len(lockGroups))
251		for normalized := range lockGroups {
252			lockNormalized = append(lockNormalized, normalized)
253		}
254		sort.Strings(lockNormalized)
255		for _, normalized := range lockNormalized {
256			if consumedLocks[normalized] {
257				continue
258			}
259			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
260			if len(candidates) == 0 {
261				continue
262			}
263			selected := candidates[0]
264			rows = append(rows, buildMissingRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, selected, candidates))
265		}
266		return rows, diagnostics
267	}
268	
269	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {
270		entries, err := os.ReadDir(location.Path)
271		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
272			return nil, nil
273		}
274		if err != nil {
275			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
276				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
277				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),
278			}, target)}
279		}
280		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
281	
282		var skills []scannedSkill
283		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
284		for _, entry := range entries {
285			if ctx.Err() != nil {
286				break
287			}
288			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
289			info, err := os.Stat(child)
290			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
291				continue
292			}
293			if err != nil {
294				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
295					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
296					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
297				}, target))
298				continue
299			}
300			if !info.IsDir() {
301				continue
302			}
303			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
304			if !present {
305				continue
306			}
307			if err != nil {
308				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
309					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
310					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),
311				}, target))
312				continue
313			}
314			physical := child
315			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
316				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
317			}
318			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
319			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
320				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
321				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
322			}
323			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)
324			agentIDs = uniqueSorted(agentIDs)
325			installation := Installation{
326				RealPath: physical, LogicalPaths: logicalPaths, AgentIDs: agentIDs,
327				Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs), Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
328			}
329			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
330				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
331			}
332			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
333		}
334		return skills, diagnostics
335	}
336	
337	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
338		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
339		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340			return "", false, nil
341		}
342		if err != nil {
343			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not inspect SKILL.md: %w", err)
344		}
345		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
346			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
347		}
348		file, err := os.Open(filename)
349		if err != nil {
350			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
351		}
352		defer file.Close()
353		if openedInfo, err := file.Stat(); err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
354			return "", true, errors.New("opened SKILL.md is not a regular file")
355		}
356	
357		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
358		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
359		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
360		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
361		consumed := int64(len(first))
362		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
363			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
364		}
365		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
366		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
367			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
368		}
369		var frontmatter strings.Builder
370		closed := false
371		for {
372			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
373			consumed += int64(len(line))
374			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
375				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376			}
377			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
378				closed = true
379				break
380			}
381			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
382			if lineErr != nil {
383				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
384					break
385				}
386				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
387			}
388		}
389		if !closed {
390			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
391		}
392		var metadata struct {
393			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
394			Description string `yaml:"description"`
395		}
396		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
397			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
398		}
399		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
400		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
401		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
402			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
403		}
404		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
405			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
406		}
407		return metadata.Name, true, nil
408	}

410	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
411		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))
412		for _, installation := range group.Installations {
413			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
414			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
415			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
416			installations = append(installations, *installation)
417		}
418		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
419			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
420				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
421			}
422			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
423		})
424		var agents []string
425		for _, installation := range installations {
426			agents = append(agents, installation.AgentIDs...)
427		}
428		agentIDs := uniqueSorted(agents)
429		agents = agentDisplayNames(agentIDs)
430		row := Skill{
431			Name: name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot,
432			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
433			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
434			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
435			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
436			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,
437			UpdateDetail: "not tracked by the skills CLI",
438		}
439		if len(installations) > 0 {
440			row.Path = installations[0].Path
441		}
442		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
443			if name == skill.Name {
444				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
445				row.Source = "dev binary"
446				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
447				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
448			} else {
449				row.UpdateDetail = "name is reserved for the binary-managed dev-cli skill"
450			}
451			return row
452		}
453		if matched {
454			copy := lock
455			row.Lock = &copy
456			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills
457			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnchecked
458			row.UpdateDetail = ""
459			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)
460			row.SourceType = safeSourceType(lock.SourceType)
461			return row
462		}
463		if len(candidates) > 1 {
464			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
465		}
466		return row
467	}

497	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
498		files, err := skill.Files()
499		if err != nil {
500			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
501			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
502			return
503		}
504		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
505		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
506		for index := range row.Installations {
507			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
508			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
509			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
510			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
511				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
512				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
513			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
514				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
515				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
516			}
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
521		for relative, want := range files {
522			got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
523			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
524				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
525			}
526		}
527		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
528	}

530	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
531	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
532	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
533		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
534			return UpdateCurrent, detail
535		}
536		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
537			return UpdateAvailable, detail
538		}
539		return UpdateFailed, detail
540	}

542	func sourceDisplay(value string) string {
543		if value == "" {
544			return ""
545		}
546		if !safeDisplayValue(value) {
547			return "[redacted]"
548		}
549		value = repo.RedactCloneRef(value)
550		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
551		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
552			parsed.User = nil
553			parsed.RawQuery = ""
554			parsed.ForceQuery = false
555			parsed.Fragment = ""
556			return parsed.String()
557		}
558		return value
559	}
560	
561	func safeSourceType(value string) string {
562		if value == "" || safeDisplayValue(value) {
563			return value
564		}
565		return "[redacted]"
566	}
```

```text
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
```

```text
35			}

41		plugins := tableValue(document["plugins"])

81	func convertCodexServer(row *Declaration, server map[string]any) {
82		command, _ := stringField(server, "command")
83		url, _ := stringField(server, "url")
84		setCommand(row, command)
85		inspectArguments(row, stringSlice(server["args"]))
86		inspectEnvironment(row, stringMap(server["env"]))
87		inspectCodexEnvVars(row, server["env_vars"])
88		setEndpoint(row, url)
89		inspectHeaders(row, stringMap(server["http_headers"]))
90		inspectEnvironmentHeaders(row, stringMap(server["env_http_headers"]))
91		if helper, ok := stringField(server, "http_headers_helper"); ok {
92			inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(helper) != "")
93		}
94		if bearer, ok := stringField(server, "bearer_token_env_var"); ok {
95			inspectBearerEnvironment(row, bearer)
96		}
97		if enabled, ok := boolField(server, "enabled"); ok {
98			row.Enabled = &enabled
99		}
100		if required, ok := boolField(server, "required"); ok {
101			row.Required = &required
102		}
103		applyCodexPolicy(row, server)
104	
105		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(command) != ""
106		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(url) != ""
107		if hasCommand && hasURL {
108			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
109		}
110		switch {
111		case hasURL:
112			row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
113		case hasCommand:
114			row.Transport = TransportStdio
115		default:
116			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
117		}
118	
119		if auth, ok := stringField(server, "auth"); ok && auth != "" {
120			switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)) {
121			case "oauth", "chatgpt":
122				addPolicy(row, PolicyAuthentication, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(auth)), 0)
123			default:
124				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
125			}
126		}
127		if oauth := tableValue(server["oauth"]); len(oauth) > 0 {
128			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
129			for _, field := range []string{"client_id", "callback_url", "callback_port"} {
130				if value, ok := scalarString(oauth[field]); ok {
131					inspectOAuthValue(row, strings.ReplaceAll(field, "_", "-"), value)
132				}
133			}
134		}
135	}
136	
137	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {
138		if enabled, ok := boolField(values, "enabled"); ok {
139			row.Enabled = &enabled
140			if row.Source == SourcePlugin {
141				addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyPluginEnabled, enabled)
142			}
143		}
144		if tools := stringSlice(values["enabled_tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
145			addPolicy(row, PolicyEnabledTools, "", len(tools))
146		}
147		if tools := stringSlice(values["disabled_tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
148			addPolicy(row, PolicyDisabledTools, "", len(tools))
149		}
150		if mode, ok := stringField(values, "default_tools_approval_mode"); ok && mode != "" {
151			mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mode))
152			switch mode {
153			case "auto", "prompt", "writes", "approve":
154				addPolicy(row, PolicyApprovalMode, mode, 0)
155			default:
156				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157			}
158		}
159		if tools := tableValue(values["tools"]); len(tools) > 0 {
160			addPolicy(row, PolicyApprovalMode, "per-tool", len(tools))
161		}
162	}

164	func inspectCodexEnvVars(row *Declaration, value any) {
165		items, ok := value.([]map[string]any)
166		if ok {
167			for _, item := range items {
168				if name, ok := stringField(item, "name"); ok && validEnvironmentName(name) {
169					addCredential(row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialEnvironmentReference, Name: name})
170				} else {
171					addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
172				}
173			}
174			return
175		}
176		for _, name := range stringSlice(value) {
177			if validEnvironmentName(name) {
178				addCredential(row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialEnvironmentReference, Name: name})
179			} else {
180				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidReference)
181			}
182		}
183	}

185	func tableValue(value any) map[string]any {
186		if table, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
187			return table
188		}
189		return nil
190	}
191	
192	func sortedTableKeys(table map[string]any) []string {
193		keys := make([]string, 0, len(table))
194		for key := range table {
195			keys = append(keys, key)
196		}
197		sort.Strings(keys)
198		return keys
199	}
200	
201	func stringField(table map[string]any, key string) (string, bool) {
202		value, ok := table[key].(string)
203		return value, ok
204	}
205	
206	func boolField(table map[string]any, key string) (bool, bool) {
207		value, ok := table[key].(bool)
208		return value, ok
209	}
210	
211	func scalarString(value any) (string, bool) {
212		switch value := value.(type) {
213		case string:
214			return value, true
215		case int64:
216			return "configured", true
217		default:
218			return "", false
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func stringSlice(value any) []string {
223		switch values := value.(type) {
224		case []string:
225			return append([]string(nil), values...)
226		case []any:
227			out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
228			for _, value := range values {
229				if text, ok := value.(string); ok {
230					out = append(out, text)
231				}
232			}
233			return out
234		default:
235			return nil
236		}
237	}
238	
239	func stringMap(value any) map[string]string {
240		table := tableValue(value)
241		if len(table) == 0 {
242			return nil
243		}
244		out := make(map[string]string, len(table))
245		for key, value := range table {
246			if text, ok := value.(string); ok {
247				out[key] = text
248			}
249		}
250		return out
251	}
```

```text
31	func parseOpenCode(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
32		standard, err := hujson.Standardize(data)
33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument
37		if code := decodeJSON(standard, &document); code != "" {
38			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
39		}
40		var rows []Declaration
41		var codes []DiagnosticCode
42		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCP) {
43			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			var server openCodeServer
49			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCP[rawName], &server); code != "" {
50				codes = append(codes, code)
51				continue
52			}
53			convertOpenCodeServer(&row, server)
54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}
57		return rows, codes
58	}
59	
60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}

78	func convertOpenCodeServer(row *Declaration, server openCodeServer) {
79		row.Enabled = copyBool(server.Enabled)
80		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Environment)
81		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
82	
83		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {
87		case "local":
88			row.Transport = TransportLocal
89			if hasCommand {
90				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
91				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
92			} else {
93				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
94			}
95			if hasURL {
96				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {
114				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {
118				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
119			}
120		}
121		convertOpenCodeOAuth(row, server.OAuth)
122	}
123	
124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}
133		var oauth openCodeOAuth
134		if code := decodeJSON(raw, &oauth); code != "" {
135			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
136			return
137		}
138		addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)
141		inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", oauth.Scope)
142	}
```

```text
987	// visibleTasks applies the state filter and the text query.
988	func (m Model) visibleTasks() []inventory.Row {
989		var out []inventory.Row
990		for _, r := range m.rows {
991			if len(m.states) > 0 {
992				if !containsState(m.states, r.Task.State) {
993					continue
994				}
995			} else if r.Task.State == task.Done && !m.showDone {
996				continue
997			}
998			if !matches(taskSearchText(r), m.filter) {
999				continue
1000			}
1001			out = append(out, r)
1002		}
1003		return out
1004	}
1005	
1006	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
1007	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
1008	// for, not alphabetical order.
1009	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1010		var out []RepoRow
1011		for _, r := range m.repos {
1012			if r.IsTry() || !r.matches(m.filter) {
1013				continue
1014			}
1015			out = append(out, r)
1016		}
1017		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1018		if sortBy == "" {
1019			sortBy = "activity"
1020		}
1021		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1022			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1023			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1024				return cmp > 0
1025			}
1026			return cmp < 0
1027		})
1028		return out
1029	}

1043		}
1044		sortTryRows(out, sortBy, m.tryReverse)

1048	type repoItem struct {
1049		Repo          RepoRow
1050		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
1051	}
1052	
1053	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
1054	
1055	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
1056		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
1057			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1058		}
1059		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
1060	}
1061	
1062	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1063	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1064	// from the repository they belong to.
1065	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1066		repos := m.visibleRepos()
1067		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
1068		for _, r := range repos {
1069			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
1070			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1071				continue
1072			}
1073			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
1074				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1075			}
1076		}
1077		return out
1078	}

1165	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1166	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1167	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1168	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1169	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1170		if row.Task == nil {
1171			return ""
1172		}
1173		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1174			return "dev sweep"
1175		}
1176		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1177			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1178		}
1179		return ""
1180	}
1181	
1182	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1183		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1184		if command == "" {
1185			return nil
1186		}
1187		switch {
1188		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1189			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1190		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1191			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1192		default:
1193			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1194		}
1195	}

1207	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1208		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1209		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {

1211			if structured {
1212				switch key {
1213				case "scope":
1214					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1215						return false
1216					}
1217					continue
1218				case "agent":
1219					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1220					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1221						return false
1222					}
1223					continue
1224				case "update":
1225					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1226						return false
1227					}
1228					continue
1229				case "repo":
1230					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1231						return false
1232					}
1233					continue
1234				case "presence":
1235					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1236						return false
1237					}
1238					continue
1239				case "integrity":
1240					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1241						return false
1242					}
1243					continue
1244				}
1245			}
1246			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1247				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1248				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1249				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1250				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1251			}, " "))
1252			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1253				return false
1254			}
1255		}
1256		return true
1257	}
```

```text
315			t.Fatalf("Claude user source reads = %d", counts[filepath.Join(home, ".claude.json")])

317		filtered := FilterDeclarations(result.Declarations, Filter{Agent: AgentCursor, Repository: "group/second"})
```

```text
14	func TestSkillUpdateConfirmationPinsSelectedRepositoryRow(t *testing.T) {
15		firstLock := &agentskill.LockMetadata{Name: "shared", SourceType: "github", SkillPath: "skills/shared/SKILL.md"}
16		secondLock := &agentskill.LockMetadata{Name: "shared", SourceType: "github", SkillPath: "skills/shared/SKILL.md"}
17		first := agentskill.Skill{Name: "shared", Scope: agentskill.ScopeProject, Checkout: "/repo/a", ManagedBy: agentskill.ManagedBySkills, Lock: firstLock}
18		second := agentskill.Skill{Name: "shared", Scope: agentskill.ScopeProject, Checkout: "/repo/b", ManagedBy: agentskill.ManagedBySkills, Lock: secondLock}
19		var selected agentskill.Skill
20		actions := Actions{UpdateSkill: func(row agentskill.Skill) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
21			selected = row
22			return exec.Command("true"), nil
23		}}
24		model := New(actions, nil, nil)
25		model.view = ViewSkills
26		model.skills = []agentskill.Skill{first, second}
27		model.skillCursor = 1
28		model.seedViewSnapshot(ViewSkills, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
29	
30		next, _ := model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune{'u'}})
31		model = next.(Model)
32		// A concurrent refresh changes the cursor's row after confirmation opened.
33		model.skills = []agentskill.Skill{first}
34		if command := model.submit(modeConfirmSkillUpdate, ""); command == nil {
35			t.Fatal("confirmation produced no update command")
36		}
37		if selected.Checkout != second.Checkout {
38			t.Fatalf("confirmation updated checkout %q, want pinned %q", selected.Checkout, second.Checkout)
39		}
40	}
```

1	# Agent skill and MCP inventory
2	
3	Use these inventories to answer two different questions:
4	
5	- `dev skill list`: which reusable instruction packages are present, and whether
6	  an explicit upstream source check reports newer lock-recorded content.
7	- `dev mcp list`: which external MCP capabilities are declared in supported
8	  static agent configuration files.
9	
10	Do not treat an MCP declaration as a skill, a live connection, or permission to
11	invoke tools.
12	
13	## Skill inventory
14	
15	```bash
16	dev skill list
17	dev skill list --repo <repo-or-checkout> --project
18	dev skill list --all
19	dev skill list --all --check --json
20	```
21	
22	Reads use a versioned snapshot of all 77 agent paths from `skills@1.5.23` plus
23	project/global locks. They never execute `skills`, Node, npm, `npx`, agent
24	detectors, or project code. `--all` scans canonical repositories; the TUI also
25	adds its startup linked checkout when distinct and scans global paths once.
26	
27	Keep status dimensions separate:
28	
29	- presence: local directory present or lock-only/missing;
30	- integrity: only embedded `dev-cli` files can be verified against the binary; additional user files are ignored;
31	- update: lock-recorded upstream content is unchecked/current/changed/missing or
32	  unverifiable.
33	
34	`--check` is the explicit network action. It groups equal Git source/ref pairs
35	and does not write installed skills or locks. `skill add` and `skill update` are
36	explicit mutations and require a directly installed `skills` executable; `dev`
37	never resolves a provider through repository-local npm bins.
38	
39	## MCP inventory
40	
41	```bash
42	dev mcp list
43	dev mcp list --repo <repo-or-checkout>
44	dev mcp list --all --json
45	dev mcp list --agent claude-code,codex --scope project
46	```
47	
48	Adapters cover Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. Rows remain
49	scope-qualified declarations; `dev` does not guess effective precedence across
50	files. `configured`, `enabled`, and `disabled` are declaration facts, not health.
51	
52	The scanner never runs agent MCP commands, configured commands/helpers, servers,
53	or URLs. It never expands environment variables, reads OAuth/token stores, or
54	loads OpenCode `{file:…}` content. Normalized output retains only safe command
55	basenames, endpoint scheme/host, argument counts, credential reference names,
56	policy counts, and redaction markers.
57	
58	Omitted sources include plugin caches, hosted connectors, remote organization
59	configuration, inline `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`, and command-line-only inputs.
60	Treat the coverage metadata as part of the result.
61

OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR is specifically mentioned as a way to point to a custom directory that will be searched for .opencode-style subdirectories. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))

```text
`OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` is an environment variable for selecting a separate configuration directory:

> “Specify a custom config directory using the `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable.”

That directory is described as a resource directory, not as another location for the main JSON configuration:

> “This directory will be searched for agents, commands, modes, and plugins just like the standard `.opencode` directory”

The documentation does **not** state that an `opencode.json` or `opencode.jsonc` placed inside `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` is loaded as the main config file. Use `OPENCODE_CONFIG` when specifying a custom config-file path.

Configuration sources are combined rather than replaced:

> “Configuration files are merged together, not replaced.”

The documented priority, from lowest to highest, is: remote organizational settings; the global file; `OPENCODE_CONFIG`; the project file; project `.opencode` resources; inline `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`; managed files; and macOS MDM preferences. Later sources win when keys conflict.

A project `.opencode` directory is loaded after the project’s `opencode.json` and supplies resources such as agents, commands, modes, plugins, skills, tools, and themes. Its subdirectories conventionally use plural names, while singular names remain supported for compatibility.
```
