329	func (s *Scanner) hostSources() []sourceSpec {
330		var sources []sourceSpec
331		add := func(spec sourceSpec) {
332			if strings.TrimSpace(spec.path) == "" {
333				return
334			}
335			if !filepath.IsAbs(spec.path) {
336				spec.path = filepath.Join(s.options.WorkingDirectory, spec.path)
337			}
338			spec.path = filepath.Clean(spec.path)
339			sources = append(sources, spec)
340		}
341		if s.options.HomeDir != "" {
342			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentClaudeCode, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.HomeDir, ".claude.json"), adapter: adapterClaudeUser})
343			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentCursor, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.HomeDir, ".cursor", "mcp.json"), adapter: adapterCursor})
344		}
345		add(sourceSpec{
346			agent: AgentClaudeCode, scope: ScopeManaged, source: SourceManaged,
347			path: s.options.ClaudeManagedConfigPath, adapter: adapterClaudeProject,
348		})
349		if s.options.CodexHome != "" {
350			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentCodex, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.CodexHome, "config.toml"), adapter: adapterCodex})
351		}
352		if s.options.GeminiCLIHome != "" {
353			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentGeminiCLI, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.GeminiCLIHome, ".gemini", "settings.json"), adapter: adapterGemini})
354		}
355		if s.options.XDGConfigHome != "" {
356			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentOpenCode, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.XDGConfigHome, "opencode", "opencode.json"), adapter: adapterOpenCode})
357			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentOpenCode, scope: ScopeUser, source: SourceDirect, path: filepath.Join(s.options.XDGConfigHome, "opencode", "opencode.jsonc"), adapter: adapterOpenCode})
358		}
359		add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentOpenCode, scope: ScopeCustom, source: SourceDirect, path: s.options.OpenCodeConfigPath, adapter: adapterOpenCode})
360		for _, name := range []string{"opencode.json", "opencode.jsonc"} {
361			if s.options.OpenCodeConfigDir != "" {
362				add(sourceSpec{
363					agent: AgentOpenCode, scope: ScopeCustom, source: SourceDirect,
364					path: filepath.Join(s.options.OpenCodeConfigDir, name), adapter: adapterOpenCode,
365				})
366			}
367		}
368		add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentGeminiCLI, scope: ScopeSystemDefaults, source: SourceManaged, path: s.options.GeminiSystemDefaultsPath, adapter: adapterGemini})
369		add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentGeminiCLI, scope: ScopeSystemOverride, source: SourceManaged, path: s.options.GeminiSystemSettingsPath, adapter: adapterGemini})
370		for _, path := range s.options.OpenCodeManagedConfigPaths {
371			adapter := adapterOpenCode
372			if strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(path), ".plist") {
373				adapter = adapterOpenCodePlist
374			}
375			add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentOpenCode, scope: ScopeManaged, source: SourceManaged, path: path, adapter: adapter})
376		}

380	func projectSources(target Target) []sourceSpec {
381		base := sourceSpec{
382			scope: ScopeProject, source: SourceDirect, repository: target.RepoDisplay,
383			repositoryPath: target.RepoPath, checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, projectRoot: target.CheckoutRoot,
384		}
385		makeSpec := func(agent Agent, relative string, adapter adapterKind) sourceSpec {
386			spec := base
387			spec.agent = agent
388			spec.path = filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
389			spec.adapter = adapter
390			return spec
391		}
392		claude := makeSpec(AgentClaudeCode, ".mcp.json", adapterClaudeProject)
393		claude.approvalPaths = []string{
394			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.json"),
395			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.local.json"),
396		}
397		return []sourceSpec{
398			claude,
399			makeSpec(AgentCodex, ".codex/config.toml", adapterCodex),
400			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
401			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
402			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
403			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
404			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
405			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
406		}
407	}

409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}

135	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
136		var rows []Declaration
137		var codes []DiagnosticCode
138		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {
139			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
140			if !ok {
141				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
142				continue
143			}
144			var server claudeServer
145			if code := decodeJSON(raw[rawName], &server); code != "" {
146				codes = append(codes, code)
147				continue
148			}
149			convertClaudeServer(&row, server)
150			if state != nil {
151				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
152				switch {
153				case enabled && disabled:
154					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
155					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
156					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
157				case enabled:
158					value := true
159					row.Enabled = &value
160					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
161				case disabled:
162					value := false
163					row.Enabled = &value
164					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
165				}
166			}
167			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
168			rows = append(rows, row)
169		}
170		return rows, codes
171	}

173	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
174		setCommand(row, server.Command)
175		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
176		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
177		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
178		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
179		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
180		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
181			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
182		}
183		if server.OAuth != nil {
184			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
185			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
186			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
187			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
188		}
189	
190		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
191		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
192		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
193		if hasCommand && hasURL {
194			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
195		}
196		switch typeName {
197		case "stdio":
198			if hasCommand {
199				row.Transport = TransportStdio
200			}
201		case "http", "streamable-http":
202			if hasURL {
203				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
204			}
205		case "sse":
206			if hasURL {
207				row.Transport = TransportSSE
208			}
209		case "ws", "websocket":
210			if hasURL {
211				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
212			}
213		case "":
214			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
215				row.Transport = TransportStdio
216			}
217		}
218		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
220		}
221	}

223	func normalizeNameSet(names []string) map[string]bool {
224		set := map[string]bool{}
225		for _, name := range names {
226			if normalized, ok := normalizedName(name); ok {
227				set[normalized] = true
228			}
229		}
230		return set
231	}

233	func sortedRawNames(values map[string]json.RawMessage) []string {
234		names := make([]string, 0, len(values))
235		for name := range values {
236			names = append(names, name)
237		}
238		sort.Strings(names)
239		return names
240	}

242	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
243		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
244			return Target{}, false
245		}
246		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
247		if err != nil {
248			return Target{}, false
249		}
250		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
251		candidateReal := candidate
252		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate); err == nil {
253			candidateReal = resolved
254		}
255		for _, target := range targets {
256			if candidate == target.CheckoutRoot {
257				return target, true
258			}
259			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate); err == nil && inside {
260				return target, true
261			}
262			targetReal := target.CheckoutRoot
263			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target.CheckoutRoot); err == nil {
264				targetReal = resolved
265			}
266			if candidateReal == targetReal {
267				return target, true
268			}
269		}
270		return Target{}, false
271	}
272	
273	func copyBool(value *bool) *bool {
274		if value == nil {
275			return nil
276		}
277		copy := *value
278		return &copy
279	}

1	// Package agentmcp inventories static MCP server declarations without loading
2	// credentials, starting servers, running helpers, or contacting endpoints.

4	
5	import (
6		"sort"
7		"strings"
8	
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// Agent identifies one supported agent configuration format.
13	type Agent string
14	
15	const (
16		AgentClaudeCode Agent = "claude-code"
17		AgentCodex      Agent = "codex"
18		AgentCursor     Agent = "cursor"
19		AgentGeminiCLI  Agent = "gemini-cli"
20		AgentOpenCode   Agent = "opencode"
21	)
22	
23	// Scope is the declaration layer in which a server was found. Layers are kept
24	// separate deliberately; this package does not calculate an effective config.
25	type Scope string
26	
27	const (
28		ScopeProject        Scope = "project"
29		ScopeLocal          Scope = "local"
30		ScopeUser           Scope = "user"
31		ScopeCustom         Scope = "custom"
32		ScopeSystemDefaults Scope = "system-defaults"
33		ScopeSystemOverride Scope = "system-override"
34		ScopeManaged        Scope = "managed"
35	)
36	
37	// DeclarationSource distinguishes ordinary declarations, plugin overrides,
38	// and administrator-managed declarations.
39	type DeclarationSource string
40	
41	const (
42		SourceDirect  DeclarationSource = "direct"
43		SourcePlugin  DeclarationSource = "plugin"
44		SourceManaged DeclarationSource = "managed"
45	)
46	
47	// Transport records only what the declaration proves statically.
48	type Transport string
49	
50	const (
51		TransportUnknown        Transport = "unknown"
52		TransportStdio          Transport = "stdio"
53		TransportHTTP           Transport = "http"
54		TransportStreamableHTTP Transport = "streamable-http"
55		TransportSSE            Transport = "sse"
56		TransportWebSocket      Transport = "ws"
57		TransportRemote         Transport = "remote"
58		TransportLocal          Transport = "local"
59	)
60	
61	// CredentialKind identifies a credential-bearing declaration without retaining
62	// its value.
63	type CredentialKind string
64	
65	const (
66		CredentialEnvironment          CredentialKind = "environment"
67		CredentialEnvironmentReference CredentialKind = "environment-reference"
68		CredentialHeader               CredentialKind = "header"
69		CredentialBearerEnvironment    CredentialKind = "bearer-environment"
70		CredentialOAuth                CredentialKind = "oauth"
71		CredentialFile                 CredentialKind = "file"
72		CredentialHelper               CredentialKind = "helper"
73	)

75	// CredentialReference contains only a safe reference name. Literal values are

82	// Redaction describes a class of source material intentionally omitted.

88		RedactionDynamicCommand   Redaction = "dynamic-command"

91		RedactionOAuthValue       Redaction = "oauth-value"
92		RedactionFileReference    Redaction = "file-reference"

101	// PolicyKind is a declared policy fact, not a computed policy decision.
102	type PolicyKind string

110		PolicyDisabledTools  PolicyKind = "disabled-tools"
111		PolicyPluginEnabled  PolicyKind = "plugin-enabled"
112		PolicyOAuth          PolicyKind = "oauth"
113		PolicyAuthentication PolicyKind = "authentication"
114		PolicyIncludeTools   PolicyKind = "include-tools"
115		PolicyExcludeTools   PolicyKind = "exclude-tools"
116	)
117	
118	// PolicyFact retains only finite policy values and collection counts. It never
119	// exposes tool names, scopes, audiences, or other potentially sensitive text.
120	type PolicyFact struct {
121		Kind  PolicyKind `json:"kind"`
122		Value string     `json:"value,omitempty"`
123		Count int        `json:"count,omitempty"`
124	}
125	
126	// DiagnosticCode is stable machine-readable coverage or file status.
127	type DiagnosticCode string
128	
129	const (
130		DiagnosticUnreadable             DiagnosticCode = "config_unreadable"
131		DiagnosticTooLarge               DiagnosticCode = "config_too_large"
132		DiagnosticNotRegular             DiagnosticCode = "config_not_regular"
133		DiagnosticSymlinkLimit           DiagnosticCode = "config_symlink_limit"
134		DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape   DiagnosticCode = "project_symlink_escape"
135		DiagnosticMalformed              DiagnosticCode = "config_malformed"
136		DiagnosticControlCharacter       DiagnosticCode = "control_character"
137		DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration     DiagnosticCode = "invalid_declaration"
138		DiagnosticInvalidName            DiagnosticCode = "invalid_server_name"
139		DiagnosticUnknownTransport       DiagnosticCode = "transport_unknown"
140		DiagnosticConflictingTransport   DiagnosticCode = "transport_conflict"
141		DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint        DiagnosticCode = "endpoint_invalid"
142		DiagnosticInvalidReference       DiagnosticCode = "credential_reference_invalid"
143		DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent DiagnosticCode = "plugin_definition_not_in_config"
144		DiagnosticTransportPrecedence    DiagnosticCode = "lower_precedence_transport_ignored"
145	)
146	
147	// CoverageDiagnostic explains a normalization limitation with fixed text that
148	// cannot echo configuration values.
149	type CoverageDiagnostic struct {
150		Code    DiagnosticCode `json:"code"`
151		Message string         `json:"message"`
152	}
153	
154	// Diagnostic reports a source-level or declaration-level problem. Messages are
155	// fixed by Code; paths are the only source-derived values retained here.
156	type Diagnostic struct {
157		Agent          Agent          `json:"agent"`
158		Scope          Scope          `json:"scope"`
159		Repository     string         `json:"repo,omitempty"`
160		RepositoryPath string         `json:"repo_path,omitempty"`
161		Checkout       string         `json:"checkout,omitempty"`
162		ConfigPath     string         `json:"config_path"`
163		Code           DiagnosticCode `json:"code"`
164		Message        string         `json:"message"`
165	}
166	
167	// Declaration is one server declaration in one scope. Duplicate names in other
168	// scopes or files remain separate rows.
169	type Declaration struct {
170		Name           string                `json:"name"`
171		Agent          Agent                 `json:"agent"`
172		Scope          Scope                 `json:"scope"`
173		Repository     string                `json:"repo,omitempty"`
174		RepositoryPath string                `json:"repo_path,omitempty"`
175		Checkout       string                `json:"checkout,omitempty"`
176		ConfigPath     string                `json:"config_path"`
177		Source         DeclarationSource     `json:"source"`
178		Plugin         string                `json:"plugin,omitempty"`
179		Enabled        *bool                 `json:"enabled,omitempty"`
180		Required       *bool                 `json:"required,omitempty"`
181		Trusted        *bool                 `json:"trusted,omitempty"`
182		Policies       []PolicyFact          `json:"policies,omitempty"`
183		Transport      Transport             `json:"transport"`
184		Endpoint       string                `json:"endpoint,omitempty"`
185		Command        string                `json:"command,omitempty"`
186		ArgumentCount  int                   `json:"argument_count,omitempty"`
187		Credentials    []CredentialReference `json:"credentials,omitempty"`
188		Redactions     []Redaction           `json:"redactions,omitempty"`
189		Coverage       []CoverageDiagnostic  `json:"coverage,omitempty"`
190	}
191	
192	// Target is shared with native skill inventory so repository and linked-
193	// checkout identity cannot drift between the two domains.
194	type Target = agenttarget.Target
195	
196	// Coverage states the fixed limits of this static inventory. It is product
197	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.
198	type Coverage struct {
199		Agents                 []Agent  `json:"agents"`
200		StaticDeclarationsOnly bool     `json:"static_declarations_only"`
201		OmittedSources         []string `json:"omitted_sources"`
202	}
203	
204	// Result contains partial declarations and non-fatal per-source diagnostics.
205	type Result struct {
206		Declarations []Declaration `json:"servers"`
207		Diagnostics  []Diagnostic  `json:"diagnostics"`
208		Coverage     Coverage      `json:"coverage"`
209	}
210	
211	func defaultCoverage() Coverage {
212		return Coverage{
213			Agents:                 []Agent{AgentClaudeCode, AgentCodex, AgentCursor, AgentGeminiCLI, AgentOpenCode},
214			StaticDeclarationsOnly: true,
215			OmittedSources: []string{
216				"runtime health and command-line-only configuration",
217				"plugin caches and hosted connectors",
218				"remote organization configuration",
219				"inline OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT",
220			},
221		}
222	}
223	
224	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
225	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
226	type Filter struct {
227		Agent          Agent
228		Scope          Scope
229		Source         DeclarationSource
230		Transport      Transport
231		Repository     string
232		NameContains   string
233		Enabled        *bool
234		HasCredentials *bool
235	}
236	
237	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
238	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
239		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
240			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
241			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
242			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
243			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
244			return false
245		}
246		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
247			return false
248		}
249		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
250			return false
251		}
252		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
253			return false
254		}
255		return true
256	}
257	
258	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
259	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
260		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
261		for _, row := range rows {
262			if f.Match(row) {
263				out = append(out, row)
264			}
265		}
266		return out
267	}
268	
269	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
270	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
271		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
272			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
273			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
274			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
275			for n := range ak {
276				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
277					return ak[n] < bk[n]
278				}
279			}
280			return false
281		})
282	}
283	
284	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
285		switch scope {
286		case ScopeProject:
287			return "0-project"
288		case ScopeLocal:
289			return "1-local"
290		case ScopeUser:
291			return "2-user"
292		case ScopeCustom:
293			return "3-custom"
294		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
295			return "4-system-defaults"
296		case ScopeSystemOverride:
297			return "5-system-override"
298		case ScopeManaged:
299			return "6-managed"
300		default:
301			return "9-" + string(scope)
302		}
303	}
304	
305	func diagnosticMessage(code DiagnosticCode) string {
306		switch code {
307		case DiagnosticUnreadable:
308			return "configuration file could not be read"
309		case DiagnosticTooLarge:
310			return "configuration file exceeds the scan size limit"
311		case DiagnosticNotRegular:
312			return "configuration source is not a regular file"
313		case DiagnosticSymlinkLimit:
314			return "configuration symlink chain exceeds the scan limit"
315		case DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape:
316			return "project configuration resolves outside the checkout"
317		case DiagnosticMalformed:
318			return "configuration file could not be decoded"
319		case DiagnosticControlCharacter:
320			return "configuration contains an unsupported control character"
321		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
322			return "server declaration has an invalid field"
323		case DiagnosticInvalidName:
324			return "server declaration has an invalid name"
325		case DiagnosticUnknownTransport:
326			return "server transport cannot be determined statically"
327		case DiagnosticConflictingTransport:
328			return "server declaration contains conflicting transport fields"
329		case DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint:
330			return "server endpoint could not be represented safely"
331		case DiagnosticInvalidReference:
332			return "credential reference name is invalid"
333		case DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent:
334			return "plugin override does not include the plugin server definition"
335		case DiagnosticTransportPrecedence:
336			return "lower-precedence transport fields were ignored"
337		default:
338			return "configuration could not be fully represented"
339		}
340	}
341	
342	func coverage(code DiagnosticCode) CoverageDiagnostic {
343		return CoverageDiagnostic{Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code)}
344	}
345

16	var errSymlinkLimit = errors.New("symlink limit reached")
17	
18	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
19		if ctx.Err() != nil {
20			return readResult{}
21		}
22		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
23		if err != nil {
24			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
25				return readResult{}
26			}
27			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
28				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
29			}
30			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
31		}
32		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
33			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
34			if err != nil || !inside {
35				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
36			}
37		}
38	
39		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
40		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
41			return readResult{}
42		}
43		if err != nil {
44			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
45		}
46		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
47			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
48		}
49		if info.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
50			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
51		}
52		file, err := os.Open(resolved)
53		if err != nil {
54			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return readResult{}
56			}
57			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
58		}
59		defer file.Close()
60		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
61		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
63		}
64		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
65			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
66		}
67		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
68			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
69			if err != nil {
70				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
71			}
72			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
73			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
74			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
75				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var body bytes.Buffer
80		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
81		for {
82			if ctx.Err() != nil {
83				return readResult{}
84			}
85			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
86			if n > 0 {
87				if int64(body.Len()+n) > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
88					return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
89				}
90				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
91			}
92			if readErr != nil {
93				if !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
94					return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
95				}
96				break
97			}
98		}
99		if ctx.Err() != nil {
100			return readResult{}
101		}
102		return readResult{data: body.Bytes(), present: true}
103	}
104	
105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

39	func installRepoSkills(ctx context.Context, app *App, root string, specs []repoSkillSpec) (repoSkillResult, error) {
40		var result repoSkillResult
41		type installGroup struct {
42			source string
43			agents []string
44			names  []string
45		}
46		var groups []installGroup
47		for _, spec := range specs {
48			key := spec.Source + "\x00" + strings.Join(spec.Agents, "\x00")
49			groupIndex := -1
50			for index := range groups {
51				if groups[index].source+"\x00"+strings.Join(groups[index].agents, "\x00") == key {
52					groupIndex = index
53					break
54				}
55			}
56			if groupIndex < 0 {
57				groups = append(groups, installGroup{source: spec.Source, agents: append([]string(nil), spec.Agents...)})
58				groupIndex = len(groups) - 1
59			}
60			groups[groupIndex].names = append(groups[groupIndex].names, spec.Name)
61		}
62		for _, group := range groups {
63			process, err := agentskill.InstallCommand(ctx, root, group.source, group.names, group.agents)
64			if err != nil {
65				return result, fmt.Errorf("prepare skills %s install: %w", strings.Join(group.names, ", "), err)
66			}
67			process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
68			if err := process.Run(); err != nil {
69				return result, fmt.Errorf("install skills %s: %w", strings.Join(group.names, ", "), err)
70			}
71			result.Installed = append(result.Installed, group.names...)
72		}
73		return result, nil
74	}

76	func runRepoSkillSetups(ctx context.Context, app *App, root string, phase repoHookPhase, specs []repoSkillSpec) (repoSkillResult, error) {
77		var result repoSkillResult
78		for _, spec := range specs {
79			if spec.Setup == nil || spec.Setup.Phase != phase ||
80				(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Setup.Script) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(spec.Setup.Builtin) == "") {
81				continue
82			}
83			if err := runRepoSkillSetup(ctx, app, root, spec.Name, *spec.Setup); err != nil {
84				if spec.Setup.Required {
85					return result, fmt.Errorf("set up skill %s: %w", spec.Name, err)
86				}
87				warning := fmt.Sprintf("skill %s setup: %v", spec.Name, err)
88				result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, warning)
89				app.warnf("%s", warning)
90				continue
91			}
92			result.Setup = append(result.Setup, spec.Name)
93		}
94		return result, nil
95	}
96	
97	func runRepoSkillSetup(ctx context.Context, app *App, root, name string, setup repoSkillSetup) error {
98		if setup.Timeout <= 0 {
99			setup.Timeout = 10 * time.Minute
100		}
101		commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, setup.Timeout)
102		defer cancel()
103		if setup.Builtin != "" {
104			return runBuiltinRepoSkillSetup(commandCtx, app, root, setup.Builtin, setup.Args)
105		}
106		skill, err := agentskill.FindProject(ctx, root, name)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		skillRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(skill.Path)
111		if err != nil {
112			return err
113		}
114		script, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(skillRoot, filepath.Join(skillRoot, filepath.FromSlash(setup.Script)))
115		if err != nil {
116			return fmt.Errorf("setup entrypoint must stay within installed skill: %w", err)
117		}
118		command := setup.Interpreter
119		args := append([]string{script}, setup.Args...)
120		if command == "" {
121			command = script
122			args = setup.Args
123		}
124		if _, err := exec.LookPath(command); err != nil {
125			return fmt.Errorf("interpreter/executable %q is unavailable", command)
126		}
127		process := exec.CommandContext(commandCtx, command, args...)
128		process.Dir = root
129		process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
130		if err := process.Run(); err != nil {
131			if commandCtx.Err() != nil {
132				return commandCtx.Err()
133			}
134			return err
135		}
136		return nil
137	}
138	
139	func runUpstreamSkillCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, root, source string) error {
140		process, err := agentskill.AddCommand(ctx, root, source)
141		if err != nil {
142			return err
143		}
144		process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = app.In, app.Out, app.Err
145		return process.Run()
146	}

Key config locations and env vars
- OpenCode supports a project config file named opencode.json (or JSONC). Project-level opencode.json is loaded from the project directory. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))  
- Global config is ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))  
- You can specify a custom config directory with OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR; that directory is searched for .opencode-style content (agents, commands, modes, plugins). ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))  
- OPENCODE_CONFIG (the docs list OPENCODE_CONFIG and OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT — OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is an inline/runtime override using an environment variable). OPENCODE_CONFIG is documented as a way to provide a custom config (override). ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))

Config precedence / merging
- Config files are merged (not replaced) and are loaded in this precedence (later overrides earlier): remote .well-known/opencode → global (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json) → custom config (OPENCODE_CONFIG env var) → project opencode.json → .opencode directories → inline (OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT). Managed settings (macOS managed preferences / .mobileconfig) and managed config files in /Library/Application Support/opencode/ are highest priority and can be admin-controlled. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))

Managed / macOS-specific behavior
- The docs specifically mention managed config files under /Library/Application Support/opencode/ and macOS managed preferences via .mobileconfig (MDM) that can override and are not user-overridable. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))

Config format and examples
- OpenCode accepts JSON and JSONC. The docs show example opencode.jsonc with a $schema value (https://opencode.ai/config.json) and options such as model, autoupdate, server.port, commands, references, etc. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config.md))

Other related notes
- The docs also mention OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR being used to locate .opencode-like directory contents (agents/, commands/, plugins/, etc.). The CLI docs and GitLab CI docs reference using custom config directories in CI/jobs. ([opencode.ai](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/))

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}
293

17	
18	type lockDocument struct {
19		Path        string
20		Scope       Scope
21		Version     int
22		Entries     map[string]LockMetadata
23		Diagnostics []Diagnostic
24		normalized  map[string][]string
25	}

30	}

32	type rawLockEntry struct {

34		SourceURL       string   `json:"sourceUrl"`
35		SourceType      string   `json:"sourceType"`
36		Ref             string   `json:"ref"`
37		SkillPath       string   `json:"skillPath"`

40		SkillFolderHash string   `json:"skillFolderHash"`

47	}
48	
49	func readProjectLock(filename string) lockDocument {
50		return readLockDocument(filename, ScopeProject, 1, 1)
51	}
52	
53	func readGlobalLock(filename string) lockDocument {
54		return readLockDocument(filename, ScopeGlobal, 1, 3)
55	}
56	
57	func readLockDocument(filename string, scope Scope, minimumVersion, maximumVersion int) lockDocument {
58		document := lockDocument{Path: filename, Scope: scope, Entries: map[string]LockMetadata{}}
59		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
60		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
61			return document
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
65				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect lock file: %v", err)))
66			return document
67		}
68		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
69			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
70				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, "lock path is not a regular file"))
71			return document
72		}
73		if info.Size() > maxLockBytes {
74			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
75				DiagnosticLockOversized, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("lock file exceeds %d bytes", maxLockBytes)))
76			return document
77		}
78		file, err := os.Open(filename)
79		if err != nil {
80			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
81				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not read lock file: %v", err)))
82			return document
83		}
84		defer file.Close()
85		openedInfo, err := file.Stat()
86		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
87			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
88				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, "opened lock is not a regular file"))
89			return document
90		}
91		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxLockBytes+1))
92		if err != nil {
93			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
94				DiagnosticLockUnreadable, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("could not read lock file: %v", err)))
95			return document
96		}
97		if int64(len(data)) > maxLockBytes {
98			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
99				DiagnosticLockOversized, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("lock file exceeds %d bytes", maxLockBytes)))
100			return document
101		}
102	
103		var raw rawLockFile
104		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
105			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
106				DiagnosticLockMalformed, scope, filename, fmt.Sprintf("invalid lock JSON: %v", err)))
107			return document
108		}
109		if raw.Version == nil {
110			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
111				DiagnosticLockMalformed, scope, filename, "lock file has no integer version"))
112			return document
113		}
114		document.Version = *raw.Version
115		if document.Version < minimumVersion || document.Version > maximumVersion {
116			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
117				DiagnosticLockUnsupported, scope, filename,
118				fmt.Sprintf("lock version %d is unsupported (want %d through %d)", document.Version, minimumVersion, maximumVersion)))
119			return document
120		}
121		if len(raw.Skills) == 0 || string(raw.Skills) == "null" {
122			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
123				DiagnosticLockMalformed, scope, filename, "lock file has no skills object"))
124			return document
125		}
126		var entries map[string]json.RawMessage
127		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw.Skills, &entries); err != nil || entries == nil {
128			document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, lockDiagnostic(
129				DiagnosticLockMalformed, scope, filename, "lock file skills must be an object"))
130			return document
131		}
132	
133		names := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
134		for name := range entries {
135			names = append(names, name)
136		}
137		sort.Strings(names)
138		for _, name := range names {
139			if !safeDisplayValue(name) || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
140				document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, Diagnostic{
141					Kind: DiagnosticLockMalformed, Scope: scope, Path: filename,
142					Message: "lock entry has an unsafe display name",
143				})
144				continue
145			}
146			normalized := normalizedName(name)
147			if normalized == "" {
148				document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, Diagnostic{
149					Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: scope, Path: filename, Name: name,
150					Message: fmt.Sprintf("lock name %q has no usable normalized name", name),
151				})
152				continue
153			}
154			rawEntry := bytes.TrimSpace(entries[name])
155			var entry rawLockEntry
156			if len(rawEntry) == 0 || rawEntry[0] != '{' || json.Unmarshal(rawEntry, &entry) != nil {
157				document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, Diagnostic{
158					Kind: DiagnosticLockMalformed, Scope: scope, Path: filename, Name: name,
159					Message: fmt.Sprintf("lock entry %q is not an object", name),
160				})
161				continue
162			}
163			source := entry.Source
164			if entry.SourceType == "local" && source != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(source) {
165				source = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filename), source))
166			}
167			metadata := LockMetadata{
168				Name: name, NormalizedName: normalized, File: filename,
169				Version: document.Version, Scope: scope, Source: source,
170				SourceURL: entry.SourceURL, SourceType: entry.SourceType, Ref: entry.Ref,
171				SkillPath: entry.SkillPath, ComputedHash: entry.ComputedHash,
172				ContentHash: entry.ContentHash, SkillFolderHash: entry.SkillFolderHash,
173				InstalledAt: entry.InstalledAt, UpdatedAt: entry.UpdatedAt,
174				PluginName: entry.PluginName, SourceBaseURL: entry.SourceBaseURL,
175				WellKnownDigest: entry.WellKnownDigest,
176				Subagents:       append([]string(nil), entry.Subagents...),
177			}
178			normalizeRecordedHash(&metadata)
179			document.Entries[name] = metadata
180		}
181		document.normalized = document.buildNamesByNormalized()
182		document.Diagnostics = append(document.Diagnostics, document.collisionDiagnostics()...)
183		return document
184	}

186	func lockDiagnostic(kind DiagnosticKind, scope Scope, filename, message string) Diagnostic {
187		return Diagnostic{Kind: kind, Scope: scope, Path: filename, Message: message}
188	}

190	func (document lockDocument) buildNamesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
191		groups := map[string][]string{}
192		for name, entry := range document.Entries {
193			normalized := entry.NormalizedName
194			if normalized == "" {
195				normalized = normalizedName(name)
196			}
197			groups[normalized] = append(groups[normalized], name)
198		}
199		for normalized := range groups {
200			sort.Strings(groups[normalized])
201		}
202		return groups
203	}
204	
205	func (document lockDocument) namesByNormalized() map[string][]string {
206		if document.normalized != nil {
207			return document.normalized
208		}
209		return document.buildNamesByNormalized()
210	}
211	
212	func (document lockDocument) collisionDiagnostics() []Diagnostic {
213		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
214		groups := document.namesByNormalized()
215		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
216		for normalized := range groups {
217			keys = append(keys, normalized)
218		}
219		sort.Strings(keys)
220		for _, normalized := range keys {
221			names := groups[normalized]
222			if normalized != "" && len(names) < 2 {
223				continue
224			}
225			message := fmt.Sprintf("lock names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized)
226			if normalized == "" {
227				message = fmt.Sprintf("lock name %s has no usable normalized name", strings.Join(names, ", "))
228			}
229			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
230				Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: document.Scope, Path: document.Path,
231				Name: normalized, Message: message,
232			})
233		}
234		return diagnostics
235	}
236	
237	// find applies deterministic lock matching: exact spelling wins; a normalized
238	// spelling is accepted only when it identifies one lock entry.
239	func (document lockDocument) find(name string) (LockMetadata, bool) {
240		if entry, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
241			return entry, true
242		}
243		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalizedName(name)]
244		if len(names) != 1 {
245			return LockMetadata{}, false
246		}
247		entry, ok := document.Entries[names[0]]
248		return entry, ok
249	}
250	
251	func (document lockDocument) candidates(normalized string) []LockMetadata {
252		names := document.namesByNormalized()[normalized]
253		entries := make([]LockMetadata, 0, len(names))
254		for _, name := range names {
255			entries = append(entries, document.Entries[name])
256		}
257		return entries
258	}

260	func globalLockPath() string {
261		if stateHome := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("XDG_STATE_HOME")); filepath.IsAbs(stateHome) {
262			return filepath.Join(filepath.Clean(stateHome), "skills", ".skill-lock.json")
263		}
264		home := homeDirectory()
265		if home == "" {
266			return ""
267		}
268		return filepath.Join(home, ".agents", ".skill-lock.json")
269	}
270	
271	// GlobalLockPath returns the native global lock location. Relative
272	// XDG_STATE_HOME values are ignored as required by the XDG specification.
273	func GlobalLockPath() string { return globalLockPath() }
274	
275	func normalizedName(value string) string {
276		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
277		var builder strings.Builder
278		lastDash := false
279		for _, character := range value {
280			valid := character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '_'
281			if valid {
282				builder.WriteRune(character)
283				lastDash = false
284			} else if !lastDash {
285				builder.WriteByte('-')
286				lastDash = true
287			}
288		}
289		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
290	}

217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,

219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {

2796		case "b":
2797			repo := ""
2798			if m.stats != nil {
2799				repo = m.stats.Repo
2800			}
2801			if repo == "" {
2802				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
2803			}
2804			if repo == "" || m.actions.BackfillStats == nil {
2805				return m, nil
2806			}
2807			m.status = "backfilling this repository from Git history…"
2808			return m, func() tea.Msg {
2809				err := m.actions.BackfillStats(context.Background(), repo)
2810				return statsBackfilledMsg{repo: repo, err: err}
2811			}
2812		}
2813		return m, nil
2814	}

2816	func (m Model) viewUsesRepos(view View) bool {
2817		switch view {
2818		case ViewFleet:
2819			return m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil
2820		case ViewSkills:
2821			return m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil
2822		case ViewMCP:
2823			return m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil
2824		default:
2825			return false
2826		}
2827	}
2828	
2829	func (m Model) viewWaitsForRepos(view View) bool {
2830		return m.viewUsesRepos(view) && m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading
2831	}
2832	
2833	func (m Model) dependentReposUnavailable(view View) error {
2834		if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2835			return nil
2836		}
2837		repos := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
2838		if repos.loading || (repos.hasSnapshot && repos.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh) {
2839			return nil
2840		}
2841		if err := m.viewError(ViewRepos); err != nil {
2842			return fmt.Errorf("local repository inventory: %w", err)
2843		}
2844		return errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
2845	}
2846	
2847	func dependentLoadingStatus(view View) string {
2848		switch view {
2849		case ViewFleet:
2850			return "loading configured dev hosts…"
2851		case ViewSkills:
2852			return "loading agent skills across repositories…"
2853		case ViewMCP:
2854			return "loading MCP declarations across repositories…"
2855		default:
2856			return "loading…"
2857		}
2858	}
2859	
2860	func (m Model) reloadDependentView(view View) tea.Cmd {
2861		switch view {
2862		case ViewFleet:
2863			return m.reloadFleet()
2864		case ViewSkills:
2865			return m.reloadSkills()
2866		case ViewMCP:
2867			return m.reloadMCP()
2868		default:
2869			return nil
2870		}
2871	}
2872	
2873	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
2874		fresh := valid && err == nil
2875		var commands []tea.Cmd
2876		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
2877			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2878				continue
2879			}
2880			state := m.viewLoad(view)
2881			if state.loading || (m.view == view && state.hasSnapshot) {
2882				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
2883				if fresh {
2884					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
2885					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
2886					continue
2887				}
2888				dependencyErr := err
2889				if dependencyErr == nil {
2890					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
2891				}
2892				current := m.viewLoad(view)
2893				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
2894				continue
2895			}
2896			if state.hasSnapshot {
2897				m.invalidateView(view)
2898			}
2899		}
2900		return batchCommands(commands...)
2901	}

2903	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads optional inventories only when their view is
2904	// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
2905	// CLI, or Node tooling.
2906	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2907		m.setAt(m.at())
2908		switch m.view {
2909		case ViewFleet:
2910			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewFleet) {
2911				m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadVisit)
2912				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewFleet); err != nil {
2913					fleet := m.viewLoad(ViewFleet)
2914					m.applyViewResult(ViewFleet, fleet.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
2915					return m, nil
2916				}
2917				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewFleet) {
2918					m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "waiting for local repositories…")
2919					return m, nil
2920				}
2921				m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "loading configured dev hosts…")
2922				return m, m.reloadFleet()
2923			}
2924		case ViewRemote:
2925			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewRemote) {
2926				m.beginViewLoad(ViewRemote, loadVisit)
2927				m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "refreshing remote repositories…")
2928				return m, m.reloadRemote()
2929			}
2930		case ViewSkills:
2931			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewSkills) {
2932				m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadVisit)
2933				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewSkills); err != nil {
2934					state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
2935					m.applyViewResult(ViewSkills, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)

2938				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewSkills) {
2939					m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "waiting for local repositories…")
2940					return m, nil
2941				}
2942				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, dependentLoadingStatus(ViewSkills))
2943				return m, m.reloadSkills()
2944			}
2945		case ViewMCP:
2946			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewMCP) {
2947				m.beginViewLoad(ViewMCP, loadVisit)
2948				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewMCP); err != nil {
2949					state := m.viewLoad(ViewMCP)
2950					m.applyViewResult(ViewMCP, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
2951					return m, nil
2952				}
2953				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewMCP) {
2954					m.setViewStatus(ViewMCP, "waiting for local repositories…")
2955					return m, nil
2956				}
2957				m.setViewStatus(ViewMCP, dependentLoadingStatus(ViewMCP))
2958				return m, m.reloadMCP()
2959			}
2960		}
2961		return m, nil
2962	}

12	
13	func resolverOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
14		if err != nil {
15			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
16		}
17		return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
18	}
19	
20	// tuiRuntimeResolver moves runtime auto-detection off the first-view path while
21	// sharing exactly one result across inventory loads and actions.
22	type tuiRuntimeResolver struct {
23		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
24		resolve func() runtime.Runtime
25		once    sync.Once
26		ready   chan struct{}
27		rt      runtime.Runtime
28	}
29	
30	func newTUIRuntimeResolver(app *App) *tuiRuntimeResolver {
31		snapshot := *app
32		return &tuiRuntimeResolver{
33			trace: app.trace, resolve: snapshot.Runtime, ready: make(chan struct{}),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
41				r.rt = r.resolve()
42				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
43				close(r.ready)
44			}()
45		})
46		if ctx == nil {
47			ctx = context.Background()
48		}
49		select {
50		case <-ctx.Done():
51			return nil, ctx.Err()
52		case <-r.ready:
53			return r.rt, nil
54		}
55	}
56	
57	// tuiProjectRootResolver keeps Git project-root discovery lazy and shared by
58	// SKILLS reads/actions.
59	type tuiProjectRootResolver struct {
60		trace       *perftrace.Recorder
61		ctx         context.Context
62		getwd       func() (string, error)
63		projectRoot func(context.Context, string) string
64		once        sync.Once
65		ready       chan struct{}
66		root        string
67		err         error
68	}
69	
70	func newTUIProjectRootResolver(trace *perftrace.Recorder, ctx context.Context) *tuiProjectRootResolver {
71		if ctx == nil {
72			ctx = context.Background()
73		}
74		return &tuiProjectRootResolver{
75			trace: trace, ctx: ctx, getwd: os.Getwd, projectRoot: agentskill.ProjectRoot,
76			ready: make(chan struct{}),
77		}
78	}
79	
80	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
81		r.once.Do(func() {
82			go func() {
83				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProjectRootResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
84				cwd, err := r.getwd()
85				if err == nil {
86					r.root = r.projectRoot(r.ctx, cwd)
87				}
88				r.err = err
89				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
90				close(r.ready)
91			}()
92		})
93		if ctx == nil {
94			ctx = context.Background()
95		}
96		select {
97		case <-ctx.Done():
98			return "", ctx.Err()
99		case <-r.ready:
100			return r.root, r.err
101		}
102	}
103	
104	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Current() (string, bool) {
105		select {
106		case <-r.ready:
107			return r.root, r.err == nil
108		default:
109			return "", false
110		}
111	}

10	func TestProjectRootResolverIsNotPoisonedByCanceledWaiter(t *testing.T) {
11		resolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(nil, t.Context())
12		resolver.getwd = func() (string, error) { return "/repo/nested", nil }
13		started := make(chan struct{})
14		release := make(chan struct{})
15		resolver.projectRoot = func(ctx context.Context, _ string) string {
16			close(started)
17			select {
18			case <-ctx.Done():
19				return "/repo/nested"
20			case <-release:
21				return "/repo"
22			}
23		}
24	
25		caller, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
26		first := make(chan error, 1)
27		go func() {
28			_, err := resolver.Resolve(caller)
29			first <- err
30		}()
31		<-started
32		cancel()
33		select {
34		case err := <-first:
35			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
36				t.Fatalf("first waiter error = %v", err)
37			}
38		case <-time.After(time.Second):
39			t.Fatal("canceled waiter did not return")
40		}
41	
42		close(release)
43		root, err := resolver.Resolve(t.Context())
44		if err != nil || root != "/repo" {
45			t.Fatalf("shared resolver root=%q err=%v", root, err)
46		}
47		if current, ok := resolver.Current(); !ok || current != "/repo" {
48			t.Fatalf("Current = %q, %v", current, ok)
49		}
50	}

44	// DefaultOptions resolves only documented static file locations. In

159	type readResult struct {

165	// Scanner is a reusable, read-only static declaration scanner.
166	type Scanner struct {
167		options    Options
168		readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult
169	}
170	
171	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
172	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
173		options = normalizeOptions(options)
174		s := &Scanner{options: options}
175		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
176		return s
177	}
178	
179	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
180	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
181		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
182	}
183	
184	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
185	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
186	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
187	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
188		if ctx == nil {
189			ctx = context.Background()
190		}
191		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
192		result := Result{Coverage: defaultCoverage()}
193	
194		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
195			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
196				finalizeResult(&result)
197				return result, err
198			}
199			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets)
200			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
201			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)

266	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {
267		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
268			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
269		}
270		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
271			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
272		}
273		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
274			options.CodexHome = ""
275		}
276		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
277			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
278		}
279		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
280			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
281		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
282			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
283		}
284		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
285			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
286		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
287			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
288		}
289		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
290			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
291		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
292			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
293		}
294		return options
295	}

297	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
298		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
299		for _, target := range targets {
300			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
301				continue
302			}
303			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
304			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
305				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
306			}
307			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
308			if err != nil {
309				continue
310			}
311			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
312			if target.RepoPath == "" {
313				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
314			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
315				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
316			}
317			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
318			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
319				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
320			}
321			if target.CommonDir == "" {
322				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
323			}
324			out = append(out, target)
325		}
326		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
327	}

380	func projectSources(target Target) []sourceSpec {
381		base := sourceSpec{
382			scope: ScopeProject, source: SourceDirect, repository: target.RepoDisplay,
383			repositoryPath: target.RepoPath, checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, projectRoot: target.CheckoutRoot,
384		}
385		makeSpec := func(agent Agent, relative string, adapter adapterKind) sourceSpec {
386			spec := base
387			spec.agent = agent
388			spec.path = filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
389			spec.adapter = adapter
390			return spec
391		}
392		claude := makeSpec(AgentClaudeCode, ".mcp.json", adapterClaudeProject)
393		claude.approvalPaths = []string{
394			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.json"),
395			filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.local.json"),
396		}
397		return []sourceSpec{
398			claude,
399			makeSpec(AgentCodex, ".codex/config.toml", adapterCodex),
400			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
401			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
402			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
403			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
404			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
405			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
406		}
407	}

409	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
410		read := s.readSource(ctx, spec)
411		if !read.present {
412			if read.code == "" {
413				return nil, nil
414			}
415			return nil, []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
416		}
417		var rows []Declaration
418		var codes []DiagnosticCode
419		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
420		switch spec.adapter {
421		case adapterClaudeProject:
422			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
423			for _, approvalPath := range spec.approvalPaths {
424				approvalSpec := spec
425				approvalSpec.path = approvalPath
426				approval := s.readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
427				switch {
428				case approval.code != "":
429					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
430				case approval.present:
431					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
432					if code != "" {
433						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
434					} else {
435						applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, enabled, disabled, enableAll)
436					}
437				}
438			}
439		case adapterClaudeUser:
440			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
441			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
442			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
443		case adapterCodex:
444			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
445		case adapterCursor:
446			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
447		case adapterGemini:
448			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
449		case adapterOpenCode:
450			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
451		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
452			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
453		default:
454			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
455		}
456		if diagnostics == nil {
457			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
458		}
459		for _, code := range codes {
460			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
461		}
462		return rows, diagnostics
463	}
464	
465	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
466		return Diagnostic{
467			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
468			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout, ConfigPath: spec.path,
469			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
474		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
475		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
476			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
477			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
478			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
479			for n := range ak {
480				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
481					return ak[n] < bk[n]
482				}
483			}
484			return false
485		})
486	}
