942	func (m Model) reloadAfterConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
943		if m.actions.Local.Start != nil {
944			local := m.startLocalLoad()
945			if refreshRemote {
946				return tea.Batch(local, m.reloadRemote())
947			}
948			return local
949		}
950		return func() tea.Msg {
951			ctx := m.viewContext(ViewTasks)
952			out := reloadMsg{
953				forceSizes:       m.forceSizeReload,
954				rowsGeneration:   m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
955				reposGeneration:  m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
956				triesGeneration:  m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
957				remoteGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).generation,
958			}
959			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
960				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTasks, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTasks})
961				out.rows, out.rowsErr = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
962				out.rowsSet, out.rowsValid = true, snapshotValid(out.rows, out.rowsErr)
963				finish(traceOutcome(out.rowsErr))
964			}
965			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
966				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRepos, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos})
967				out.repos, out.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
968				out.reposSet, out.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(out.repos, out.reposErr)
969				finish(traceOutcome(out.reposErr))
970			}
971			if m.actions.Tries.Reload != nil {
972				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTries, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewTries})
973				out.tries, out.triesErr = m.actions.Tries.Reload(ctx, m.showAllTries)
974				out.triesSet, out.triesValid = true, snapshotValid(out.tries, out.triesErr)
975				finish(traceOutcome(out.triesErr))
976			}
977			if refreshRemote && m.actions.ReloadRemote != nil {
978				finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRemote, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRemote})
979				out.remotes, out.remoteErr = m.actions.ReloadRemote(ctx)
980				out.remoteSet, out.remoteValid = true, snapshotValid(out.remotes, out.remoteErr)
981				finish(traceOutcome(out.remoteErr))
982			}
983			return out
984		}
985	}
986	
987	// visibleTasks applies the state filter and the text query.
988	func (m Model) visibleTasks() []inventory.Row {
989		var out []inventory.Row
990		for _, r := range m.rows {
991			if len(m.states) > 0 {
992				if !containsState(m.states, r.Task.State) {
993					continue
994				}
995			} else if r.Task.State == task.Done && !m.showDone {
996				continue
997			}
998			if !matches(taskSearchText(r), m.filter) {
999				continue
1000			}
1001			out = append(out, r)
1002		}
1003		return out
1004	}
1005	
1006	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
1007	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
1008	// for, not alphabetical order.
1009	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1010		var out []RepoRow
1011		for _, r := range m.repos {
1012			if r.IsTry() || !r.matches(m.filter) {
1013				continue
1014			}
1015			out = append(out, r)
1016		}
1017		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1018		if sortBy == "" {
1019			sortBy = "activity"
1020		}
1021		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1022			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1023			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1024				return cmp > 0
1025			}
1026			return cmp < 0
1027		})
1028		return out
1029	}
1030	
1031	// visibleTries applies structured experiment filters and keeps sorting local to
1032	// the view so repository ordering remains independent.
1033	func (m Model) visibleTries() []TryRow {
1034		out := make([]TryRow, 0, len(m.tries))
1035		for _, row := range m.tries {
1036			if row.matches(m.filter) {
1037				out = append(out, row)
1038			}
1039		}
1040		sortBy := m.trySort
1041		if sortBy == "" {
1042			sortBy = "activity"
1043		}
1044		sortTryRows(out, sortBy, m.tryReverse)
1045		return out
1046	}

1048	type repoItem struct {
1049		Repo          RepoRow
1050		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
1051	}
1052	
1053	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
1054	
1055	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
1056		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
1057			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1058		}
1059		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
1060	}
1061	
1062	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1063	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1064	// from the repository they belong to.
1065	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1066		repos := m.visibleRepos()
1067		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
1068		for _, r := range repos {
1069			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
1070			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1071				continue
1072			}
1073			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
1074				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1075			}
1076		}
1077		return out
1078	}

1080	func repoKey(r RepoRow) string {
1081		if r.Repo.CommonDir != "" {
1082			return r.Repo.CommonDir
1083		}
1084		return r.Repo.Path
1085	}
1086	
1087	func (m Model) repoExpanded(r RepoRow) bool {
1088		key := repoKey(r)
1089		for _, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
1090			if expanded == key {
1091				return true
1092			}
1093		}
1094		return false
1095	}
1096	
1097	func (m *Model) toggleRepo(r RepoRow) {
1098		key := repoKey(r)
1099		for i, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
1100			if expanded == key {
1101				m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos[:i]...), m.expandedRepos[i+1:]...)
1102				return
1103			}
1104		}
1105		m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos...), key)
1106	}

1108	// visibleRemotes filters the combined forge inventory. Local clones sort
1109	// first, then recently updated repositories.
1110	func (m Model) visibleRemotes() []RemoteRow {
1111		var out []RemoteRow
1112		for _, r := range m.remotes {
1113			if r.matches(m.filter) {
1114				out = append(out, r)
1115			}
1116		}
1117		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1118			if out[i].Cloned() != out[j].Cloned() {
1119				return out[i].Cloned()
1120			}
1121			if !out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
1122				return out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
1123			}
1124			return out[i].Repo.Label() < out[j].Repo.Label()
1125		})
1126		return out
1127	}
1128	
1129	func (m Model) visibleFleet() []FleetRow {
1130		var out []FleetRow
1131		for _, row := range m.fleet {
1132			if row.Local && !m.showLocalFleet {
1133				continue
1134			}
1135			if matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
1136				out = append(out, row)
1137			}
1138		}
1139		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1140			leftName, rightName := "", ""
1141			if out[i].Repository != nil {
1142				leftName = strings.ToLower(out[i].Repository.Display)
1143			}
1144			if out[j].Repository != nil {
1145				rightName = strings.ToLower(out[j].Repository.Display)
1146			}
1147			if leftName != rightName {
1148				return leftName < rightName
1149			}
1150			return out[i].Host < out[j].Host
1151		})
1152		return out
1153	}

1155	func (m Model) fleetCount() int {

1157		for _, row := range m.fleet {
1158			if !row.Local || m.showLocalFleet {
1159				count++
1160			}

1162		return count

1165	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1166	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1167	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1168	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1169	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1170		if row.Task == nil {
1171			return ""
1172		}
1173		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1174			return "dev sweep"
1175		}
1176		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1177			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1178		}
1179		return ""
1180	}
1181	
1182	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1183		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1184		if command == "" {
1185			return nil
1186		}
1187		switch {
1188		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1189			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1190		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1191			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1192		default:
1193			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1194		}
1195	}

1207	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1208		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1209		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1210			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1211			if structured {
1212				switch key {
1213				case "scope":
1214					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1215						return false
1216					}
1217					continue
1218				case "agent":
1219					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1220					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1221						return false
1222					}
1223					continue
1224				case "update":
1225					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1226						return false
1227					}
1228					continue
1229				case "repo":
1230					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1231						return false
1232					}
1233					continue
1234				case "presence":
1235					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1236						return false
1237					}
1238					continue
1239				case "integrity":
1240					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1241						return false
1242					}
1243					continue
1244				}
1245			}
1246			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1247				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1248				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1249				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1250				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1251			}, " "))
1252			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1253				return false
1254			}
1255		}
1256		return true
1257	}
1258	
1259	func (m Model) visibleMCP() []agentmcp.Declaration {
1260		var out []agentmcp.Declaration
1261		for _, row := range m.mcp {

1268	
1269	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1270		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1271		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1272			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1273			if structured {
1274				var field string
1275				switch key {
1276				case "repo":
1277					field = row.Repository
1278				case "agent":
1279					field = string(row.Agent)
1280				case "scope":
1281					field = string(row.Scope)
1282				case "transport":
1283					field = string(row.Transport)
1284				case "managed":
1285					field = string(row.Source)
1286				case "state":
1287					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1288				default:
1289					field = ""
1290				}
1291				if field != "" {
1292					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1293						return false
1294					}
1295					continue
1296				}
1297			}
1298			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1299				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1300				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1301				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1302			}, " "))
1303			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1304				return false
1305			}
1306		}
1307		return true
1308	}

1310	func mcpDeclarationState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
1311		if row.Enabled == nil {
1312			return "configured"
1313		}
1314		if *row.Enabled {
1315			return "enabled"
1316		}
1317		return "disabled"
1318	}

1320	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1321	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1322		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1323		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1324			switch {
1325			case x > y:
1326				return -1
1327			case x < y:
1328				return 1
1329			default:
1330				return 0
1331			}
1332		}
1333		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1334			if x == y {
1335				return 0
1336			}
1337			if x {
1338				return -1
1339			}
1340			return 1
1341		}
1342		latest := func() int {
1343			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1344				return 0
1345			}
1346			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1347				return -1
1348			}
1349			return 1
1350		}
1351	
1352		switch sortBy {
1353		case "name":
1354			return nameCmp
1355		case "latest":
1356			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1357				return c
1358			}
1359		case "git":
1360			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1361				return c
1362			}
1363			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1364				return c
1365			}
1366		case "size":
1367			switch {
1368			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1369				return -1
1370			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1371				return 1
1372			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1373				return -1
1374			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1375				return 1
1376			}
1377		case "tasks":
1378			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1379				return c
1380			}
1381			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1382				return c
1383			}
1384		default: // activity
1385			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1386				return c
1387			}
1388			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1389				return c
1390			}
1391			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1392				return c
1393			}
1394			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1395				return c
1396			}
1397			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1398				return c
1399			}
1400		}
1401		return nameCmp
1402	}

1410		return false

1453	// setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
1454	func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
1455		n := m.count()
1456		switch {
1457		case n == 0:
1458			i = 0
1459		case i >= n:
1460			i = n - 1
1461		case i < 0:
1462			i = 0
1463		}
1464		switch m.view {
1465		case ViewRepos:
1466			m.repoCursor = i
1467		case ViewFleet:
1468			m.fleetCursor = i
1469		case ViewTries:
1470			m.tryCursor = i
1471		case ViewRemote:
1472			m.remoteCursor = i
1473		case ViewSkills:
1474			m.skillCursor = i
1475		case ViewMCP:
1476			m.mcpCursor = i
1477		default:
1478			m.taskCursor = i
1479		}
1480	}

1573	// matchRemoteLocals fills cached remote rows from the freshly loaded local
1574	// inventory without another scan.
1575	func (m *Model) matchRemoteLocals() {
1576		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
1577		byRemote := map[string]RepoRow{}
1578		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1579		for _, r := range m.repos {
1580			if r.RemoteName == "" {
1581				continue
1582			}
1583			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1584			if ambiguous[key] {
1585				continue
1586			}
1587			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1588				delete(byRemote, key)
1589				ambiguous[key] = true
1590				continue
1591			}
1592			byRemote[key] = r
1593		}
1594		triesByIdentity := map[string]TryRow{}
1595		ambiguousTry := map[string]bool{}
1596		for _, row := range m.tries {
1597			identity := row.Item.RemoteIdentity
1598			if !row.Present() || identity == "" || ambiguousTry[identity] {
1599				continue
1600			}
1601			if _, exists := triesByIdentity[identity]; exists {
1602				delete(triesByIdentity, identity)
1603				ambiguousTry[identity] = true
1604				continue
1605			}
1606			triesByIdentity[identity] = row
1607		}
1608		for i := range m.remotes {
1609			key := string(m.remotes[i].Repo.Forge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName)
1610			identity := ""
1611			for _, raw := range []string{m.remotes[i].Repo.CloneURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.SSHURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.URL} {
1612				if identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
1613					break
1614				}
1615			}
1616			repository, repoOK := byRemote[key]
1617			try, tryOK := triesByIdentity[identity]
1618			sameCheckout := repoOK && tryOK && remotePathsOverlap(repository, try)
1619			if ambiguous[key] || ambiguousTry[identity] || (repoOK && tryOK && !sameCheckout) {
1620				m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1621				continue
1622			}
1623			if repoOK {
1624				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = repository.Repo.Path
1625				m.remotes[i].LocalName = repository.Repo.Display()
1626				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1627				if repository.Asset != nil {
1628					m.remotes[i].LocalKind = repository.Asset.Kind
1629				}
1630				continue
1631			}
1632			if tryOK {
1633				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = try.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1634				m.remotes[i].LocalName = try.Item.DisplayName()
1635				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindTry
1636				continue
1637			}
1638			m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1639		}
1640	}
1641	
1642	func remotePathsOverlap(repository RepoRow, try TryRow) bool {
1643		for _, left := range []string{repository.Repo.Path, repository.Repo.RealPath} {
1644			for _, right := range []string{try.Item.Live.CurrentPath, try.Item.Live.RealPath} {
1645				if left != "" && right != "" && filepath.Clean(left) == filepath.Clean(right) {
1646					return true
1647				}
1648			}
1649		}
1650		return false
1651	}
1652	
1653	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
1654	// tools and for the cd directive.
1655	func (m Model) currentDir() string {
1656		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1657			if r.CheckoutExists {
1658				return r.Checkout
1659			}
1660			return ""
1661		}
1662		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
1663			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
1664				if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
1665					return checkout.Worktree.Path
1666				}
1667				return ""
1668			}
1669			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
1670		}
1671		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Present() {
1672			return r.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1673		}
1674		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
1675			return r.LocalPath
1676		}
1677		return ""
1678	}
1679	
1680	// Update implements tea.Model.
1681	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
1682		switch msg := msg.(type) {
1683		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
1684			m.width, m.height = msg.Width, msg.Height
1685			return m, nil
1686	
1687		case localMsg:
1688			if msg.done {
1689				request := msg.load.Request
1690				current := m.localGeneration == request.CycleGeneration
1691				if !current {
1692					return m, nil
1693				}
1694				m.finishLocalLoad()
1695				m.forceSizeReload = false
1696				return m.beginSizeLoad(request.ForceSizes)
1697			}
1698			var accepted bool
1699			m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(msg.result)
1700			next := waitForLocal(msg.load)
1701			if accepted && msg.result.View == ViewRepos {
1702				if fleet := m.afterReposResult(msg.result.Valid, msg.result.Err); fleet != nil {
1703					return m, tea.Batch(next, fleet)
1704				}
1705			}
1706			return m, next
1707	
1708		case reloadMsg:
1709			acceptedLocal := false
1710			reposAccepted := false
1711			if msg.rowsSet && m.applyViewResult(
1712				ViewTasks, msg.rowsGeneration, msg.rowsValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1713				resultFreshness(msg.rowsErr), len(msg.rows), msg.rowsErr, msg.rowsValid,
1714			) {
1715				if msg.rowsValid {
1716					m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), msg.rows...)
1717				}
1718				acceptedLocal = true
1719			}
1720			if msg.reposSet && m.applyViewResult(
1721				ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1722				resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
1723			) {
1724				if msg.reposValid {
1725					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
1726					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1727				}
1728				acceptedLocal = true
1729				reposAccepted = true
1730			}
1731			if msg.triesSet && m.applyViewResult(
1732				ViewTries, msg.triesGeneration, msg.triesValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1733				resultFreshness(msg.triesErr), len(msg.tries), msg.triesErr, msg.triesValid,
1734			) {
1735				if msg.triesValid {
1736					m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), msg.tries...)
1737					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1738				}
1739				acceptedLocal = true
1740			}
1741			if msg.remoteSet && m.applyViewResult(
1742				ViewRemote, msg.remoteGeneration, msg.remoteValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1743				resultFreshness(msg.remoteErr), len(msg.remotes), msg.remoteErr, msg.remoteValid,
1744			) && msg.remoteValid {
1745				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.remotes...)
1746			}
1747			if acceptedLocal {
1748				m.forceSizeReload = false
1749			}
1750			m.setAt(m.at())
1751			m, sizeCmd := m.beginSizeLoad(msg.forceSizes)
1752			if reposAccepted {
1753				if fleetCmd := m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr); fleetCmd != nil {
1754					return m, tea.Batch(sizeCmd, fleetCmd)
1755				}
1756			}
1757			return m, sizeCmd
1758	
1759		case sizeMsg:
1760			if msg.loadID == 0 || msg.loadID != m.sizeLoad.ID {
1761				return m, nil
1762			}
1763			if msg.done {
1764				m.sizeLoad = diskusage.Load{}
1765				return m, nil
1766			}
1767			m.applySizeResult(msg.result)
1768			return m, waitForSize(m.sizeLoad)
1769	
1770		case remoteCacheMsg:
1771			if !msg.result.Found {
1772				return m, nil
1773			}
1774			freshness := perftrace.FreshnessFresh
1775			if msg.result.Stale {
1776				freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
1777			}
1778			if m.applyCacheSeed(ViewRemote, msg.generation, len(msg.result.Rows), freshness) {
1779				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.result.Rows...)
1780				m.matchRemoteLocals()
1781			}
1782			return m, nil
1783	
1784		case fleetCacheMsg:
1785			if !msg.result.Found {
1786				return m, nil
1787			}
1788			if m.applyCacheSeed(ViewFleet, msg.generation, len(msg.result.Rows), perftrace.FreshnessStale) {
1789				m.fleet = append([]FleetRow(nil), msg.result.Rows...)
1790			}
1791			return m, nil
1792	
1793		case remoteMsg:
1794			if !m.applyViewResult(
1795				ViewRemote, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1796				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1797			) {
1798				return m, nil
1799			}
1800			if msg.valid {
1801				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.rows...)
1802				if msg.matchLocals {
1803					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1804				}
1805			}
1806			m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "")
1807			m.setAt(m.at())
1808			return m, nil
1809	
1810		case fleetMsg:
1811			if !m.applyViewResult(
1812				ViewFleet, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1813				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1814			) {
1815				return m, nil
1816			}
1817			if msg.valid {
1818				m.fleet = append([]FleetRow(nil), msg.rows...)
1819			}
1820			m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "")
1821			m.setAt(m.at())
1822			return m, nil
1823	
1824		case skillsMsg:
1825			if !m.applyViewResult(
1826				ViewSkills, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1827				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1828			) {
1829				return m, nil
1830			}
1831			m.skillsChecking = false
1832			m.skillsInventoryErr = msg.inventoryErr
1833			if msg.valid {
1834				m.skills = append([]agentskill.Skill(nil), msg.rows...)
1835			}
1836			switch {
1837			case msg.err != nil:
1838				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "")
1839			case msg.status != "":
1840				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, msg.status)
1841			case msg.checked:
1842				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "skill update check complete")
1843			default:
1844				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "")
1845			}
1846			m.setAt(m.at())
1847			return m, nil
1848	
1849		case mcpMsg:
1850			if !m.applyViewResult(
1851				ViewMCP, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1852				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1853			) {
1854				return m, nil
1855			}
1856			if msg.valid {
1857				m.mcp = append([]agentmcp.Declaration(nil), msg.rows...)
1858			}
1859			m.setViewStatus(ViewMCP, "")
1860			m.setAt(m.at())
1861			return m, nil
1862	
1863		case toolsMsg:
1864			if msg.generation != m.toolGeneration {
1865				return m, nil
1866			}
1867			m.actions.Tools = append([]Tool(nil), msg.tools...)
1868			return m, nil
1869	
1870		case skillProcessMsg:
1871			if msg.err != nil {
1872				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1873				return m, nil
1874			}
1875			m.err = nil
1876			m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadAction)
1877			if msg.action == "update" {
1878				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "reloading and verifying "+msg.name+"…")
1879				return m, m.reloadUpdatedSkill(msg.name, msg.lockName, msg.scope, msg.checkout)
1880			}
1881			m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "reloading agent skills…")
1882			return m, m.reloadSkills()
1883	
1884		case statsBackfilledMsg:
1885			if msg.err != nil {
1886				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1887				return m, nil
1888			}
1889			m.status = "backfill complete; loading heatmap…"
1890			return m, m.loadStats(msg.repo)
1891	
1892		case configEditedMsg:
1893			if msg.err != nil {
1894				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1895				return m, nil
1896			}
1897			m.beginConfigLoad()
1898			m.status = "reloading config…"
1899			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
1900	
1901		case fleetConfigEditedMsg:
1902			if msg.err != nil {
1903				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1904				return m, nil
1905			}
1906			if m.actions.ValidateFleetConfig != nil {
1907				if err := m.actions.ValidateFleetConfig(); err != nil {
1908					// A rejected file is still on disk; showing the parse error is
1909					// the only way the user learns why the fleet did not change.
1910					m.err, m.status = err, "remotes.toml was not applied"
1911					return m, nil
1912				}
1913			}
1914			m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadConfig)
1915			m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "refreshing fleet…")
1916			return m, m.reloadFleet()
1917	
1918		case configMsg:
1919			if msg.generation != m.configGeneration {
1920				return m, nil
1921			}
1922			if m.configCancel != nil {
1923				m.configCancel()
1924				m.configCancel, m.configContext = nil, nil
1925			}
1926			if msg.err != nil {
1927				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1928				m.forceSizeReload = false
1929				return m, nil
1930			}
1931			if msg.update.Apply != nil {
1932				msg.update.Apply()
1933			}
1934			m.beginLocalLoads(loadConfig)
1935			if msg.refreshRemote {
1936				m.beginViewLoad(ViewRemote, loadConfig)
1937			} else {
1938				m.invalidateView(ViewRemote)
1939			}
1940			m.actions.Tools = append([]Tool(nil), msg.update.Tools...)
1941			m.toolGeneration++
1942			m.actions.RepoColumns = append([]string(nil), msg.update.RepoColumns...)
1943			m.actions.RepoSort = msg.update.RepoSort
1944			m.actions.RepoReverse = msg.update.RepoReverse
1945			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
1946			reload := m.reloadAfterConfig(msg.refreshRemote)
1947			if len(m.actions.Tools) == 0 {
1948				return m, reload
1949			}
1950			return m, tea.Batch(reload, m.probeTools())
1951	
1952		case statsMsg:
1953			if msg.err != nil {
1954				m.err = msg.err
1955				m.stats = nil
1956			} else {
1957				m.err = nil
1958				m.stats = &msg.panel
1959			}
1960			m.status = ""
1961			return m, nil
1962	
1963		case triesMsg:
1964			accepted := false
1965			reposAccepted := false
1966			if msg.triesSet && m.applyViewResult(
1967				ViewTries, msg.triesGeneration, msg.triesValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1968				resultFreshness(msg.triesErr), len(msg.tries), msg.triesErr, msg.triesValid,
1969			) {
1970				if msg.triesValid {
1971					m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), msg.tries...)
1972					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1973				}
1974				accepted = true
1975			}
1976			if msg.reposSet && m.applyViewResult(
1977				ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1978				resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
1979			) {
1980				if msg.reposValid {
1981					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
1982					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1983				}
1984				accepted = true
1985				reposAccepted = true
1986			}
1987			m.setAt(m.at())
1988			var sizeCmd tea.Cmd
1989			if accepted {
1990				m, sizeCmd = m.beginSizeLoad(false)
1991			}
1992			if reposAccepted {
1993				if fleetCmd := m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr); fleetCmd != nil {
1994					return m, tea.Batch(sizeCmd, fleetCmd)
1995				}
1996			}
1997			return m, sizeCmd
1998	
1999		case tryActionMsg:
2000			if msg.err != nil {
2001				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
2002				if msg.result.RefreshRepos {
2003					m.beginTryLoads(true, loadAction)
2004					return m, m.reloadTries(true)
2005				}
2006				return m, nil
2007			}
2008			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.result.Status
2009			if msg.result.CD != "" {
2010				m.chosen, m.quitting = msg.result.CD, true
2011				return m, tea.Quit
2012			}
2013			if msg.result.RuntimeHandle != "" {
2014				m.activate, m.quitting = msg.result.RuntimeHandle, true
2015				return m, tea.Quit
2016			}
2017			m.beginTryLoads(msg.result.RefreshRepos, loadAction)
2018			return m, m.reloadTries(msg.result.RefreshRepos)
2019	
2020		case noteListMsg:
2021			var fleetCmd, sizeCmd tea.Cmd
2022			if msg.reposSet {
2023				accepted := m.applyViewResult(
2024					ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2025					resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
2026				)
2027				if accepted && msg.reposValid {
2028					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
2029					m.matchRemoteLocals()
2030				}
2031				if accepted {
2032					m, sizeCmd = m.beginSizeLoad(false)
2033					fleetCmd = m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr)
2034				}
2035			}
2036			followup := batchCommands(sizeCmd, fleetCmd)
2037			if msg.request != m.noteRequest || msg.targetKey != m.noteTarget.Key() || !m.noteMode() {
2038				return m, followup // note overlay moved; independent REPOS result is still resolved
2039			}
2040			m.noteLoading = false
2041			if msg.err != nil {
2042				m.err = msg.err
2043				return m, followup
2044			}
2045			m.notes, m.err = msg.notes, nil
2046			m.clampNoteCursor()
2047			return m, followup
2048	
2049		case noteActionMsg:
2050			if msg.err != nil {
2051				m.err = msg.err
2052				return m, nil
2053			}
2054			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
2055			if msg.returnBrowse {
2056				m.mode, m.noteLoading = modeNoteBrowse, true
2057				return m.beginNoteLoad(true)
2058			}
2059			m.mode = modeList
2060			m.beginLocalLoads(loadAction)
2061			return m, m.reload()
2062	
2063		case actionMsg:
2064			if msg.err != nil {
2065				m.err = msg.err
2066				return m, nil
2067			}
2068			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
2069			m.forceSizeReload = msg.forceSizes
2070			if msg.remoteName != "" && msg.localPath != "" {
2071				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
2072				for i := range m.remotes {
2073					if m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName == msg.remoteName {
2074						m.remotes[i].LocalPath = msg.localPath
2075						break
2076					}
2077				}
2078			}
2079			if msg.cd != "" {
2080				// Under a runtime with no sessions the only useful outcome is
2081				// putting the user in the directory, which needs the alternate
2082				// screen torn down first.
2083				m.chosen, m.quitting = msg.cd, true
2084				return m, tea.Quit
2085			}
2086			if msg.activate != "" {
2087				m.activate, m.quitting = msg.activate, true
2088				return m, tea.Quit
2089			}
2090			// Clone already updated the selected REMOTE row; only local data
2091			// needs a refresh. A network round-trip here would make a successful
2092			// clone feel hung for several seconds.
2093			m.beginLocalLoads(loadAction)
2094			return m, m.reload()
2095	
2096		case copyMsg:
2097			if msg.err != nil {
2098				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
2099			} else {
2100				m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
2101			}
2102			return m, nil
2103	
2104		case tea.KeyMsg:
2105			fields := perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.View(m.view.String())}
2106			m.trace.MarkOnce(perftrace.TUIFirstKeyReceived, fields)
2107			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIKeyUpdate, fields)
2108			defer finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
2109			if m.mode == modeNoteBrowse || m.mode == modeNoteAdd ||
2110				m.mode == modeNoteSearch || m.mode == modeNoteConfirmDelete {
2111				return m.updateNotes(msg)
2112			}
2113			if m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
2114				return m.updateOverlay(msg)
2115			}
2116			if m.mode == modeStats {
2117				return m.updateStats(msg)
2118			}
2119			if m.mode == modeCopy {
2120				return m.updateCopy(msg)
2121			}
2122			switch m.mode {
2123			case modeFilter:
2124				return m.updateFilter(msg)
2125			case modeEditNext, modeConfirmPark, modeStartTask, modeStartDirect, modeConfirmClone, modeConfirmSkillUpdate:
2126				return m.updatePrompt(msg)
2127			}
2128			return m.updateList(msg)
2129		}
2130		return m, nil
2131	}
2132	
2133	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2134		n := m.count()
2135		page := m.listHeight() / 2
2136		if page < 1 {
2137			page = 1
2138		}
2139	
2140		switch msg.String() {
2141		case "q", "ctrl+c":
2142			m.quitting = true
2143			return m, tea.Quit
2144		case "esc":
2145			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
2146			// becomes the meaning of the key.
2147			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
2148				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
2149				m.setAt(0)
2150				return m, nil
2151			}
2152			m.quitting = true
2153			return m, tea.Quit
2154	
2155		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
2156		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
2157			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
2158		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
2159			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
2160		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
2161			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
2162		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
2163			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
2164		case "g", "home":
2165			m.setAt(0)
2166		case "G", "end":
2167			m.setAt(n - 1)
2168	
2169		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
2170		// no horizontal axis of its own.
2171		case "tab", "l", "right":
2172			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
2173			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2174		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
2175			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]
2176			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2177	
2178		case "/":
2179			m.mode = modeFilter
2180			m.input.SetValue(m.filter)
2181			m.input.Placeholder = "filter"
2182			m.input.CursorEnd()
2183			m.input.Focus()
2184			return m, textinput.Blink
2185	
2186		case "?":
2187			return m.openHelpOverlay(), nil
2188	
2189		case "n":
2190			if m.view == ViewTries {
2191				return m.openTryForm(TryCreate, TryRow{})
2192			}
2193			if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
2194				return m.openNoteAdd(target, false)
2195			}

2504	func (m Model) beginNoteLoad(refreshRepos bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
2505		m.noteRequest++
2506		request, targetKey, target := m.noteRequest, m.noteTarget.Key(), m.noteTarget
2507		reposGeneration := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation
2508		if refreshRepos {
2509			reposGeneration = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadAction)
2510		}
2511		query := m.noteQuery
2512		m.noteLoading = true
2513		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2514			if m.actions.Notes.List == nil {
2515				return noteListMsg{request: request, targetKey: targetKey, reposGeneration: reposGeneration}
2516			}
2517			var (
2518				notes []*note.Note
2519				err   error
2520			)
2521			if query != "" && m.actions.Notes.Search != nil {
2522				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.Search(m.baseContext(), target, query)
2523			} else {
2524				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.List(m.baseContext(), target)
2525			}
2526			msg := noteListMsg{
2527				notes: notes, request: request, targetKey: targetKey, err: err,
2528				reposGeneration: reposGeneration,
2529			}
2530			if refreshRepos && m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
2531				msg.repos, msg.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(m.viewContext(ViewRepos))
2532				msg.reposSet, msg.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(msg.repos, msg.reposErr)
2533			}
2534			return msg
2535		}
2536	}

2556	func (m Model) updateNotes(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2557		switch m.mode {
2558		case modeNoteBrowse:
2559			switch msg.String() {

2561				m.mode, m.notes, m.noteQuery, m.err = modeList, nil, "", nil
2562				m.noteRequest++

2568			case "k", "up":

2570				m.noteExpanded = false
2571				m.clampNoteCursor()
2572			case "g", "home":
2573				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = 0, false
2574			case "G", "end":
2575				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = len(m.notes)-1, false
2576				m.clampNoteCursor()
2577			case "enter":
2578				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
2579					m.noteExpanded = !m.noteExpanded
2580				}
2581			case "a", "n":
2582				return m.openNoteAdd(m.noteTarget, true)
2583			case "/":
2584				m.mode = modeNoteSearch
2585				m.input.SetValue(m.noteQuery)
2586				m.input.Placeholder = "search body, tags, repo"
2587				m.input.CursorEnd()
2588				return m, m.input.Focus()
2589			case "d":
2590				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
2591					m.mode = modeNoteConfirmDelete
2592				}
2593			case "e":
2594				n, ok := m.currentNote()
2595				if !ok || m.actions.Notes.Edit == nil {
2596					return m, nil
2597				}
2598				edit, err := m.actions.Notes.Edit(n)
2599				if err != nil {
2600					m.err = err
2601					return m, nil
2602				}
2603				return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
2604					if edit.Complete != nil {
2605						runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
2606					}
2607					return noteActionMsg{status: "updated note " + n.ID[:8], returnBrowse: true, err: runErr}
2608				})
2609			}
2610			return m, nil
2611	
2612		case modeNoteAdd:
2613			switch msg.String() {
2614			case "esc":
2615				m.input.Blur()
2616				if m.noteReturnToBrowse {
2617					m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
2618				} else {
2619					m.mode = modeList
2620				}
2621				return m, nil
2622			case "enter":

2628				m.input.Blur()
2629				returnBrowse := m.noteReturnToBrowse

2631					status, err := m.actions.Notes.Add(context.Background(), m.noteTarget, body)
2632					return noteActionMsg{status: status, returnBrowse: returnBrowse, err: err}
2633				}
2634			}
2635			input, cmd := m.input.Update(msg)
2636			m.input = input
2637			return m, cmd
2638	
2639		case modeNoteSearch:

2641			case "esc":

2675	func (m Model) updateCopy(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2676		if msg.String() == "esc" {
2677			m.mode = modeList
2678			return m, nil
2679		}
2680		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
2681		if !ok {
2682			m.mode = modeList
2683			return m, nil
2684		}
2685		checkoutIndex := -1
2686		if item.child() {
2687			checkoutIndex = item.CheckoutIndex
2688		}
2689	
2690		var payload, label string
2691		switch msg.String() {
2692		case "y":
2693			payload = inventory.FormatRepoContext(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2694			if item.child() {
2695				label = "worktree context"
2696			} else {
2697				label = "repo context"
2698			}
2699		case "p":
2700			label = "checkout path"
2701			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
2702				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Worktree.Path
2703			} else {
2704				payload = item.Repo.Repo.Path
2705			}
2706		case "b":
2707			label = "branch"
2708			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
2709				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Branch()
2710			} else if main, found := item.Repo.Context.Main(); found {
2711				payload = main.Branch()
2712			} else {
2713				payload = item.Repo.Status.Branch
2714			}
2715			if payload == "" {
2716				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("selected checkout has detached HEAD")
2717				return m, nil
2718			}
2719		case "s":
2720			label = "runtime sessions"
2721			payload = inventory.FormatSessions(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
2722			if payload == "" {
2723				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no live runtime sessions to copy")
2724				return m, nil
2725			}
2726		case "w":
2727			label = "worktree paths"
2728			payload = inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(item.Repo.Context)
2729			if payload == "" {
2730				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no linked worktrees to copy")
2731				return m, nil
2732			}
2733		default:
2734			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown copy key %q", msg.String())
2735			return m, nil
2736		}
2737	
2738		m.mode = modeList
2739		if m.actions.Copy == nil {
2740			m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable; use `dev repo context`")
2741			return m, nil
2742		}
2743		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2744			err := m.actions.Copy(payload)
2745			if err != nil {
2746				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w; use `dev repo context` as a fallback", label, err)}
2747			}
2748			return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
2749		}
2750	}

153	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
155			return m, nil
156		}
157		if index < 0 {
158			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
159		}
160		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {
161			index = 0
162		}
163		for fieldIndex := 0; fieldIndex < m.overlay.fieldCount; fieldIndex++ {
164			m.overlay.fields[fieldIndex].input.Blur()

170	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
171		switch m.overlay.kind {
172		case overlayHelp:
173			switch message.String() {
174			case "esc", "?", "q":
175				m.overlay = overlayState{}
176			}
177			return m, nil
178	
179		case overlayTryMenu:
180			switch message.String() {
181			case "esc", "q":
182				m.overlay = overlayState{}
183				return m, nil
184			case "j", "down":
185				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
186					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
187				}
188				return m, nil
189			case "k", "up":
190				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
191					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
192				}
193				return m, nil
194			case "enter":
195				if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
196					return m, nil
197				}
198				action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
199				row := m.overlay.target
200				switch action {
201				case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
202					return m.openTryForm(action, row)
203				case TryArchive:
204					return m.openTryConfirmation(action, row)
205				case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
206					m.overlay = overlayState{}
207					m.status = string(action) + " in progress…"
208					return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: action, ID: row.Item.ID})
209				}
210			}
211			return m, nil
212	
213		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
214			switch message.String() {
215			case "esc":
216				m.overlay = overlayState{}
217				m.err = nil
218				return m, nil
219			case "tab", "down":
220				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
221			case "shift+tab", "up":
222				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
223			case "enter":
224				return m.submitTryOverlay()
225			}
226			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
227			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
228			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
229			return m, command
230		}
231		return m, nil
232	}
233	
234	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
235		value := func(key string) string {
236			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
237				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
238					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
239				}
240			}
241			return ""
242		}
243		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
244			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
245			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
246			note := value("note")
247			m.overlay = overlayState{}
248			m.err = nil
249			m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil
260			}
261			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
262			if !ok {
263				m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
264				return m, nil
265			}
266			request.NoGit = !gitInit
267		case TryMark:
268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:
275			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
276				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:
280			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil
285		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
286		return m, m.applyTry(request)
287	}

289	func (m Model) renderOverlay() string {
290		var builder strings.Builder
291		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  "+strings.ToUpper(m.overlay.title)) + "\n\n")
292		switch m.overlay.kind {
293		case overlayHelp:
294			builder.WriteString("  navigation\n")
295			builder.WriteString("    j/k, arrows move · ctrl+d/u page · g/G first/last · tab/h/l switch view\n")
296			builder.WriteString("    / filter · 0 clear · r reload · esc close/clear/quit · q quit\n\n")
297			builder.WriteString("  TASKS   enter open · n add note · N notes · p park · c next · 1/2/3 state · a done\n")
298			builder.WriteString("  REPOS   enter open · n add note · N notes · space worktrees · m metadata · y copy · s worktree task · d direct task · O/R sort\n")
299			builder.WriteString("  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · e edit remotes.toml · r refresh · read-only Git overview\n")
300			builder.WriteString("  TRY     enter open · n create · space actions · a history · O/R sort\n")
301			builder.WriteString("  REMOTE  enter open local · n/N notes when cloned · c clone\n")
302			builder.WriteString("  SKILLS  a interactive add · c check updates · u update selected\n")
303			builder.WriteString("  MCP     static declarations only · r reload\n\n")
304			builder.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("? / esc / q close help"))
305	
306		case overlayTryMenu:
307			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.target.Item.DisplayName(), contract(m.overlay.target.Item.Live.CurrentPath)))
308			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.optionCount; index++ {
309				prefix := "  "
310				line := fmt.Sprintf("%-12s %s", m.overlay.options[index], m.overlay.optionLabels[index])
311				if index == m.overlay.optionIndex {
312					prefix = "▸ "
313					line = styleSelected.Render(line)
314				}
315				builder.WriteString(prefix + line + "\n")
316			}
317			builder.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("j/k choose · enter continue · esc cancel"))
318	
319		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
320			if m.overlay.target.Item.ID != "" {
321				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.target.Item.DisplayName(), contract(m.overlay.target.Item.Live.CurrentPath)))
322			} else if m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Path != "" {
323				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Display(), contract(m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Path)))
324			}
325			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
326				marker := "  "
327				if index == m.overlay.fieldIndex {
328					marker = "▸ "
329				}
330				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s%-10s %s\n", marker, m.overlay.fields[index].label+":", m.overlay.fields[index].input.View()))
331			}
332			if m.err != nil {
333				builder.WriteString("\n  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()))
334			}
335			builder.WriteString("\n\n  " + styleHelp.Render("tab field · enter submit · esc cancel"))
336		}
337		return builder.String()
338	}

170	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
171		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
172		if generation != state.generation {
173			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
174				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
175				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
176			})
177			return false
178		}
179		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
180		count := rows
181		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
182			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
183			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
184			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
185		})
186		return true
187	}

189	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
190	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
191	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
192	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
196		if generation != state.generation {
197			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
214				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
219			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
220		}
221		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
222		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
223			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
224			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
225			Generation: generation,
226		})
227		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
228			cancel()
229			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
230			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
231		}
232		return true
233	}

235	func resultFreshness(err error) perftrace.Freshness {
236		if err != nil {
237			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
238		}
239		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
240	}
241	
242	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
243		switch {
244		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
245			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
246		case err != nil && valid:
247			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
248		case err != nil || !valid:
249			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
250		default:
251			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
252		}
253	}

255	func (m Model) viewLoad(view View) viewLoadState { return m.loads[int(view)] }

258		state := m.viewLoad(view)
259		if state.loading {
260			return false
261		}
262		if state.hasSnapshot && state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh {
263			return false
264		}
265		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
266	}

17	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
18	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
19	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
20	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
21	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
22		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
23		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
24		// terminal width.
25		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
26		h := m.height - fixed
27		if h < 3 {
28			return 3
29		}
30		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
31		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
32			h--
33		}
34		return h
35	}
36	
37	func (m Model) listPreambleLines() int {
38		lines := 1 // the table header, or the one-line empty/loading state
39		switch m.view {
40		case ViewRemote:
41			if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.visibleRemotes()) > 0 {
42				lines++
43			}
44		case ViewSkills:
45			if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading && len(m.visibleSkills()) > 0 {
46				lines++
47			}
48		case ViewMCP:
49			if m.viewLoad(ViewMCP).loading && len(m.visibleMCP()) > 0 {
50				lines++
51			}
52		}
53		return lines
54	}
55	
56	func lineCount(s string) int {
57		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
58		if s == "" {
59			return 0
60		}
61		return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
62	}
63	
64	// View implements tea.Model.
65	func (m Model) View() (output string) {
66		defer func() {
67			m.trace.MarkOnce(perftrace.TUIInitialViewReturned, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.View(m.view.String())})
68			m.signalFirstView()
69		}()
70		if m.quitting {
71			return ""
72		}
73		if m.noteMode() {
74			return m.renderNotes()
75		}
76		if m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
77			return m.renderOverlay()
78		}
79		if m.mode == modeStats {
80			return m.renderStats()
81		}
82		var b strings.Builder
83		b.WriteString(m.renderHeader())
84		b.WriteString("\n")
85	
86		switch m.view {
87		case ViewRepos:
88			b.WriteString(m.renderRepos())
89		case ViewFleet:
90			b.WriteString(m.renderFleet())
91		case ViewTries:
92			b.WriteString(m.renderTries())
93		case ViewRemote:
94			b.WriteString(m.renderRemotes())
95		case ViewSkills:
96			b.WriteString(m.renderSkills())
97		case ViewMCP:
98			b.WriteString(m.renderMCP())
99		default:
100			b.WriteString(m.renderTasks())
101		}
102	
103		b.WriteString("\n")
104		b.WriteString(m.renderDetail())
105		b.WriteString("\n")
106		b.WriteString(m.renderFooter())
107		return b.String()
108	}
109	
110	func (m Model) renderStats() string {
111		var b strings.Builder
112		title := "repo activity"
113		if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
114			title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
115		}
116		b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
117		if m.err != nil {
118			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
119		} else if m.stats == nil {
120			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading activity…") + "\n")
121		} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
122			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
123			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
124		} else {
125			b.WriteString(m.stats.Heatmap)
126			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
127				styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
128				m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
129		}
130		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
131		return b.String()
132	}
133	
134	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
135		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
136		if d < time.Hour {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
138		}
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
140	}
141	
142	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
143	// is another one — is never in doubt.
144	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
145		build := func(compact, summary bool) string {
146			short := map[View]string{
147				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
148				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
149			}
150			var tabs []string
151			for _, view := range Views {
152				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
153				if compact {
154					name = short[view]
155				}
156				label := name
157				if !compact {
158					label = " " + name + " "
159				}
160				if view == m.view {
161					tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
162				} else {
163					tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
164				}
165			}
166			line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│"))
167			if summary {
168				line += "   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
169			}
170			if m.filter != "" {
171				line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
172			}
173			return line
174		}
175		line := build(false, true)
176		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
177			line = build(false, false)
178		}
179		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
180			line = build(true, false)
181		}
182		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
183			line = styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + styleSelected.Render(strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()))
184			if m.filter != "" {
185				available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(line) - 4
186				if available > 1 {
187					line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
188				}
189			}
190		}
191		return line + "\n"
192	}
193	
194	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
195	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
196	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
197		h := m.listHeight()
198		if n <= h {
199			return 0, n
200		}
201		from = m.at() - h/2
202		if from < 0 {
203			from = 0
204		}
205		if from+h > n {
206			from = n - h
207		}
208		return from, from + h
209	}

211	const (
212		taskRepoBreakpoint = 97
213		taskRepoWidth      = 16
214	)
215	
216	func (m Model) renderTasks() string {
217		rows := m.visibleTasks()
218		if len(rows) == 0 {
219			return m.emptyTasks()
220		}
221		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
222		showRepo := m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint
223	
224		headers := []string{
225			fitCell("TASK", nameW),
226			fitCell("STATE", 6),
227		}
228		if showRepo {
229			headers = append(headers, fitCell("REPO", taskRepoWidth))
230		}
231		headers = append(headers,
232			fitCell("BRANCH", branchW),
233			fitCell("GIT", 16),
234			fitCell("AGE", 5),
235			fitCell("NEXT", nextW),
236		)
237	
238		var b strings.Builder
239		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
240	
241		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
242		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
243			r := rows[i]
244			cells := []string{
245				fitCell(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
246				fitCell(r.Task.State.Label(), 6),
247			}
248			if showRepo {
249				cells = append(cells, fitCell(r.Task.Repo, taskRepoWidth))
250			}
251			cells = append(cells,
252				fitCell(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
253				fitCell(gitColumn(r), 16),
254				fitCell(shortAge(r), 5),
255				fitCell(nextColumn(r), nextW),
256			)
257			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
258			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))
259		}
260		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
261		return b.String()
262	}
263	
264	func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
265		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
266		if len(items) == 0 {
267			if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
268				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
269			}
270			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
271				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
272		}
273		columns := m.repoColumns()
274	
275		var b strings.Builder
276		var headers []string
277		for _, c := range columns {
278			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
279		}
280		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
281	
282		from, to := m.window(len(items))
283		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
284			item := items[i]
285			r := item.Repo
286			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
287			for _, c := range columns {
288				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
289			}
290			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
291			styled := line
292			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
293				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
294					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
295				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
296					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
297					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
298				}
299			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
300				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
301			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
302				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
303			}
304			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
305		}
306		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
307		return b.String()
308	}
309	
310	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
311		r := item.Repo
312		checkout, child := item.checkout()
313		if !child {
314			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
315				marker := "▸ "
316				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
317					marker = "▾ "
318				}
319				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
320			}
321			if name == "live" {
322				return parentLiveColumn(r)
323			}
324			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
325		}
326	
327		switch name {
328		case "repo":
329			connector := "├─ "
330			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
331				connector = "└─ "
332			}
333			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
334			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
335				label = checkout.Branch()
336			}
337			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
338				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
339			}
340			return connector + label
341		case "branch":
342			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
343				return branch
344			}
345			return "(detached)"
346		case "git":
347			switch {
348			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
349				return "prunable"
350			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
351				return "locked"
352			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
353				return "?"
354			default:
355				return checkout.Status.Summary()
356			}
357		case "live":
358			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout)
359		case "latest":
360			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
361		case "worktrees":
362			return "—"
363		case "tasks":
364			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
365		case "notes":
366			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
367				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
368			}
369			return "—"
370		case "category":
371			return "—"
372		case "path":
373			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
374		}
375		return ""
376	}
377	
378	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
379		sessions := r.Sessions()
380		if len(sessions) == 0 {
381			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
382		}
383		if len(sessions) > 1 {
384			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
385		}
386		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
387		if status != "" {
388			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
389		}
390		return r.Runtime
391	}
392	
393	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) string {
394		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
395			return "closed"
396		}
397		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
398			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
399		}
400		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
401			return runtimeName + ":" + status
402		}
403		return runtimeName
404	}
405	
406	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
407		if len(tasks) == 0 {
408			return "—"
409		}
410		counts := map[task.State]int{}
411		for _, t := range tasks {
412			counts[t.State]++
413		}
414		var parts []string
415		for _, state := range task.States {
416			if counts[state] > 0 {
417				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
418			}
419		}
420		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
421	}
422	
423	type repoColumnSpec struct {
424		name, header string
425		width, min   int
426	}
427	
428	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
429		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
430		if len(names) == 0 {
431			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
432		}
433		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
434			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
435			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
436			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
437			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
438			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
439			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
440			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
441			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
442			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
443			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
444			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
445			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
446		}
447		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
448		for _, name := range names {
449			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
450				columns = append(columns, c)
451			}
452		}
453		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
454		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
455		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
456		for _, c := range columns {
457			total += c.width
458		}
459		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
460			for i := range columns {
461				if columns[i].name != preferred {
462					continue
463				}
464				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
465				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
466				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
467				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
468					columns[i].width--
469					total--
470				}
471			}
472			if total <= m.width {
473				break
474			}
475		}
476		return columns
477	}
478	
479	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
480		switch name {
481		case "repo":
482			return r.Repo.Display()
483		case "branch":
484			if r.Repo.Bare {
485				return "(bare)"
486			}
487			return r.Status.Branch
488		case "git":
489			if r.Repo.Bare {
490				return "—"
491			}
492			return r.Status.Summary()
493		case "remote":
494			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
495				return "?"
496			}
497			return r.Topology.Summary()
498		case "size":
499			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
500		case "live":
501			if !r.Live {
502				return "—"
503			}
504			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
505				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
506			}
507			return r.Runtime
508		case "latest":
509			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
510		case "worktrees":
511			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
512				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
513			}
514			return "—"
515		case "tasks":
516			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
517				return tasks
518			}
519			return "—"
520		case "notes":
521			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
522				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
523			}
524			return "—"
525		case "category":
526			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
527				return r.Repo.Category
528			}
529			return "—"
530		case "path":
531			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
532		}
533		return ""
534	}
535	
536	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
537		if at.IsZero() {
538			return "—"
539		}
540		d := time.Since(at)
541		switch {
542		case d < time.Hour:
543			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
544		case d < 24*time.Hour:
545			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
546		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
547			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
548		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
549			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
550		default:
551			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
552		}
553	}
554	
555	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
556		s = pad(s, width)
557		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
558			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
559		}
560		return s
561	}
562	
563	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
564		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
565			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
566		}
567		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
568		if len(rows) == 0 {
569			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
570				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
571			}
572			if m.filter != "" {
573				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
574			}
575			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
576		}
577		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
578		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
579		if descW < 12 {
580			descW = 12
581		}
582	
583		var b strings.Builder
584		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
585			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
586		}
587		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
588			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
589		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
590		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
591			r := rows[i]
592			local := "—"
593			if r.Cloned() {
594				local = "yes"
595				if r.LocalKind != "" {
596					local = string(r.LocalKind)
597					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
598						local = "repo"
599					}
600				}
601			}
602			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
603			if vis == "" {
604				vis = "—"
605			}
606			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
607				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
608				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
609			styled := line
610			if r.Cloned() {
611				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
612			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
613				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
614			}
615			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
616		}
617		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
618		return b.String()
619	}
620	
621	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
622		rows := m.visibleFleet()
623		if len(rows) == 0 {
624			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
625				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
626			}
627			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
628				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
629			}
630			if !m.showLocalFleet {
631				for _, row := range m.fleet {
632					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
633						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
634					}
635				}
636			}
637			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
638		}
639		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
640		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
641		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
642		if pathW < 12 {
643			pathW = 12
644		}
645		var b strings.Builder
646		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
647			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
648		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
649		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
650			row := rows[i]
651			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
652			if row.Repository != nil {
653				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
654				if row.Repository.Live {
655					live = row.Repository.Runtime
656					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
657						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
658					}
659				}
660				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
661			}
662			state := string(row.State)
663			if row.FromCache {
664				state = "stale"
665			}
666			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
667				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
668				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
669			styled := line
670			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
671				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
672			} else if row.State != "ok" {
673				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
674			}
675			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
676		}
677		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
678		return b.String()
679	}
680	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {

686		if len(rows) == 0 {

691				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"

695	
696		var headers []string

698		switch {
699		case m.width >= 110:
700			repoW, scopeW, skillW, installW, updateW, agentW := 16, 7, 20, 9, 10, 20
701			sourceW := max(12, m.width-96)
702			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}

705			}
706		case m.width >= 82:
707			repoW, scopeW, installW, updateW := 16, 7, 9, 10
708			flex := max(28, m.width-54)
709			skillW, agentW := flex/2, flex-flex/2
710			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}
711			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
712				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW)}
713			}
714		default:
715			repoW, updateW := 14, 10
716			skillW := max(12, m.width-30)
717			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW)}
718			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
719				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW)}
720			}
721		}
722	
723		var b strings.Builder
724		if state.loading {
725			message := "Showing installed skills while refreshing…"
726			if m.skillsChecking {
727				message = "Showing installed skills while checking sources…"
728			}
729			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render(message) + "\n")
730		}
731		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
732		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
733		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
734			row := rows[i]
735			line := strings.Join(values(row), "  ")
736			styled := line
737			switch row.UpdateStatus {
738			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
739				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
740			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
741				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
742			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
743				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
744			}
745			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
746		}
747		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
748		return b.String()
749	}

843	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
844		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
845		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
846			part := string(policy.Kind)
847			if policy.Value != "" {
848				part += ":" + policy.Value
849			}
850			if policy.Count > 0 {
851				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
852			}
853			parts = append(parts, part)
854		}
855		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
856	}

859		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
860		for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
861			part := string(credential.Kind)
862			if credential.Name != "" {
863				part += ":" + credential.Name
864			}
865			parts = append(parts, part)
866		}
867		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
868	}

870	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
871		var parts []string
872		for _, item := range []struct {
873			label string
874			n     int
875		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
876			if item.n > 0 {
877				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
878			}
879		}
880		if len(parts) == 0 {
881			return "—"
882		}
883		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
884	}

901	func skillAgentSummary(agents []string) string {
902		if len(agents) == 0 {
903			return "—"
904		}
905		if len(agents) <= 3 {

907		}
908		return strings.Join(agents[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(agents)-3)

917	
918	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
919		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
920			return "—"
921		}
922		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
923		switch {
924		case d < 24*time.Hour:
925			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
926		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
927			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
928		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
929			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
930		default:
931			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
932		}
933	}

962	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
963		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
964		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
965			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
966		}
967		avail := m.width - fixed
968		if avail < 40 {
969			avail = 40
970		}
971		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
972		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
973		next = avail - name - branch
974		if next < 10 {
975			next = 10
976		}
977		return name, branch, next
978	}

993				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +

1008				"\n  to: " + contract(filepath.Join("<project_root>", r.Repo.Name)) +
1009				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to clone into project_root · esc to cancel")
1010		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:

1012			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("update "+string(row.Scope)+" skill "+row.Name) +

1017				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("press a second key · esc to cancel")

1020		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {

1347	func (m Model) renderFooter() string {
1348		viewErr, viewStatus := m.viewError(m.view), m.viewStatus(m.view)
1349		var status string
1350		switch {
1351		case m.err != nil:
1352			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + m.err.Error())
1353		case viewErr != nil:
1354			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + viewErr.Error())
1355		case m.status != "":
1356			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + m.status)
1357		case viewStatus != "":
1358			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + viewStatus)
1359		}
1360	
1361		var bindings []string
1362		switch m.view {
1363		case ViewRepos:
1364			sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1365			if sortBy == "" {
1366				sortBy = "activity"
1367			}
1368			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1369				sortBy += "↑"
1370			}
1371			if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
1372				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open worktree", "space collapse")
1373			} else {
1374				bindings = append(bindings, "enter ad hoc", "space worktrees", "m metadata", "n add note", "N notes", "s worktree task", "d direct task")
1375			}
1376			bindings = append(bindings, "O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1377		case ViewFleet:
1378			if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil {
1379				bindings = append(bindings, "enter remote open")
1380			}
1381			local := "hidden"
1382			if m.showLocalFleet {
1383				local = "shown"
1384			}
1385			bindings = append(bindings, "a local:"+local, "r refresh")
1386		case ViewTries:
1387			sortBy := m.trySort
1388			if sortBy == "" {
1389				sortBy = "activity"
1390			}
1391			if m.tryReverse {
1392				sortBy += "↑"
1393			}
1394			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "n new", "space actions", "a history",
1395				"O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1396		case ViewRemote:
1397			if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
1398				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local", "n add note", "N notes")
1399			} else {
1400				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
1401			}
1402		case ViewSkills:
1403			bindings = append(bindings, "a add", "c check", "u update selected")
1404		case ViewMCP:
1405			bindings = append(bindings, "r reload declarations")
1406		default:
1407			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1408				if command := taskRecoveryCommand(row); command != "" {
