588			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
589				active := appState.Current()
590				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
591				if err != nil {
592					return "", err
593				}
594				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
595					return "", err
596				}
597				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
598				if err != nil {
599					return "", err
600				}
601				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
602					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
603				}
604				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
605				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
606					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
607				}
608				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
609				if err != nil {
610					return "", err
611				}
612				t := &task.Task{
613					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
614					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
615					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
616				}
617				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
618				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
619					return "", err
620				}
621				annotate(active, rt, t)
622				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
623			},

625			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
626				active := appState.Current()
627				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
628				if err != nil {
629					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
630				}
631				defer store.Close()
632				until := time.Now()
633				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
634				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
635					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
636				})
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
639				}
640				seconds, days := 0, 0
641				for _, value := range totals {
642					seconds += value
643					if value > 0 {
644						days++
645					}
646				}
647				return tui.StatsPanel{
648					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
649					Since: since, Until: until,
650					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
651						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
652					}),
653				}, nil
654			},
655

665				}
666				defer store.Close()
667				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
668				return err
669			},

688			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
689				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
690				if err != nil {
691					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
692				}
693				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
694				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
695				if err != nil {
696					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
697				}
698				status := "config + data reloaded"
699				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
700					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
701				}
702				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
703					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
704					Tools:       externalTools(next),
705					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
706					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
707					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
708				}, status, nil
709			},
710		}
711	
712		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
713		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
714		// while dozens of repos are probed.
715		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
716		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
717		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
718		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
719		cancelRun()
720		app.finishTrace()
721		if err != nil {
722			return err
723		}
724		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
725		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
726		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
727			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
728				return app.cdDirective(dir)
729			}
730			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
731				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
732				if resolveErr != nil {
733					return resolveErr
734				}
735				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
736			}
737		}
738		return nil
739	}

741	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
742		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
743		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
744	}
745	
746	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
747		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
748		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
749		if err != nil {
750			return nil, err
751		}
752		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
753		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
754		if !sessionsSet {
755			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
756		}
757		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
758		for _, item := range items {
759			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
760			if item.Entry != nil {
761				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
762					copy := location
763					row.Location = &copy
764				}
765			}
766			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
767			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
768				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
769					sizeRepo = &discovered
770				}
771			}
772			if sizeRepo != nil {
773				worktreeCount := 0
774				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
775					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
776				}
777				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
778			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
779				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
780			}
781			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
782				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
783			}
784			if item.Live.Present {
785				for _, session := range sessions {
786					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
787						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
788						row.Live = true
789						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
790						break
791					}
792				}
793			}
794			rows = append(rows, row)
795		}
796		return rows, listErr
797	}
798	
799	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
800		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
801		if err != nil {
802			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
803		}
804		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
805			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
806				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
807				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
808			})
809			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
810			return item, resolveErr
811		}
812		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
813			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
814				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
815			}
816			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
817			if openErr != nil {
818				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
819			}
820			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
821			if rt.Name() == "none" {
822				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
823			} else {
824				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
825				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
826			}
827			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
828				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
829			}
830			return result, nil
831		}
832	
833		switch request.Action {
834		case tui.TryOpen:
835			item, resolveErr := resolve()
836			if resolveErr != nil {
837				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
838			}
839			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
840	
841		case tui.TryCreate:
842			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
843				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
844			})
845			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
846			if created.InitWarning != nil {
847				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
848			}
849			if createErr != nil {
850				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
851			}
852			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
853			if created.Existing {
854				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
855			}
856			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
857			result.RefreshRepos = true
858			return result, openErr
859	
860		case tui.TryMark:
861			item, resolveErr := resolve()
862			if resolveErr != nil {
863				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
864			}
865			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
866			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
867			note := request.Note
868			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
869				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
870			})
871			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
872			return tui.TryActionResult{
873				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
874			}, patchErr
875	
876		case tui.TryDeprecate:
877			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
878			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
879			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
880	
881		case tui.TryReactivate:
882			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
883			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
884			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
885	
886		case tui.TryArchive:
887			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
888			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
889			return tui.TryActionResult{
890				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
891			}, transitionErr
892	
893		case tui.TryRestore:
894			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
895			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
896			return tui.TryActionResult{
897				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
898			}, transitionErr
899	
900		case tui.TryGraduate:
901			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
902				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
903			})
904			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
905			if graduateErr != nil {
906				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
907			}
908			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
909			result.RefreshRepos = true
910			return result, openErr
911		}
912		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
913	}
914	
915	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
916	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
917	type repoCollectOptions struct {
918		IncludeTries bool
919		Sessions     []runtime.Session
920		SessionsSet  bool
921		Tasks        []*task.Task
922		TasksSet     bool
923		Repos        []repo.Repo
924		ReposSet     bool
925		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
926	}
927	
928	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
929	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
930	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
931		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
932	}
933	
934	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
935		repos := options.Repos
936		var err error
937		if !options.ReposSet {
938			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
939			if err != nil {
940				return nil, err
941			}
942		}
943		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
944		if err != nil {
945			return nil, err
946		}
947		if !options.IncludeTries {
948			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
949			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
950			for index, repository := range repos {
951				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
952					continue
953				}
954				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
955				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
956			}
957			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
958		}
959		tasks := options.Tasks
960		if !options.TasksSet {
961			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
962			if err != nil {
963				return nil, err
964			}
965		}
966		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
967		for _, t := range tasks {
968			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
969		}
970		sessions := options.Sessions
971		if !options.SessionsSet {
972			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
973		}
974		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
975		if app.Notes != nil {
976			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
977			if noteErr != nil {
978				return nil, noteErr
979			}
980			for _, n := range allNotes {
981				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
982			}
983		}
984	
985		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
986		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
987		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
988		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
989		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
990		limiter := options.Limiter
991		if limiter == nil {
992			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
993		}
994		var wg sync.WaitGroup
995		for i, r := range repos {
996			wg.Add(1)
997			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
998				defer wg.Done()
999				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1000				if !ok {
1001					return
1002				}
1003				defer release()
1004	
1005				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1006				if row.Asset != nil {
1007					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1008					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1009					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1010						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1011					}
1012				}
1013				if r.HasGit {
1014					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1015				}
1016				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1017				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1018					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1019				}
1020				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1021				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1022				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1023				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1024					row.Status = main.Status
1025				}
1026				if !r.Bare {
1027					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1028				}
1029				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1030					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1031					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1032				}
1033				if r.HasGit {
1034					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1035						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1036						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1037					}, row.Worktrees)
1038				} else {
1039					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1040				}
1041				out[i] = row
1042			}(i, r)
1043		}
1044		wg.Wait()
1045		return out, ctx.Err()
1046	}
1047	
1048	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1049	//
1050	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1051	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1052	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1053	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1054		var out []tui.Tool
1055		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1056			run := t.Run
1057			name := t.Name
1058			if name == "" {
1059				name = firstWord(run)
1060			}
1061			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1062			if t.Interactive {
1063				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1064				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1065				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1066				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1067				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1068			}
1069			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1070				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1071				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1072			})
1073		}
1074		return out
1075	}
1076	
1077	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1078	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1079	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1080	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1081		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1082	}
1083	
1084	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1085		if ctx == nil {
1086			ctx = context.Background()
1087		}
1088		word := firstWord(run)
1089		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1090			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1091			if word == "" {
1092				return false
1093			}
1094			word = firstWord(word)
1095		}
1096		if word == "" {
1097			return false
1098		}
1099		if interactive {
1100			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1101			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1102			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1103			defer cancel()
1104			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1105				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1106			return probe.Run() == nil
1107		}
1108		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1109			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1110			return err == nil
1111		}
1112		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1113		return err == nil
1114	}
1115	
1116	func firstWord(s string) string {
1117		f := strings.Fields(s)
1118		if len(f) == 0 {
1119			return ""
1120		}
1121		return f[0]
1122	}
1123	
1124	func shellPath() string {
1125		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1126			return s
1127		}
1128		return "/bin/sh"
1129	}
1130	
1131	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1132	// of private repositories.
1133	func remoteCachePath() string {
1134		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1135	}
1136	
1137	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1138		parts := []string{
1139			"forge-source-v1",
1140			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1141			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1142			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1143		}
1144		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1145			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1146		}
1147		sort.Strings(parts)
1148		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1149		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1150	}
1151	
1152	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1153	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1154	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1155	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1156		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1157		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1158		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1159			return nil, false, false
1160		}
1161		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1162		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1163			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1164		}
1165		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1166	}
1167	
1168	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1169	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1170	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1171		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1172		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1173			return nil, false
1174		}
1175		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1176	}
1177	
1178	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1179		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1180		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1181		for _, r := range locals {
1182			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1183				continue
1184			}
1185			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1186			if ambiguous[key] {
1187				continue
1188			}
1189			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1190				delete(byRemote, key)
1191				ambiguous[key] = true
1192				continue
1193			}
1194			byRemote[key] = r
1195		}
1196		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1197		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1198			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1199			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1200				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1201				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1202				if local.Asset != nil {
1203					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1204				}
1205			}
1206			out = append(out, row)
1207		}
1208		return out
1209	}
1210	
1211	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1212	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1213	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1214	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1215		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1216		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1217			return nil, false
1218		}
1219		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1220	}
1221	
1222	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1223		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1224		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1225			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1226		}
1227		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1228	}
1229	
1230	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1231	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1232	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1233	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1234		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1235		LocalsSet    bool
1236		Providers    []forge.Forge
1237		ProvidersSet bool
1238	}
1239	
1240	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1241		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1242	}
1243	
1244	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1245		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1246	}
1247	
1248	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1249		type result struct {
1250			kind  forge.Kind
1251			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1252			err   error
1253		}
1254		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1255		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1256			if options.LocalsSet {
1257				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1258			}
1259			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1260		}
1261		providers := options.Providers
1262		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1263			providers = configuredForges(app)
1264		}
1265		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1266		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1267		available := 0
1268		var unavailable []error
1269		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1270		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1271		for _, f := range providers {
1272			if !f.Available() {
1273				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1274				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1275				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1276					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1277					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1278					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1279				}
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1283			available++
1284			wg.Add(1)
1285			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1286				defer wg.Done()
1287				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1288				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1289			}(f)
1290		}
1291		wg.Wait()
1292		close(ch)
1293		if available == 0 {
1294			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1295				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1296				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1297					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1298				}
1299				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1300			}
1301			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1302				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1303			}
1304			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1305		}
1306	
1307		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1308		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1309			old = forge.Cache{}
1310		}
1311		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1312		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1313		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1314			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1315		}
1316		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1317			statuses[kind] = status
1318		}
1319		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1320		successful := 0
1321		now := time.Now().UTC()
1322		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1323			status := statuses[kind]
1324			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1325			statuses[kind] = status
1326		}
1327		for res := range ch {
1328			if res.err != nil {
1329				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1330				status := statuses[res.kind]
1331				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1332				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1333					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1334					status.FetchedAt = now
1335					status.Complete = false
1336				}
1337				statuses[res.kind] = status
1338				continue
1339			}
1340			successful++
1341			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1342			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1343		}
1344		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1345		complete := true
1346		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1347		for kind := range expected {
1348			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1349			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1350				complete = false
1351			}
1352			if ok {
1353				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1354			}
1355			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1356		}
1357		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1358		if successful > 0 {
1359			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1360				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1361				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1362			})
1363		}
1364		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1365	}
1366	
1367	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1368		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1369			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1370				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1371			}
1372			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1373		})
1374	}
1375	
1376	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1377		providers := forge.All()
1378		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1379			return providers
1380		}
1381		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1382		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1383			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1384				Organization: target.Organization,
1385				Project:      target.Project,
1386			})
1387		}
1388		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1389	}
1390	
1391	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1392		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1393		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1394		if assetErr != nil {
1395			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1396			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1397		}
1398		type localMatch struct {
1399			repository repo.Repo
1400			asset      *catalog.Entry
1401		}
1402		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1403		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1404		for index, r := range locals {
1405			if r.Bare {
1406				continue
1407			}
1408			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1409			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1410				continue
1411			}
1412			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1413			if ambiguous[key] {
1414				continue
1415			}
1416			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1417				delete(localByRemote, key)
1418				ambiguous[key] = true
1419				continue
1420			}
1421			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1422		}
1423		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1424		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1425			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1426			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1427				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1428				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1429				if local.asset != nil {
1430					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1431				}
1432			}
1433			out = append(out, row)
1434		}
1435		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1436		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1437		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1438		return out
1439	}
1440	
1441	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1442		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1443			return
1444		}
1445		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1446		if err != nil {
1447			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1448			return
1449		}
1450		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1451			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1452		}
1453		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1454			return
1455		}
1456		host := config.Hostname()
1457		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1458		for _, entry := range entries {
1459			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1460			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1461				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1462				continue
1463			}
1464			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1465		}
1466		for index := range rows {
1467			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1468			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1469			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1470				continue
1471			}
1472			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1473			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1474			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1475			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1476		}
1477	}
1478	
1479	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1480		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1481			if candidate == "" {
1482				continue
1483			}
1484			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1485				return candidate
1486			}
1487		}
1488		return ""
1489	}

1491	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1492		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1493		if err != nil {
1494			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1495		}
1496		path := tmp.Name()
1497		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1498			_ = tmp.Close()
1499			_ = os.Remove(path)
1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1503			_ = os.Remove(path)
1504			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1505		}
1506		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1507		if err != nil {
1508			_ = os.Remove(path)
1509			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1510		}
1511		return tui.NoteEdit{
1512			Command: proc,
1513			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1514				if runErr != nil {
1515					_ = os.Remove(path)
1516					return runErr
1517				}
1518				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1519				if err != nil {
1520					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1521				}
1522				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1523					_ = os.Remove(path)
1524					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1525				}
1526				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1527				if err != nil {
1528					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1529				}
1530				_ = os.Remove(path)
1531				return nil
1532			},
1533		}, nil
1534	}

161	func (m *Model) seedViewSnapshot(view View, source perftrace.Source, freshness perftrace.Freshness, actionable bool) {
162		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
163		state.hasSnapshot = true
164		state.source = source
165		state.freshness = freshness
166		state.outcome = perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
167		state.actionable = actionable

169	
170	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
171		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
172		if generation != state.generation {
173			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
174				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
175				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
176			})
177			return false
178		}
179		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
180		count := rows
181		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
182			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
183			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
184			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
185		})
186		return true
187	}
188	
189	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
190	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
191	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
192	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
196		if generation != state.generation {
197			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
214				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
219			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
220		}
221		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
222		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
223			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
224			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
225			Generation: generation,
226		})
227		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
228			cancel()
229			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
230			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
231		}
232		return true
233	}
234	
235	func resultFreshness(err error) perftrace.Freshness {
236		if err != nil {
237			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
238		}
239		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
240	}
241	
242	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
243		switch {
244		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
245			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
246		case err != nil && valid:
247			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
248		case err != nil || !valid:
249			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
250		default:
251			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
252		}
253	}
254	
255	func (m Model) viewLoad(view View) viewLoadState { return m.loads[int(view)] }
256	
257	func (m Model) viewNeedsLoad(view View) bool {
258		state := m.viewLoad(view)
259		if state.loading {
260			return false
261		}
262		if state.hasSnapshot && state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh {
263			return false
264		}
265		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
266	}

153	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
155			return m, nil
156		}
157		if index < 0 {
158			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
159		}
160		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {

162		}

170	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
171		switch m.overlay.kind {
172		case overlayHelp:
173			switch message.String() {
174			case "esc", "?", "q":
175				m.overlay = overlayState{}
176			}
177			return m, nil
178	
179		case overlayTryMenu:
180			switch message.String() {
181			case "esc", "q":
182				m.overlay = overlayState{}
183				return m, nil
184			case "j", "down":
185				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
186					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
187				}
188				return m, nil
189			case "k", "up":
190				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
191					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
192				}
193				return m, nil
194			case "enter":
195				if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
196					return m, nil
197				}
198				action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
199				row := m.overlay.target
200				switch action {
201				case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
202					return m.openTryForm(action, row)
203				case TryArchive:
204					return m.openTryConfirmation(action, row)
205				case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
206					m.overlay = overlayState{}
207					m.status = string(action) + " in progress…"
208					return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: action, ID: row.Item.ID})
209				}
210			}
211			return m, nil
212	
213		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
214			switch message.String() {
215			case "esc":
216				m.overlay = overlayState{}
217				m.err = nil
218				return m, nil
219			case "tab", "down":
220				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
221			case "shift+tab", "up":
222				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
223			case "enter":
224				return m.submitTryOverlay()
225			}
226			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
227			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
228			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
229			return m, command
230		}
231		return m, nil
232	}

236			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
237				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
238					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
239				}
240			}
241			return ""
242		}
243		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
244			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
245			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
246			note := value("note")

250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil

264				return m, nil

268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:

277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:

281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil

1	// Package gittest builds throwaway git repositories for tests. It is a test
2	// helper that lives in a normal package so every package's tests can share it.
3	package gittest
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"os"
8		"os/exec"
9		"path/filepath"
10		"strings"
11		"testing"
12	)
13	
14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {
16		T    *testing.T
17		Root string
18	}
19	
20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49	
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.
51	func (r *Repo) Git(args ...string) string {
52		r.T.Helper()
53		return r.GitIn(r.Root, args...)
54	}
55	
56	// GitIn runs a git command in an arbitrary directory (e.g. a linked worktree).
57	func (r *Repo) GitIn(dir string, args ...string) string {
58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,
64			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
65			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
68		if err != nil {
69			r.T.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), dir, err, out)
70		}
71		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
72	}
73	
74	// Write creates or replaces a file relative to the repo root.
75	func (r *Repo) Write(rel, content string) string {
76		r.T.Helper()
77		p := filepath.Join(r.Root, rel)
78		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
79			r.T.Fatal(err)
80		}
81		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
82			r.T.Fatal(err)
83		}
84		return p
85	}
86	
87	// Commit writes a file and commits it.
88	func (r *Repo) Commit(rel, content, message string) {
89		r.T.Helper()
90		r.Write(rel, content)
91		r.Git("add", rel)
92		r.Git("commit", "-m", message)
93	}
94	
95	// Branch creates and checks out a new branch from the current HEAD.
96	func (r *Repo) Branch(name string) {
97		r.T.Helper()
98		r.Git("switch", "-c", name)
99	}
100	
101	// WithRemote turns a second bare repository into "origin" and pushes main,
102	// so tests can exercise ahead/behind and published-branch logic.
103	func (r *Repo) WithRemote() string {
104		r.T.Helper()
105		remote := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "origin.git")
106		r.GitIn(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "init", "--bare", "--initial-branch=main", remote)
107		r.Git("remote", "add", "origin", remote)
108		r.Git("push", "-u", "origin", "main")
109		return remote
110	}

112	// Ctx is a convenience background context for gitx calls in tests.
113	func Ctx() context.Context { return context.Background() }

880	func (m Model) reloadUpdatedSkill(name, lockName string, scope agentskill.Scope, checkout string) tea.Cmd {
881		generation := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).generation
882		locals := append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)
883		return func() tea.Msg {
884			if m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos == nil && m.actions.ReloadSkills == nil {
885				return skillsMsg{
886					generation: generation, valid: true, loaded: true, status: "updated " + name,
887					inventoryErr: m.skillsInventoryErr, err: m.skillsInventoryErr,
888				}
889			}
890			var rows []agentskill.Skill
891			var err error
892			if m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil {
893				rows, err = m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), locals)
894			} else {
895				rows, err = m.actions.ReloadSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills))
896			}
897			if err != nil && rows == nil {
898				return skillsMsg{generation: generation, valid: false, loaded: true, inventoryErr: err, err: err}
899			}
900			verified := false
901			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil {
902				for i := range rows {
903					candidateName := rows[i].Name
904					if rows[i].Lock != nil {
905						candidateName = rows[i].Lock.Name
906					}
907					if candidateName == lockName && rows[i].Scope == scope && rows[i].Checkout == checkout {
908						checked := m.actions.CheckSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), []agentskill.Skill{rows[i]})
909						if len(checked) == 1 {
910							rows[i] = checked[0]
911							verified = true
912						}
913						break
914					}
915				}
916			}
917			status := "updated " + name
918			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil && !verified {
919				status += "; matching row was not found for source verification"
920			}
921			return skillsMsg{
922				generation: generation, rows: rows, valid: snapshotValid(rows, err), loaded: true,
923				checked: verified, status: status, inventoryErr: err, err: err,
924			}
925		}
926	}

1433-Claude Code reads instructions, settings, skills, subagents, and memory from your project directory and from `~/.claude` in your home directory. Commit project files to git to share them with your team; files in `~/.claude` are personal configuration that applies across all your projects.
1434-
1435:On Windows, `~/.claude` resolves to `%USERPROFILE%\.claude`. If you set [`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`](/docs/en/env-vars), every `~/.claude` path on this page lives under that directory instead.
1436-
1437-Most users only edit `CLAUDE.md` and `settings.json`. The rest of the directory is optional: add skills, rules, or subagents as you need them.
1438-
1439-## Explore the directory
--
1462-| :------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------- |
1463-| Give Claude project context and conventions        | `CLAUDE.md`                              | project or global | [Memory](/docs/en/memory)                                |
1464-| Allow or block specific tool calls                 | `settings.json` `permissions` or `hooks` | project or global | [Permissions](/docs/en/permissions), [Hooks](/docs/en/hooks)  |
1465-| Run a script before or after tool calls            | `settings.json` `hooks`                  | project or global | [Hooks](/docs/en/hooks)                                  |
1466:| Set environment variables for the session          | `settings.json` `env`                    | project or global | [Settings](/docs/en/settings-reference#all-settings)     |
1467-| Keep personal overrides out of git                 | `settings.local.json`                    | project only      | [Settings scopes](/docs/en/settings#where-settings-live) |
1468-| Add a prompt or capability you invoke with `/name` | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`                 | project or global | [Skills](/docs/en/skills)                                |
1469-| Define a specialized subagent with its own tools   | `agents/*.md`                            | project or global | [Subagents](/docs/en/sub-agents)                         |
1470-| Orchestrate many subagents from a script           | `workflows/*.js`                         | project or global | [Dynamic workflows](/docs/en/workflows)                  |
--
1479-  Several things can override what you put in these files:
1480-
1481-  * [Managed settings](/docs/en/server-managed-settings) deployed by your organization take precedence over everything, apart from the [exceptions under Settings precedence](/docs/en/settings#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence)
1482-  * CLI flags like `--permission-mode` or `--settings` override `settings.json` for that session
1483:  * Some environment variables take precedence over their equivalent setting, but this varies: check the [environment variables reference](/docs/en/env-vars) for each one
1484-
1485-  See [settings precedence](/docs/en/settings#settings-precedence) for the full order.
1486-</Note>

2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (

8		"errors"
9		"fmt"

19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}

499:* **User** and **Project local**: create them yourself, or let Claude Code create them. It writes `~/.claude/settings.json` the first time you change an option in the `/config` menu that it stores in user settings, such as the theme, and `.claude/settings.local.json` the first time you give a standing approval on a permission prompt, such as "Yes, and don't ask again" for a Bash command. A few `/config` options, including **Show tips**, save to `.claude/settings.local.json` instead of the user file.
543:* **When the file stays with `.claude/settings.json` instead**: outside a git repository, when the repository root is your home directory, on Windows, or when the repository root or its `.git` or `.claude` entry isn't owned by your user.
628:* **`--settings`**: pass a key as JSON, inline or as a path to a file. Claude Code applies it above your user, project, and local files and below managed settings. It can set any key your user settings file can set; it can't set `Managed` or `Global config` keys.
636:If you press `s` in the `/model` picker, Claude Code switches the model without saving it as your user default. Claude Code applies some `/effort` levels, such as `max` and `ultracode`, to the current session only; see [Adjust effort level](/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level).
646:Claude Code watches your settings files and reloads them when they change, so it applies most edits to the running session without a restart, including edits to `permissions`, `hooks`, and credential helpers such as `apiKeyHelper`. The reload covers user, project, local, and managed settings, and Claude Code runs the [`ConfigChange` hook](/docs/en/hooks#configchange) for each settings-file change it detects, not for managed settings that arrive from MDM or the claude.ai console. Managed settings that arrive through MDM or from the claude.ai console reach a running session on a schedule rather than on save; the [delivery table](/docs/en/managed-settings#choose-a-delivery-mechanism) gives it per source.
668:* **Settings Error**: a user, project, or local file has invalid JSON or a value the schema rejects. At the start of an interactive session Claude Code shows a dialog that lets you fix the file with Claude's help, exit, or continue without the broken settings.
694:2. **Command line arguments**: flags you pass when you start `claude` from a terminal, for one session; see [Change a setting for one session](#change-a-setting-for-one-session). Claude Code merges JSON you pass with `--settings <file-or-json>` with your settings files by the same rules as the other levels: it takes a key you set here over the same key in local, project, or user settings, and keeps the lower-level value for a key you omit.
703:### Lists merge instead of overriding
708:* [`modelPicker`](/docs/en/settings-reference#modelpicker) holds one ordered list of rows plus a replace flag, so Claude Code never merges rows from two sources. It takes the whole value from the highest of managed settings, `--settings`, and user settings that defines it, and ignores the key in project and local settings. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.
709:* [`availableModels`](/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels): when the managed settings Claude Code applies define it, Claude Code applies that list as-is and ignores entries you add in user, project, or local settings, unless an app that embeds Claude Code supplies its own model list; see [Exceptions to managed settings precedence](#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence). Across managed sources the list never merges either; [how Claude Code combines managed sources](/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources) says which source's list applies. Across non-managed scopes Claude Code merges the arrays as usual.
716:While Claude works, Claude Code shows a one-line tip under the spinner, such as "Use /config to change your default permission mode (including Plan Mode)". Suppose you want those tips off, so you set [`spinnerTipsEnabled`](/docs/en/settings-reference#spinnertipsenabled) to `false` in `~/.claude/settings.json`. Each scenario below is something that can turn them back on, and what you can do about it.
720:Your team's `.claude/settings.json` sets it to `true`. Claude Code uses the project value because shared project sits above user, so you see tips in that project and nowhere else.
722:You can get your value back: add `"spinnerTipsEnabled": false` to `.claude/settings.local.json` in that project. Project local sits above shared project, so your sessions there stop showing tips and your teammates' sessions don't change.
726:Your organization's managed settings set it to `true`. Nothing you put in user, project, or local settings turns tips off, and neither does `--settings`. Managed is the top level.
732:You started the session with `claude --settings '{"spinnerTipsEnabled": true}'`. Command line sits above every file except managed, so that session shows tips even though your files say `false`.
760:* **The file can't set that value.** [`permissions.defaultMode`](/docs/en/settings-reference#permissions-defaultmode) values `auto` and `bypassPermissions` don't take effect from project or local settings; set them in user or managed settings instead, or pass `--permission-mode` for one session. Before v2.1.257, `bypassPermissions` took effect from any file.
771:* **Claude Code ignores the key in a repository file.** Look for `User, local, or managed`, `User or managed`, `Managed`, or `Global config` in the Scope column of the [All settings](/docs/en/settings-reference#all-settings) index; those keys never apply from the shared file, apart from [`autoContinueAtUsageLimit`](/docs/en/settings-reference#autocontinueatusagelimit), which a repository file can still switch off: while the file sets the key and no user, `--settings`, or managed value does, Claude Code reads the setting as off. `Global config` keys apply only from `~/.claude.json`.

70	func checkUpdatesWith(ctx context.Context, rows []Skill, deps updateCheckDeps) []Skill {
71		out := append([]Skill(nil), rows...)
72		groupsByKey := map[string][]updateMember{}
73		for index := range out {

89			normalized := *metadata
90			if normalized.RecordedHash == "" || normalized.HashKind == "" {
91				normalizeRecordedHash(&normalized)

94				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
95				out[index].UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no comparable content hash"

97			}
98			key := url + "\x00" + metadata.Ref
99			groupsByKey[key] = append(groupsByKey[key], updateMember{index: index, url: url, ref: metadata.Ref})
100		}
101	
102		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groupsByKey))
103		for key := range groupsByKey {

106		sort.Strings(keys)

109			groups = append(groups, updateGroup{key: key, members: groupsByKey[key]})

215	func sourceURL(entry LockMetadata) (string, bool) {
216		if entry.SourceType == "local" || entry.SourceType == "node_modules" || entry.SourceType == "well-known" {
217			return "", false
218		}
219		if entry.SourceURL != "" {
220			return entry.SourceURL, true
221		}
222		if entry.SourceType == "github" {
223			parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(entry.Source, "/"), "/")
224			if len(parts) >= 2 {
225				return "https://github.com/" + parts[0] + "/" + parts[1] + ".git", true
226			}
227		}
228		if strings.Contains(entry.Source, "://") || strings.HasSuffix(entry.Source, ".git") {
229			return entry.Source, true
230		}
231		return "", false
232	}

234	func cloneSourceCheckout(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (sourceCheckout, error) {
235		dir, err := cloneSource(ctx, url, ref)
236		if err != nil {
237			return sourceCheckout{}, err
238		}
239		parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
240		return sourceCheckout{dir: dir, cleanup: func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }}, nil
241	}

243	func cloneSource(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (string, error) {
244		if !safeFetchRef(ref) {
245			return "", errors.New("skill source ref is not safe to pass to Git")
246		}
247		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-skill-check-*")
248		if err != nil {
249			return "", err
250		}
251		dir := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
252		if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, "", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", "--", url, dir); err != nil {
253			_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
254			return "", err
255		}
256		if ref != "" {
257			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", "origin", ref); err != nil {
258				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
259				return "", err
260			}
261			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
262				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
263				return "", err
264			}
265		}
266		return dir, nil
267	}

269	func safeFetchRef(ref string) bool {
270		if ref == "" {
271			return true
272		}
273		if strings.TrimSpace(ref) != ref || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "-") {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !strings.ContainsFunc(ref, func(r rune) bool {
277			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
278		})
279	}

281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""
283		computed := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ComputedHash)
284		folder := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.SkillFolderHash)
285		content := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ContentHash)
286	
287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {
288			switch {
289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {
301				return
302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"
310			return
311		}
312		// Scope-less package tests and older callers may still supply either global
313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func validHexHash(value string, length int) bool {
323		if len(value) != length {
324			return false
325		}
326		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
327		return err == nil
328	}
329	
330	func checkOneResult(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
331		entry := skillLock(row)
332		if entry == nil {
333			return UpdateUnknown, "skill has no lock metadata"
334		}
335		folder, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath)
336		if !ok {
337			return UpdateUnknown, "invalid skill path in lock entry"
338		}
339		abs := filepath.Join(repoDir, filepath.FromSlash(folder))
340		info, err := os.Stat(abs)
341		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
342			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
343				return UpdateMissing, "skill path no longer exists upstream"
344			}
345			return UpdateFailed, "could not inspect upstream skill path"
346		}
347		if !insidePath(repoDir, abs) {
348			return UpdateUnknown, "skill path escapes the fetched source"
349		}
350	
351		expected, kind := entry.RecordedHash, entry.HashKind
352		if expected == "" {
353			copy := *entry
354			normalizeRecordedHash(&copy)
355			expected, kind = copy.RecordedHash, copy.HashKind
356		}
357		var actual string
358		var hashErr error
359		switch kind {
360		case "git-tree":
361			spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
362			if folder != "" {
363				spec = "HEAD:" + folder
364			}
365			actual, hashErr = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
366		case "sha256-folder":
367			actual, hashErr = folderHashContext(ctx, abs)
368		case "sha256-skill-file":
369			actual, hashErr = fileHashContext(ctx, filepath.Join(abs, "SKILL.md"))
370		}
371		if hashErr != nil {
372			if ctx.Err() != nil {
373				return UpdateFailed, "update check canceled"
374			}
375			return UpdateFailed, "could not compute upstream content hash"
376		}
377		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
378			return UpdateUnknown, "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
379		}
380		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
381			return UpdateCurrent, "matches the recorded upstream content"
382		}
383		return UpdateAvailable, "upstream content changed"
384	}
385	
386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}
411	
412	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
413		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
414	}
415	
416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

21	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
22	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
23	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
24	type MutationProvider struct {
25		Available bool
26		Command   string
27		Path      string
28		Detail    string
29	}
30	
31	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
32	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
33	// or project code.
34	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
35		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
36	}
37	
38	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
39	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
40	// mutates it.
41	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
42		if path, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
43			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
44				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
45			}
46			return MutationProvider{Path: path, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside a repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
47		}
48		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
49			return MutationProvider{
50				Path:   path,
51				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
52			}
53		}
54		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
55	}

57	func trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot string) (string, bool) {

60		}

65		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(clean)
66		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) || pathUsesNodeModulesBin(resolved) {
67			return "", false
68		}
69		resolved = filepath.Clean(resolved)
70		if projectRoot != "" {
71			inside, err := pathx.Contains(projectRoot, resolved)
72			if err != nil || inside {
73				return "", false
74			}
75		}
76		return resolved, true

79	func pathUsesNodeModulesBin(path string) bool {

103	func canonicalMutationRoot(root string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
104		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
105		if err != nil {
106			return "", err
107		}
108		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
