123		root, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
124		candidate, candidateErr := filepath.Abs(candidate)

129		return err == nil && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != ".." &&

160	// InstallCommand installs an explicit set of skills for explicit agents in
161	// project scope. The caller owns confirmation; --yes only suppresses the
162	// provider's duplicate prompt after that decision.
163	func InstallCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string, names, agents []string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
164		if source == "" {
165			source = DefaultSource
166		}
167		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
168			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
169		}
170		if len(names) == 0 {

172		}
173		for _, name := range names {

184			}

186		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		args := []string{"add", source, "--skill"}
191		args = append(args, names...)
192		args = append(args, "--agent")
193		args = append(args, agents...)
194		args = append(args, "--yes")
195		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(ProjectRoot(ctx, projectRoot), true)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil

202	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
203	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {

211			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
212		}
213		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, err
216		}
217		args := []string{"update", "--yes"}
218		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
219			args = append(args, "--global")
220		} else {
221			args = append(args, "--project")
222		}
223		args = append(args, name)
224		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
229	}

158			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
159		}
160		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
161		for path := range byPhysical {
162			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
163		}
164		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
165		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
166		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
167			group := byPhysical[path]
168			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
169			result = append(result, *group)
170		}
171		return result
172	}

174	func scanScope(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, locations []physicalScanLocation, document lockDocument) ([]Skill, []Diagnostic) {
175		diagnostics := decorateDiagnostics(document.Diagnostics, target)
176		var scanned []scannedSkill
177		for _, location := range locations {
178			if ctx.Err() != nil {
179				break
180			}
181			found, foundDiagnostics := scanLocation(ctx, scope, target, location)
182			scanned = append(scanned, found...)
183			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, foundDiagnostics...)
184		}
185	
186		groups := map[string]*skillAggregate{}
187		normalizedInstalled := map[string][]string{}
188		for _, found := range scanned {
189			group := groups[found.Name]
190			if group == nil {
191				group = &skillAggregate{Installations: map[string]*Installation{}}
192				groups[found.Name] = group
193			}
194			group.Names = append(group.Names, found.Name)
195			normalized := normalizedName(found.Name)
196			normalizedInstalled[normalized] = append(normalizedInstalled[normalized], found.Name)
197			physical := found.Installation.RealPath
198			installation := group.Installations[physical]
199			if installation == nil {
200				copy := found.Installation
201				group.Installations[physical] = &copy
202				installation = &copy
203			} else {
204				installation.LogicalPaths = append(installation.LogicalPaths, found.Installation.LogicalPaths...)
205				installation.AgentIDs = append(installation.AgentIDs, found.Installation.AgentIDs...)
206			}
207			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
208			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
209			if len(installation.LogicalPaths) > 0 {
210				installation.Path = installation.LogicalPaths[0]
211			}
212			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
213		}
214	
215		for normalized, names := range normalizedInstalled {
216			names = uniqueSorted(names)
217			normalizedInstalled[normalized] = names
218			if len(names) > 1 {
219				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
220					Kind: DiagnosticNameCollision, Scope: scope, Name: normalized,
221					Message: fmt.Sprintf("installed skill names %s normalize to %q", strings.Join(names, ", "), normalized),
222				}, target))
223			}
224		}
225		exactNames := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
226		for name := range groups {
227			exactNames = append(exactNames, name)
228		}
229		sort.Strings(exactNames)
230		consumedLocks := map[string]bool{}
231		rows := make([]Skill, 0, len(groups)+len(document.Entries))
232		for _, name := range exactNames {
233			group := groups[name]
234			normalized := normalizedName(name)
235			var lock LockMetadata
236			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
237			matched := false
238			if exact, ok := document.Entries[name]; ok {
239				lock, matched = exact, true
240			} else if len(normalizedInstalled[normalized]) == 1 && len(candidates) == 1 {
241				lock, matched = candidates[0], true
242			}
243			if matched {
244				consumedLocks[normalized] = true
245			}
246			rows = append(rows, buildPresentRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, name, group, lock, candidates, matched))
247		}
248	
249		lockGroups := document.namesByNormalized()
250		lockNormalized := make([]string, 0, len(lockGroups))
251		for normalized := range lockGroups {
252			lockNormalized = append(lockNormalized, normalized)
253		}
254		sort.Strings(lockNormalized)
255		for _, normalized := range lockNormalized {
256			if consumedLocks[normalized] {
257				continue
258			}
259			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
260			if len(candidates) == 0 {
261				continue
262			}
263			selected := candidates[0]
264			rows = append(rows, buildMissingRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, selected, candidates))
265		}
266		return rows, diagnostics
267	}

269	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {
270		entries, err := os.ReadDir(location.Path)
271		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
272			return nil, nil
273		}
274		if err != nil {
275			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
276				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
277				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),
278			}, target)}
279		}
280		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
281	
282		var skills []scannedSkill
283		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
284		for _, entry := range entries {
285			if ctx.Err() != nil {
286				break
287			}
288			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
289			info, err := os.Stat(child)
290			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
291				continue
292			}
293			if err != nil {
294				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
295					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
296					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
297				}, target))
298				continue
299			}
300			if !info.IsDir() {
301				continue
302			}
303			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
304			if !present {
305				continue
306			}
307			if err != nil {
308				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
309					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
310					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),
311				}, target))
312				continue
313			}
314			physical := child
315			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
316				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
317			}
318			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
319			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
320				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
321				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
322			}
323			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)
324			agentIDs = uniqueSorted(agentIDs)
325			installation := Installation{
326				RealPath: physical, LogicalPaths: logicalPaths, AgentIDs: agentIDs,
327				Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs), Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
328			}
329			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
330				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
331			}
332			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
333		}
334		return skills, diagnostics
335	}
336	
337	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
338		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
339		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340			return "", false, nil
341		}
342		if err != nil {
343			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not inspect SKILL.md: %w", err)
344		}
345		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
346			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
347		}
348		file, err := os.Open(filename)
349		if err != nil {
350			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
351		}
352		defer file.Close()
353		if openedInfo, err := file.Stat(); err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
354			return "", true, errors.New("opened SKILL.md is not a regular file")
355		}
356	
357		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
358		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
359		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
360		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
361		consumed := int64(len(first))
362		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
363			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
364		}
365		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
366		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
367			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
368		}
369		var frontmatter strings.Builder
370		closed := false
371		for {
372			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
373			consumed += int64(len(line))
374			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
375				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376			}
377			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
378				closed = true
379				break
380			}
381			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
382			if lineErr != nil {
383				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
384					break
385				}
386				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
387			}
388		}
389		if !closed {
390			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
391		}
392		var metadata struct {
393			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
394			Description string `yaml:"description"`
395		}
396		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
397			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
398		}
399		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
400		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
401		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
402			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
403		}
404		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
405			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
406		}
407		return metadata.Name, true, nil
408	}

410	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
411		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))
412		for _, installation := range group.Installations {
413			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
414			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
415			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
416			installations = append(installations, *installation)
417		}
418		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
419			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
420				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
421			}
422			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
423		})
424		var agents []string
425		for _, installation := range installations {
426			agents = append(agents, installation.AgentIDs...)
427		}
428		agentIDs := uniqueSorted(agents)
429		agents = agentDisplayNames(agentIDs)
430		row := Skill{
431			Name: name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot,
432			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
433			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
434			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
435			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
436			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,
437			UpdateDetail: "not tracked by the skills CLI",
438		}
439		if len(installations) > 0 {
440			row.Path = installations[0].Path
441		}
442		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
443			if name == skill.Name {
444				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
445				row.Source = "dev binary"
446				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
447				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
448			} else {
449				row.UpdateDetail = "name is reserved for the binary-managed dev-cli skill"
450			}
451			return row
452		}
453		if matched {
454			copy := lock
455			row.Lock = &copy
456			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills
457			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnchecked
458			row.UpdateDetail = ""
459			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)
460			row.SourceType = safeSourceType(lock.SourceType)
461			return row
462		}
463		if len(candidates) > 1 {
464			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
465		}
466		return row
467	}
468	
469	func buildMissingRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata) Skill {
470		copy := lock
471		row := Skill{
472			Name: lock.Name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot, Agents: []string{},
473			Source: sourceDisplay(lock.Source), SourceURL: sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL),
474			SourceType: safeSourceType(lock.SourceType),
475			ManagedBy:  ManagedBySkills, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnchecked,
476			Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
477			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Presence: PresenceMissing, Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
478			Attribution: registryAttribution(nil), RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
479			Lock: &copy, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
480		}
481		if directManagedSkillName(lock.Name) {
482			row.Lock = nil
483			if lock.Name == skill.Name {
484				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
485				row.Source, row.SourceURL, row.SourceType = "dev binary", "", ""
486				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateAvailable
487				row.UpdateDetail = "bundled skill is missing; run `dev skill install`"
488			} else {
489				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByExternal
490				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
491				row.UpdateDetail = "name is reserved for the binary-managed dev-cli skill"
492			}
493		}
494		return row
495	}
496	
497	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
498		files, err := skill.Files()
499		if err != nil {
500			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
501			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
502			return
503		}
504		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
505		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
506		for index := range row.Installations {
507			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
508			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
509			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
510			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
511				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
512				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
513			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
514				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
515				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
516			}
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
521		for relative, want := range files {
522			got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
523			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
524				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
525			}
526		}
527		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
528	}
529	
530	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
531	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
532	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
533		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
534			return UpdateCurrent, detail
535		}
536		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
537			return UpdateAvailable, detail
538		}
539		return UpdateFailed, detail
540	}
541	
542	func sourceDisplay(value string) string {
543		if value == "" {
544			return ""
545		}
546		if !safeDisplayValue(value) {
547			return "[redacted]"
548		}
549		value = repo.RedactCloneRef(value)
550		parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
551		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
552			parsed.User = nil
553			parsed.RawQuery = ""
554			parsed.ForceQuery = false
555			parsed.Fragment = ""
556			return parsed.String()
557		}
558		return value
559	}
560	
561	func safeSourceType(value string) string {
562		if value == "" || safeDisplayValue(value) {
563			return value
564		}
565		return "[redacted]"
566	}
567	
568	func registryAttribution(agentIDs []string) Attribution {
569		return Attribution{Registry: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, AgentIDs: uniqueSorted(agentIDs)}
570	}
571	
572	func decorateDiagnostics(input []Diagnostic, target agenttarget.Target) []Diagnostic {
573		result := make([]Diagnostic, len(input))
574		for index, diagnostic := range input {
575			result[index] = decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic, target)
576		}
577		return result
578	}
579	
580	func decorateDiagnostic(diagnostic Diagnostic, target agenttarget.Target) Diagnostic {
581		diagnostic.Repository = target.RepoDisplay
582		diagnostic.RepositoryPath = target.RepoPath
583		diagnostic.Checkout = target.CheckoutRoot
584		return diagnostic
585	}

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}
180	
181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {
182		switch base {
183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:
186			return home, ""
187		case baseConfigHome:
188			if value := absoluteEnvironment("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"); value != "" {
189				return value, "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
190			}
191			if home == "" {
192				return "", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
193			}
194			return filepath.Join(home, ".config"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
195		case baseCodexHome:
196			return environmentBase("CODEX_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".codex")), "CODEX_HOME"
197		case baseClaudeHome:
198			return environmentBase("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", filepath.Join(home, ".claude")), "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
199		case baseVibeHome:
200			return environmentBase("VIBE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".vibe")), "VIBE_HOME"
201		case baseHermesHome:
202			return environmentBase("HERMES_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".hermes")), "HERMES_HOME"
203		case baseAutohandHome:
204			return environmentBase("AUTOHAND_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".autohand")), "AUTOHAND_HOME"
205		case baseGrokHome:
206			return environmentBase("GROK_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".grok")), "GROK_HOME"
207		case baseOpenClawHome:
208			if home == "" {
209				return "", ""
210			}
211			for _, candidate := range []string{".openclaw", ".clawdbot", ".moltbot"} {
212				path := filepath.Join(home, candidate)
213				if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
214					return path, ""
215				}
216			}
217			return filepath.Join(home, ".openclaw"), ""
218		default:
219			return home, ""
220		}
221	}
222	
223	func environmentBase(name, fallback string) string {
224		if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); filepath.IsAbs(value) {
225			return filepath.Clean(value)
226		}
227		if filepath.IsAbs(fallback) {
228			return fallback
229		}
230		return ""
231	}
232	
233	func absoluteEnvironment(name string) string {
234		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
235		if filepath.IsAbs(value) {
236			return filepath.Clean(value)
237		}
238		return ""
239	}

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}

208	// Inventory scans cwd's current target and the requested global scope.
209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}

217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}

276	// ManagedName returns the canonical lock key for one unambiguous provider-
277	// managed skill. Direct-managed dev-cli and option-like keys are never handed

279	func directManagedSkillName(name string) bool {
280		return reservedSkillNameKey(name) == reservedSkillNameKey(skill.Name)
281	}

283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}

300		if entry.SkillPath == "" || !safeProviderSkillName(entry.Name) {
301			return false
302		}
303		switch entry.SourceType {
304		case "local", "node_modules":
305			return false
306		default:
307			return true
308		}
309	}

342	// FindProject returns one installed project-scoped skill by exact or normalized
343	// name. An exact name wins when normalized filesystem names collide.
344	func FindProject(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string) (Skill, error) {
345		rows, err := List(ctx, projectRoot, ListOptions{Project: true})
346		if err != nil {
347			return Skill{}, err
348		}
349		for _, row := range rows {
350			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && row.Name == name {
351				return row, nil
352			}
353		}
354		want := normalizedName(name)
355		var matches []Skill
356		for _, row := range rows {
357			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
358				matches = append(matches, row)
359			}
360		}
361		if len(matches) == 1 {
362			return matches[0], nil
363		}
364		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
365	}

367	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
368	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
369	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
370		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
371		for _, result := range results {
372			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
373			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
374			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
375				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
376			}
377			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
378				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
379			}
380		}
381		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
382		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
383		return merged
384	}

386	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
387		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
388			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
389			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
390				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
391			}
392			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
393				return left.Repository < right.Repository
394			}
395			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
396				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
397			}
398			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
399			if leftName != rightName {
400				return leftName < rightName
401			}
402			if left.Name != right.Name {
403				return left.Name < right.Name
404			}
405			return left.Path < right.Path
406		})
407	}
408	
409	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
410		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
411			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
412			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
413				return left.Repository < right.Repository
414			}
415			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
416				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
417			}
418			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
419				return left.Scope < right.Scope
420			}
421			if left.Path != right.Path {
422				return left.Path < right.Path
423			}
424			if left.Name != right.Name {
425				return left.Name < right.Name
426			}
427			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
428				return left.Kind < right.Kind
429			}
430			return left.Message < right.Message
431		})
432	}
433	
434	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {
435		if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
436			return false
437		}
438		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
439			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
440		})
441	}
442	
443	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
444		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
445		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)
455		}
456		sort.Strings(out)
457		return out
458	}
459	
460	func homeDirectory() string {
461		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
462		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
463			return ""
464		}
465		return home
466	}

1	package inventory
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}
86

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}

596	func traceOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {

600		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):

602		default:

609	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
610		filtered := commands[:0]
611		for _, command := range commands {
612			if command != nil {
613				filtered = append(filtered, command)
614			}
615		}
616		switch len(filtered) {
617		case 0:
618			return nil
619		case 1:
620			return filtered[0]
621		default:
622			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
623		}
624	}

668	func (m Model) probeTools() tea.Cmd {
669		generation := m.toolGeneration
670		tools := append([]Tool(nil), m.actions.Tools...)
671		ctx := m.baseContext()
672		return func() tea.Msg {
673			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTools, perftrace.Fields{Generation: generation})
674			jobs := make(chan int, len(tools))
675			for index := range tools {
676				jobs <- index
677			}
678			close(jobs)
679			var workers sync.WaitGroup
680			for range min(2, len(tools)) {
681				workers.Go(func() {
682					for index := range jobs {
683						available := true
684						if tools[index].Probe != nil {
685							available = tools[index].Probe(ctx)
686						}
687						if ctx.Err() != nil {
688							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnknown
689						} else if available {
690							tools[index].Availability = ToolAvailable
691						} else {
692							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnavailable
693						}
694					}
695				})
696			}
697			workers.Wait()
698			finish(traceOutcome(ctx.Err()))
699			return toolsMsg{generation: generation, tools: tools}
700		}
701	}

898				return skillsMsg{generation: generation, valid: false, loaded: true, inventoryErr: err, err: err}
899			}
900			verified := false
901			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil {
902				for i := range rows {
903					candidateName := rows[i].Name
904					if rows[i].Lock != nil {
905						candidateName = rows[i].Lock.Name
906					}
907					if candidateName == lockName && rows[i].Scope == scope && rows[i].Checkout == checkout {
908						checked := m.actions.CheckSkills(m.viewContext(ViewSkills), []agentskill.Skill{rows[i]})
909						if len(checked) == 1 {
910							rows[i] = checked[0]
911							verified = true
912						}
913						break
914					}
915				}
916			}
917			status := "updated " + name
918			if m.actions.CheckSkills != nil && !verified {
919				status += "; matching row was not found for source verification"
920			}
921			return skillsMsg{
922				generation: generation, rows: rows, valid: snapshotValid(rows, err), loaded: true,
923				checked: verified, status: status, inventoryErr: err, err: err,
924			}
925		}
926	}

1017		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort

1048	type repoItem struct {
1049		Repo          RepoRow
1050		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
1051	}
1052	
1053	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
1054	
1055	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
1056		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
1057			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1058		}
1059		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
1060	}

1062	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1063	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1064	// from the repository they belong to.
1065	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1066		repos := m.visibleRepos()
1067		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
1068		for _, r := range repos {
1069			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
1070			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1071				continue
1072			}
1073			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
1074				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1075			}
1076		}
1077		return out
1078	}

1165	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1166	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1167	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1168	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1169	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1170		if row.Task == nil {
1171			return ""
1172		}
1173		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1174			return "dev sweep"
1175		}
1176		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1177			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1178		}
1179		return ""
1180	}
1181	
1182	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1183		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1184		if command == "" {
1185			return nil
1186		}
1187		switch {
1188		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1189			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1190		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1191			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1192		default:
1193			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1194		}
1195	}

1207	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1208		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1209		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1210			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1211			if structured {
1212				switch key {
1213				case "scope":
1214					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1215						return false
1216					}
1217					continue
1218				case "agent":
1219					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1220					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1221						return false
1222					}
1223					continue
1224				case "update":
1225					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1226						return false
1227					}
1228					continue
1229				case "repo":
1230					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1231						return false
1232					}
1233					continue
1234				case "presence":
1235					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1236						return false
1237					}
1238					continue
1239				case "integrity":
1240					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1241						return false
1242					}
1243					continue
1244				}
1245			}
1246			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1247				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1248				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1249				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1250				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1251			}, " "))
1252			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1253				return false
1254			}
1255		}
1256		return true
1257	}

17	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually

19	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
20	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
21	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
22		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
23		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
24		// terminal width.
25		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
26		h := m.height - fixed
27		if h < 3 {
28			return 3
29		}
30		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
31		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
32			h--
33		}
34		return h
35	}

194	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
195	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
196	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
197		h := m.listHeight()
198		if n <= h {
199			return 0, n
200		}
201		from = m.at() - h/2
202		if from < 0 {
203			from = 0
204		}
205		if from+h > n {
206			from = n - h
207		}
208		return from, from + h
209	}

211	const (
212		taskRepoBreakpoint = 97
213		taskRepoWidth      = 16
214	)
215	
216	func (m Model) renderTasks() string {
217		rows := m.visibleTasks()
218		if len(rows) == 0 {
219			return m.emptyTasks()
220		}
221		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
222		showRepo := m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint
223	
224		headers := []string{
225			fitCell("TASK", nameW),
226			fitCell("STATE", 6),
227		}
228		if showRepo {
229			headers = append(headers, fitCell("REPO", taskRepoWidth))
230		}
231		headers = append(headers,
232			fitCell("BRANCH", branchW),
233			fitCell("GIT", 16),
234			fitCell("AGE", 5),
235			fitCell("NEXT", nextW),
236		)
237	
238		var b strings.Builder
239		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
240	
241		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
242		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
243			r := rows[i]
244			cells := []string{
245				fitCell(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
246				fitCell(r.Task.State.Label(), 6),
247			}
248			if showRepo {
249				cells = append(cells, fitCell(r.Task.Repo, taskRepoWidth))
250			}
251			cells = append(cells,
252				fitCell(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
253				fitCell(gitColumn(r), 16),
254				fitCell(shortAge(r), 5),
255				fitCell(nextColumn(r), nextW),
256			)
257			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
258			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))
259		}
260		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
261		return b.String()
262	}

264	func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
265		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
266		if len(items) == 0 {
267			if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
268				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
269			}
270			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
271				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
272		}
273		columns := m.repoColumns()
274	
275		var b strings.Builder
276		var headers []string
277		for _, c := range columns {
278			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
279		}
280		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
281	
282		from, to := m.window(len(items))
283		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
284			item := items[i]
285			r := item.Repo
286			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
287			for _, c := range columns {
288				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
289			}
290			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
291			styled := line
292			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
293				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
294					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
295				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
296					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
297					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
298				}
299			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
300				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
301			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
302				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
303			}
304			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
305		}
306		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
307		return b.String()
308	}

310	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
311		r := item.Repo
312		checkout, child := item.checkout()
313		if !child {
314			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
315				marker := "▸ "
316				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
317					marker = "▾ "
318				}
319				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
320			}
321			if name == "live" {
322				return parentLiveColumn(r)
323			}
324			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
325		}
326	
327		switch name {
328		case "repo":
329			connector := "├─ "
330			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
331				connector = "└─ "
332			}
333			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
334			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
335				label = checkout.Branch()
336			}
337			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
338				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
339			}
340			return connector + label
341		case "branch":
342			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
343				return branch
344			}
345			return "(detached)"
346		case "git":
347			switch {
348			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
349				return "prunable"
350			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
351				return "locked"
352			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
353				return "?"
354			default:
355				return checkout.Status.Summary()
356			}
357		case "live":
358			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout)
359		case "latest":
360			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
361		case "worktrees":
362			return "—"
363		case "tasks":
364			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
365		case "notes":
366			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
367				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
368			}
369			return "—"
370		case "category":
371			return "—"
372		case "path":
373			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
374		}
375		return ""
376	}

378	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
379		sessions := r.Sessions()
380		if len(sessions) == 0 {
381			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
382		}
383		if len(sessions) > 1 {
384			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
385		}
386		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
387		if status != "" {
388			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
389		}
390		return r.Runtime
391	}
392	
393	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) string {
394		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
395			return "closed"
396		}
397		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
398			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
399		}
400		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
401			return runtimeName + ":" + status
402		}
403		return runtimeName
404	}
405	
406	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
407		if len(tasks) == 0 {
408			return "—"
409		}
410		counts := map[task.State]int{}
411		for _, t := range tasks {
412			counts[t.State]++
413		}
414		var parts []string
415		for _, state := range task.States {
416			if counts[state] > 0 {
417				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
418			}
419		}
420		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
421	}
422	
423	type repoColumnSpec struct {
424		name, header string
425		width, min   int
426	}
427	
428	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
429		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
430		if len(names) == 0 {
431			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
432		}
433		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
434			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
435			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
436			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
437			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
438			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
439			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
440			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
441			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
442			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
443			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
444			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
445			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
446		}
447		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
448		for _, name := range names {
449			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
450				columns = append(columns, c)
451			}
452		}
453		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
454		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
455		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
456		for _, c := range columns {
457			total += c.width
458		}
459		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
460			for i := range columns {
461				if columns[i].name != preferred {
462					continue
463				}
464				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
465				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
466				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
467				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
468					columns[i].width--
469					total--
470				}
471			}
472			if total <= m.width {
473				break
474			}
475		}
476		return columns
477	}
478	
479	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
480		switch name {
481		case "repo":
482			return r.Repo.Display()
483		case "branch":
484			if r.Repo.Bare {
485				return "(bare)"
486			}
487			return r.Status.Branch
488		case "git":
489			if r.Repo.Bare {
490				return "—"
491			}
492			return r.Status.Summary()
493		case "remote":
494			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
495				return "?"
496			}
497			return r.Topology.Summary()
498		case "size":
499			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
500		case "live":
501			if !r.Live {
502				return "—"
503			}
504			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
505				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
506			}
507			return r.Runtime
508		case "latest":
509			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
510		case "worktrees":
511			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
512				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
513			}
514			return "—"
515		case "tasks":
516			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
517				return tasks
518			}
519			return "—"
520		case "notes":
521			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
522				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
523			}
524			return "—"
525		case "category":
526			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
527				return r.Repo.Category
528			}
529			return "—"
530		case "path":
531			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
532		}
533		return ""
534	}

536	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
537		if at.IsZero() {
538			return "—"
539		}
540		d := time.Since(at)

546		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
547			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
548		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:

func TestVerifyExplicitLinkedWorktreeAliasIsPreserved(t *testing.T) {
    repository := gittest.New(t)
    linked := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(repository.Root), "linked")
    repository.Git("worktree", "add", "-b", "feat/alias-fixture", linked)
    aliases := t.TempDir()
    mainAlias := filepath.Join(aliases, "main-alias")
    linkedAlias := filepath.Join(aliases, "linked-alias")
    if err := os.Symlink(repository.Root, mainAlias); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.Symlink(linked, linkedAlias); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    mainTarget, err := agenttarget.ResolveRepository(context.Background(), nil, mainAlias)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    linkedTarget, err := agenttarget.ResolveRepository(context.Background(), nil, linkedAlias)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    t.Logf("main alias target:   %+v", mainTarget)
    t.Logf("linked alias target: %+v", linkedTarget)

    if mainTarget.RepoPath != mainAlias || mainTarget.CheckoutRoot != mainAlias {
        t.Fatalf("main alias lost: %+v", mainTarget)
    }
    if linkedTarget.CheckoutRoot != linkedAlias {
        t.Fatalf("linked checkout alias lost: got %q, want %q (target=%+v)", linkedTarget.CheckoutRoot, linkedAlias, linkedTarget)
    }
}

func TestVerifyCurrentAllAndTUIIdentityAgreeForConfiguredAlias(t *testing.T) {
    repository := gittest.New(t)
    index := t.TempDir()
    alias := filepath.Join(index, "friendly")
    if err := os.Symlink(repository.Root, alias); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    current, err := agenttarget.Current(context.Background(), alias)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    all, err := agenttarget.All(context.Background(), []string{index})
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    combined := agenttarget.WithCurrent(all, current)
    t.Logf("current: %+v", current)
    t.Logf("all:     %+v", all)
    t.Logf("TUI-style WithCurrent: %+v", combined)
    if len(all) != 1 || len(combined) != 1 { t.Fatalf("unexpected target counts: all=%+v combined=%+v", all, combined) }
    if current.RepoPath != all[0].RepoPath || current.RepoDisplay != all[0].RepoDisplay {
        t.Fatalf("current identity differs from --all/TUI: current=%+v all=%+v combined=%+v", current, all, combined)
    }
}

func TestVerifyDedupeCanonicalizesMissingSuffixBelowSymlink(t *testing.T) {
    base := t.TempDir()
    physical := filepath.Join(base, "physical")
    common := filepath.Join(base, "common")
    if err := os.MkdirAll(physical, 0o755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.MkdirAll(common, 0o755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    alias := filepath.Join(base, "alias")
    if err := os.Symlink(physical, alias); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    aliasMissing := filepath.Join(alias, "not-created", "checkout")
    physicalMissing := filepath.Join(physical, "not-created", "checkout")

    aliasCanonical, err := pathx.Canonical(aliasMissing)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    physicalCanonical, err := pathx.Canonical(physicalMissing)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if aliasCanonical != physicalCanonical { t.Fatalf("fixture is not canonically equal: %q != %q", aliasCanonical, physicalCanonical) }

    got := agenttarget.Dedupe([]agenttarget.Target{
        {RepoName: "demo", RepoDisplay: "demo", RepoPath: alias, CheckoutRoot: aliasMissing, CommonDir: common},
        {RepoName: "demo", RepoDisplay: "demo", RepoPath: physical, CheckoutRoot: physicalMissing, CommonDir: common},
    })
    t.Logf("pathx canonical alias=%q physical=%q; agenttarget dedupe=%+v", aliasCanonical, physicalCanonical, got)
    if len(got) != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("canonically identical missing-suffix targets were not deduplicated: %+v", got)
    }
}

func TestVerifyClaudeLocalUsesMostSpecificTarget(t *testing.T) {
    home := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "home")
    parent := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "parent")
    child := filepath.Join(parent, "nested")
    for _, path := range []string{home, child} {
        if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    }
    document := map[string]any{"projects": map[string]any{

            "nested-local": map[string]any{"command": "server"},
        }},
    }}

    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, ".claude.json"), data, 0o644); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    targets := []agenttarget.Target{
        {RepoName: "parent", RepoDisplay: "a-parent", RepoPath: parent, CheckoutRoot: parent, CommonDir: filepath.Join(parent, ".git")},
        {RepoName: "child", RepoDisplay: "z-child", RepoPath: child, CheckoutRoot: child, CommonDir: filepath.Join(child, ".git")},
    }
    scanner := NewScanner(Options{HomeDir: home, WorkingDirectory: parent, Concurrency: 1})
    result, err := scanner.Scan(context.Background(), targets)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    for _, row := range result.Declarations {
        if row.Agent == AgentClaudeCode && row.Scope == ScopeLocal && row.Name == "nested-local" {
            t.Logf("nested local declaration: %+v", row)
            if row.Repository != "z-child" || row.Checkout != child {
                t.Fatalf("nested local declaration attributed to containing parent instead of exact child: %+v", row)
            }
            return
        }
    }
    t.Fatalf("nested local declaration not found: %+v", result)
}

func TestVerifyGlobalAgentsPathExcludesProjectOnlyAgents(t *testing.T) {
    home := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "home")
    t.Setenv("HOME", home)
    t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
    t.Setenv("XDG_STATE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".state"))
    for name, subdir := range map[string]string{
        "CODEX_HOME": ".codex", "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR": ".claude", "VIBE_HOME": ".vibe",
        "HERMES_HOME": ".hermes", "AUTOHAND_HOME": ".autohand", "GROK_HOME": ".grok",
    } {
        t.Setenv(name, filepath.Join(home, subdir))
    }
    skillDir := filepath.Join(home, ".agents", "skills", "fixture")
    if err := os.MkdirAll(skillDir, 0o755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(skillDir, "SKILL.md"), []byte("---\nname: fixture\ndescription: attribution fixture\n---\n"), 0o644); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    definitions := agentskill.Registry()
    for _, definition := range definitions {
        if definition.ID == "promptscript" && definition.GlobalSkillsDir != "" {
            t.Fatalf("fixture assumption changed: promptscript now has global path %q", definition.GlobalSkillsDir)
        }
    }
    result, err := agentskill.Scan(context.Background(), nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if len(result.Skills) != 1 || len(result.Skills[0].Installations) != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected global rows: %+v", result.Skills)
    }
    ids := result.Skills[0].Installations[0].AgentIDs
    t.Logf("global ~/.agents/skills agent IDs: %v", ids)
    if slices.Contains(ids, "promptscript") {
        t.Fatalf("project-only promptscript was attributed to a global installation: %v", ids)
    }
}

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}

208	// Inventory scans cwd's current target and the requested global scope.
209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}

217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}

268	// List preserves the original row-only API. Native diagnostics are available
269	// through Inventory or Scan and never turn a malformed neighboring scope into a
270	// fatal whole-scan error.
271	func List(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) ([]Skill, error) {
272		result, err := Inventory(ctx, cwd, options)
273		return result.Skills, err
274	}

276	// ManagedName returns the canonical lock key for one unambiguous provider-
277	// managed skill. Direct-managed dev-cli and option-like keys are never handed
278	// to the external update command.
279	func directManagedSkillName(name string) bool {
280		return reservedSkillNameKey(name) == reservedSkillNameKey(skill.Name)
281	}
282	
283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}

299	func lockUpdateable(entry LockMetadata) bool {
300		if entry.SkillPath == "" || !safeProviderSkillName(entry.Name) {
301			return false
302		}
303		switch entry.SourceType {
304		case "local", "node_modules":
305			return false
306		default:
307			return true
308		}
309	}

311	// CanUpdate reports whether a listed row has enough safe lock metadata for the
312	// external provider's named update flow.
313	func CanUpdate(row Skill) bool {
314		return row.ManagedBy == ManagedBySkills && row.Lock != nil && lockUpdateable(*row.Lock) &&
315			!directManagedSkillName(row.Lock.Name)
316	}

318	func ManagedName(ctx context.Context, cwd, name string, scope Scope) (string, bool) {
319		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
320			return "", false
321		}
322		root := ProjectRoot(ctx, cwd)
323		var document lockDocument
324		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
325			document = readGlobalLock(globalLockPath())
326		} else {
327			document = readProjectLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
328		}
329		entry, ok := document.find(name)
330		if !ok || !lockUpdateable(entry) {
331			return "", false
332		}
333		return entry.Name, true
334	}

338		_, ok := ManagedName(ctx, cwd, name, scope)
339		return ok
340	}

342	// FindProject returns one installed project-scoped skill by exact or normalized
343	// name. An exact name wins when normalized filesystem names collide.
344	func FindProject(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string) (Skill, error) {
345		rows, err := List(ctx, projectRoot, ListOptions{Project: true})
346		if err != nil {
347			return Skill{}, err
348		}
349		for _, row := range rows {
350			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && row.Name == name {
351				return row, nil
352			}
353		}
354		want := normalizedName(name)
355		var matches []Skill
356		for _, row := range rows {
357			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
358				matches = append(matches, row)
359			}
360		}
361		if len(matches) == 1 {
362			return matches[0], nil
363		}
364		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
365	}

367	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
368	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
369	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
370		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
371		for _, result := range results {
372			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
373			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
374			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
375				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
376			}
377			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
378				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
379			}
380		}
381		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
382		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
383		return merged
384	}

386	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
387		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
388			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
389			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
390				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
391			}
392			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
393				return left.Repository < right.Repository
394			}
395			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
396				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
397			}
398			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
399			if leftName != rightName {
400				return leftName < rightName
401			}
402			if left.Name != right.Name {
403				return left.Name < right.Name
404			}
405			return left.Path < right.Path
406		})
407	}
408	
409	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
410		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
411			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
412			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
413				return left.Repository < right.Repository
414			}
415			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
416				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
417			}
418			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
419				return left.Scope < right.Scope
420			}
421			if left.Path != right.Path {
422				return left.Path < right.Path
423			}
424			if left.Name != right.Name {
425				return left.Name < right.Name
426			}
427			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
428				return left.Kind < right.Kind
429			}
430			return left.Message < right.Message
431		})
432	}

436			return false
437		}
438		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
439			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)

443	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
444		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
445		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)
455		}
456		sort.Strings(out)
457		return out
458	}

462		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
463			return ""
464		}

281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""

287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {

289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {

302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"

313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}

386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}
