416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

21	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
22	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
23	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
24	type MutationProvider struct {
25		Available bool
26		Command   string
27		Path      string
28		Detail    string
29	}
30	
31	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
32	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
33	// or project code.
34	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
35		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
36	}
37	
38	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
39	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
40	// mutates it.
41	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
42		if path, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
43			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
44				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
45			}
46			return MutationProvider{Path: path, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside a repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
47		}
48		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
49			return MutationProvider{
50				Path:   path,
51				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
52			}
53		}
54		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
55	}
56	
57	func trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot string) (string, bool) {
58		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
59			return "", false
60		}
61		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
62		if pathUsesNodeModulesBin(clean) || projectRoot != "" && lexicalPathInside(projectRoot, clean) {
63			return "", false
64		}
65		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(clean)
66		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) || pathUsesNodeModulesBin(resolved) {
67			return "", false
68		}
69		resolved = filepath.Clean(resolved)
70		if projectRoot != "" {
71			inside, err := pathx.Contains(projectRoot, resolved)
72			if err != nil || inside {
73				return "", false
74			}
75		}
76		return resolved, true
77	}
78	
79	func pathUsesNodeModulesBin(path string) bool {
80		parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(path), "/")
81		for index := 0; index+1 < len(parts); index++ {
82			if parts[index] == "node_modules" && parts[index+1] == ".bin" {
83				return true
84			}
85		}
86		return false
87	}
88	
89	func interactiveProvider(projectRoot string) (provider, error) {
90		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot)
91		if !status.Available {
92			return provider{}, errors.New(status.Detail)
93		}
94		return provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}, nil
95	}
96	
97	func (p provider) command(ctx context.Context, cwd string, args ...string) *exec.Cmd {
98		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, p.bin, args...)
99		cmd.Dir = cwd
100		return cmd
101	}
102	
103	func canonicalMutationRoot(root string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
104		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
105		if err != nil {
106			return "", err
107		}
108		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
109		if err != nil {
110			if allowMissing && os.IsNotExist(err) {
111				return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
112			}
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve skill mutation root: %w", err)
114		}
115		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
116		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
117			return "", errors.New("skill mutation root is not a directory")
118		}
119		return filepath.Clean(resolved), nil
120	}
121	
122	func lexicalPathInside(root, candidate string) bool {
123		root, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
124		candidate, candidateErr := filepath.Abs(candidate)
125		if rootErr != nil || candidateErr != nil {
126			return false
127		}
128		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(root), filepath.Clean(candidate))
129		return err == nil && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != ".." &&
130			!strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
131	}
132	
133	func safeProviderSkillName(name string) bool {
134		return name == strings.TrimSpace(name) && !strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") && safeDisplayValue(name)
135	}
136	
137	func safeProviderArgument(value string) bool {
138		return value == strings.TrimSpace(value) && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "-") && safeDisplayValue(value)
139	}
140	
141	// AddCommand opens the upstream interactive installer in projectRoot.
142	func AddCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
143		if source == "" {
144			source = DefaultSource
145		}
146		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
147			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
148		}
149		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, err
152		}
153		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		return p.command(ctx, root, "add", source), nil
158	}
159	
160	// InstallCommand installs an explicit set of skills for explicit agents in
161	// project scope. The caller owns confirmation; --yes only suppresses the
162	// provider's duplicate prompt after that decision.
163	func InstallCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string, names, agents []string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
164		if source == "" {
165			source = DefaultSource
166		}
167		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
168			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
169		}
170		if len(names) == 0 {
171			return nil, errors.New("at least one skill is required")
172		}
173		for _, name := range names {
174			if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
175				return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
176			}
177		}
178		if len(agents) == 0 {
179			return nil, errors.New("at least one agent is required")
180		}
181		for _, agent := range agents {
182			if !safeProviderArgument(agent) {
183				return nil, errors.New("agent name is not safe to pass to the provider")
184			}
185		}
186		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		args := []string{"add", source, "--skill"}
191		args = append(args, names...)
192		args = append(args, "--agent")
193		args = append(args, agents...)
194		args = append(args, "--yes")
195		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(ProjectRoot(ctx, projectRoot), true)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
200	}
201	
202	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
203	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
204		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
205			return nil, errors.New("dev-cli is managed by the dev binary, not the skills provider")
206		}
207		if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
208			return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
209		}
210		if scope != ScopeProject && scope != ScopeGlobal {
211			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
212		}
213		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, err
216		}
217		args := []string{"update", "--yes"}
218		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
219			args = append(args, "--global")
220		} else {
221			args = append(args, "--project")
222		}
223		args = append(args, name)
224		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
229	}
230	
231	// ProviderVersion reports a directly installed skills executable. It never
232	// falls back to npx, even with --no-install, because version probes are reads.
233	func ProviderVersion(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (string, error) {
234		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(cwd)
235		if !status.Available {
236			return "", errors.New(status.Detail)
237		}
238		p := provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}
239		cmd := p.command(ctx, cwd, "--version")
240		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
241		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
242		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
243			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
244			if detail == "" {
245				detail = err.Error()
246			}
247			return "", fmt.Errorf("skills: %s", detail)
248		}
249		return "skills " + strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
250	}

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}

181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {

183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:

187		case baseConfigHome:

197		case baseClaudeHome:

199		case baseVibeHome:

215				}
216			}
217			return filepath.Join(home, ".openclaw"), ""
218		default:
219			return home, ""
220		}
221	}
222	
223	func environmentBase(name, fallback string) string {
224		if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); filepath.IsAbs(value) {
225			return filepath.Clean(value)
226		}
227		if filepath.IsAbs(fallback) {
228			return fallback
229		}
230		return ""
231	}
232	
233	func absoluteEnvironment(name string) string {
234		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
235		if filepath.IsAbs(value) {
236			return filepath.Clean(value)
237		}
238		return ""
239	}

1	package inventory

3	import (
4		"context"

7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}

61	// CheckUpdates compares lock-recorded content with current Git sources. Source

70	func checkUpdatesWith(ctx context.Context, rows []Skill, deps updateCheckDeps) []Skill {
71		out := append([]Skill(nil), rows...)
72		groupsByKey := map[string][]updateMember{}
73		for index := range out {
74			metadata := skillLock(out[index])
75			if out[index].ManagedBy != ManagedBySkills || metadata == nil {
76				continue
77			}
78			url, ok := sourceURL(*metadata)

80				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
81				out[index].UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no checkable Git source and skill path"
82				continue
83			}
84			if _, safe := safeSkillFolder(metadata.SkillPath); !safe {
85				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
86				out[index].UpdateDetail = "invalid skill path in lock entry"
87				continue
88			}
89			normalized := *metadata
90			if normalized.RecordedHash == "" || normalized.HashKind == "" {
91				normalizeRecordedHash(&normalized)
92			}
93			if normalized.RecordedHash == "" || normalized.HashKind == "" {
94				out[index].UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
95				out[index].UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
96				continue
97			}
98			key := url + "\x00" + metadata.Ref
99			groupsByKey[key] = append(groupsByKey[key], updateMember{index: index, url: url, ref: metadata.Ref})
100		}
101	
102		keys := make([]string, 0, len(groupsByKey))
103		for key := range groupsByKey {
104			keys = append(keys, key)
105		}
106		sort.Strings(keys)
107		groups := make([]updateGroup, 0, len(keys))
108		for _, key := range keys {
109			groups = append(groups, updateGroup{key: key, members: groupsByKey[key]})
110		}
111		if len(groups) == 0 {
112			return out
113		}
114		if deps.clone == nil {
115			deps.clone = cloneSourceCheckout
116		}
117		if deps.check == nil {
118			deps.check = checkOneResult
119		}
120		if deps.workers <= 0 {
121			deps.workers = defaultUpdateWorkers
122		}
123		if deps.workers > len(groups) {
124			deps.workers = len(groups)
125		}
126	
127		jobs := make(chan int, len(groups))
128		results := make(chan updateGroupResult, len(groups))
129		for position := range groups {

131		}
132		close(jobs)
133

135		workers.Add(deps.workers)
136		for range deps.workers {

141					result := updateGroupResult{position: position}

144						results <- result

154						results <- result
155						continue
156					}
157					func() {

159							defer checkout.cleanup()
160						}
161						cached := map[string]rowUpdate{}
162						for _, member := range group.members {
163							if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
164								result.updates = append(result.updates, rowUpdate{member.index, UpdateFailed, "update check canceled: " + err.Error()})
165								continue

171							cacheKey := metadata.SkillPath + "\x00" + metadata.HashKind + "\x00" + metadata.RecordedHash
172							if previous, ok := cached[cacheKey]; ok {
173								previous.index = member.index
174								result.updates = append(result.updates, previous)
175								continue
176							}
177							status, detail := deps.check(ctx, checkout.dir, out[member.index])
178							update := rowUpdate{member.index, status, detail}

180							result.updates = append(result.updates, update)
181						}

215	func sourceURL(entry LockMetadata) (string, bool) {
216		if entry.SourceType == "local" || entry.SourceType == "node_modules" || entry.SourceType == "well-known" {
217			return "", false
218		}
219		if entry.SourceURL != "" {
220			return entry.SourceURL, true
221		}
222		if entry.SourceType == "github" {
223			parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(entry.Source, "/"), "/")
224			if len(parts) >= 2 {
225				return "https://github.com/" + parts[0] + "/" + parts[1] + ".git", true
226			}
227		}
228		if strings.Contains(entry.Source, "://") || strings.HasSuffix(entry.Source, ".git") {
229			return entry.Source, true
230		}
231		return "", false
232	}

234	func cloneSourceCheckout(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (sourceCheckout, error) {
235		dir, err := cloneSource(ctx, url, ref)
236		if err != nil {

238		}

243	func cloneSource(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (string, error) {
244		if !safeFetchRef(ref) {
245			return "", errors.New("skill source ref is not safe to pass to Git")
246		}
247		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-skill-check-*")
248		if err != nil {
249			return "", err
250		}
251		dir := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
252		if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, "", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", "--", url, dir); err != nil {
253			_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
254			return "", err
255		}
256		if ref != "" {
257			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", "origin", ref); err != nil {
258				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
259				return "", err
260			}
261			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
262				_ = os.RemoveAll(parent)
263				return "", err
264			}
265		}
266		return dir, nil
267	}

269	func safeFetchRef(ref string) bool {
270		if ref == "" {
271			return true
272		}
273		if strings.TrimSpace(ref) != ref || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "-") {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !strings.ContainsFunc(ref, func(r rune) bool {
277			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
278		})
279	}

281	func normalizeRecordedHash(metadata *LockMetadata) {
282		metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = "", ""
283		computed := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ComputedHash)
284		folder := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.SkillFolderHash)
285		content := strings.TrimSpace(metadata.ContentHash)
286	
287		setFolderHash := func(hash string) bool {
288			switch {
289			case validHexHash(hash, 40):
290				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "git-tree"
291				return true
292			case validHexHash(hash, 64):
293				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = hash, "sha256-folder"
294				return true
295			default:
296				return false
297			}
298		}
299		if metadata.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
300			if setFolderHash(folder) {
301				return
302			}
303			if validHexHash(content, 64) {
304				metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
305			}
306			return
307		}
308		if validHexHash(computed, 64) {
309			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = computed, "sha256-folder"
310			return
311		}
312		// Scope-less package tests and older callers may still supply either global
313		// representation; parsed project-v1 locks never reach this branch with them.
314		if metadata.Scope == "" && setFolderHash(folder) {
315			return
316		}
317		if metadata.Scope == "" && validHexHash(content, 64) {
318			metadata.RecordedHash, metadata.HashKind = content, "sha256-skill-file"
319		}
320	}

322	func validHexHash(value string, length int) bool {
323		if len(value) != length {
324			return false
325		}
326		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
327		return err == nil
328	}

330	func checkOneResult(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row Skill) (UpdateStatus, string) {
331		entry := skillLock(row)
332		if entry == nil {
333			return UpdateUnknown, "skill has no lock metadata"
334		}
335		folder, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath)
336		if !ok {
337			return UpdateUnknown, "invalid skill path in lock entry"
338		}
339		abs := filepath.Join(repoDir, filepath.FromSlash(folder))
340		info, err := os.Stat(abs)
341		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
342			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
343				return UpdateMissing, "skill path no longer exists upstream"
344			}
345			return UpdateFailed, "could not inspect upstream skill path"
346		}
347		if !insidePath(repoDir, abs) {
348			return UpdateUnknown, "skill path escapes the fetched source"
349		}
350	
351		expected, kind := entry.RecordedHash, entry.HashKind
352		if expected == "" {
353			copy := *entry
354			normalizeRecordedHash(&copy)
355			expected, kind = copy.RecordedHash, copy.HashKind
356		}
357		var actual string
358		var hashErr error
359		switch kind {
360		case "git-tree":
361			spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
362			if folder != "" {

364			}
365			actual, hashErr = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
366		case "sha256-folder":
367			actual, hashErr = folderHashContext(ctx, abs)
368		case "sha256-skill-file":
369			actual, hashErr = fileHashContext(ctx, filepath.Join(abs, "SKILL.md"))
370		}
371		if hashErr != nil {
372			if ctx.Err() != nil {
373				return UpdateFailed, "update check canceled"
374			}
375			return UpdateFailed, "could not compute upstream content hash"
376		}
377		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
378			return UpdateUnknown, "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
379		}
380		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
381			return UpdateCurrent, "matches the recorded upstream content"
382		}
383		return UpdateAvailable, "upstream content changed"
384	}

386	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
387		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
388		if p == "" || strings.ContainsRune(p, '\x00') {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		// filepath.VolumeName follows the host OS, so reject a Windows drive prefix
392		// explicitly even when dev is checking a lock file on Unix.
393		if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' && ((p[0] >= 'a' && p[0] <= 'z') || (p[0] >= 'A' && p[0] <= 'Z')) {
394			return "", false
395		}
396		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
397			p = path.Dir(p)
398		}
399		if p == "." {
400			p = ""
401		}
402		clean := path.Clean(p)
403		if clean == "." {
404			clean = ""
405		}
406		if path.IsAbs(clean) || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || filepath.VolumeName(filepath.FromSlash(clean)) != "" {
407			return "", false
408		}
409		return clean, true
410	}

412	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
413		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
414	}
415	
416	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
417		type file struct {
418			name string
419			path string
420		}
421		var files []file
422		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
423			if err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
427				return ctxErr
428			}
429			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
430				return filepath.SkipDir
431			}
432			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
433				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
434				if err != nil {
435					return err
436				}
437				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
438			}
439			return nil
440		})
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		collator := collate.New(language.English)
445		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
446			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
447				return order < 0
448			}
449			return files[i].name < files[j].name
450		})
451		hash := sha256.New()
452		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
453		for _, file := range files {
454			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
455				return "", err
456			}
457			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
458			input, err := os.Open(file.path)
459			if err != nil {
460				return "", err
461			}
462			for {
463				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
464					_ = input.Close()
465					return "", err
466				}
467				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
468				if read > 0 {
469					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
470				}
471				if readErr != nil {
472					_ = input.Close()
473					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
474						break
475					}
476					return "", readErr
477				}
478			}
479		}
480		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
481	}
482	
483	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
484		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
485		if err != nil {
486			return "", err
487		}
488		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
489			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
490		}
491		input, err := os.Open(filename)
492		if err != nil {
493			return "", err
494		}
495		defer input.Close()
496		openedInfo, err := input.Stat()
497		if err != nil || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() {
498			return "", errors.New("opened skill hash target is not a regular file")
499		}
500		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
501		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
502			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
503		}
504		hash := sha256.New()
505		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
506		for {
507			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
508				return "", err
509			}
510			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
511			if read > 0 {
512				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
513			}
514			if readErr != nil {
515				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
516					break
517				}
518				return "", readErr
519			}
520		}
521		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
522	}
523	
524	func insidePath(root, candidate string) bool {
525		inside, err := pathx.Contains(root, candidate)
526		return err == nil && inside
527	}
528	
529	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
530		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
531		cmd.Dir = dir
532		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
533		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
534		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
535			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
536		}
537		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
538	}

13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14	)

16	type provider struct {
17		bin   string
18		label string
19	}
20	
21	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
22	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
23	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
24	type MutationProvider struct {
25		Available bool
26		Command   string
27		Path      string
28		Detail    string
29	}
30	
31	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
32	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
33	// or project code.
34	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
35		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
36	}
37	
38	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
39	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
40	// mutates it.
41	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
42		if path, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
43			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
44				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
45			}
46			return MutationProvider{Path: path, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside a repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
47		}
48		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
49			return MutationProvider{
50				Path:   path,
51				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
52			}
53		}
54		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
55	}
56	
57	func trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot string) (string, bool) {
58		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
59			return "", false
60		}
61		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
62		if pathUsesNodeModulesBin(clean) || projectRoot != "" && lexicalPathInside(projectRoot, clean) {
63			return "", false
64		}
65		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(clean)
66		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) || pathUsesNodeModulesBin(resolved) {
67			return "", false
68		}
69		resolved = filepath.Clean(resolved)
70		if projectRoot != "" {
71			inside, err := pathx.Contains(projectRoot, resolved)
72			if err != nil || inside {
73				return "", false
74			}
75		}
76		return resolved, true
77	}
78	
79	func pathUsesNodeModulesBin(path string) bool {
80		parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(path), "/")
81		for index := 0; index+1 < len(parts); index++ {
82			if parts[index] == "node_modules" && parts[index+1] == ".bin" {
83				return true
84			}
85		}
86		return false
87	}
88	
89	func interactiveProvider(projectRoot string) (provider, error) {
90		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot)
91		if !status.Available {
92			return provider{}, errors.New(status.Detail)
93		}
94		return provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}, nil
95	}
96	
97	func (p provider) command(ctx context.Context, cwd string, args ...string) *exec.Cmd {
98		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, p.bin, args...)
99		cmd.Dir = cwd
100		return cmd
101	}
102	
103	func canonicalMutationRoot(root string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
104		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
105		if err != nil {
106			return "", err
107		}
108		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
109		if err != nil {
110			if allowMissing && os.IsNotExist(err) {
111				return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
112			}
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve skill mutation root: %w", err)
114		}
115		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
116		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
117			return "", errors.New("skill mutation root is not a directory")
118		}
119		return filepath.Clean(resolved), nil
120	}
121	
122	func lexicalPathInside(root, candidate string) bool {
123		root, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
124		candidate, candidateErr := filepath.Abs(candidate)
125		if rootErr != nil || candidateErr != nil {
126			return false
127		}
128		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(root), filepath.Clean(candidate))
129		return err == nil && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != ".." &&
130			!strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
131	}
132	
133	func safeProviderSkillName(name string) bool {
134		return name == strings.TrimSpace(name) && !strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") && safeDisplayValue(name)
135	}
136	
137	func safeProviderArgument(value string) bool {
138		return value == strings.TrimSpace(value) && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "-") && safeDisplayValue(value)
139	}
140	
141	// AddCommand opens the upstream interactive installer in projectRoot.
142	func AddCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
143		if source == "" {
144			source = DefaultSource
145		}
146		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
147			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
148		}
149		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, err
152		}
153		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		return p.command(ctx, root, "add", source), nil
158	}
159	
160	// InstallCommand installs an explicit set of skills for explicit agents in
161	// project scope. The caller owns confirmation; --yes only suppresses the
162	// provider's duplicate prompt after that decision.
163	func InstallCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string, names, agents []string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
164		if source == "" {
165			source = DefaultSource
166		}
167		if !safeProviderArgument(source) {
168			return nil, errors.New("skill source is not safe to pass to the provider")
169		}
170		if len(names) == 0 {
171			return nil, errors.New("at least one skill is required")
172		}
173		for _, name := range names {
174			if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
175				return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
176			}
177		}
178		if len(agents) == 0 {
179			return nil, errors.New("at least one agent is required")
180		}
181		for _, agent := range agents {
182			if !safeProviderArgument(agent) {
183				return nil, errors.New("agent name is not safe to pass to the provider")
184			}
185		}
186		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		args := []string{"add", source, "--skill"}
191		args = append(args, names...)
192		args = append(args, "--agent")
193		args = append(args, agents...)
194		args = append(args, "--yes")
195		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(ProjectRoot(ctx, projectRoot), true)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
200	}
201	
202	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
203	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
204		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
205			return nil, errors.New("dev-cli is managed by the dev binary, not the skills provider")
206		}
207		if !safeProviderSkillName(name) {
208			return nil, errors.New("skill name is not safe to pass to the provider")
209		}
210		if scope != ScopeProject && scope != ScopeGlobal {
211			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
212		}
213		p, err := interactiveProvider(projectRoot)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, err
216		}
217		args := []string{"update", "--yes"}
218		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
219			args = append(args, "--global")
220		} else {
221			args = append(args, "--project")
222		}
223		args = append(args, name)
224		root, err := canonicalMutationRoot(projectRoot, false)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		return p.command(ctx, root, args...), nil
229	}
230	
231	// ProviderVersion reports a directly installed skills executable. It never
232	// falls back to npx, even with --no-install, because version probes are reads.
233	func ProviderVersion(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (string, error) {
234		status := MutationProviderStatusFor(cwd)
235		if !status.Available {
236			return "", errors.New(status.Detail)
237		}
238		p := provider{bin: status.Path, label: "skills"}
239		cmd := p.command(ctx, cwd, "--version")
240		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
241		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
242		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
243			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
244			if detail == "" {
245				detail = err.Error()
246			}
247			return "", fmt.Errorf("skills: %s", detail)
248		}
249		return "skills " + strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
250	}

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}

181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {
182		switch base {
183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:
186			return home, ""
187		case baseConfigHome:

191			if home == "" {

194			return filepath.Join(home, ".config"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
195		case baseCodexHome:
196			return environmentBase("CODEX_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".codex")), "CODEX_HOME"
197		case baseClaudeHome:
198			return environmentBase("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", filepath.Join(home, ".claude")), "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
199		case baseVibeHome:

201		case baseHermesHome:

203		case baseAutohandHome:

205		case baseGrokHome:

207		case baseOpenClawHome:

209				return "", ""
210			}
211			for _, candidate := range []string{".openclaw", ".clawdbot", ".moltbot"} {
212				path := filepath.Join(home, candidate)
213				if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
214					return path, ""
215				}
216			}
217			return filepath.Join(home, ".openclaw"), ""
218		default:
219			return home, ""
220		}
221	}
222	
223	func environmentBase(name, fallback string) string {
224		if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); filepath.IsAbs(value) {
225			return filepath.Clean(value)
226		}
227		if filepath.IsAbs(fallback) {
228			return fallback
229		}
230		return ""
231	}
232	
233	func absoluteEnvironment(name string) string {
234		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
235		if filepath.IsAbs(value) {
236			return filepath.Clean(value)
237		}
238		return ""
239	}

446		for _, value := range values {
447			if value == "" {
448				continue
449			}
450			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
451				continue
452			}
453			seen[value] = struct{}{}
454			out = append(out, value)

1	package inventory

3	import (

12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
17	)
18	
19	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
20	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
21	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
22	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
23	type Target struct {
24		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
25		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
26		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
27		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
28		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
29	}
30	
31	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
32	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
33	func (t Target) Key() string {
34		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
35	}
36	
37	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
38	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
39	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
40	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
41		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
42		if err == nil {
43			return target, nil
44		}
45		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
46			return Target{}, ctxErr
47		}
48		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
49			return Target{}, err
50		}
51		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
52		if pathErr != nil {
53			return Target{}, pathErr
54		}
55		name := filepath.Base(root)
56		return Target{
57			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
58			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
59		}, nil
60	}
61	
62	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
63	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
64		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
65		if err != nil {
66			return Target{}, err
67		}
68		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
69		if err != nil {
70			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
71		}
72		return fromGit(found)
73	}
74	
75	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
76	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
77	// worktree path is preserved.
78	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
79		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
80		if err != nil {
81			return Target{}, err
82		}
83		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
84		if err != nil {
85			return Target{}, err
86		}
87		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
88		// An explicit linked-worktree path must keep the main repository identity
89		// discovered by Git instead of becoming the worktree directory basename.
90		if comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath) {
91			if found.Name != "" {
92				target.RepoName = found.Name
93			}
94			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
95				target.RepoDisplay = display
96			}
97			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
98			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
99		}
100		return target, nil
101	}
102	
103	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
104	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
105		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
106	}
107	
108	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
109	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
110	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
111	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
112		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
113			return Target{}, false
114		}
115		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
116		commonDir := found.CommonDir
117		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
118			return Target{}, false
119		}
120		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
121		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
122		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
123		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
124		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
125		name := found.Name
126		if name == "" {
127			name = filepath.Base(repository)
128		}
129		display := found.Display()
130		if display == "" {
131			display = name
132		}
133		return Target{
134			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
135			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
136		}, true
137	}
138	
139	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
140	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
141	
142	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
143	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
144	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
145	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
146		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
147		for _, found := range repositories {
148			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
149				targets = append(targets, target)
150			}
151		}
152		return Dedupe(targets)
153	}
154	
155	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
156	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
157	
158	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
159	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
160	// other target builders.
161	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
162		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
163		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
164			for _, target := range targets {
165				if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
166					current.RepoName = target.RepoName
167					current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
168					current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
169					break
170				}
171			}
172			out = append(out, current)
173		}
174		return Dedupe(out)
175	}
176	
177	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
178	// concrete main-checkout targets.
179	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
180		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
185	}
186	
187	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
188	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
189	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
190		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
191		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
192		for _, target := range targets {
193			key := target.Key()
194			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
195				continue
196			}
197			seen[key] = struct{}{}
198			out = append(out, target)
199		}
200		Sort(out)
201		return out
202	}
203	
204	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
205	func Sort(targets []Target) {
206		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
207			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
208			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
209			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
210				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
211			}
212			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
213				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
214			}
215			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
216				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
217			}
218			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
219				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
220			}
221			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
222				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
223			}
224			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
225		})
226	}
227	
228	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
229		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
230			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
231		}
232		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
233		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
234		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
235		name := found.Name
236		if name == "" {
237			name = filepath.Base(repository)
238		}
239		return Target{
240			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
241			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
242		}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
246		for _, value := range values {
247			if value != "" {
248				return value
249			}
250		}
251		return ""
252	}
253	
254	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
255		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
256		if err != nil {
257			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
258		}
259		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
260			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
261		}
262		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
263	}
264	
265	func navigationPath(value string) string {
266		if value == "" {
267			return ""
268		}
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err == nil {
271			value = absolute
272		}
273		return filepath.Clean(value)
274	}
275	
276	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
277		if value == "" {
278			return ""
279		}
280		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
281		if err == nil {
282			value = absolute
283		}
284		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(value); err == nil {
285			value = resolved
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func comparablePath(value string) string {
291		return canonicalPath(value)
292	}
293

683	<span id="which-value-wins" />
684	
685	## Settings precedence
686	
687	When the same key appears in more than one place, Claude Code uses the value from the highest level that sets it. The stack below shows the levels, highest on top; a key at a higher level overrides the same key anywhere below it.
688	
689	<SettingsPrecedence />
690	
691	In order, highest precedence first:
692	
693	1. **Managed settings**: settings your organization deploys, by a `managed-settings.json` file, an MDM policy, or [server-managed settings](/docs/en/server-managed-settings) from the claude.ai console. Nothing you set overrides them: a key you pass with `--settings` doesn't override the same managed key, and a flag such as `--model` picks only from the models your organization allows. A managed `model` sets the model each session starts with, and you can still switch with `/model`; the lock is [`availableModels`](/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels), which constrains `/model`, `--model`, and the `model` key in your own files. When your organization delivers more than one managed source, the rules for [precedence within the managed tier](/docs/en/managed-settings#precedence-within-the-managed-tier) say what Claude Code reads from each.
694	2. **Command line arguments**: flags you pass when you start `claude` from a terminal, for one session; see [Change a setting for one session](#change-a-setting-for-one-session). Claude Code merges JSON you pass with `--settings <file-or-json>` with your settings files by the same rules as the other levels: it takes a key you set here over the same key in local, project, or user settings, and keeps the lower-level value for a key you omit.
695	3. **Project local settings** (`.claude/settings.local.json`): your personal settings for this project.
696	4. **Shared project settings** (`.claude/settings.json`): settings your team checks into source control.
697	5. **User settings** (`~/.claude/settings.json`): your personal settings for every project.
698	
699	Environment variables aren't a level in this stack. When a behavior has both a shell variable and a settings key, which one applies is decided per pair, not by level: `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` exported in your shell applies over the `model` key from any file, while `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` applies only when no file sets `model`. The [environment variables reference](/docs/en/env-vars#precedence) says which keys have a pair and which one Claude Code reads first. An `env` block inside a settings file is an ordinary key and follows the levels above.
700	
701	For a few security-sensitive keys, Claude Code honors a stricter value from a lower level over a managed value; [Exceptions to managed settings precedence](#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence) lists them.
702	
703	### Lists merge instead of overriding
704	
705	When you set the same list key, such as `permissions.allow`, in more than one file, Claude Code combines the lists instead of picking one, so each file can add entries without removing another file's. Four keys that hold model lists or per-model entries follow their own rules:
706	
707	* [`fallbackModel`](/docs/en/settings-reference#fallbackmodel) is an ordered chain where position carries meaning, so Claude Code takes the whole value from the highest-precedence file that defines it.
708	* [`modelPicker`](/docs/en/settings-reference#modelpicker) holds one ordered list of rows plus a replace flag, so Claude Code never merges rows from two sources. It takes the whole value from the highest of managed settings, `--settings`, and user settings that defines it, and ignores the key in project and local settings. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.
709	* [`availableModels`](/docs/en/settings-reference#availablemodels): when the managed settings Claude Code applies define it, Claude Code applies that list as-is and ignores entries you add in user, project, or local settings, unless an app that embeds Claude Code supplies its own model list; see [Exceptions to managed settings precedence](#exceptions-to-managed-settings-precedence). Across managed sources the list never merges either; [how Claude Code combines managed sources](/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources) says which source's list applies. Across non-managed scopes Claude Code merges the arrays as usual.
710	* [`modelSettings`](/docs/en/settings-reference#modelsettings): Claude Code resolves it one model at a time, together with [`effortLevel`](/docs/en/settings-reference#effortlevel). The `modelSettings` entry states which file's value applies to a model.
711	
712	<span id="examples" />
713	
714	### Precedence examples
715	
716	While Claude works, Claude Code shows a one-line tip under the spinner, such as "Use /config to change your default permission mode (including Plan Mode)". Suppose you want those tips off, so you set [`spinnerTipsEnabled`](/docs/en/settings-reference#spinnertipsenabled) to `false` in `~/.claude/settings.json`. Each scenario below is something that can turn them back on, and what you can do about it.
717	
718	#### Team settings override personal settings
719	
720	Your team's `.claude/settings.json` sets it to `true`. Claude Code uses the project value because shared project sits above user, so you see tips in that project and nowhere else.
721	
722	You can get your value back: add `"spinnerTipsEnabled": false` to `.claude/settings.local.json` in that project. Project local sits above shared project, so your sessions there stop showing tips and your teammates' sessions don't change.
723

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Evaluating potential defects**

I need to identify defects in the update processes. First, the CLI update validates the ManagedName using ProjectRoot and allows a global lock independent of the root. The UpdateCommand requires a projectRoot directory relative to a trusted binary. With TUI, it looks like UpdateSkill passes a stale row when checking for updates without revalidating the lock, which could lead to issues. The use of context in TUI is fine for executing commands. I need to ensure reload processes correctly handle errors and updates, too. 

**Assessing update processes**

The update handler checks the network for the status but prioritizes error messages, which clears the status even though rows are still valid. I think it’s okay since it shows the error as expected. The checkSkills function initiates a new view load, and the sync operation might block if the command goroutine is canceled. It processes the entire skills slice, which is fine, but errors from local scans can reappear if not handled correctly. The TUI confirmation mode also has key input filtering that doesn’t change the prompt. 

**Reviewing update handling**

The Enter function uses a stale exact row without revalidation, which I find concerning. There's no status message like "updating..." during provider execution since submitting doesn't set a status. This might not be a defect, but it feels a little off. If the UpdateSkill callback returns an error, I see that the skillProcessMsg gets an action update but is missing some details like the name. I need to check the lock parser semantics for any mismatches, while the provider CLI seems fine with the syntax used for updates.
</details></think>

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="WebFetch"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **WebFetch**</summary>
 `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars`

```text
`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` sets the directory Claude Code uses for its configuration and state files. It defaults to `~/.claude`.

It also relocates the user-level `~/.claude.json` file, which contains personal MCP server configuration. If you set:

```bash
export CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.config/claude"
claude
```

the personal configuration file is stored at:

```text
$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json
# /home/<user>/.config/claude/.claude.json
```

Thus, personal MCP servers move with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; they are not kept in the original `~/.claude.json`.
```
</details></tool-use>

The schema is keyed per server as `"mcp_servers.<id>"`. These are the direct server-level fields:

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.args"` | `"array<string>"` | Arguments for a stdio MCP launcher. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.auth"` | `"oauth \| chatgpt"` | Authentication fallback for HTTP servers; OAuth is the default. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.bearer_token_env_var"` | `"string"` | Environment variable containing an HTTP bearer token. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.command"` | `"string"` | Launcher command for a stdio server. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.cwd"` | `"string"` | Working directory for the stdio process. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.default_tools_approval_mode"` | `"auto \| prompt \| writes \| approve"` | Default MCP-tool approval behavior. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.disabled_tools"` | `"array<string>"` | Tools denied after the enabled-tool allowlist is applied. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.enabled"` | `"boolean"` | Enables or disables the configured server. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.enabled_tools"` | `"array<string>"` | Allowlist of exposed tool names. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.env"` | `"map<string,string>"` | Environment variables forwarded to stdio. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.env_http_headers"` | `"map<string,string>"` | HTTP headers populated from environment variables. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.env_vars"` | `"array<string \| { name = string, source = \"local\" \| \"remote\" }>"` | Additional environment variables allowed for stdio. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.experimental_environment"` | `"local \| remote"` | Selects local or remote experimental stdio execution. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.http_headers"` | `"map<string,string>"` | Static headers sent with HTTP requests. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.required"` | `"boolean"` | Makes startup or resume fail if the enabled server cannot initialize. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.startup_timeout_ms"` | `"number"` | Millisecond alias for the startup timeout. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.startup_timeout_sec"` | `"number"` | Per-server startup-timeout override. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.tool_timeout_sec"` | `"number"` | Per-tool timeout override. |
| `"mcp_servers.<id>.url"` | `"string"` | Endpoint for a streamable HTTP MCP server. |

### Requested fields

The exact reference rows are:

> `"mcp_servers.<id>.scopes" — "array<string>" — "OAuth scopes to request when authenticating to that MCP server."`

> `"mcp_servers.<id>.oauth_resource" — "string" — "Optional RFC 8707 OAuth resource parameter to include during MCP login."`

Both are **per-server top-level fields** under `mcp_servers.<id>`, rather than fields inside the nested `oauth` table.

### Nested fields

- `"mcp_servers.<id>.oauth.callback_port"` — `"integer"`: fixed callback-listener port; overrides the global setting.
- `"mcp_servers.<id>.oauth.callback_url"` — `"string"`: server-specific OAuth callback URL.
- `"mcp_servers.<id>.oauth.client_id"` — `"string"`: pre-registered OAuth client identifier.
- `"mcp_servers.<id>.tools.<tool>.approval_mode"` — `"auto | prompt | writes | approve"`: per-tool approval override.

105	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
106	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
107	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
108		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
113	}
114	
115	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
116		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
117		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
118		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
119		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
120		current := root
121		for index, component := range components {
122			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
123			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
124			if err != nil {
125				return "", err
126			}
127			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
128				current = candidate
129				continue
130			}
131			if followed >= limit {
132				return "", errSymlinkLimit
133			}
134			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
135			if err != nil {
136				return "", err
137			}
138			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
139				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
140			}
141			if index+1 < len(components) {
142				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
143			}
144			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
145			if err != nil {
146				return "", err
147			}
148			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
149		}
150		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
151	}

### Local-scope storage

> “Local scope is the default. A local-scoped server loads only in the project where you added it and stays private to you. Claude Code stores it in `~/.claude.json` under that project's path, so the same server won't appear in your other projects.”

The documentation further states:

> “The command writes the server into the entry for your current project inside `~/.claude.json`.”

Example:

```json
{
  "projects": {
    "/path/to/your/project": {
      "mcpServers": {
        "stripe": {
          "type": "http",
          "url": "https://mcp.stripe.com"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> “A local-scoped server loads only in the project where you added it…”

The provided content does **not** contain an explicit statement describing when nested project-path entries apply—for example, whether a parent entry is inherited by a child directory or whether the most-specific nested path wins.

68					return fmt.Errorf("choose at most one of --all or --repo")
69				}
70				project := projectOnly || !globalOnly
71				if !project && (all || repoRef != "") {
72					return fmt.Errorf("--all and --repo require project scope")
73				}
74				cwd, err := os.Getwd()
75				if err != nil {
76					return err
77				}
78				targets, err := resolveAgentTargets(cmd.Context(), app, cwd, all, repoRef, project)
79				if err != nil {
80					return err
81				}
82				result, err := inventory.CollectAgentSkills(cmd.Context(), targets, inventory.AgentSkillOptions{
83					Project: projectOnly, Global: globalOnly, Check: check,
84				})
85				if err != nil {
86					return err
87				}
88				renderSkillDiagnostics(app, result.Diagnostics)
89				if jsonOut {
90					return renderSkillJSON(app, result.Skills)
91				}
92				return renderSkillTable(app, result.Skills, targets, projectOnly, globalOnly)
93			},
94		}
95		f := cmd.Flags()
96		f.BoolVarP(&projectOnly, "project", "p", false, "list project skills")
97		f.BoolVarP(&globalOnly, "global", "g", false, "list global skills")
98		f.BoolVar(&all, "all", false, "scan every configured canonical repository")
99		f.StringVarP(&repoRef, "repo", "r", "", "scan one repository or explicit checkout path")
100		f.BoolVar(&check, "check", false, "contact Git sources and check for updates without installing them")
101		f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit a stable machine-readable JSON array")
102		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "repo", completeRepoFlag(app))

106	func resolveAgentTargets(ctx context.Context, app *App, cwd string, all bool, repoRef string, project bool) ([]agenttarget.Target, error) {
107		if !project {
108			return nil, nil
109		}
110		if all {
111			return agenttarget.All(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots())
112		}
113		if repoRef != "" {
114			target, err := agenttarget.ResolveRepository(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoRef)
115			if err != nil {
116				return nil, err
117			}
118			return []agenttarget.Target{target}, nil
119		}
120		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		return []agenttarget.Target{target}, nil
125	}

167	func renderSkillJSON(app *App, rows []agentskill.Skill) error {
168		out := make([]skillJSON, 0, len(rows))
169		for _, row := range rows {
170			installations := make([]skillInstallationJSON, 0, len(row.Installations))
171			for _, installation := range row.Installations {
172				installations = append(installations, skillInstallationJSON{
173					Path: installation.Path, RealPath: installation.RealPath,
174					LogicalPaths: installation.LogicalPaths, AgentIDs: installation.AgentIDs,
175					Integrity: string(installation.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: installation.IntegrityDetail,
176				})
177			}
178			item := skillJSON{
179				Name: row.Name, Scope: string(row.Scope), ScopeRoot: row.ScopeRoot,
180				Path: row.Path, Agents: row.Agents, Source: row.Source,
181				SourceURL: row.SourceURL, SourceType: row.SourceType,
182				ManagedBy: string(row.ManagedBy), UpdateStatus: string(row.UpdateStatus),
183				UpdateDetail: row.UpdateDetail, Repo: row.Repository, RepoPath: row.RepositoryPath,
184				Checkout: row.Checkout, Installations: installations, Presence: string(row.Presence),
185				Integrity: string(row.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: row.IntegrityDetail,
186				AgentIDs: row.Attribution.AgentIDs, RegistrySource: row.Attribution.Registry,
187				RegistryVersion: row.RegistryVersion,
188			}
189			if row.Lock != nil {
190				item.LockVersion, item.Ref, item.SkillPath = row.Lock.Version, row.Lock.Ref, row.Lock.SkillPath
191				item.Plugin, item.InstalledAt, item.UpdatedAt = row.Lock.PluginName, row.Lock.InstalledAt, row.Lock.UpdatedAt
192				item.WellKnownDigest = row.Lock.WellKnownDigest
193			}
194			out = append(out, item)
195		}
196		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
197		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
198		return enc.Encode(out)
199	}

201	func renderSkillTable(app *App, rows []agentskill.Skill, targets []agenttarget.Target, project, global bool) error {
202		if !project && !global {
203			project = true
204		}
205		if project {
206			if len(targets) == 1 {
207				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "project root  %s\n\n", config.Contract(targets[0].CheckoutRoot))
208			} else {
209				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "project roots  %d repositories\n\n", len(targets))
210			}
211		}
212		if len(rows) == 0 {
213			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No agent skills found.")
214			return nil
215		}
216		style := app.outStyle()
217		t := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "SKILL", "INSTALL", "UPDATE", "AGENTS", "SOURCE", "PATH")
218		for _, row := range rows {
219			path := "—"
220			if row.Path != "" {
221				path = config.Contract(row.Path)
222			}
223			t.Add(dash(row.Repository), style.dim(string(row.Scope)), row.Name,
224				style.updateState(skillInstallLabel(row)), style.updateState(shortUpdate(row.UpdateStatus)),
225				compactAgents(row.Agents), dash(row.Source), path)
226		}
227		t.Render(app.Out)
228		return nil
229	}

231	func skillInstallLabel(row agentskill.Skill) string {
232		if row.Presence == agentskill.PresenceMissing {
233			return "missing"
234		}
235		switch row.Integrity {
236		case agentskill.IntegrityVerified:
237			return "verified"
238		case agentskill.IntegrityDrifted:
239			return "drifted"
240		default:
241			return "present"
242		}
243	}

245	func renderSkillDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentskill.Diagnostic) {
246		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
247			owner := string(diagnostic.Scope)
248			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
249				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
250			}
251			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: skill inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
252				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.Path), diagnostic.Message)
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
257		if len(agents) == 0 {
258			return "—"
259		}
260		names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
261		sort.Strings(names)
262		if len(names) <= 3 {
263			return strings.Join(names, ", ")
264		}
265		return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
266	}
267	
268	func shortUpdate(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
269		switch status {
270		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
271			return "update"
272		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
273			return "missing"
274		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
275			return "unknown"
276		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
277			return "failed"
278		default:
279			return string(status)
280		}
281	}

538	+func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
539	+	query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
540	+	for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
541	+		key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
542	+		if structured {
543	+			var field string
544	+			switch key {
545	+			case "repo":
546	+				field = row.Repository
547	+			case "agent":
548	+				field = string(row.Agent)
549	+			case "scope":
550	+				field = string(row.Scope)
551	+			case "transport":
552	+				field = string(row.Transport)
553	+			case "managed":
554	+				field = string(row.Source)
555	+			case "state":
556	+				field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
557	+			default:
558	+				field = ""
559	+			}
560	+			if field != "" {
561	+				if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
562	+					return false
563	+				}
564	+				continue
565	+			}
566	+		}
567	+		search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
568	+			row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
569	+			row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
570	+			string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
571	+		}, " "))
572	+		if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
573	+			return false
574	+		}
575	+	}
576	+	return true
577	+}

230	
231	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
232	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
233		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
234			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
235				return false
236			}
237		}
238		return true
239	}
240	
241	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
242	//
243	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
247		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
248	}
249	
250	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
251	// process per repository in the scan roots.
252	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
253		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())
254	}
255	
256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}
297	
298	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
299	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
300	
301	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
302	
303	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
304	type AmbiguousError struct {
305		Ref        string
306		Candidates []Repo
307	}
308	
309	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
310		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
311		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
312			names[i] = c.Display()
313		}
314		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
315	}

193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]

198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{

215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
