453				continue
454			}
455			hash := sha256.New()
456			if err := writeGitBlob(ctx, repoDir, file.oid, hash); err != nil {
457				return "", err
458			}
459			return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
460		}
461		return "", errGitSkillPathMissing
462	}
463	
464	func gitTreeFiles(ctx context.Context, repoDir, folder string) ([]gitTreeFile, error) {
465		args := []string{"--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", "HEAD", "--"}
466		if folder != "" {
467			args = append(args, folder)
468		}
469		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
470		command.Dir = repoDir
471		output, err := command.Output()
472		if err != nil {
473			return nil, err
474		}
475		prefix := ""
476		if folder != "" {
477			prefix = strings.TrimSuffix(folder, "/") + "/"
478		}
479		var files []gitTreeFile
480		for _, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
481			if len(record) == 0 {
482				continue
483			}
484			header, rawPath, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
485			if !ok {
486				return nil, errors.New("unexpected git tree record")
487			}
488			fields := bytes.Fields(header)
489			if len(fields) != 3 || string(fields[1]) != "blob" || !strings.HasPrefix(string(fields[0]), "100") {
490				continue
491			}
492			fullPath := filepath.ToSlash(string(rawPath))
493			name := fullPath
494			if prefix != "" {
495				if !strings.HasPrefix(fullPath, prefix) {
496					continue
497				}
498				name = strings.TrimPrefix(fullPath, prefix)
499			}
500			if name == "" || ignoredHashPath(name) {
501				continue
502			}
503			files = append(files, gitTreeFile{name: name, oid: string(fields[2])})
504		}
505		if len(files) == 0 {
506			return nil, errGitSkillPathMissing
507		}
508		return files, nil
509	}
510	
511	func writeGitBlob(ctx context.Context, repoDir, oid string, destination io.Writer) error {
512		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "cat-file", "blob", oid)
513		command.Dir = repoDir
514		command.Stdout = destination
515		return command.Run()
516	}
517	
518	func ignoredHashPath(name string) bool {
519		for _, component := range strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(name), "/") {
520			if component == ".git" || component == "node_modules" {
521				return true
522			}
523		}
524		return false
525	}
526	
527	func isASCII(value string) bool {
528		for index := range len(value) {
529			if value[index] >= 0x80 {
530				return false
531			}
532		}
533		return true
534	}
535	
536	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
537		return folderHashContext(context.Background(), dir)
538	}
539	
540	func folderHashContext(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
541		type file struct {
542			name string
543			path string
544		}
545		var files []file
546		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
547			if err != nil {
548				return err
549			}
550			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
551				return ctxErr
552			}
553			if entry.IsDir() && filename != dir && (entry.Name() == ".git" || entry.Name() == "node_modules") {
554				return filepath.SkipDir
555			}
556			if entry.Type().IsRegular() {
557				relative, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
558				if err != nil {
559					return err
560				}
561				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(relative), path: filename})
562			}
563			return nil
564		})
565		if err != nil {
566			return "", err
567		}
568		collator := collate.New(language.English)
569		sort.SliceStable(files, func(i, j int) bool {
570			if order := collator.CompareString(files[i].name, files[j].name); order != 0 {
571				return order < 0
572			}
573			return files[i].name < files[j].name
574		})
575		hash := sha256.New()
576		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
577		for _, file := range files {
578			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
579				return "", err
580			}
581			_, _ = io.WriteString(hash, file.name)
582			input, openedInfo, err := safefile.OpenRegular(file.path)
583			if err != nil {
584				return "", err
585			}
586			currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(file.path)
587			if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
588				_ = input.Close()
589				return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
590			}
591			for {
592				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
593					_ = input.Close()
594					return "", err
595				}
596				read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
597				if read > 0 {
598					_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
599				}
600				if readErr != nil {
601					_ = input.Close()
602					if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
603						break
604					}
605					return "", readErr
606				}
607			}
608		}
609		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
610	}
611	
612	func fileHashContext(ctx context.Context, filename string) (string, error) {
613		info, err := os.Lstat(filename)
614		if err != nil {
615			return "", err
616		}
617		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
618			return "", errors.New("skill hash target is not a regular file")
619		}
620		input, openedInfo, err := safefile.OpenRegular(filename)
621		if err != nil {
622			return "", err
623		}
624		defer input.Close()
625		currentInfo, err := os.Lstat(filename)
626		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
627			return "", errors.New("skill hash target changed while opening")
628		}
629		hash := sha256.New()
630		buffer := make([]byte, 32*1024)
631		for {
632			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
633				return "", err
634			}
635			read, readErr := input.Read(buffer)
636			if read > 0 {
637				_, _ = hash.Write(buffer[:read])
638			}
639			if readErr != nil {
640				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
641					break
642				}
643				return "", readErr
644			}
645		}
646		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
647	}
648	
649	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
650		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
651		cmd.Dir = dir
652		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
653		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
654		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
655			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
656		}
657		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
658	}

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}
207	
208	// Inventory scans cwd's current target and the requested global scope.
209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}
216	
217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}
262	
263	// ScanTargets is an explicit compatibility name for Scan.
264	func ScanTargets(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
265		return Scan(ctx, targets, options)

268	// List preserves the original row-only API. Native diagnostics are available
269	// through Inventory or Scan and never turn a malformed neighboring scope into a
270	// fatal whole-scan error.
271	func List(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) ([]Skill, error) {
272		result, err := Inventory(ctx, cwd, options)
273		return result.Skills, err
274	}

276	// ManagedName returns the canonical lock key for one unambiguous provider-
277	// managed skill. Direct-managed dev-cli and option-like keys are never handed
278	// to the external update command.
279	func directManagedSkillName(name string) bool {
280		return reservedSkillNameKey(name) == reservedSkillNameKey(skill.Name)
281	}
282	
283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}
298	
299	func lockUpdateable(entry LockMetadata) bool {
300		if entry.SkillPath == "" || !safeProviderSkillName(entry.Name) {
301			return false
302		}
303		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(entry.SourceType)) {
304		case "github", "git", "gitlab":
305			_, ok := sourceURL(entry)
306			return ok
307		case "well-known":
308			return strings.TrimSpace(entry.Source) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(entry.SourceURL) != ""
309		default:
310			return false
311		}
312	}

318			!directManagedSkillName(row.Lock.Name)
319	}

329		} else {
330			document = readProjectLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
331		}
332		entry, ok := document.find(name)

334			return "", false
335		}
336		return entry.Name, true
337	}

358		var matches []Skill
359		for _, row := range rows {
360			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
361				matches = append(matches, row)
362			}
363		}
364		if len(matches) == 1 {
365			return matches[0], nil
366		}
367		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
368	}
369	
370	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
371	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
372	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
373		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
374		for _, result := range results {
375			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
376			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
377			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
378				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
379			}
380			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
381				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
382			}
383		}
384		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
385		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
386		return merged
387	}
388	
389	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
390		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
391			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
392			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
393				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
394			}
395			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
396				return left.Repository < right.Repository
397			}
398			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
399				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
400			}
401			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
402			if leftName != rightName {
403				return leftName < rightName
404			}
405			if left.Name != right.Name {
406				return left.Name < right.Name
407			}
408			return left.Path < right.Path
409		})
410	}
411	
412	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
413		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
414			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
415			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
416				return left.Repository < right.Repository
417			}
418			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
419				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
420			}
421			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
422				return left.Scope < right.Scope
423			}
424			if left.Path != right.Path {
425				return left.Path < right.Path
426			}
427			if left.Name != right.Name {
428				return left.Name < right.Name
429			}
430			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
431				return left.Kind < right.Kind
432			}
433			return left.Message < right.Message
434		})
435	}
436	
437	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {
438		if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
439			return false
440		}
441		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
442			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
443		})
444	}
445	
446	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
447		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
448		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
449		for _, value := range values {
450			if value == "" {
451				continue
452			}
453			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
454				continue
455			}
456			seen[value] = struct{}{}
457			out = append(out, value)
458		}
459		sort.Strings(out)
460		return out
461	}
462	
463	func homeDirectory() string {
464		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
465		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
466			return ""
467		}
468		return home
469	}

106	func resolveAgentTargets(ctx context.Context, app *App, cwd string, all bool, repoRef string, project bool) ([]agenttarget.Target, error) {

112		}
113		if repoRef != "" {

115			if err != nil {
116				return nil, err
117			}
118			return []agenttarget.Target{target}, nil
119		}
120		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		canonical, discoverErr := agenttarget.All(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots())
125		if discoverErr == nil {
126			target = agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(canonical, target)
127		}
128		return []agenttarget.Target{target}, nil
129	}

184				Path: row.Path, Agents: row.Agents, Source: row.Source,
185				SourceURL: row.SourceURL, SourceType: row.SourceType,
186				ManagedBy: string(row.ManagedBy), UpdateStatus: string(row.UpdateStatus),
187				UpdateDetail: row.UpdateDetail, Repo: row.Repository, RepoPath: row.RepositoryPath,
188				Checkout: row.Checkout, Installations: installations, Presence: string(row.Presence),
189				Integrity: string(row.Integrity), IntegrityDetail: row.IntegrityDetail,
190				AgentIDs: row.Attribution.AgentIDs, RegistrySource: row.Attribution.Registry,
191				RegistryVersion: row.RegistryVersion,
192			}

222		for _, row := range rows {
223			path := "—"
224			if row.Path != "" {
225				path = config.Contract(row.Path)

228				style.updateState(skillInstallLabel(row)), style.updateState(shortUpdate(row.UpdateStatus)),
229				compactAgents(row.Agents), dash(row.Source), path)
230		}
231		t.Render(app.Out)
232		return nil
233	}

260	func compactAgents(agents []string) string {
261		if len(agents) == 0 {
262			return "—"
263		}
264		names := append([]string(nil), agents...)
265		sort.Strings(names)
266		if len(names) <= 3 {
267			return strings.Join(names, ", ")
268		}
269		return strings.Join(names[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(names)-3)
270	}

465	// generateCommandReference renders the whole command tree as markdown. This is
466	// the single source of truth for what the skill tells an agent dev can do.
467	func generateCommandReference(root *cobra.Command) string {
468		var b strings.Builder
469		b.WriteString("<!-- generated by `dev skill sync`; do not edit by hand -->\n\n")
470		if flags := renderFlagSet(root.PersistentFlags()); flags != "" {
471			b.WriteString("### Global options\n\n")
472			b.WriteString(flags)
473			b.WriteString("\n")
474		}
475		writeCommand(&b, root, 0)
476		return b.String()
477	}
478	
479	func writeCommand(b *strings.Builder, c *cobra.Command, depth int) {
480		if c.Hidden || c.Name() == "no-help" {
481			return
482		}
483		if depth > 0 {
484			fmt.Fprintf(b, "### `%s`\n\n%s\n\n", c.CommandPath(), firstLine(c.Short))
485			if usage := c.UseLine(); usage != "" {
486				fmt.Fprintf(b, "```\n%s\n```\n\n", usage)
487			}
488			if flags := renderFlags(c); flags != "" {
489				b.WriteString(flags)
490				b.WriteString("\n")
491			}
492		}
493		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
494			writeCommand(b, sub, depth+1)
495		}
496	}
497	
498	func renderFlags(c *cobra.Command) string {
499		return renderFlagSet(c.LocalNonPersistentFlags())
500	}
501	
502	func renderFlagSet(flags *pflag.FlagSet) string {
503		var b strings.Builder
504		flags.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
505			if f.Hidden {
506				return
507			}
508			name := "--" + f.Name
509			if f.Shorthand != "" {
510				name = "-" + f.Shorthand + ", " + name
511			}
512			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` — %s\n", name, f.Usage)
513		})
514		return b.String()
515	}
516	
517	func firstLine(s string) string {
518		if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
519			return s[:i]
520		}
521		return s
522	}

49				if err != nil {
50					return err
51				}
52				project := len(scopeFilter) == 0 || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeProject] || scopeFilter[agentmcp.ScopeLocal]
53				if !project && (all || repoRef != "") {
54					return fmt.Errorf("--all and --repo require project or local scope")
55				}
56				cwd, err := os.Getwd()
57				if err != nil {
58					return err
59				}
60				targets, err := resolveAgentTargets(cmd.Context(), app, cwd, all, repoRef, project)
61				if err != nil {
62					return err
63				}
64				result, err := agentmcp.Scan(cmd.Context(), targets)
65				if err != nil {
66					return err
67				}
68				result.Declarations = filterMCPDeclarations(result.Declarations, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
69				result.Diagnostics = filterMCPDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics, agentFilter, scopeFilter)
70				if jsonOut {
71					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
72					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
73					return encoder.Encode(result)
74				}
75				renderMCPDiagnostics(app, result.Diagnostics)
76				return renderMCPTable(app, result.Declarations)
77			},
78		}
79		flags := cmd.Flags()
80		flags.BoolVar(&all, "all", false, "scan every configured canonical repository")
81		flags.StringVarP(&repoRef, "repo", "r", "", "scan one repository or explicit checkout path")
82		flags.StringSliceVar(&agents, "agent", nil, "agent format: claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, opencode")
83		flags.StringSliceVar(&scopes, "scope", nil, "declaration scope: project, local, user, custom, system-defaults, system-override, managed")
84		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit a stable sanitized JSON envelope")
85		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "repo", completeRepoFlag(app))
86		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "agent", fixedCompletions("claude-code", "codex", "cursor", "gemini-cli", "opencode"))
87		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "scope", fixedCompletions("project", "local", "user", "custom", "system-defaults", "system-override", "managed"))
88		return cmd
89	}

91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}
132	
133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}
143	
144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {
145		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Diagnostic, 0, len(rows))
146		for _, row := range rows {
147			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered
153	}
154	
155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}

514				} else {

520			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {

525				}

527				if next != "" {
528					updated.Next = next
529				}
530				runtimeForTask(active, &updated) // normalize empty handle/name provenance
531				if updated.RuntimeHandle != "" {
532					if _, _, err := closeTaskRuntime(ctx, active, &updated, checkoutOf(&updated)); err != nil {
533						return "", err
534					}
535				}
536				// The dashboard only parks warm: going cold removes a checkout,
537				// which is too consequential for a single keystroke.
538				updated.State, updated.Owner = task.Warm, config.Hostname()
539				if err := active.Tasks.Save(&updated); err != nil {
540					return "", err
541				}

561			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the

563			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {

565				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
566				if err != nil {

568				}
569				actionApp := *active
570				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
571				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
572					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
573				})
574				if err != nil {
575					return "", err
576				}
577				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)

584			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
585				active := appState.Current()
586				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
587				if err != nil {
588					return "", err
589				}
590				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
591					return "", err
592				}
593				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
594				if err != nil {
595					return "", err
596				}
597				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
598					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
599				}
600				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
601				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
602					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
603				}
604				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
605				if err != nil {
606					return "", err
607				}
608				t := &task.Task{
609					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
610					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
611					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
612				}
613				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
614				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
615					return "", err
616				}
617				annotate(active, rt, t)
618				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
619			},

621			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
622				active := appState.Current()
623				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
624				if err != nil {
625					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
626				}
627				defer store.Close()
628				until := time.Now()
629				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
630				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
631					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
632				})
633				if err != nil {
634					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
635				}
636				seconds, days := 0, 0
637				for _, value := range totals {
638					seconds += value
639					if value > 0 {
640						days++
641					}
642				}
643				return tui.StatsPanel{
644					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
645					Since: since, Until: until,
646					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
647						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
648					}),
649				}, nil
650			},

664				return err
665			},

684			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
685				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
686				if err != nil {

689				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
690				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
691				if err != nil {
692					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
693				}
694				status := "config + data reloaded"
695				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
696					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
697				}
698				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
699					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
700					Tools:       externalTools(next),
701					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
702					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
703					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,

708		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
709		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
710		// while dozens of repos are probed.
711		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
712		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
713		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
714		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
715		cancelRun()
716		app.finishTrace()
717		if err != nil {
718			return err
719		}
720		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
721		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
722		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
723			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
724				return app.cdDirective(dir)
725			}
726			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
727				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
728				if resolveErr != nil {
729					return resolveErr
730				}
731				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
732			}
733		}
734		return nil
735	}

737	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
738		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
739		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
740	}
741	
742	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
743		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
744		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
745		if err != nil {
746			return nil, err
747		}
748		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
749		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
750		if !sessionsSet {
751			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
752		}
753		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
754		for _, item := range items {
755			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
756			if item.Entry != nil {
757				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
758					copy := location
759					row.Location = &copy
760				}
761			}
762			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
763			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
764				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
765					sizeRepo = &discovered
766				}
767			}
768			if sizeRepo != nil {
769				worktreeCount := 0
770				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
771					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
772				}
773				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
774			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
775				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
776			}
777			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
778				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
779			}
780			if item.Live.Present {
781				for _, session := range sessions {
782					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
783						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
784						row.Live = true
785						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
786						break
787					}
788				}
789			}
790			rows = append(rows, row)
791		}
792		return rows, listErr
793	}
794	
795	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
796		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
797		if err != nil {
798			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
799		}
800		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
801			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
802				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
803				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
804			})
805			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
806			return item, resolveErr
807		}
808		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
809			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
810				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
811			}
812			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
813			if openErr != nil {
814				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
815			}
816			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
817			if rt.Name() == "none" {
818				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
819			} else {
820				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
821				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
822			}
823			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
824				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
825			}
826			return result, nil
827		}
828	
829		switch request.Action {
830		case tui.TryOpen:
831			item, resolveErr := resolve()
832			if resolveErr != nil {
833				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
834			}
835			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
836	
837		case tui.TryCreate:
838			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
839				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
840			})
841			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
842			if created.InitWarning != nil {
843				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
844			}
845			if createErr != nil {
846				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
847			}
848			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
849			if created.Existing {
850				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
851			}
852			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
853			result.RefreshRepos = true
854			return result, openErr
855	
856		case tui.TryMark:
857			item, resolveErr := resolve()
858			if resolveErr != nil {
859				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
860			}
861			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
862			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
863			note := request.Note
864			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
865				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
866			})
867			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
868			return tui.TryActionResult{
869				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
870			}, patchErr
871	
872		case tui.TryDeprecate:
873			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
874			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
875			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
876	
877		case tui.TryReactivate:
878			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
879			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
880			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
881	
882		case tui.TryArchive:
883			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
884			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
885			return tui.TryActionResult{
886				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
887			}, transitionErr
888	
889		case tui.TryRestore:
890			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
891			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
892			return tui.TryActionResult{
893				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
894			}, transitionErr
895	
896		case tui.TryGraduate:
897			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
898				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
899			})
900			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
901			if graduateErr != nil {
902				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
903			}
904			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
905			result.RefreshRepos = true
906			return result, openErr
907		}
908		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
909	}
910	
911	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
912	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
913	type repoCollectOptions struct {
914		IncludeTries bool
915		Sessions     []runtime.Session
916		SessionsSet  bool
917		Tasks        []*task.Task
918		TasksSet     bool
919		Repos        []repo.Repo
920		ReposSet     bool
921		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
922	}
923	
924	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
925	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
926	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
927		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
928	}
929	
930	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
931		repos := options.Repos
932		var err error
933		if !options.ReposSet {
934			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
935			if err != nil {
936				return nil, err
937			}
938		}
939		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
940		if err != nil {
941			return nil, err
942		}
943		if !options.IncludeTries {
944			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
945			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
946			for index, repository := range repos {
947				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
948					continue
949				}
950				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
951				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
952			}
953			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
954		}
955		tasks := options.Tasks
956		if !options.TasksSet {
957			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
958			if err != nil {
959				return nil, err
960			}
961		}
962		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
963		for _, t := range tasks {
964			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
965		}
966		sessions := options.Sessions
967		if !options.SessionsSet {
968			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
969		}
970		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
971		if app.Notes != nil {
972			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
973			if noteErr != nil {
974				return nil, noteErr
975			}
976			for _, n := range allNotes {
977				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
978			}
979		}
980	
981		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
982		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
983		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
984		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
985		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
986		limiter := options.Limiter
987		if limiter == nil {
988			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
989		}
990		var wg sync.WaitGroup
991		for i, r := range repos {
992			wg.Add(1)
993			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
994				defer wg.Done()
995				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
996				if !ok {
997					return
998				}
999				defer release()
1000	
1001				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1002				if row.Asset != nil {
1003					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1004					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1005					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1006						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1007					}
1008				}
1009				if r.HasGit {
1010					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1011				}
1012				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1013				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1014					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1015				}
1016				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1017				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1018				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1019				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1020					row.Status = main.Status
1021				}
1022				if !r.Bare {
1023					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1024				}
1025				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1026					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1027					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1028				}
1029				if r.HasGit {
1030					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1031						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1032						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1033					}, row.Worktrees)
1034				} else {
1035					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1036				}
1037				out[i] = row
1038			}(i, r)
1039		}
1040		wg.Wait()
1041		return out, ctx.Err()
1042	}
1043	
1044	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1045	//
1046	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1047	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1048	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1049	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1050		var out []tui.Tool
1051		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1052			run := t.Run
1053			name := t.Name
1054			if name == "" {
1055				name = firstWord(run)
1056			}
1057			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1058			if t.Interactive {
1059				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1060				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1061				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1062				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1063				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1064			}
1065			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1066				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1067				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1068			})
1069		}
1070		return out
1071	}
1072	
1073	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1074	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1075	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1076	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1077		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1078	}
1079	
1080	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1081		if ctx == nil {
1082			ctx = context.Background()
1083		}
1084		word := firstWord(run)
1085		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1086			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1087			if word == "" {
1088				return false
1089			}
1090			word = firstWord(word)
1091		}
1092		if word == "" {
1093			return false
1094		}
1095		if interactive {
1096			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1097			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1098			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1099			defer cancel()
1100			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1101				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1102			return probe.Run() == nil
1103		}
1104		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1105			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1106			return err == nil
1107		}
1108		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1109		return err == nil
1110	}
1111	
1112	func firstWord(s string) string {
1113		f := strings.Fields(s)
1114		if len(f) == 0 {
1115			return ""
1116		}
1117		return f[0]
1118	}
1119	
1120	func shellPath() string {
1121		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1122			return s
1123		}
1124		return "/bin/sh"
1125	}
1126	
1127	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1128	// of private repositories.
1129	func remoteCachePath() string {
1130		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1131	}
1132	
1133	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1134		parts := []string{
1135			"forge-source-v1",
1136			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1137			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1138			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1139		}
1140		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1141			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1142		}
1143		sort.Strings(parts)
1144		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1145		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1146	}
1147	
1148	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1149	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1150	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1151	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1152		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1153		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1154		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1155			return nil, false, false
1156		}
1157		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1158		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1159			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1160		}
1161		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1162	}
1163	
1164	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1165	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1166	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1167		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1168		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1169			return nil, false
1170		}
1171		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1172	}
1173	
1174	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1175		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1176		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1177		for _, r := range locals {
1178			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1179				continue
1180			}
1181			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1182			if ambiguous[key] {
1183				continue
1184			}
1185			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1186				delete(byRemote, key)
1187				ambiguous[key] = true
1188				continue
1189			}
1190			byRemote[key] = r
1191		}
1192		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1193		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1194			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1195			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1196				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1197				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1198				if local.Asset != nil {
1199					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1200				}
1201			}
1202			out = append(out, row)
1203		}
1204		return out
1205	}
1206	
1207	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1208	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1209	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1210	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1211		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1212		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1213			return nil, false
1214		}
1215		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1216	}
1217	
1218	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1219		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1220		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1221			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1222		}
1223		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1224	}
1225	
1226	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1227	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1228	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1229	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1230		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1231		LocalsSet    bool
1232		Providers    []forge.Forge
1233		ProvidersSet bool
1234	}
1235	
1236	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1237		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1238	}
1239	
1240	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1241		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1242	}
1243	
1244	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1245		type result struct {
1246			kind  forge.Kind
1247			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1248			err   error
1249		}
1250		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1251		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1252			if options.LocalsSet {
1253				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1254			}
1255			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1256		}
1257		providers := options.Providers
1258		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1259			providers = configuredForges(app)
1260		}
1261		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1262		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1263		available := 0
1264		var unavailable []error
1265		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1266		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1267		for _, f := range providers {
1268			if !f.Available() {
1269				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1270				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1271				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1272					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1273					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1274					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1275				}
1276				continue
1277			}
1278			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1279			available++
1280			wg.Add(1)
1281			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1282				defer wg.Done()
1283				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1284				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1285			}(f)
1286		}
1287		wg.Wait()
1288		close(ch)
1289		if available == 0 {
1290			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1291				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1292				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1293					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1294				}
1295				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1296			}
1297			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1298				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1299			}
1300			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1301		}
1302	
1303		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1304		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1305			old = forge.Cache{}
1306		}
1307		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1308		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1309		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1310			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1311		}
1312		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1313			statuses[kind] = status
1314		}
1315		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1316		successful := 0
1317		now := time.Now().UTC()
1318		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1319			status := statuses[kind]
1320			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1321			statuses[kind] = status
1322		}
1323		for res := range ch {
1324			if res.err != nil {
1325				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1326				status := statuses[res.kind]
1327				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1328				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1329					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1330					status.FetchedAt = now
1331					status.Complete = false
1332				}
1333				statuses[res.kind] = status
1334				continue
1335			}
1336			successful++
1337			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1338			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1339		}
1340		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1341		complete := true
1342		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1343		for kind := range expected {
1344			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1345			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1346				complete = false
1347			}
1348			if ok {
1349				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1350			}
1351			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1352		}
1353		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1354		if successful > 0 {
1355			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1356				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1357				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1358			})
1359		}
1360		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1361	}
1362	
1363	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1364		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1365			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1366				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1367			}
1368			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1369		})
1370	}
1371	
1372	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1373		providers := forge.All()
1374		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1375			return providers
1376		}
1377		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1378		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1379			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1380				Organization: target.Organization,
1381				Project:      target.Project,
1382			})
1383		}
1384		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1385	}
1386	
1387	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1388		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1389		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1390		if assetErr != nil {
1391			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1392			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1393		}
1394		type localMatch struct {
1395			repository repo.Repo
1396			asset      *catalog.Entry
1397		}
1398		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1399		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1400		for index, r := range locals {
1401			if r.Bare {
1402				continue
1403			}
1404			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1405			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1406				continue
1407			}
1408			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1409			if ambiguous[key] {
1410				continue
1411			}
1412			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1413				delete(localByRemote, key)
1414				ambiguous[key] = true
1415				continue
1416			}
1417			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1418		}
1419		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1420		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1421			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1422			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1423				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1424				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1425				if local.asset != nil {
1426					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1427				}
1428			}
1429			out = append(out, row)
1430		}
1431		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1432		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1433		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1434		return out
1435	}
1436	
1437	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1438		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1439			return
1440		}
1441		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1442		if err != nil {
1443			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1444			return
1445		}
1446		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1447			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1448		}
1449		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1450			return
1451		}
1452		host := config.Hostname()
1453		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1454		for _, entry := range entries {
1455			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1456			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1457				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1458				continue
1459			}
1460			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1461		}
1462		for index := range rows {
1463			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1464			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1465			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1466				continue
1467			}
1468			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1469			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1470			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1471			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1472		}
1473	}
1474	
1475	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1476		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1477			if candidate == "" {
1478				continue
1479			}
1480			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1481				return candidate
1482			}
1483		}
1484		return ""
1485	}
1486	
1487	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1488		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1489		if err != nil {
1490			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1491		}
1492		path := tmp.Name()
1493		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1494			_ = tmp.Close()
1495			_ = os.Remove(path)
1496			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1497		}
1498		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1499			_ = os.Remove(path)
1500			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1501		}
1502		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1503		if err != nil {
1504			_ = os.Remove(path)
1505			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1506		}
1507		return tui.NoteEdit{
1508			Command: proc,
1509			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1510				if runErr != nil {
1511					_ = os.Remove(path)
1512					return runErr
1513				}
1514				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1515				if err != nil {
1516					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1517				}
1518				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1519					_ = os.Remove(path)
1520					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1521				}
1522				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1523				if err != nil {
1524					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1525				}
1526				_ = os.Remove(path)
1527				return nil
1528			},
1529		}, nil
1530	}

13	func resolverOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
14		if err != nil {
15			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
16		}
17		return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
18	}

20	// tuiRuntimeResolver moves runtime auto-detection off the first-view path while
21	// sharing exactly one result across inventory loads and actions.
22	type tuiRuntimeResolver struct {
23		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
24		resolve func() runtime.Runtime
25		once    sync.Once
26		ready   chan struct{}
27		rt      runtime.Runtime
28	}
29	
30	func newTUIRuntimeResolver(app *App) *tuiRuntimeResolver {
31		snapshot := *app
32		return &tuiRuntimeResolver{
33			trace: app.trace, resolve: snapshot.Runtime, ready: make(chan struct{}),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
41				r.rt = r.resolve()
42				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
43				close(r.ready)
44			}()
45		})
46		if ctx == nil {
47			ctx = context.Background()
48		}
49		select {
50		case <-ctx.Done():
51			return nil, ctx.Err()
52		case <-r.ready:
53			return r.rt, nil
54		}
55	}

58	// SKILLS reads/actions.

61		ctx     context.Context
62		getwd   func() (string, error)

64		once    sync.Once

84				cwd, err := r.getwd()

90				close(r.ready)
91			}()
92		})
93		if ctx == nil {
94			ctx = context.Background()
95		}
96		select {
97		case <-ctx.Done():
98			return agenttarget.Target{}, ctx.Err()
99		case <-r.ready:
100			return r.target, r.err
101		}
102	}

174				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
175				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
176			})
177			return false
178		}
179		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
180		count := rows
181		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
182			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
183			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,

185		})

192	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
193		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
194	
195		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
196		if generation != state.generation {

198				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
199				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
200			})
201			return false
202		}
203	
204		state.loading = false
205		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
206		state.outcome = outcome
207		if valid {
208			state.hasSnapshot = true
209			state.source = source
210			state.freshness = freshness
211			state.actionable = actionable
212			count := rows
213			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
214				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
215				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
216				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
217			})
218		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
219			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
220		}
221		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
222		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
223			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
224			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
225			Generation: generation,
226		})
227		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {

230			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil

246		case err != nil && valid:

248		case err != nil || !valid:
249			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
250		default:
251			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
252		}
253	}

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
18	)
19	
20	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
21	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
22	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
23	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
24	type Target struct {
25		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
26		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
27		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
28		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
29		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
30	}
31	
32	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
33	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
34	func (t Target) Key() string {
35		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
36	}
37	
38	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
39	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
40	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
41	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
42		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
43		if err == nil {
44			return target, nil
45		}
46		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
47			return Target{}, ctxErr
48		}
49		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
50			return Target{}, err
51		}
52		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
53		if pathErr != nil {
54			return Target{}, pathErr
55		}
56		name := filepath.Base(root)
57		return Target{
58			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
59			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
60		}, nil
61	}
62	
63	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
64	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
65		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
66		if err != nil {
67			return Target{}, err
68		}
69		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
70		if err != nil {
71			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
72		}
73		return fromGit(found)
74	}
75	
76	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
77	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
78	// worktree path is preserved.
79	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
80		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Target{}, err
83		}
84		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
85		if err != nil {
86			return Target{}, err
87		}
88		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
89		// An explicit linked-worktree path keeps the main repository identity from
90		// Git, but its checkout root remains the navigation path the caller selected.
91		switch {
92		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath):
93			if found.Name != "" {
94				target.RepoName = found.Name
95			}
96			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
97				target.RepoDisplay = display
98			}
99			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
100			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
101		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot):
102			target.CheckoutRoot = navigationPath(found.Path)
103		}
104		return target, nil
105	}
106	
107	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
108	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
109		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
110	}
111	
112	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
113	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
114	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
115	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
116		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
117			return Target{}, false
118		}
119		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
120		commonDir := found.CommonDir
121		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
122			return Target{}, false
123		}
124		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
125		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
126		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
127		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
128		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
129		name := found.Name
130		if name == "" {
131			name = filepath.Base(repository)
132		}
133		display := found.Display()
134		if display == "" {
135			display = name
136		}
137		return Target{
138			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
139			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
140		}, true
141	}
142	
143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
161	
162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
167		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
168			current = ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)
169			out = append(out, current)
170		}
171		return Dedupe(out)
172	}
173	
174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the
175	// canonical repository's configured navigation identity when it is known.
176	func ReconcileCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) Target {
177		for _, target := range targets {
178			if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
179				current.RepoName = target.RepoName
180				current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
181				current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
182				if comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot) == comparablePath(current.CheckoutRoot) {
183					current.CheckoutRoot = target.CheckoutRoot
184				}
185				break
186			}
187		}
188		return current
189	}
190	
191	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
192	// concrete main-checkout targets.
193	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
194		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
199	}
200	
201	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
202	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
203	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
204		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
205		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
206		for _, target := range targets {
207			key := target.Key()
208			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
209				continue
210			}
211			seen[key] = struct{}{}
212			out = append(out, target)
213		}
214		Sort(out)
215		return out
216	}
217	
218	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
219	func Sort(targets []Target) {
220		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
221			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
222			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
223			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
224				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
225			}
226			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
227				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
228			}
229			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
230				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
231			}
232			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
233				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
234			}
235			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
236				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
237			}
238			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
239		})
240	}
241	
242	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
243		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
244			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
245		}
246		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
247		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
248		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
249		name := found.Name
250		if name == "" {
251			name = filepath.Base(repository)
252		}
253		return Target{
254			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
255			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
256		}, nil
257	}
258	
259	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
260		for _, value := range values {
261			if value != "" {
262				return value
263			}
264		}
265		return ""
266	}
267	
268	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err != nil {
271			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
272		}
273		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
274			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
275		}
276		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
277	}
278	
279	func navigationPath(value string) string {
280		if value == "" {
281			return ""
282		}
283		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
284		if err == nil {
285			value = absolute
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
291		if value == "" {
292			return ""
293		}
294		if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(value); err == nil {
295			return resolved
296		}
297		return navigationPath(value)
298	}
299	
300	func comparablePath(value string) string {
301		return canonicalPath(value)
302	}
303

26	
27	// View is which list the dashboard is showing.
28	type View int
29	
30	const (
31		// ViewTasks lists recorded change streams — what am I working on.
32		ViewTasks View = iota
33		// ViewRepos lists every repository under the scan roots — what do I have.
34		ViewRepos
35		// ViewFleet lists repository observations across configured machines.
36		ViewFleet
37		// ViewTries lists durable scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history.
38		ViewTries
39		// ViewRemote lists repositories visible through configured forge CLIs.
40		ViewRemote
41		// ViewSkills lists project and global agent skills.
42		ViewSkills
43		// ViewMCP lists static MCP server declarations across agent formats.
44		ViewMCP
45	)
46	
47	// Views is the cycle order.
48	var Views = []View{ViewTasks, ViewRepos, ViewFleet, ViewTries, ViewRemote, ViewSkills, ViewMCP}
49	
50	func (v View) String() string {
51		switch v {
52		case ViewRepos:
53			return "repos"
54		case ViewFleet:
55			return "fleet"
56		case ViewTries:
57			return "try"
58		case ViewRemote:
59			return "remote"
60		case ViewSkills:
61			return "skills"
62		case ViewMCP:
63			return "mcp"
64		default:
65			return "tasks"
66		}
67	}
68	
69	// Actions is everything the dashboard can do. The TUI owns no domain logic:
70	// it calls back into the same code paths the non-interactive commands use, so
71	// behaviour cannot diverge between them.
72	// LoadWarning carries nonfatal inventory diagnostics without making an accepted
73	// snapshot stale or retrying it on every tab visit.
74	type LoadWarning struct{ Message string }
75	
76	func (w LoadWarning) Error() string { return w.Message }
77	
78	func splitLoadWarning(err error) (string, error) {
79		var warning LoadWarning
80		if errors.As(err, &warning) {
81			return warning.Message, nil
82		}
83		return "", err
84	}
85	
86	type Actions struct {
87		// Reload re-reads the task inventory.
88		Reload func(ctx context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error)
89		// ReloadRepos re-reads the repository list.
90		ReloadRepos func(ctx context.Context) ([]RepoRow, error)
91		// ReloadFleet fans out to configured dev hosts. It is lazy like REMOTE.
92		ReloadFleet          func(ctx context.Context) ([]FleetRow, error)
93		ReloadFleetWithRepos func(ctx context.Context, repos []RepoRow) ([]FleetRow, error)
94		// ReloadRemote queries configured forge CLIs. It is lazy: the network is untouched
95		// until the REMOTE view is opened. Production supplies accepted local rows so
96		// matching does not trigger another repository discovery.
97		ReloadRemote          func(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRow, error)
98		ReloadRemoteWithRepos func(ctx context.Context, repos []RepoRow) ([]RemoteRow, error)
99		// ReloadSkills reads local project/global skill state without contacting sources.
100		ReloadSkills          func(ctx context.Context) ([]agentskill.Skill, error)
101		ReloadSkillsWithRepos func(ctx context.Context, repos []RepoRow) ([]agentskill.Skill, error)
102		// ReloadMCP reads static declarations only; it never starts or probes servers.
103		ReloadMCP          func(ctx context.Context) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error)
104		ReloadMCPWithRepos func(ctx context.Context, repos []RepoRow) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error)
105		// Cache seeds are local-only and asynchronous. Live REMOTE/FLEET work remains
106		// lazy until its view is requested.
107		LoadRemoteCache func(ctx context.Context) RemoteCacheResult
108		LoadFleetCache  func(ctx context.Context) FleetCacheResult
109		// AfterFirstView performs optional background work only after the initial
110		// application frame has been computed.
111		AfterFirstView func(ctx context.Context)
112		// CheckSkills performs the explicitly requested read-only network comparison.
113		CheckSkills func(ctx context.Context, rows []agentskill.Skill) []agentskill.Skill
114		// AddSkill and UpdateSkill return locked interactive processes for tea to suspend around.
115		AddSkill    func() (*agentskill.MutationCommand, error)
116		UpdateSkill func(row agentskill.Skill) (*agentskill.MutationCommand, error)
117		// Repos and Tries group asset-specific metadata and lifecycle actions.
118		Repos RepoActions
119		Tries TryActions
120		Notes NoteActions
121		Sizes SizeActions
122		Local LocalActions
123		// Open makes a task live.
124		Open func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (OpenResult, error)
125		// OpenRepo makes a repository live.
126		OpenRepo func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow) (OpenResult, error)
127		// OpenCheckout makes one linked worktree live.
128		OpenCheckout func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) (OpenResult, error)
129		// OpenRemote opens a remote's existing local checkout.
130		OpenRemote func(ctx context.Context, r RemoteRow) (OpenResult, error)
131		// OpenFleet returns an interactive process for a local or remote fleet row.
132		OpenFleet func(ctx context.Context, r FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error)
133		// CloneRemote clones a remote that has no local checkout and returns the
134		// new path, so the row can be updated without querying the network again.
135		CloneRemote func(ctx context.Context, r RemoteRow) (OpenResult, string, error)
136		// Park closes a task's session and records its next action.
137		Park func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) (string, error)
138		// SetNext records a task's next action.
139		SetNext func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) error
140		// Start creates an isolated worktree task in a repository.
141		Start func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, name string) (string, error)
142		// StartDirect tracks the repository's currently checked-out branch without
143		// creating a branch or worktree.
144		StartDirect func(ctx context.Context, r RepoRow, name string) (string, error)
145		// LoadStats builds the selected repository's activity heatmap.
146		LoadStats func(ctx context.Context, repo string) (StatsPanel, error)
147		// BackfillStats derives this repository's history into the activity store.
148		BackfillStats func(ctx context.Context, repo string) error
149		// Copy writes one of the repo-context payloads to the system clipboard.
150		Copy func(text string) error
151		// EditConfig returns the editor process; tea suspends around it.
152		EditConfig func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
153		// EditFleetConfig does the same for remotes.toml, which is a separate file
154		// with its own schema — the FLEET view's `e` would otherwise open the
155		// config that has nothing to do with what it is showing.
156		EditFleetConfig func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
