```text
346	// New builds the dashboard.
347	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
348		in := textinput.New()
349		in.CharLimit = 200
350	
351		m := Model{
352			actions:        actions,
353			rows:           rows,
354			repos:          repos,
355			input:          in,
356			width:          100,
357			height:         30,
358			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
359			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
360		}
361		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
362			m.toolGeneration = 1
363		}
364		if rows != nil {
365			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
366		}
367		if repos != nil {
368			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
369		}
370		return m
371	}

437	// Init implements tea.Model.
438	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
439		commands := []tea.Cmd{textinput.Blink}
440		if m.initialLoad {
441			commands = append(commands, m.reload())
442		}
443		if len(m.actions.Tools) > 0 {
444			commands = append(commands, m.probeTools())
445		}
446		if m.actions.LoadRemoteCache != nil {
447			commands = append(commands, m.loadRemoteCache())
448		}
449		if m.actions.LoadFleetCache != nil {
450			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetCache())
451		}
452		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
453			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
454		}
455		return tea.Batch(commands...)
456	}

613	func traceOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
614		switch {
615		case err == nil:
616			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
617		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
618			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
619		default:
620			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
621		}
622	}
623	
624	func snapshotValid[T any](rows []T, err error) bool { return err == nil || rows != nil }
625	
626	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
627		filtered := commands[:0]
628		for _, command := range commands {
629			if command != nil {
630				filtered = append(filtered, command)
631			}
632		}
633		switch len(filtered) {
634		case 0:
635			return nil
636		case 1:
637			return filtered[0]
638		default:
639			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
640		}
641	}
```

```text
910		return func() tea.Msg {

913				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)

916					warning: m.skillsInventoryWarning, inventoryErr: m.skillsInventoryErr, err: m.skillsInventoryErr,
917				}

1045	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
1046	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
1047	// for, not alphabetical order.
1048	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1049		var out []RepoRow
1050		for _, r := range m.repos {
1051			if r.IsTry() || !r.matches(m.filter) {
1052				continue
1053			}
1054			out = append(out, r)
1055		}
1056		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1057		if sortBy == "" {
1058			sortBy = "activity"
1059		}
1060		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1061			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1062			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1063				return cmp > 0
1064			}
1065			return cmp < 0
1066		})
1067		return out
1068	}

1087	type repoItem struct {

1096			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1097		}

1101	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1102	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away

1104	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {

1110				continue
1111			}

1114			}
1115		}
1116		return out
1117	}

1204	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1205	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1206	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1207	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1208	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1209		if row.Task == nil {
1210			return ""
1211		}
1212		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1213			return "dev sweep"
1214		}
1215		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1216			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1217		}
1218		return ""
1219	}
1220	
1221	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1222		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1223		if command == "" {
1224			return nil
1225		}
1226		switch {
1227		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1228			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1229		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1230			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1231		default:
1232			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1233		}
1234	}

1246	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1247		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1248		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1249			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1250			if structured {
1251				switch key {
1252				case "scope":
1253					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1254						return false
1255					}
1256					continue
1257				case "agent":
1258					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1259					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1260						return false
1261					}
1262					continue
1263				case "update":
1264					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1265						return false
1266					}
1267					continue
1268				case "repo":
1269					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1270						return false
1271					}
1272					continue
1273				case "presence":
1274					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1275						return false
1276					}
1277					continue
1278				case "integrity":
1279					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1280						return false
1281					}
1282					continue
1283				}
1284			}
1285			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1286				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1287				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1288				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1289				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1290			}, " "))
1291			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1292				return false
1293			}
1294		}
1295		return true
1296	}

1392		case "name":
1393			return nameCmp
1394		case "latest":
```

```text
1427			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1428				return c
1429			}
1430			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1431				return c
1432			}
1433			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1434				return c
1435			}
1436			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1437				return c
1438			}
1439		}
1440		return nameCmp
1441	}
1442	
1443	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
1444		for _, v := range list {
1445			if v == s {
1446				return true
1447			}
1448		}
1449		return false
1450	}

1452	// count is how many rows the current view has.
1453	func (m Model) count() int {
1454		switch m.view {
1455		case ViewRepos:
1456			return len(m.visibleRepoItems())
1457		case ViewFleet:
1458			return len(m.visibleFleet())
1459		case ViewTries:
1460			return len(m.visibleTries())
1461		case ViewRemote:
1462			return len(m.visibleRemotes())
1463		case ViewSkills:
1464			return len(m.visibleSkills())
1465		case ViewMCP:
1466			return len(m.visibleMCP())
1467		default:
1468			return len(m.visibleTasks())
1469		}
1470	}

1472	// at is the cursor position in the current view.
1473	func (m Model) at() int {
1474		switch m.view {
1475		case ViewRepos:
1476			return m.repoCursor
1477		case ViewFleet:
1478			return m.fleetCursor
1479		case ViewTries:
1480			return m.tryCursor
1481		case ViewRemote:
1482			return m.remoteCursor
1483		case ViewSkills:
1484			return m.skillCursor
1485		case ViewMCP:
1486			return m.mcpCursor
1487		default:
1488			return m.taskCursor
1489		}

1491	
1492	// setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
1493	func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
1494		n := m.count()
1495		switch {
1496		case n == 0:
1497			i = 0
1498		case i >= n:
1499			i = n - 1
1500		case i < 0:
1501			i = 0
1502		}
1503		switch m.view {
1504		case ViewRepos:
1505			m.repoCursor = i
1506		case ViewFleet:
1507			m.fleetCursor = i
1508		case ViewTries:
1509			m.tryCursor = i
1510		case ViewRemote:
1511			m.remoteCursor = i
1512		case ViewSkills:
1513			m.skillCursor = i
1514		case ViewMCP:
1515			m.mcpCursor = i
1516		default:
1517			m.taskCursor = i
1518		}
1519	}

1612	// matchRemoteLocals fills cached remote rows from the freshly loaded local
1613	// inventory without another scan.
1614	func (m *Model) matchRemoteLocals() {
1615		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
1616		byRemote := map[string]RepoRow{}
1617		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1618		for _, r := range m.repos {
1619			if r.RemoteName == "" {
1620				continue
1621			}
1622			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1623			if ambiguous[key] {
1624				continue
1625			}
1626			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1627				delete(byRemote, key)
1628				ambiguous[key] = true
1629				continue
1630			}
1631			byRemote[key] = r
1632		}
1633		triesByIdentity := map[string]TryRow{}
1634		ambiguousTry := map[string]bool{}
1635		for _, row := range m.tries {
1636			identity := row.Item.RemoteIdentity
1637			if !row.Present() || identity == "" || ambiguousTry[identity] {
1638				continue
1639			}
1640			if _, exists := triesByIdentity[identity]; exists {
1641				delete(triesByIdentity, identity)
1642				ambiguousTry[identity] = true
1643				continue
1644			}
1645			triesByIdentity[identity] = row
1646		}
1647		for i := range m.remotes {
1648			key := string(m.remotes[i].Repo.Forge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName)
1649			identity := ""
1650			for _, raw := range []string{m.remotes[i].Repo.CloneURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.SSHURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.URL} {
1651				if identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
1652					break
1653				}
1654			}
1655			repository, repoOK := byRemote[key]
1656			try, tryOK := triesByIdentity[identity]
1657			sameCheckout := repoOK && tryOK && remotePathsOverlap(repository, try)
1658			if ambiguous[key] || ambiguousTry[identity] || (repoOK && tryOK && !sameCheckout) {
1659				m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1660				continue
1661			}
1662			if repoOK {
1663				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = repository.Repo.Path
1664				m.remotes[i].LocalName = repository.Repo.Display()
1665				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1666				if repository.Asset != nil {
1667					m.remotes[i].LocalKind = repository.Asset.Kind
1668				}
1669				continue
1670			}
1671			if tryOK {
1672				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = try.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1673				m.remotes[i].LocalName = try.Item.DisplayName()
1674				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindTry
1675				continue
1676			}
1677			m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1678		}
1679	}
1680	
1681	func remotePathsOverlap(repository RepoRow, try TryRow) bool {
1682		for _, left := range []string{repository.Repo.Path, repository.Repo.RealPath} {
1683			for _, right := range []string{try.Item.Live.CurrentPath, try.Item.Live.RealPath} {
1684				if left != "" && right != "" && filepath.Clean(left) == filepath.Clean(right) {
1685					return true
1686				}
1687			}
1688		}
1689		return false
1690	}
1691	
1692	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
1693	// tools and for the cd directive.
1694	func (m Model) currentDir() string {
1695		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1696			if r.CheckoutExists {
1697				return r.Checkout
1698			}
1699			return ""
1700		}
1701		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
1702			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
1703				if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
1704					return checkout.Worktree.Path
1705				}
1706				return ""
1707			}
1708			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
1709		}
1710		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Present() {
1711			return r.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1712		}
1713		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
1714			return r.LocalPath
1715		}
1716		return ""
1717	}
1718	
1719	// Update implements tea.Model.
1720	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
1721		switch msg := msg.(type) {
1722		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
1723			m.width, m.height = msg.Width, msg.Height
1724			return m, nil
1725	
1726		case localMsg:
1727			if msg.done {
1728				request := msg.load.Request
1729				current := m.localGeneration == request.CycleGeneration
1730				if !current {
1731					return m, nil
1732				}
1733				m.finishLocalLoad()
1734				m.forceSizeReload = false
1735				return m.beginSizeLoad(request.ForceSizes)
1736			}
1737			var accepted bool
1738			m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(msg.result)
1739			next := waitForLocal(msg.load)
1740			if accepted && msg.result.View == ViewRepos {
1741				if fleet := m.afterReposResult(msg.result.Valid, msg.result.Err); fleet != nil {
1742					return m, tea.Batch(next, fleet)
1743				}
1744			}
1745			return m, next
1746	
1747		case reloadMsg:
1748			acceptedLocal := false
1749			reposAccepted := false
1750			if msg.rowsSet && m.applyViewResult(
1751				ViewTasks, msg.rowsGeneration, msg.rowsValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1752				resultFreshness(msg.rowsErr), len(msg.rows), msg.rowsErr, msg.rowsValid,
1753			) {
1754				if msg.rowsValid {
1755					m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), msg.rows...)
1756				}
1757				acceptedLocal = true
1758			}
1759			if msg.reposSet && m.applyViewResult(
1760				ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1761				resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
1762			) {
1763				if msg.reposValid {
1764					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
1765					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1766				}
1767				acceptedLocal = true
1768				reposAccepted = true
1769			}
1770			if msg.triesSet && m.applyViewResult(
1771				ViewTries, msg.triesGeneration, msg.triesValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1772				resultFreshness(msg.triesErr), len(msg.tries), msg.triesErr, msg.triesValid,
1773			) {
1774				if msg.triesValid {
1775					m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), msg.tries...)
1776					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1777				}
1778				acceptedLocal = true
1779			}
1780			if msg.remoteSet && m.applyViewResult(
1781				ViewRemote, msg.remoteGeneration, msg.remoteValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1782				resultFreshness(msg.remoteErr), len(msg.remotes), msg.remoteErr, msg.remoteValid,
1783			) && msg.remoteValid {
1784				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.remotes...)
1785			}
1786			if acceptedLocal {
1787				m.forceSizeReload = false
1788			}
1789			m.setAt(m.at())
1790			m, sizeCmd := m.beginSizeLoad(msg.forceSizes)
1791			if reposAccepted {
1792				if fleetCmd := m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr); fleetCmd != nil {
1793					return m, tea.Batch(sizeCmd, fleetCmd)
1794				}
1795			}
1796			return m, sizeCmd
1797	
1798		case sizeMsg:
1799			if msg.loadID == 0 || msg.loadID != m.sizeLoad.ID {
1800				return m, nil
1801			}
1802			if msg.done {
1803				m.sizeLoad = diskusage.Load{}
1804				return m, nil
1805			}
1806			m.applySizeResult(msg.result)
1807			return m, waitForSize(m.sizeLoad)
1808	
1809		case remoteCacheMsg:
1810			if !msg.result.Found {
1811				return m, nil
1812			}
1813			freshness := perftrace.FreshnessFresh
1814			if msg.result.Stale {
1815				freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
1816			}
1817			if m.applyCacheSeed(ViewRemote, msg.generation, len(msg.result.Rows), freshness) {
1818				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.result.Rows...)
1819				m.matchRemoteLocals()
1820			}
1821			return m, nil
1822	
1823		case fleetCacheMsg:
1824			if !msg.result.Found {
1825				return m, nil
1826			}
1827			if m.applyCacheSeed(ViewFleet, msg.generation, len(msg.result.Rows), perftrace.FreshnessStale) {
1828				m.fleet = append([]FleetRow(nil), msg.result.Rows...)
1829			}
1830			return m, nil
1831	
1832		case remoteMsg:
1833			if !m.applyViewResult(
1834				ViewRemote, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1835				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1836			) {
1837				return m, nil
1838			}
1839			if msg.valid {
1840				m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), msg.rows...)
1841				if msg.matchLocals {
1842					m.matchRemoteLocals()
1843				}
1844			}
1845			m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "")
1846			m.setAt(m.at())
1847			return m, nil
1848	
1849		case fleetMsg:
1850			if !m.applyViewResult(
1851				ViewFleet, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1852				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1853			) {
1854				return m, nil
1855			}
1856			if msg.valid {
1857				m.fleet = append([]FleetRow(nil), msg.rows...)
1858			}
1859			m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "")
1860			m.setAt(m.at())
1861			return m, nil
1862	
1863		case skillsMsg:
1864			if !m.applyViewResult(
1865				ViewSkills, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1866				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1867			) {
1868				return m, nil
1869			}
1870			m.skillsChecking = false
1871			m.skillsInventoryErr = msg.inventoryErr
1872			m.skillsInventoryWarning = msg.warning
1873			if msg.valid {
1874				m.skills = append([]agentskill.Skill(nil), msg.rows...)
1875			}
1876			switch {
1877			case msg.err != nil:
1878				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "")
1879			case msg.status != "":
1880				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, msg.status)
1881			case msg.warning != "":
1882				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, msg.warning)
1883			case msg.checked:
1884				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "skill update check complete")
1885			default:
1886				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "")
1887			}
1888			m.setAt(m.at())
1889			return m, nil
1890	
1891		case mcpMsg:
1892			if !m.applyViewResult(
1893				ViewMCP, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
1894				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
1895			) {
1896				return m, nil
1897			}
1898			if msg.valid {
1899				m.mcp = append([]agentmcp.Declaration(nil), msg.rows...)
1900			}
1901			m.setViewStatus(ViewMCP, msg.warning)
1902			m.setAt(m.at())
1903			return m, nil
1904	
1905		case toolsMsg:
1906			if msg.generation != m.toolGeneration {
1907				return m, nil
1908			}
1909			m.actions.Tools = append([]Tool(nil), msg.tools...)
1910			return m, nil
1911	
1912		case skillProcessMsg:
1913			if msg.err != nil {
1914				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1915				return m, nil
1916			}
1917			m.err = nil
1918			m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadAction)
1919			if msg.action == "update" {
1920				m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "reloading and verifying "+msg.name+"…")
1921				return m, m.reloadUpdatedSkill(msg.name, msg.lockName, msg.scope, msg.checkout)
1922			}
1923			m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "reloading agent skills…")
1924			return m, m.reloadSkills()
1925	
1926		case statsBackfilledMsg:
1927			if msg.err != nil {
1928				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1929				return m, nil
1930			}
1931			m.status = "backfill complete; loading heatmap…"
1932			return m, m.loadStats(msg.repo)
1933	
1934		case configEditedMsg:
1935			if msg.err != nil {
1936				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1937				return m, nil
1938			}
1939			m.beginConfigLoad()
1940			m.status = "reloading config…"
1941			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
1942	
1943		case fleetConfigEditedMsg:
1944			if msg.err != nil {
1945				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1946				return m, nil
1947			}
1948			if m.actions.ValidateFleetConfig != nil {
1949				if err := m.actions.ValidateFleetConfig(); err != nil {
1950					// A rejected file is still on disk; showing the parse error is
1951					// the only way the user learns why the fleet did not change.
1952					m.err, m.status = err, "remotes.toml was not applied"
1953					return m, nil
1954				}
1955			}
1956			m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadConfig)
1957			m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "refreshing fleet…")
1958			return m, m.reloadFleet()
1959	
1960		case configMsg:
1961			if msg.generation != m.configGeneration {
1962				return m, nil
1963			}
1964			if m.configCancel != nil {
1965				m.configCancel()
1966				m.configCancel, m.configContext = nil, nil
1967			}
1968			if msg.err != nil {
1969				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
1970				m.forceSizeReload = false
1971				return m, nil
1972			}
1973			if msg.update.Apply != nil {
1974				msg.update.Apply()
1975			}
1976			m.beginLocalLoads(loadConfig)
1977			if msg.refreshRemote {
1978				m.beginViewLoad(ViewRemote, loadConfig)
1979			} else {
1980				m.invalidateView(ViewRemote)
1981			}
1982			m.actions.Tools = append([]Tool(nil), msg.update.Tools...)
1983			m.toolGeneration++
1984			m.actions.RepoColumns = append([]string(nil), msg.update.RepoColumns...)
1985			m.actions.RepoSort = msg.update.RepoSort
1986			m.actions.RepoReverse = msg.update.RepoReverse
1987			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
1988			reload := m.reloadAfterConfig(msg.refreshRemote)
1989			if len(m.actions.Tools) == 0 {
1990				return m, reload
1991			}
1992			return m, tea.Batch(reload, m.probeTools())
1993	
1994		case statsMsg:
1995			if msg.err != nil {
1996				m.err = msg.err
1997				m.stats = nil
1998			} else {
1999				m.err = nil
2000				m.stats = &msg.panel
2001			}
2002			m.status = ""
2003			return m, nil
2004	
2005		case triesMsg:
2006			accepted := false
2007			reposAccepted := false
2008			if msg.triesSet && m.applyViewResult(
2009				ViewTries, msg.triesGeneration, msg.triesValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2010				resultFreshness(msg.triesErr), len(msg.tries), msg.triesErr, msg.triesValid,
2011			) {
2012				if msg.triesValid {
2013					m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), msg.tries...)
2014					m.matchRemoteLocals()
2015				}
2016				accepted = true
2017			}
2018			if msg.reposSet && m.applyViewResult(
2019				ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2020				resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
2021			) {
2022				if msg.reposValid {
2023					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
2024					m.matchRemoteLocals()
2025				}
2026				accepted = true
2027				reposAccepted = true
2028			}
2029			m.setAt(m.at())
2030			var sizeCmd tea.Cmd
2031			if accepted {
2032				m, sizeCmd = m.beginSizeLoad(false)
2033			}
2034			if reposAccepted {
2035				if fleetCmd := m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr); fleetCmd != nil {
2036					return m, tea.Batch(sizeCmd, fleetCmd)
2037				}
2038			}
2039			return m, sizeCmd
2040	
2041		case tryActionMsg:
2042			if msg.err != nil {
2043				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
```

```text
2551	func (m Model) beginNoteLoad(refreshRepos bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
2552		m.noteRequest++
2553		request, targetKey, target := m.noteRequest, m.noteTarget.Key(), m.noteTarget
2554		reposGeneration := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation
2555		if refreshRepos {
2556			reposGeneration = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadAction)
2557		}
2558		query := m.noteQuery
2559		m.noteLoading = true
2560		return m, func() tea.Msg {
2561			if m.actions.Notes.List == nil {
2562				return noteListMsg{request: request, targetKey: targetKey, reposGeneration: reposGeneration}
2563			}
2564			var (
2565				notes []*note.Note
2566				err   error
2567			)
2568			if query != "" && m.actions.Notes.Search != nil {
2569				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.Search(m.baseContext(), target, query)
2570			} else {
2571				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.List(m.baseContext(), target)
2572			}
2573			msg := noteListMsg{
2574				notes: notes, request: request, targetKey: targetKey, err: err,
2575				reposGeneration: reposGeneration,
2576			}
2577			if refreshRepos && m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
2578				msg.repos, msg.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(m.viewContext(ViewRepos))
2579				msg.reposSet, msg.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(msg.repos, msg.reposErr)
2580			}
2581			return msg
2582		}
2583	}
```

```text
239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
245			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
246			return false
247		}
248		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}
259	
260	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
261	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
262		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
263		for _, row := range rows {
264			if f.Match(row) {
265				out = append(out, row)
266			}
267		}
268		return out
269	}

271	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
272	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
273		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
274			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
275			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
276			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
277			for n := range ak {
278				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
279					return ak[n] < bk[n]
280				}
281			}
282			return false
283		})
284	}
```

```text
17	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
18		if ctx.Err() != nil {
19			return readResult{}
20		}
21		resolved, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
22		if err != nil {
23			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
24				return readResult{}
25			}
26			if errors.Is(err, errSymlinkLimit) {
27				return readResult{code: DiagnosticSymlinkLimit}
28			}
29			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
30		}
31		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
32			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, resolved)
33			if err != nil || !inside {
34				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
35			}
36		}
37	
38		file, openedInfo, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
39		if err != nil {
40			switch {
41			case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
42				return readResult{}
43			case errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular):
44				return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
45			default:
46				return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
47			}
48		}
49		defer file.Close()
50		if openedInfo.Size() > s.options.MaxFileBytes {
51			return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
52		}
53		if spec.projectRoot != "" {
54			currentPath, err := resolveBoundedSymlinks(spec.path, s.options.MaxSymlinkDepth)
55			if err != nil {
56				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
57			}
58			inside, err := pathx.Contains(spec.projectRoot, currentPath)
59			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)
60			if err != nil || !inside || statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(openedInfo, currentInfo) {
61				return readResult{code: DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape}
62			}
63		}
64	
65		body, err := safefile.ReadAll(ctx, file, s.options.MaxFileBytes)
66		if err != nil {
67			switch {
68			case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
69				return readResult{}
70			case errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrTooLarge):
71				return readResult{code: DiagnosticTooLarge}
72			default:
73				return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
74			}
75		}
76		return readResult{data: body, present: true}
77	}
78	
79	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
80	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
81	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
82		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
83		if err != nil {
84			return "", err
85		}
86		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
87	}
88	
89	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
90		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
91		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
92		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
93		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
94		current := root
95		for index, component := range components {
96			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
97			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
98			if err != nil {
99				return "", err
100			}
101			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
102				current = candidate
103				continue
104			}
105			if followed >= limit {
106				return "", errSymlinkLimit
107			}
108			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
109			if err != nil {
110				return "", err
111			}
112			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
113				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
114			}
115			if index+1 < len(components) {
116				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
117			}
118			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
119			if err != nil {
120				return "", err
121			}
122			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
123		}
124		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
125	}
126
```

```text
156	func managedPreferenceUsername(home string) string {
157		if current, err := user.Current(); err == nil {
158			username := strings.TrimSpace(current.Username)
159			if username != "" && filepath.Base(username) == username && !stringContainsControl(username) {
160				return username
161			}
162		}
163		username := filepath.Base(home)
164		if username == "" || username == "." || username == string(filepath.Separator) || stringContainsControl(username) {
165			return ""
166		}

196	type readResult struct {

202	// Scanner is a reusable, read-only static declaration scanner.
203	type Scanner struct {
204		options    Options
205		readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult
206	}
207	
208	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
209	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
210		options = normalizeOptions(options)
211		s := &Scanner{options: options}
212		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
213		return s
214	}
215	
216	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
217	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
218		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
219	}
220	
221	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
222	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
223	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
224	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
225		if ctx == nil {
226			ctx = context.Background()
227		}
228		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
229		result := Result{
230			Declarations: make([]Declaration, 0),
231			Diagnostics:  make([]Diagnostic, 0),
232			Coverage:     defaultCoverage(),
233		}
234		type cachedRead struct {
235			ready  chan struct{}
236			result readResult
237		}
238		var readMu sync.Mutex
239		reads := map[string]*cachedRead{}
240		readSource := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
241			key := spec.path + "\x00" + spec.projectRoot
242			readMu.Lock()
243			entry := reads[key]
244			if entry == nil {
245				entry = &cachedRead{ready: make(chan struct{})}
246				reads[key] = entry
247				readMu.Unlock()
248				entry.result = s.readSource(ctx, spec)
249				close(entry.ready)
250				return entry.result
251			}
252			readMu.Unlock()
253			select {
254			case <-ctx.Done():
255				return readResult{}
256			case <-entry.ready:
257				return entry.result
258			}
259		}
260	
261		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
262			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
263				finalizeResult(&result)
264				return result, err
265			}
266			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets, readSource)
267			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
268			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
269		}
270		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
271			finalizeResult(&result)
272			return result, err
273		}
274	
275		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
276		jobs := make(chan int)
277		workers := s.options.Concurrency
278		if workers > len(targets) {
279			workers = len(targets)
280		}
281		var wg sync.WaitGroup
282		for range workers {
283			wg.Add(1)
284			go func() {
285				defer wg.Done()
286				for {
287					select {
288					case <-ctx.Done():
289						return
290					case index, ok := <-jobs:
291						if !ok {
292							return
293						}
294						for _, spec := range s.projectSources(targets[index]) {
295							if ctx.Err() != nil {
296								return
297							}
298							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil, readSource)
299							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
300							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
301						}
302					}
303				}
304			}()
305		}
306		for index := range targets {
307			select {
308			case jobs <- index:
309			case <-ctx.Done():
310				close(jobs)
311				wg.Wait()
312				for _, partial := range projectResults {
313					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
314					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
315				}
316				finalizeResult(&result)
317				return result, ctx.Err()
318			}
319		}
320		close(jobs)
321		wg.Wait()
322		for _, partial := range projectResults {
323			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
324			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
325		}
326		finalizeResult(&result)
327		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
328			return result, err
329		}
330		return result, nil
331	}

333	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {
334		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
335			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
336		}
337		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
338			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
339		}
340		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
341			options.CodexHome = ""
342		}
343		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
344			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
345		}
346		for _, path := range []*string{&options.ClaudeUserConfigPath, &options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, &options.ClaudeManagedConfigPath} {
347			if *path != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(*path) {
348				*path = ""
349			}
350		}
351		managedSettings := options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths[:0]
352		for _, path := range options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {
353			if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
354				managedSettings = append(managedSettings, filepath.Clean(path))
355			}
356		}
357		options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths = managedSettings
358		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
359			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
360		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
361			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
362		}
363		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
364			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
365		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
366			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
367		}
368		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
369			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
370		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
371			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
372		}
373		return options
374	}

376	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
377		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
378		for _, target := range targets {
379			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
380				continue
381			}
382			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
383			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
384				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
385			}
386			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
387			if err != nil {
388				continue
389			}
390			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
391			if target.RepoPath == "" {
392				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
393			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
394				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
395			}
396			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
397			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
398				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
399			}
400			if target.CommonDir == "" {
401				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
402			}
403			out = append(out, target)
404		}
405		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
406	}

441		}

452		add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentGeminiCLI, scope: ScopeSystemOverride, source: SourceManaged, path: s.options.GeminiSystemSettingsPath, adapter: adapterGemini})
453		for _, path := range s.options.OpenCodeManagedConfigPaths {

463	func (s *Scanner) projectSources(target Target) []sourceSpec {
464		base := sourceSpec{
465			scope: ScopeProject, source: SourceDirect, repository: target.RepoDisplay,
466			repositoryPath: target.RepoPath, checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, projectRoot: target.CheckoutRoot,
467		}
468		makeSpec := func(agent Agent, relative string, adapter adapterKind) sourceSpec {
469			spec := base
470			spec.agent = agent
471			spec.path = filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
472			spec.adapter = adapter
473			return spec
474		}
475		approvalSpec := func(path string, scope Scope, source DeclarationSource, confined bool) sourceSpec {
476			spec := base
477			spec.agent = AgentClaudeCode
478			spec.scope = scope
479			spec.source = source
480			spec.path = path
481			if !confined {
482				spec.projectRoot = ""
483			}
484			return spec
485		}
486		claude := makeSpec(AgentClaudeCode, ".mcp.json", adapterClaudeProject)
487		addApproval := func(path string, scope Scope, source DeclarationSource, confined bool) {
488			if strings.TrimSpace(path) != "" {
489				claude.approvalSources = append(claude.approvalSources, approvalSpec(path, scope, source, confined))
490			}
491		}
492		addApproval(s.options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, ScopeUser, SourceDirect, false)
493		addApproval(filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.json"), ScopeProject, SourceDirect, true)
494		addApproval(filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.local.json"), ScopeLocal, SourceDirect, true)
495		for _, path := range s.options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {
496			addApproval(path, ScopeManaged, SourceManaged, false)
497		}
498		return []sourceSpec{
499			claude,
500			makeSpec(AgentCodex, ".codex/config.toml", adapterCodex),
501			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
502			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
503			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
504			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
505			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
506			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
507		}
508	}

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}
571	
572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}
580	
581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}
```

```text
113		}
114		rows, codes := convertClaudeServers(document.MCPServers, spec, nil)
115		if len(document.Projects) == 0 || len(targets) == 0 {
116			return rows, codes, nil
117		}
118		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
119	
120		projectKeys := make([]string, 0, len(document.Projects))
121		for projectPath := range document.Projects {
122			projectKeys = append(projectKeys, projectPath)
123		}
124		sort.Strings(projectKeys)
125		for _, projectPath := range projectKeys {
126			target, ok := matchClaudeTarget(projectPath, targets)
127			if !ok {
128				continue
129			}
130			localSpec := spec
131			localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
132			localSpec.repository = target.RepoDisplay
133			localSpec.repositoryPath = target.RepoPath
134			localSpec.checkout = target.CheckoutRoot
135			localSpec.localProjectPath = filepath.Clean(projectPath)
136			localSpec.projectRoot = ""
137			var project claudeProject
138			if code := decodeJSON(document.Projects[projectPath], &project); code != "" {
139				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
140				continue
141			}
142			state := &claudeProjectState{
143				enabled:  normalizeNameSet(project.EnabledMCPServers),
144				disabled: normalizeNameSet(project.DisabledMCPServers),
145			}
146			localRows, localCodes := convertClaudeServers(project.MCPServers, localSpec, state)
147			rows = append(rows, localRows...)
148			for _, code := range localCodes {
149				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
150			}
151		}
152		return rows, codes, diagnostics
153	}

155	type claudeProjectState struct {

160	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
161		var rows []Declaration
162		var codes []DiagnosticCode
163		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {
164			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
165			if !ok {
166				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
167				continue
168			}
169			var server claudeServer
170			if code := decodeJSON(raw[rawName], &server); code != "" {
171				codes = append(codes, code)
172				continue
173			}
174			convertClaudeServer(&row, server)
175			if state != nil {
176				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
177				switch {
178				case enabled && disabled:
179					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
180					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
181					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
182				case enabled:
183					value := true
184					row.Enabled = &value
185					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
186				case disabled:
187					value := false
188					row.Enabled = &value
189					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
190				}
191			}
192			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
193			rows = append(rows, row)
194		}
195		return rows, codes
196	}

198	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
199		setCommand(row, server.Command)
200		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
201		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
202		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
203		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
204		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
205		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
206			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
207		}
208		if server.OAuth != nil {
209			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
210			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
211			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
212			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
213		}
214	
215		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
216		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
217		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
218		if hasCommand && hasURL {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
220		}
221		switch typeName {
222		case "stdio":
223			if hasCommand {
224				row.Transport = TransportStdio
225			}
226		case "http":
227			if hasURL {
228				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
229			}
230		case "streamable-http":
231			if hasURL {
232				row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
233			}
234		case "sse":
235			if hasURL {
236				row.Transport = TransportSSE
237			}
238		case "ws", "websocket":
239			if hasURL {
240				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
241			}
242		case "":
243			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
244				row.Transport = TransportStdio
245			}
246		}
247		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
248			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
249		}
250	}

252	func normalizeNameSet(names []string) map[string]bool {
253		set := map[string]bool{}
254		for _, name := range names {
255			if normalized, ok := normalizedName(name); ok {
256				set[normalized] = true
257			}
258		}
259		return set

263		names := make([]string, 0, len(values))
264		for name := range values {
265			names = append(names, name)
266		}
267		sort.Strings(names)

270	
271	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
272		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
273			return Target{}, false
274		}
275		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
276		if err != nil {
277			return Target{}, false
278		}
279		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
280		candidateCanonical := candidate
281		if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate); err == nil {
282			candidateCanonical = resolved
283		}
284	
285		for _, target := range targets {
286			checkout := filepath.Clean(target.CheckoutRoot)
287			checkoutCanonical := checkout
288			if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout); err == nil {
289				checkoutCanonical = resolved
290			}
291			if candidate == checkout || candidateCanonical == checkoutCanonical {
292				return target, true
293			}
294		}
295	
296		bestIndex, bestDepth := -1, -1
297		for index, target := range targets {
298			inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate)
299			if err != nil || !inside {
300				continue
301			}
302			checkout := filepath.Clean(target.CheckoutRoot)
303			if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout); err == nil {
304				checkout = resolved
305			}
306			if depth := len(checkout); depth > bestDepth {
307				bestIndex, bestDepth = index, depth
308			}
309		}
310		if bestIndex >= 0 {
311			return targets[bestIndex], true
312		}
313		return Target{}, false
314	}
315	
316	func copyBool(value *bool) *bool {
317		if value == nil {
318			return nil
319		}
320		copy := *value
321		return &copy
322	}
```

```text
81	func convertCodexServer(row *Declaration, server map[string]any) {

102		}

146	func applyCodexPolicy(row *Declaration, values map[string]any) {
147		if enabled, ok := boolField(values, "enabled"); ok {

151			}
152		}

154			addPolicy(row, PolicyEnabledTools, "", len(tools))
```

```text
1	package agentmcp
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"strings"
6	)
7	
8	type cursorDocument struct {
9		MCPServers map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"mcpServers"`
10	}
11	
12	type cursorServer struct {
13		Type    string            `json:"type"`
14		Command string            `json:"command"`
15		Args    []string          `json:"args"`
16		Env     map[string]string `json:"env"`
17		EnvFile string            `json:"envFile"`
18		URL     string            `json:"url"`
19		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
20		Auth    *cursorAuth       `json:"auth"`
21	}
22	
23	type cursorAuth struct {
24		ClientID     string   `json:"CLIENT_ID"`
25		ClientSecret string   `json:"CLIENT_SECRET"`
26		Scopes       []string `json:"scopes"`
27	}
28	
29	func parseCursor(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
30		var document cursorDocument
31		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
32			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
33		}
34		var rows []Declaration
35		var codes []DiagnosticCode
36		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCPServers) {
37			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
38			if !ok {
39				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
40				continue
41			}
42			var server cursorServer
43			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCPServers[rawName], &server); code != "" {
44				codes = append(codes, code)
45				continue
46			}
47			setCommand(&row, server.Command)
48			inspectArguments(&row, server.Args)
49			inspectEnvironment(&row, server.Env)
50			if strings.TrimSpace(server.EnvFile) != "" {
51				addCredential(&row, CredentialReference{Kind: CredentialFile})
52				addRedaction(&row, RedactionFileReference)
53			}
54			setEndpoint(&row, server.URL)
55			inspectHeaders(&row, server.Headers)
56			if server.Auth != nil {
57				addPolicy(&row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
58				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-id", server.Auth.ClientID)
59				inspectOAuthValue(&row, "client-secret", server.Auth.ClientSecret)
60				for _, scope := range server.Auth.Scopes {
61					inspectOAuthValue(&row, "scope", scope)
62				}
63			}
64	
65			hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
66			hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
67			if hasCommand && hasURL {
68				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
69			} else if hasURL {
70				// Cursor's static URL form does not identify SSE versus streamable HTTP.
71				row.Transport = TransportRemote
72			} else if hasCommand {
73				row.Transport = TransportStdio
74			}
75			if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
76				addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
77			}
78			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
79			rows = append(rows, row)
80		}
81		return rows, codes
82	}
83
```

 `./internal/agentmcp/opencode.go`

```text
1	package agentmcp
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"strings"
6	
7		"github.com/tailscale/hujson"
8		"howett.net/plist"
9	)
10	
11	type openCodeDocument struct {
12		MCP map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"mcp"`
13	}
14	
15	type openCodeServer struct {
16		Type        string            `json:"type"`
17		Command     []string          `json:"command"`
18		Environment map[string]string `json:"environment"`
19		URL         string            `json:"url"`
20		Headers     map[string]string `json:"headers"`
21		Enabled     *bool             `json:"enabled"`
22		OAuth       json.RawMessage   `json:"oauth"`
23	}
24	
25	type openCodeOAuth struct {
26		ClientID     string `json:"clientId"`
27		ClientSecret string `json:"clientSecret"`
28		Scope        string `json:"scope"`
29	}
30	
31	func parseOpenCode(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
32		standard, err := hujson.Standardize(data)
33		if err != nil {
34			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
35		}
36		var document openCodeDocument
37		if code := decodeJSON(standard, &document); code != "" {
38			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}
39		}
40		var rows []Declaration
41		var codes []DiagnosticCode
42		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(document.MCP) {
43			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)
44			if !ok {
45				codes = append(codes, DiagnosticInvalidName)
46				continue
47			}
48			var server openCodeServer
49			if code := decodeJSON(document.MCP[rawName], &server); code != "" {
50				codes = append(codes, code)
51				continue
52			}
53			convertOpenCodeServer(&row, server)
54			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
55			rows = append(rows, row)
56		}
57		return rows, codes
58	}
59	
60	func parseOpenCodePlist(data []byte, spec sourceSpec) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
61		var document map[string]any
62		if _, err := plist.Unmarshal(data, &document); err != nil {
63			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
64		}
65		if containsControl(document) {
66			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticControlCharacter}
67		}
68		for _, key := range []string{"PayloadDisplayName", "PayloadIdentifier", "PayloadType", "PayloadUUID", "PayloadVersion", "_manualProfile"} {
69			delete(document, key)
70		}
71		normalized, err := json.Marshal(document)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
74		}
75		return parseOpenCode(normalized, spec)
76	}
77	
78	func convertOpenCodeServer(row *Declaration, server openCodeServer) {
79		row.Enabled = copyBool(server.Enabled)
80		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Environment)
81		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
82	
83		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
84		hasCommand := len(server.Command) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(server.Command[0]) != ""
85		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
86		switch typeName {
87		case "local":
88			row.Transport = TransportLocal
89			if hasCommand {
90				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
91				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
92			} else {
93				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
94			}
95			if hasURL {
96				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
97				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
98			}
99		case "remote":
100			row.Transport = TransportRemote
101			if hasURL {
102				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
103			} else {
104				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
105			}
106			if hasCommand {
107				addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
108				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
109				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
110			}
111		default:
112			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
113			if hasCommand {
114				setCommand(row, server.Command[0])
115				inspectArguments(row, server.Command[1:])
116			}
117			if hasURL {
118				setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
119			}
120		}
121		convertOpenCodeOAuth(row, server.OAuth)
122	}
123	
124	func convertOpenCodeOAuth(row *Declaration, raw json.RawMessage) {
125		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
126		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
127			return
128		}
129		if trimmed == "false" {
130			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, false)
131			return
132		}
133		var oauth openCodeOAuth
134		if code := decodeJSON(raw, &oauth); code != "" {
135			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
136			return
137		}
138		addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
139		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", oauth.ClientID)
140		inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-secret", oauth.ClientSecret)
141		inspectOAuthValue(row, "scope", oauth.Scope)
142	}
143
```

```text
2920	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
2921		fresh := valid && err == nil
2922		var commands []tea.Cmd
2923		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
2924			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
2925				continue
2926			}
2927			state := m.viewLoad(view)
2928			if state.loading || m.view == view {
2929				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
2930				if fresh {
2931					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
2932					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
2933					continue
2934				}
2935				dependencyErr := err
2936				if dependencyErr == nil {
2937					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
2938				}
2939				current := m.viewLoad(view)
2940				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
2941				continue
2942			}
2943			if state.hasSnapshot {
2944				m.invalidateView(view)
2945			}
2946		}
2947		return batchCommands(commands...)
2948	}

3215	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
3216	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
3217	// the dashboard is displaying.
3218	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
3219		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
3220			if t.Key != key {
3221				continue
3222			}
3223			if t.Probe != nil && t.Availability != ToolAvailable {
3224				detail := "availability is still being checked"
3225				if t.Availability == ToolUnavailable {
3226					detail = "is not installed"
3227				}
3228				return func() tea.Msg {
3229					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s %s", t.Command[0], detail)}
3230				}
3231			}
3232			dir := m.currentDir()
3233			if dir == "" {
3234				return func() tea.Msg {
3235					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
3236				}
3237			}
3238			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
3239			c.Dir = dir
3240			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3241				if err != nil {
3242					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
3243				}
3244				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name, forceSizes: true}
3245			})
3246		}
3247		return nil
3248	}

3291		}

3293			project, global := 0, 0

3295				if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeProject {
3296					project++
3297				} else if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeGlobal {
3298					global++
3299				}

3305		}
3306		if len(parts) == 0 {
3307			return "no tasks"
```

```text
24		// terminal width.

134	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
135		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
136		if d < time.Hour {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
138		}
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
140	}

142	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
143	// is another one — is never in doubt.
144	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
145		build := func(compact, summary bool) string {
146			short := map[View]string{
147				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
148				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
149			}
150			var tabs []string
151			for _, view := range Views {
152				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
153				if compact {
154					name = short[view]
155				}
156				label := name
157				if !compact {
158					label = " " + name + " "
159				}
160				if view == m.view {
161					tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
162				} else {
163					tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
164				}
165			}
166			line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│"))
167			if summary {
168				line += "   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
169			}
170			if m.filter != "" {
171				line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
172			}
173			return line
174		}
175		line := build(false, true)
176		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
177			line = build(false, false)
178		}
179		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
180			line = build(true, false)
181		}
182		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
183			line = styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + styleSelected.Render(strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()))
184			if m.filter != "" {
185				available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(line) - 4
186				if available > 1 {
187					line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
188				}
189			}
190		}
191		return line + "\n"
192	}

194	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
195	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
196	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
197		h := m.listHeight()
198		if n <= h {
199			return 0, n
200		}
201		from = m.at() - h/2
202		if from < 0 {
203			from = 0
204		}
205		if from+h > n {
206			from = n - h
207		}
208		return from, from + h
209	}

310	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
311		r := item.Repo
312		checkout, child := item.checkout()
313		if !child {
314			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
315				marker := "▸ "
316				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
317					marker = "▾ "
318				}
319				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
320			}
321			if name == "live" {
322				return parentLiveColumn(r)
323			}
324			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
325		}
326	
327		switch name {
328		case "repo":
329			connector := "├─ "
330			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
331				connector = "└─ "
332			}
333			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
334			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
335				label = checkout.Branch()
336			}
337			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
338				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
339			}
340			return connector + label
341		case "branch":
342			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
343				return branch
344			}
345			return "(detached)"
346		case "git":
347			switch {
348			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
349				return "prunable"
350			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
351				return "locked"
352			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
353				return "?"
354			default:
355				return checkout.Status.Summary()
356			}
357		case "live":
358			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout)
359		case "latest":
360			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
361		case "worktrees":
362			return "—"
363		case "tasks":
364			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
365		case "notes":
366			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
367				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
368			}
369			return "—"
370		case "category":
371			return "—"
372		case "path":
373			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
374		}
375		return ""
376	}

406	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
407		if len(tasks) == 0 {
408			return "—"
409		}
410		counts := map[task.State]int{}
411		for _, t := range tasks {
412			counts[t.State]++
413		}
414		var parts []string
415		for _, state := range task.States {
416			if counts[state] > 0 {
417				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
418			}
419		}
420		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
421	}
```

```text
536	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
537		if at.IsZero() {
538			return "—"
539		}
540		d := time.Since(at)
541		switch {
542		case d < time.Hour:
543			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
544		case d < 24*time.Hour:
545			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
546		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
547			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
548		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
549			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
550		default:
551			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
552		}
553	}

843	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

846			part := string(policy.Kind)

848				part += ":" + policy.Value
849			}
850			if policy.Count > 0 {
851				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
852			}
853			parts = append(parts, part)
854		}
855		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")

857	
858	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
859		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
860		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
861			part := string(credential.Kind)
862			if credential.Name != "" {
863				part += ":" + credential.Name
864			}
865			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
866			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
867				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
868				if len(parts) == 0 {
869					if remaining == 1 {
870						return pad(part, maxWidth)
871					}
872					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
873				}
874				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
875			}
876			parts = append(parts, part)
877		}
878		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
879	}

929	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
930		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
931			return "—"
932		}
933		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
934		switch {
935		case d < 24*time.Hour:
936			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
937		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
938			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
939		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
940			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
941		default:
942			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
943		}
944	}
```

```text
973	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
974		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10

977		}
978		avail := m.width - fixed
979		if avail < 40 {
980			avail = 40
981		}
982		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
983		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
984		next = avail - name - branch

987		}
988		return name, branch, next
```

```text
153	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
155			return m, nil
156		}

158			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
159		}
160		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {

162		}
163		for fieldIndex := 0; fieldIndex < m.overlay.fieldCount; fieldIndex++ {
164			m.overlay.fields[fieldIndex].input.Blur()

170	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
171		switch m.overlay.kind {
172		case overlayHelp:
173			switch message.String() {
174			case "esc", "?", "q":
175				m.overlay = overlayState{}
176			}
177			return m, nil
178	
179		case overlayTryMenu:
180			switch message.String() {
181			case "esc", "q":
182				m.overlay = overlayState{}
183				return m, nil
184			case "j", "down":
185				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
186					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
187				}
188				return m, nil
189			case "k", "up":
190				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
191					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
192				}
193				return m, nil
194			case "enter":
195				if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
196					return m, nil
197				}
198				action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
199				row := m.overlay.target
200				switch action {
201				case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
202					return m.openTryForm(action, row)
203				case TryArchive:
204					return m.openTryConfirmation(action, row)
205				case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
206					m.overlay = overlayState{}
207					m.status = string(action) + " in progress…"
208					return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: action, ID: row.Item.ID})
209				}
210			}
211			return m, nil
212	
213		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
214			switch message.String() {
215			case "esc":
216				m.overlay = overlayState{}
217				m.err = nil
218				return m, nil
219			case "tab", "down":
220				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
221			case "shift+tab", "up":
222				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
223			case "enter":
224				return m.submitTryOverlay()
225			}
226			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
227			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
228			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
229			return m, command
230		}
231		return m, nil
232	}

234	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
235		value := func(key string) string {
236			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
237				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
238					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
239				}
240			}
241			return ""
242		}
243		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
244			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
245			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
246			note := value("note")
247			m.overlay = overlayState{}
248			m.err = nil
249			m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil
260			}
261			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
262			if !ok {
263				m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
264				return m, nil
265			}
266			request.NoGit = !gitInit
267		case TryMark:
268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:
275			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
276				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:
280			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil
285		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
286		return m, m.applyTry(request)
287	}
```

```text
1462	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1463	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1464	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1465		if width < 20 {
1466			width = 20
1467		}
1468		var lines []string
1469		cur := ""
1470		for _, it := range items {
1471			candidate := it
1472			if cur != "" {
1473				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1474			}
1475			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1476				lines = append(lines, cur)
1477				cur = it
1478				continue
1479			}
1480			cur = candidate
1481		}
1482		if cur != "" {
1483			lines = append(lines, cur)
1484		}
1485		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1486	}
```

```text
36	func TestProjectRootResolverIsNotPoisonedByCanceledWaiter(t *testing.T) {
37		resolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(nil, t.Context())
38		resolver.getwd = func() (string, error) { return "/repo/nested", nil }
39		started := make(chan struct{})
40		release := make(chan struct{})
41		resolver.resolve = func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (agenttarget.Target, error) {
42			close(started)
43			select {
44			case <-ctx.Done():
45				return agenttarget.Target{CheckoutRoot: "/repo/nested"}, nil
46			case <-release:
47				return agenttarget.Target{CheckoutRoot: "/repo"}, nil
48			}
49		}
50	
51		caller, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
52		first := make(chan error, 1)
53		go func() {
54			_, err := resolver.Resolve(caller)
55			first <- err
56		}()
57		<-started
58		cancel()
59		select {
60		case err := <-first:
61			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
62				t.Fatalf("first waiter error = %v", err)
63			}
64		case <-time.After(time.Second):
65			t.Fatal("canceled waiter did not return")
66		}
67	
68		close(release)
69		root, err := resolver.Resolve(t.Context())
70		if err != nil || root != "/repo" {
71			t.Fatalf("shared resolver root=%q err=%v", root, err)
72		}
73		if current, ok := resolver.Current(); !ok || current != "/repo" {
74			t.Fatalf("Current = %q, %v", current, ok)
75		}
76	}
```

```text
23	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
24	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
25	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
26	type MutationProvider struct {
27		Available bool
28		Command   string
29		Path      string
30		Detail    string
31	}
32	
33	// MutationCommand keeps provider execution behind one host-wide lock. Callers
34	// may either Run directly or Prepare the underlying process for Bubble Tea.
35	type MutationCommand struct {
36		Command *exec.Cmd
37		ctx     context.Context
38	}
39	
40	// Prepare acquires the provider mutation lock and returns an idempotent
41	// completion callback that joins process and release errors.
42	func (m *MutationCommand) Prepare() (*exec.Cmd, func(error) error, error) {
43		if m == nil || m.Command == nil {
44			return nil, nil, errors.New("skill mutation command is empty")
45		}
46		ctx := m.ctx
47		if ctx == nil {
48			ctx = context.Background()
49		}
50		cache, err := os.UserCacheDir()
51		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(cache) {
52			return nil, nil, errors.New("could not resolve the user cache for skill mutation locking")
53		}
54		lease, err := lockx.AcquireDir(ctx, filepath.Join(cache, "dev-cli", "skill-mutation"), "agent skill mutation")
55		if err != nil {
56			return nil, nil, err
57		}
58		var once sync.Once
59		var result error
60		finish := func(processErr error) error {
61			once.Do(func() { result = errors.Join(processErr, lease.Close()) })
62			return result
63		}
64		return m.Command, finish, nil
65	}
66	
67	// Run executes the provider while holding the host-wide mutation lock.
68	func (m *MutationCommand) Run() error {
69		command, finish, err := m.Prepare()
70		if err != nil {
71			return err
72		}
73		return finish(command.Run())
74	}
```

```text
239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
245			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
246			return false
247		}
248		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}

260	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
```

```text
510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}
571	
572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}
580	
581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}
```

```text
160	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
161		var rows []Declaration
162		var codes []DiagnosticCode
163		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {
```
